AI.motivation: 磁流体（含磁性纳米颗粒的液体）可在外磁场下变形，适合作为可进入受限空间、可操控物体的软体机器人本体；但其非线性连续介质动力学使可靠控制困难。已有工作利用电磁铁阵列的空间磁场建立并维持平衡态构型，而互补目标是：在有限驱动条件下利用流体自身动力学，达到那些在平衡态下无法维持的瞬态形状。
AI.method: 采用深度基于模型的强化学习（deep model-based RL）控制瞬态形状；策略直接通过物理交互学习，以视觉观测为输入，输出单个固定电磁铁的电流指令，从而引导运动中的磁流体趋向预设几何形状。
AI.result: 学习得到的策略可重复实现多种形状，涵盖多边形（polygons）、星形（asterisks）和五格骨牌（pentominoes）等。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，直接从物理交互中学习能够实现可靠的流体形状控制，为磁流体软体机器人的控制开辟了新途径。

title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a proof or vote across samples, but a forecaster must be causal; it cannot use future information to score a candidate. We propose Backtest-Gated Augmentation Averaging (BGAA), a TTC algorithm for time series forecasting that builds a causal verifier from the series's own history, using rolling-origin backtests to score structured views of the context, discard those that underperform the untransformed context, and average the survivors' predictive distributions. BGAA improves every tested TSFM-benchmark combination, reducing MASE by 0.5-1.0% on GIFT-Eval, 1.3-5.0% on fev-bench, and 1.7-5.9% on BOOM, where a 313M model with TTC outperforms the 1B and 2.5B models in its family. We further show that useful views have structured, model-dependent effects consistent with a prior-transport interpretation. On the 53 cross-fittable GIFT-Eval configs, the deployed policy gains only 0.4-1.3% CRPS, versus 1.4-4.1% when choosing the best view for each dataset configuration and 17-19% when choosing the best view separately for each test window. This gap suggests that a major remaining challenge is window-level view selection.

AI.tldr: 提出BGAA：用滚动原点回测构建因果验证器，对上下文的结构化视图打分筛选并平均其预测分布，实现时间序列预测的测试时计算（TTC）。
AI.motivation: TTC在语言模型中通过生成、验证、选择候选输出提升性能，但该范式难以直接迁移到时间序列预测：预测器必须保持因果性，不能利用未来信息给候选打分，因此缺少可行的验证信号。
AI.method: 从序列自身历史构造因果验证器：采用滚动原点回测（rolling-origin backtest）对上下文的结构化视图（structured views）评分，剔除劣于未变换上下文的视图，对幸存视图的预测分布进行平均（augmentation averaging）。
AI.result: 在所有测试的TSFM基准组合上均有提升：GIFT-Eval上MASE降低0.5–1.0%，fev-bench降低1.3–5.0%，BOOM降低1.7–5.9%；313M模型加TTC后超过同族1B与2.5B模型。视图效果具有结构化、模型依赖的特征，符合先验迁移（prior-transport）解释。53个可交叉拟合的GIFT-Eval配置上，实际策略仅提升0.4–1.3% CRPS，而按数据集配置选最优视图为1.4–4.1%，按每个测试窗口单独选最优视图可达17–19%。
AI.conclusion: BGAA证明因果TTC可有效用于时间序列预测并带来稳定增益，但部署策略与窗口级最优之间存在显著差距，表明窗口级视图选择是后续主要挑战。

title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
summary: Simulated manipulation benchmarks measure policy performance using hand-written success checkers that label each episode as a success or failure. Passing an expert demonstration shows that a checker accepts one way of completing the task. Learned policies, however, may stop after partial progress or complete the task in a different way. A checker may then accept an incomplete execution (phantom success) or reject an execution that satisfies the instruction (silent failure). In this paper, we introduce SimAudit, an LLM-based pipeline that audits success checkers against task instructions. SimAudit analyzes the instruction and checker code to identify scenarios where the two may disagree, recreates those scenarios in simulation, and runs the original checker. Multi-view renderings are then used to verify whether the observed behavior satisfies the instruction. Across RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, and RoboDojo, 183 simulated test cases produced the predicted checker verdict. Visual verification and deduplication yielded 61 distinct defects across 49 tasks, including 40 phantom successes and 21 silent failures. Most defects in RoboCasa365 accepted incomplete executions, most in RoboDojo rejected valid executions, and both error types were common in RoboTwin 2.0. These findings suggest that validating success checkers requires testing both incomplete executions and valid alternatives to expert demonstrations, and motivate more rigorous evaluation protocols for future benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SimAudit，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，用任务指令审计仿真操作基准中手写的成功判别器，发现并量化了"幻影成功"与"静默失败"两类缺陷。
AI.motivation: 仿真操作基准普遍依赖手写成功判别器给回合打成功/失败标签，但专家示范只能证明判别器接受某一种完成方式。学到的策略可能中途停止或以不同方式完成任务，导致判别器接受不完整执行（幻影成功）或拒绝符合指令的执行（静默失败），使基准评测结果不可靠。
AI.method: SimAudit 分三步：①LLM 同时分析任务指令与判别器代码，推断二者可能产生分歧的场景；②在仿真中重现这些场景并运行原始判别器；③利用多视角渲染做视觉核验，判断实际行为是否满足指令，随后去重统计缺陷。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365 和 RoboDojo 上共 183 个仿真测试用例均产生预测的判别器判定；经视觉核验与去重后，在 49 个任务中发现 61 个独立缺陷，含 40 个幻影成功和 21 个静默失败。RoboCasa365 的缺陷多为接受不完整执行，RoboDojo 多为拒绝合法执行，RoboTwin 2.0 两类错误均常见。
AI.conclusion: 验证成功判别器必须同时测试不完整执行和专家示范之外的合法替代方案；当前主流基准的成功判别器存在系统性缺陷，亟需更严格的评测协议。

title: Bayesian $κ$-Explorer for Minimax Model Estimation in MDPs
summary: We study active exploration for minimax transition estimation in unknown Markov decision processes (MDPs). Frequentist $κ$-Explorer~\citep{gu2026kappa} addresses this problem through a parameterized family of exploration objectives, but requires confidence-bound constructions and joint optimization over plausible transition kernels and occupancy measures, introducing a computational burden that limits its practical applicability. We develop Bayesian $κ$-Explorer, which simplifies this procedure by placing Dirichlet priors on the transition distributions. Under the posterior mean estimator, the posterior expected squared $\ell_2$ error equals the total posterior variance, providing a closed-form exploration signal. The algorithm plans under the posterior mean model, eliminating confidence-set optimization. Under the stated assumptions, this simpler planning procedure retains the $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/3})$ surrogate convergence rate of frequentist $κ$-Explorer. We further bound the maximum posterior variance relative to the optimal asymptotic minimax allocation benchmark. Experiments on Pendulum, Mountain Car, and Taxi demonstrate lower worst-case transition-estimation errors than the tested baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bayesian κ-Explorer，通过对转移分布施加 Dirichlet 先验，将 minimax 转移估计的主动探索问题简化为后验均值规划，避免置信界构造与置信集联合优化，同时保持 O~(T^{-1/3}) 的收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 无模型 MDP 中的 minimax 转移核估计需要主动探索。已有的 frequentist κ-Explorer 虽然通过参数化探索目标族解决了该问题，但依赖置信界构造，并需在可行转移核集合与占用度量上做联合优化，计算负担重，限制实用性。作者希望保留其理论最优性，同时显著降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯视角：对转移分布施加 Dirichlet 先验。在引入后验均值估计量后，后验期望平方 ℓ2 误差等于总后验方差，从而得到闭式（closed-form）的探索信号，无需显式置信区间。算法直接在后验均值模型下进行规划，消除置信集优化；理论上给出代理收敛率分析，并将最大后验方差与最优渐近 minimax 分配基准进行界比较。
AI.result: 在所述假设下，简化后的规划过程仍保持 frequentist κ-Explorer 的 O~(T^{-1/3}) 代理收敛率；并给出了最大后验方差相对于最优渐近 minimax 分配基准的界。在 Pendulum、Mountain Car 和 Taxi 上的实验显示，其最坏情况转移估计误差低于所测基线。
AI.conclusion: Dirichlet 后验均值框架可在不牺牲 minimax 意义下探索效果的前提下，用闭式后验方差替代置信界与联合优化，得到计算上更实用、理论上保持同阶收敛率的主动探索算法，并在多个连续/离散控制任务上验证了更低的 worst-case 转移估计误差。

title: Verify2Act: Critic-Guided Latent World Models for Verifying Language-Conditioned Manipulation Plans
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can propose multi-step manipulation plans, but they have no grounded model of how a scene will change, and the pixel-level world models that could check those plans are slow and drift over long horizons. We present Verify2Act, a modular verification framework that separates semantic action proposal from latent physical verification. A VLM proposes candidate plans, a latent world model (V2A-WM) imagines each of them in the DINOv2 feature space, and a dual-head critic checks the imagined rollouts for temporal consistency and goal satisfaction before anything is executed. V2A-WM extends recent flow-matching world models with cross-attention action grounding and a causal temporal history window. We deploy the full system on a low-cost robot arm, training the world model and critic only on data generated in a digital twin. Across six language-conditioned tasks, Verify2Act reaches 83.3\% task success, compared with 61.7\% for a latent world model without our architectural changes, 53.3\% for the VLM alone, and 46.7\% for a pixel-diffusion world model. It verified every plan it executed and incurred no planning-induced failures: all of its failed episodes were caused by low-level grasp or placement slips. In simulation, Verify2Act obtains the highest five-task chain success on CALVIN among the compared baselines with 30$\times$ fewer reflective VLM calls than pixel-diffusion verification, and the highest success on cluttered nut assembly.

AI.tldr: Verify2Act 提出模块化验证框架，将语义动作提议与潜空间物理验证分离：VLM 提议候选计划，潜世界模型在 DINOv2 特征空间想象 rollout，双头评论器检查时序一致性与目标达成后才执行。在低成本机械臂上六项语言条件任务达 83.3% 成功率，验证了所有执行计划且无规划导致的失败。
AI.motivation: VLM 能提出多步操作计划，但缺乏对场景如何变化的具身化模型；像素级世界模型虽可校验计划，却速度慢且在长时程上漂移。因此需要一种既能校验计划、又高效稳定的验证机制。
AI.method: 模块化框架：①VLM 生成候选计划；②潜世界模型 V2A-WM 在 DINOv2 特征空间想象各计划的 rollout，该模型在流匹配世界模型基础上引入交叉注意力动作接地与因果时序历史窗口；③双头评论器检查想象轨迹的时序一致性与目标满足度，通过后才执行。世界模型与评论器仅在数字孪生生成的数据上训练，部署于低成本机械臂。
AI.result: 六项语言条件任务成功率 83.3%，对比：无架构改动的潜世界模型 61.7%、纯 VLM 53.3%、像素扩散世界模型 46.7%。所有执行计划均通过验证，无规划导致的失败，失败均源于底层抓取/放置滑移。仿真中 CALVIN 五任务链成功率最高，反思式 VLM 调用比像素扩散验证少 30 倍；杂乱螺母装配任务成功率最高。
AI.conclusion: 在潜特征空间进行物理验证是一种高效、可靠的计划校验途径：相比像素级世界模型更快、漂移更小，并能显著提升长时程任务成功率；系统仅用数字孪生数据训练即可零样本迁移到真实低成本机械臂，剩余失败归因于底层控制而非规划。

title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
summary: Empirical finance research often reuses natural experiments to study other outcomes, raising concerns about multiple testing and publication bias. We use AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 papers that reuse 13 natural experiments. The agents rebuild the data, reproduce each paper's main estimate and re-estimate it across grids totaling 62,409 estimated defensible specifications. Based on the reproductions and the specification grids, we develop measures of empirical robustness. We reproduce 42% of the main estimates of claims with a signed effect under the papers' own specifications. Across all defensible specifications, on average 25% keep the published sign and have $p < 0.10$. Across experiments, claims based on regression discontinuity are more robust than difference-in-differences claims. Within experiments, claims about first-order effects, claims with larger published $t$-statistics, claims whose authors' data or code we find, claims in top journals, and claims with fewer earlier papers on the same experiment are more robust. Claims on experiments that more papers reuse are not less robust on average. Our findings quantify how much published claims depend on analysis choices, thereby showing that large-scale multiverse analysis becomes feasible with agentic coding.

AI.tldr: 本文用AI智能体对324篇复用13个自然实验的论文做多重宇宙分析，重建数据并复现、重估62,409个可辩护设定，发现复现率42%，全部可辩护设定中平均仅25%保持原符号且p<0.10，并刻画了稳健性的决定因素。
AI.motivation: 实证金融研究常复用同一自然实验研究不同结果，引发多重检验与发表偏倚担忧；但缺乏大规模、系统量化已发表结论对分析选择依赖程度的证据，而人工做多重宇宙分析成本过高。
AI.method: 用AI智能体对324篇复用13个自然实验的论文开展多重宇宙分析：重建数据、按原文设定复现主估计，并在设定网格上重估，共62,409个可辩护设定；基于复现结果与设定网格构造经验稳健性度量，并做实验间与实验内的横截面比较。
AI.result: 在论文自身设定下，有符号效应主张的主估计复现率42%；全部可辩护设定中平均25%保持发表符号且p<0.10。实验间：RD比DID更稳健。实验内：一阶效应、发表t值更大、能找到作者数据或代码、顶刊、同一实验先前论文更少的主张更稳健；被更多论文复用的实验并不更不稳健。
AI.conclusion: 已发表主张对分析选择的依赖程度可被定量刻画；智能体编码使大规模多重宇宙分析变得可行，为实证研究的稳健性评估提供了可扩展范式。

title: Identity World Model: Recognizing People in an Imagined Latent World
summary: Whole-body human recognition has advanced rapidly with large vision models. However, existing methods remain fragile under real-world variations, as they tie identity to transient cues such as clothing, texture, pose, or viewpoint. We argue that a robust recognizer should not merely learn to ignore these cues, but imagine how a person would be represented if they changed. To this end, we propose IDWorld, an identity world model: just as a latent world model predicts the features of a scene after an action, IDWorld predicts how a person would be represented under a changed condition. In a single forward pass, IDWorld imagines these counterfactual features under shared canonical conditions, such as the same outfit, a fixed view, or a bare silhouette, without rendering any pixels. Compared with explicit imagination in pixels, this latent imagination keeps nearly the same accuracy while being over 11x faster, at 5.9 ms per frame. Since each imagined condition has its own strengths, IDWorld then fuses them adaptively, weighting each condition for every probe-gallery pair. Extensive experiments show that IDWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on CCPG and CCGR-MINI, outperforms the compared methods on MEVID, and generalizes best to CASIA-B* and SUSTech1K, with the best mAP on CCVID. These results suggest identity world models offer a simple yet effective path to robust recognition. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: IDWorld 提出"身份世界模型"，在潜空间中单次前向预测人物在反事实条件（同一着装、固定视角、裸轮廓）下的表示，并进行自适应加权融合，实现更强的全身行人识别鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有全身行人识别方法将身份与服装、纹理、姿态、视角等瞬态线索绑定，在真实变化下脆弱；作者认为稳健识别器不应只是"学会忽略"这些线索，而应"想象"人物条件改变后的表示。
AI.method: 借鉴潜空间世界模型（预测动作后场景特征）的思想，IDWorld 预测人物在条件改变后的表示。一次前向传播即在共享规范条件下（相同服装、固定视角、裸轮廓等）想象反事实特征，无需渲染像素；随后对每个 probe-gallery 对自适应地为各条件加权融合。
AI.result: 潜空间想象在精度几乎不变的前提下比像素级显式想象快 11 倍以上（5.9 ms/帧）。CCPG、CCGR-MINI 达 SOTA，MEVID 上优于对比方法，在 CASIA-B*、SUSTech1K 上泛化最佳，CCVID 上取得最佳 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 身份世界模型为稳健全身行人识别提供了一条简单而有效的路径；代码将公开。

title: Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are effective tools for mechanistic interpretability by decomposing neural representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, a single sparse representation in traditional SAEs is responsible for both reconstruction fidelity and interpretability, which are not guaranteed to align. To separate these objectives, we propose DualSAE, a modular framework that augments standard SAEs with a plug-in Residual Branch. A standard SAE serves as the Sparse Branch, learning a sparse code that contains the dominant semantics of the input. The added Residual Branch models the non-semantic information omitted by the Sparse Branch. We ensure that the contributions of the two branches towards the overall reconstruction have minimal overlap through a decorrelation loss. We also adopt a two-stage training strategy that first stabilizes sparse representation learning before coupling with the Residual Branch. Across diverse encoder-SAE configurations on two vision datasets and two language corpora, DualSAE achieves mean relative improvements of approximately 29% in reconstruction fidelity and 34% in interpretability (measured by monosemanticity score). Moreover, with more interpretable representations, DualSAE yields consistent performance gains in the downstream applications of topic modeling, hypothesis generation, and LLM steering. Qualitative analysis further suggests that the Sparse Branch indeed preserves dominant semantic content, whereas the Residual Branch captures non-semantic information to improve reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出DualSAE——在标准稀疏自编码器上外挂可插拔的残差分支，将重建保真与可解释性解耦，两个视觉数据集与两个语言语料上平均分别提升约29%重建保真度与34%可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统SAE用单一稀疏表示同时承担重建保真度与可解释性两个目标，而二者并不必然一致，存在目标耦合与冲突。
AI.method: 模块化框架：标准SAE作为稀疏分支学习输入的主导语义稀疏码，新增残差分支建模被稀疏分支忽略的非语义信息；通过去相关损失最小化两分支对整体重建贡献的重叠；采用两阶段训练，先稳定稀疏表示学习再与残差分支耦合。
AI.result: 在多种编码器-SAE配置、两个视觉数据集与两个语言语料上，重建保真度平均相对提升约29%，可解释性（单义性得分）平均相对提升约34%；在主题建模、假设生成与LLM引导等下游任务上取得一致性能增益；定性分析显示稀疏分支保留主导语义内容、残差分支捕捉非语义信息。
AI.conclusion: 将重建与可解释性解耦的双分支设计有效兼顾两者，且更可解释的表示可迁移至下游应用。

title: A Synthetic Multi-Modal Testbed for Security Stress Testing of Agentic Counter-UAS Systems
summary: Agentic cyber-physical systems rely on perception and state estimation to support autonomous decisions. Degraded, inconsistent, or manipulated sensor observations can therefore propagate through an autonomous pipeline and create security-relevant failures. This work presents a synthetic Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) testbed developed in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for repeatable stress testing of perception and tracking algorithms supporting agentic decision-making. A simplified quadrotor follows scripted trajectories while co-located virtual sensors generate synchronized RGB, RTX LiDAR, and illustrative IR-like observations. The testbed varies target range, motion, clutter, occlusion, and sensor availability, with future stress cases including sensor dropout, temporal misalignment, cross-modal disagreement, and false observations. As an initial exemplar, a nonlinear coordinated-turn Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is evaluated over a 20-s maneuvering trajectory using LiDAR target-centroid measurements. Position error and uncertainty are compared as LiDAR observations degrade and are lost. The framework provides a reproducible environment for studying how sensing degradation affects downstream autonomous estimation and resilience in agentic C-UAS systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中构建了一个合成反无人机（C-UAS）测试平台，通过脚本化四旋翼轨迹与同步的RGB、RTX LiDAR及类红外虚拟传感器，支持对感知与跟踪算法进行可重复的压力测试；并以非线性协同转弯EKF为例，评估LiDAR退化与丢失下的定位误差与不确定性。
AI.motivation: 代理式信息物理系统依赖感知与状态估计做自主决策，退化、不一致或被操纵的传感器观测会沿自主流水线传播并引发安全相关失效，因此需要一个可控、可重复的环境来系统研究传感退化对下游估计与韧性的影响。
AI.method: 基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim搭建合成C-UAS测试平台：简化四旋翼执行脚本化机动轨迹，共置虚拟传感器生成时间同步的RGB、RTX LiDAR与示意性类红外观测；平台可调节目标距离、运动、杂波、遮挡与传感器可用性，并预留传感器丢帧、时间错位、跨模态不一致与虚假观测等压力用例。作为示例，采用非线性协同转弯EKF，基于LiDAR目标质心量测在20秒机动轨迹上评估，对比LiDAR观测逐步退化与丢失时的位置误差和不确定性。
AI.result: 在20秒机动轨迹上给出了随LiDAR观测退化及丢失时的EKF位置误差与不确定性对比结果，显示估计性能随传感质量下降而相应变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究传感退化如何影响代理式C-UAS系统的下游自主估计与韧性提供了可复现的实验环境，并为后续跨模态不一致、虚假观测等压力测试奠定基础。

title: When AI Analysts Disagree: Agentic Multiverse Analysis and the Robustness of Empirical Research
comment: This paper subsumes arXiv:2603.16744. 45 pages, including appendices
summary: Every empirical analysis on observational data rests on dozens of defensible analytical choices ("forks") that its readers cannot see. We develop an agentic multiverse analysis (AMA) framework that makes a conclusion's sensitivity to those choices visible at scale, and we position it as a decision-support instrument for human experts. A pilot study first deploys 150 autonomous AI coding agents on one dataset and one set of research questions and finds that they disagree through the same defensible methodological choices human analysts make, though over a narrower range. AI peer review leaves their dispersion almost unchanged. Exposure to top-rated exemplar reports then collapses it, largely through imitation rather than analysis. Built on those lessons, AMA has agents enumerate a published paper's possible fork space, score every fork against a validity rubric, execute the validated specification grid, and cross-examine one another's work under strict separation of duties. Applied to ten empirical studies from a leading management journal's replication packages (1,755 specification estimates), the framework reproduces every paper's original estimates, and shows that some conclusions hold across every specification the assessment validates, while others are sensitive to individual analytical choices that the published texts do not discuss. The case studies suggest our AMA-based measures can serve as robustness proxies for empirical findings. AI makes multiverse analysis practical, where it once required resources few research teams can afford: our exercises take hours of agent time and tens of dollars per paper. We discuss the implications for replication policy and for AI-assisted peer review in information systems.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能体多重宇宙分析"(AMA)框架，用多AI编码智能体系统枚举、评分并执行论文的"分析分叉"空间，从而在规模化层面可视化结论对合理分析选择的敏感性，并将其定位为面向人类专家的决策支持工具。
AI.motivation: 观察性数据的实证分析依赖数十个读者不可见的"合理分析选择"（分叉），现有研究难以检验结论对这些选择的敏感性；传统多重宇宙分析成本高，少数研究团队难以承担。
AI.method: 先开展试点：150个自主AI编码智能体在同一数据集与同一研究问题上工作，考察其分歧范围及AI同行评审、高分范例暴露的影响。在此基础上构建AMA框架：由智能体枚举已发表论文可能的分叉空间、按效度评分标准对每个分叉打分、执行通过验证的设定网格，并在严格的职责分离下相互交叉质询。
AI.result: 试点发现智能体通过与人相似的、可辩护的方法论选择产生分歧，但分歧范围更窄；AI同行评审几乎不改变离散度；接触高分范例报告后离散度大幅收敛，且主要源于模仿而非分析。AMA应用于某顶级管理期刊复制包中的10项实证研究（1,755个设定估计），复现了每篇论文的原始估计，并表明部分结论在所有通过验证的设定下稳健，另一些则对正文未讨论的单一分析选择敏感。
AI.conclusion: 案例研究表明AMA衍生指标可作为实证发现的稳健性代理；AI使原本资源密集的多重宇宙分析变得可行（每篇论文数小时智能体时间、数十美元成本）；并讨论了对复制政策与AI辅助同行评审的启示。

title: Recurrent Vision Language Models Solve the Shell Game
summary: Tracking a hidden object through a video is effortless for humans, yet it remains a bottleneck for vision language models (VLMs). In the shell game, where a ball is hidden under one of several identical cups that are then swapped, VLMs that answer directly stay near chance, thinking models fail on long games, and fine-tuning learns only the lengths it has seen. We argue that the limit is serial computation: each swap must be composed with the last result, and a VLM of fixed depth has only a fixed number of state transitions for it. To address this, we propose RecurrentVLM, which makes every attention layer of a pretrained VLM recur over time by computing the keys and values of finished frame groups from the layer's own output. With a single answer token, RecurrentVLM reaches 100% on VET-Bench and 99.6% on MET-Bench, and 99% on 50-swap games after training on at most 30 swaps. We also observe several interesting phenomena: length generalization emerges suddenly at an aha moment; without recurrence, each swap costs an attention layer; the ball's state forms in the first four attention layers; and recurrence keeps the latest state at the cost of details of earlier moments. These results suggest that recurrent VLMs are a potential solution for tracking the states of unobserved objects in video. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文指出VLM追踪隐藏物体（贝壳游戏）失败的根本原因是串行计算能力受限——固定深度模型的状态转移次数有限，提出让预训练VLM每层注意力沿时间递归的RecurrentVLM，单答案token下在VET-Bench达100%、MET-Bench达99.6%，仅训练30次换杯即可在50次换杯上达99%，并报告了"啊哈时刻"式长度泛化等有趣现象。
AI.motivation: 人类可轻松追踪视频中被隐藏的物体（如贝壳游戏中杯子换位下的球），但VLM难以做到：直接作答接近随机，思维链/推理模型在长序列游戏上失效，微调只能泛化到见过的长度。作者认为瓶颈在于串行计算：每次换杯都需与上一次结果复合，而固定深度的VLM只有固定的状态转移次数，无法完成随长度增长的串行状态更新。
AI.method: 提出RecurrentVLM：在预训练VLM的每个注意力层上引入沿时间的递归，即用该层自身的输出计算已完成帧组的key和value，使每层随时间反复复用与更新状态；最终仅用一个答案token输出结果，从而在不增加深度的前提下获得与换杯次数相当的串行状态转移能力。
AI.result: 单答案token下，RecurrentVLM在VET-Bench达100%、MET-Bench达99.6%；最多仅用30次换杯训练，在50次换杯游戏上仍达99%。观察到若干现象：长度泛化在"啊哈时刻"突然出现；不使用递归时，每次换杯需消耗一个注意力层；球的状态在前四个注意力层即已形成；递归能保留最新状态但牺牲早期时刻的细节。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，递归式VLM是追踪视频中未观测物体状态的一种有前景的解决路径；作者认为串行计算是当前VLM在该类任务上的核心限制，而逐层时间递归可有效突破该限制。代码将开源。

title: Game-Theoretic Data Allocation for Expert Specialization and Routing
summary: Can the allocation used to train experts also predict which expert will perform best on a prompt? Such a connection would make the intended division of labor inspectable before training and allow the allocation itself to guide inference. We introduce InflEns, a mixture of LoRA experts whose training weights and inference routes come from the same location game in a fixed prompt-trait space. Players choose positions to maximize their expected shares of the prompt distribution, without using expert losses. We utilize the game's kernel-general theoretical criterion for when co-located positions become locally unstable to separation. We evaluate InflEns on a corpus assembled from seven safety-related benchmarks, which demonstrates that the highest-share expert has the lowest held-out response negative log-likelihood (NLL) on approximately 90% of prompts across four kernels under a sharpened simplex representation, compared with approximately 15% after permuting allocations across prompts. We demonstrate that the method performs comparably to published learned gates without having to train an explicit gate on the experts. Because the router is fixed, we can trace harmful behavior to a single expert and retrain only that expert, which lowers HarmBench attack success from 0.51 to 0.02 while keeping instruction following. The game also gives us several controls over how the experts specialize, including the kernel choice and its parameters, the trait-space geometry, and the number of experts. Importantly, InflEns is a general framework that can be extended to any encoder and data distribution.

AI.tldr: InflEns 提出一种"影响博弈"驱动的 LoRA 专家混合框架：专家训练权重与推理路由来自同一固定 prompt-特质空间中的选址博弈，无需训练显式门控即可对齐路由与专家专长，并可用于可解释的安全对齐与定点修复。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：若"用于训练专家的分配"也能预测"哪个专家在某 prompt 上表现最好"，则分工可在训练前被检视，并让分配本身直接指导推理；由此可摆脱需额外训练、难以解释的门控网络。
AI.method: 方法：构建 InflEns——由 LoRA 专家组成的混合模型；在固定 prompt-特质空间中定义选址博弈，玩家（专家）选择位置以最大化其在 prompt 分布上的期望份额，目标函数不含专家损失；采用该博弈的 kernel-general 理论判据判断共址位置何时局部不稳定而分离；在精简单纯形表示下比较四种核。
AI.result: 结果：在由七个安全相关基准汇编的语料上，最高份额专家在约 90% 的 prompt 上取得最低留出响应 NLL（四种核、锐化单纯形表示），而跨 prompt 置换分配后仅约 15%；性能与已发表的学习型门控相当，但无需训练显式门控；因路由器固定，可将有害行为追溯到单一专家并仅重训该专家，HarmBench 攻击成功率由 0.51 降至 0.02，同时保持指令遵循能力。
AI.conclusion: 结论：分配份额与专家实际表现高度一致，路由可解释且可审计；核选择及参数、特质空间几何、专家数量提供对专业化程度的显式控制；InflEns 为通用框架，可扩展到任意编码器与数据分布。

title: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

AI.tldr: WEVO 提出无遥操作框架，在以动作条件化的视频世界模型中对全身人形 VLA 策略进行后训练。视频世界模型 RL 将真机任务平均成功率从 23.3% 提升到 75.0%，优于真机 RL 的 48.3%。
AI.motivation: 强化学习可超越模仿学习提升 VLA 策略，但人形机器人在真机上探索存在安全风险，而仿真 RL 又会利用残余的 sim-to-real 差距（域差），导致策略在真机上失效。因此需要一个既安全又与部署对齐的 RL 环境。
AI.method: 1) 构建动作条件化的视频世界模型（WM），引入仿真操控与运动 play 数据以增强接触动力学与视角变化的预测；2) 用合成示范训练 VLA，并在每个任务上采集 20 条真实机器人自主 rollout，用于将 WM 对齐到部署观测分布；3) 将 VLA、全身控制器（WBC）与视频 WM 组成闭环 RL 环境，配以稠密进度奖励进行策略优化。全流程无需遥操作。
AI.result: 在三个真机任务上：加入 play 数据提升了所有评估的 WM 指标及下游策略成功率；视频 WM RL 将平均成功率由 23.3% 提升至 75.0%，显著高于真机 RL 的 48.3%。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与视频世界模型具有互补优势：仿真提供策略初始化与广泛覆盖，视频 WM 提供与部署对齐的环境用于策略改进。该框架为人形全身 VLA 的安全、可扩展 RL 后训练提供了可行路径。

title: Steering Automated Scientific Discovery via Audited Epistemic Exploration
summary: Scientific discovery requires revisiting the hypotheses in light of new evidence and identifying promising directions beyond those already explored. However, research agents often make claims that are not supported by their observations, explore a narrow hypothesis space, and retain beliefs despite recognizing conflicting evidence. These failures motivate the search for an explicit epistemic state that captures both beliefs about existing hypotheses and directions for further exploration. To this end, we propose Epistemic Compass (EpiCompass), a plug-and-play scaffold that maintains this state through an epistemic tree linking hypotheses, evidence, beliefs, and revisions. As an investigation progresses, EpiCompass reassesses the hypotheses explored against accumulated evidence and uses unresolved conflicts and unexplored directions to guide hypothesis generation. It selects candidates by anticipated epistemic gain, accounting for both refinement of existing hypotheses and expansion of the hypothesis space, and verifies the final conclusion against the accumulated evidence. Experimental results across three scientific discovery benchmarks and three LLM backbones demonstrate that EpiCompass consistently outperforms baselines, with further analyses showing reductions in errors of unsupported claims and failures to revise beliefs.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的认知脚手架 EpiCompass，用“认知树”显式维护假设、证据、信念与修正，引导 LLM 研究智能体做更严谨的科学发现。
AI.motivation: 研究型智能体存在三类缺陷：提出无观察支撑的断言、假设空间探索狭窄、即使发现冲突证据仍固守原有信念。根因在于缺乏一个显式的“认知状态”来同时表征对已有假设的信念与待探索方向。
AI.method: EpiCompass 以认知树将假设、证据、信念与修正链接为可维护状态；随调查推进，依据累积证据重新评估已探索假设，并利用未解决的冲突与未探索方向驱动新假设生成；以“预期认知增益”（兼顾已有假设精化与假设空间扩展）筛选候选；最后将结论与累积证据核验。
AI.result: 在三个科学发现基准、三种 LLM 骨干上均稳定优于基线；进一步分析显示，无支撑断言类错误与“未能修正信念”类失败显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 显式的认知状态表示是提升研究智能体科学发现可靠性的有效手段，且该脚手架可即插即用、跨模型与任务泛化。

title: Beyond Restoration: Content-Degradation Factor Unfolding for Real-World Concealed Object Segmentation
summary: Reliable visual perception under degradation requires distinguishing task-relevant content from degradation-induced variations, especially in concealed object segmentation (COS), where foreground cues are inherently weak. The central challenge is not merely improving visibility, but identifying reliable content evidence amid degradation-induced variations. RGB-space segmentation often entangles content and degradation cues, while restoration-based methods primarily focus on image recovery and task interaction. This motivates explicit factorization to distinguish content evidence from degradation effects and assess its reliability. Retinex provides a spatially aligned basis for this separation but remains illumination-centric. We therefore extend it to content-degradation formation with task-asymmetric factor roles. The Factor Unfolding Network (FUN) uses the content factor R as the sole source of direct semantic evidence for segmentation, while the degradation factor L captures degradation-related variations and generates a spatial reliability map to calibrate this evidence. A unified energy couples observation formation with reliability-weighted foreground-background separation, and its alternating updates yield a coarse-to-fine network without clean-image supervision. In this way, FUN factorizes degradation for perception rather than removing it. Extensive experiments across clean and degraded conditions and diverse segmentation tasks demonstrate robust performance and generalization. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出因子展开网络FUN，将Retinex扩展为内容-退化形成模型，以内容因子R作为语义证据唯一来源、退化因子L生成空间可靠性图进行校准，通过统一能量的交替更新实现无干净图像监督的由粗到细分割。
AI.motivation: 退化条件下可靠视觉感知的关键在于区分任务相关内容与退化引起的变异，而非仅提升可见性。在隐蔽目标分割（COS）中前景线索本就微弱，RGB空间分割易将内容与退化线索纠缠，而基于复原的方法主要关注图像恢复与任务交互，缺乏对内容证据可靠性的显式评估。
AI.method: 将Retinex从以光照为中心扩展为内容-退化形成模型，并赋予任务非对称的因子角色。构建因子展开网络（FUN）：内容因子R作为分割的直接语义证据唯一来源，退化因子L捕捉退化相关变异并生成空间可靠性图对证据进行校准；设计统一能量函数耦合观测形成与可靠性加权的前景-背景分离，其交替更新展开为由粗到细的网络，无需干净图像监督。
AI.result: 在干净与退化条件以及多种分割任务上的大量实验表明，FUN具有稳健的性能与良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FUN的核心思路是"为感知而分解退化"而非"移除退化"：通过显式因子分解区分内容证据与退化效应并评估其可靠性，为退化条件下的隐蔽目标分割提供了有效的建模范式。

title: PDE-State Conditioning for Learned Optimization Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimization depends on global properties of the underlying PDE and how the physics residual evolves across the domain. Standard optimizers such as Adam use fixed gradient-based statistics, while learned PINN optimizers replace the fixed rule with a learned update built from local parameters and optimization-history features. However, none explicitly use PDE-level information. We study two coupled design questions: what PDE-level information should a learned optimizer observe, and how should that information influence its update? We introduce an 11-dimensional PDE state-capturing operator structure, residual geometry, and short-horizon update response, and use it to condition a structured meta-learned optimizer through bounded feature-wise modulation. Repeated design studies identify the compact residual-geometry state G2 and bounded FiLM as the strongest overall choices among those tested. The resulting PDE-State-conditioned optimizer improves all evaluation metrics (relative-L2, L1, solution MSE, and physics MSE) over Adam and the unconditioned learned optimizer on Linear Advection, KdV, and Burgers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学习型PINN优化器应观测哪些PDE层级信息以及如何利用该信息，提出11维PDE状态（算子结构、残差几何、短视界更新响应），并用有界FiLM调制结构化元学习优化器；实验确定残差几何状态G2+有界FiLM为最优组合，在三个方程上全面优于Adam和无条件学习优化器。
AI.motivation: PINN优化依赖底层PDE的全局性质及物理残差在区域内的演化，但Adam等标准优化器只用固定梯度统计，学习型PINN优化器虽用局部参数与优化历史特征构建学习更新规则，却均未显式利用PDE层级信息。作者因此聚焦两个耦合的设计问题：学习优化器应观测何种PDE层级信息，以及该信息应如何影响其更新。
AI.method: 构建11维PDE状态，涵盖算子结构、残差几何与短视界更新响应；以此通过有界特征级调制（FiLM）对结构化元学习优化器进行条件化；并开展重复性设计研究以比较不同状态表示与调制方式。
AI.result: 在测试的所有方案中，紧凑的残差几何状态G2与有界FiLM组合总体表现最佳；由此得到的PDE状态条件化优化器在线性平流、KdV与Burgers方程上，使相对L2、L1、解MSE与物理MSE全部指标均优于Adam及无条件学习优化器。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入PDE层级状态信息并以受限方式注入学习优化器是有效且可迁移的设计方向；残差几何是最具信息量的状态成分，有界FiLM提供稳定的条件化机制。

title: Plan your Self-Adaptation! Ontology-Mediated Task and Architecture Co-adaptation Planning for Robots
summary: Autonomous robots may need to adapt both their task plans and architectural configurations as operating conditions change. These decisions are interdependent: architectural configurations determine which actions a robot can perform, while task plans determine which capabilities are required. This paper presents PLANTA, an ontology-mediated approach to task and architecture co-adaptation that considers these dependencies during mission planning. PLANTA uses an ontology expressed in the Web Ontology Language to represent architectural alternatives and their associated functional and quality requirements, while the Planning Domain Definition Language defines task actions and mission goals. By automatically translating and integrating these models, PLANTA enables joint planning of task and reconfiguration actions. The approach uses satisficing planning and replans when changes during execution invalidate the current plan. PLANTA is evaluated in two robotic scenarios involving underwater inspection and ground navigation. The results support the feasibility of runtime co-adaptation and show lower planning time and memory consumption compared with optimal-policy generation in the evaluated navigation scenario, while producing plans of similar quality.

AI.tldr: PLANTA是一种本体中介的任务-架构协同自适应方法，用OWL表示架构方案与功能/质量需求、用PDDL定义任务动作与目标，自动翻译并集成两者以联合规划任务与重构动作，支持可满足性规划与执行期重规划，并在水下检测与地面导航两场景中验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人运行条件变化时需同时调整任务计划与架构配置，二者相互依赖：架构决定可执行动作，任务计划决定所需能力。现有方法在任务规划阶段未同时考虑这种双向依赖。
AI.method: 以OWL本体表示架构备选方案及其功能与质量需求，以PDDL定义任务动作与任务目标；自动翻译并集成两类模型，从而把任务动作与重构动作纳入统一规划；采用可满足性规划（satisficing planning），并在执行中变化使当前计划失效时进行重规划。
AI.result: 在水下检测与地面导航两个机器人场景中验证了运行时协同自适应的可行性；在导航场景中相较最优策略生成方法，规划时间与内存消耗更低，且生成的计划质量相近。
AI.conclusion: 本体中介的模型集成可有效支撑任务与架构的联合规划与在线重规划；相较最优策略生成，可满足性规划在保持计划质量的同时显著降低计算开销，具备运行时部署的可行性。

title: MKA: Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Agents on end-to-end professional tasks
summary: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding. Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format. Existing benchmarks leave this capability largely untested: removing image-viewing tools leaves Gemini 4 Carbon's score on GDPval unchanged, and single-format evaluations such as GDP.pdf and GDP.xlsx do not require reasoning across files or modalities. MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors. Deliverables are graded against expert-weighted rubrics by a sandboxed agentic autorater that agrees with human domain experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments in our expert-graded study (Cohen's $κ= 0.91$), scored by weighted satisfaction rate (WSR) overall and on frontier criteria unsaturated by prior-generation models (Climb-WSR). Across the frontier models we evaluate (Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), Claude Fable 5.2 (56.6% Climb-WSR, 73.3% Overall WSR) and Gemini 4 Carbon (54.3% Climb-WSR, 71.9% Overall WSR) achieve the highest scores, while Carbon uses $5.7\times$ fewer tokens. Even for the strongest models, Climb-WSR remains below 57%, leaving substantial headroom for multimodal agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MKA（Multimodal Knowledge Agent）基准，用于衡量自主智能体在依赖视觉理解的端到端专业知识工作上的能力：智能体需从CAD图纸、电路原理图、影像学片子、复杂图表与地理空间地图等多种视觉密集文件中提取并整合信息，交付.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf/.docx/.html/.png等独立成果物。基准含10个经济领域共200项任务，采用专家加权评分标准、由沙箱化智能体自动评分器裁定，其与人类专家判定一致率96.2%（κ=0.91）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准基本未测试"依赖视觉理解的多文件、跨模态专业交付"能力：在GDPval上移除图像查看工具后Gemini 4 Carbon得分不变，说明该基准并未真正依赖视觉；而GDP.pdf、GDP.xlsx等单一格式评测也不要求跨文件、跨模态推理。因此需要构建一个强调视觉密集输入与端到端成果产出的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建MKA基准：10个经济部门、200项任务；每项任务要求智能体从多份视觉密集文件（CAD蓝图、电子原理图、放射影像、复杂图表、地理空间地图）中抽取并融合信息，产出指定格式的独立交付物（.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf/.docx/.html/.png）。评分采用专家加权评分量表（rubric），由沙箱化智能体式自动评分器（agentic autorater）逐条裁定，并以加权满足率（WSR）为总体指标，另设Climb-WSR衡量前代模型尚未饱和的前沿评分项；通过专家评分研究验证自动评分器的可靠性。
AI.result: 自动评分器与人类领域专家在96.2%的评分项判定上一致（Cohen's κ=0.91）。在所评测的前沿模型（Gemini 4 Carbon、Claude Fable 5.2、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra）中，Claude Fable 5.2（Climb-WSR 56.6%，总体WSR 73.3%）与Gemini 4 Carbon（Climb-WSR 54.3%，总体WSR 71.9%）得分最高，而Carbon的token消耗仅为前者的约1/5.7。
AI.conclusion: 即便最强模型Climb-WSR亦低于57%，多模态智能体在视觉密集的专业知识工作上仍有显著提升空间；MKA提供了高一致性的可扩展评测手段，并揭示"效率—效果"权衡（Gemini 4 Carbon以低得多的token成本接近最高分）。

title: Branch Caching After Step Distillation in Four- and Eight-Step Image Generators
summary: Can a distilled image generator save time by reusing features between its few remaining denoising steps? We study a fixed branch cache that replaces selected attention and MLP evaluations while preserving the student's noise schedule. One full trajectory and one raw-cache trajectory from the same initial noise supply a scalar correction for each branch type and reuse position. At $1024^2$, one internal reuse reduces four-step Qwen-Image-Lightning denoising time from 1.279 to 0.977 seconds. Three reuses yield $1.51\times$ speedup on eight-step Lightning and $1.53\times$ on eight-step Hyper-FLUX. We evaluate image quality on all 200 DrawBench prompts. With the reuse positions held fixed, correction improves mean same-seed image fidelity over raw reuse by 0.66 and 0.87 dB on the two Lightning students. On Hyper-FLUX the PSNR difference is 0.01 dB, while LPIPS improves from 0.1625 to 0.1546. These results measure the effect of branch caching and correction while retaining each student's original sampling grid.

AI.tldr: 在蒸馏图像生成器的少量去噪步之间复用特征分支（attention/MLP）以加速推理，并通过一次标量校正缓解原始复用带来的质量损失，实现约1.5倍加速且保真度显著改善。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏后的图像生成器只剩极少去噪步，单步开销占比高，因此希望利用步间特征复用来节省时间；但直接复用（raw cache）会引入误差，需要在保持学生模型原始噪声调度（采样网格）不变的前提下补偿。
AI.method: 采用固定分支缓存：在选定去噪步上跳过部分attention与MLP计算，用缓存结果替代，且不改动学生的noise schedule。对每类分支和每个复用位置，从同一初始噪声出发分别跑一条完整轨迹和一条raw-cache轨迹，据此估计一个标量校正量；复用位置在实验中固定。
AI.result: 1024²下，一次内部复用使四步Qwen-Image-Lightning去噪时间由1.279s降至0.977s；三次复用在八步Lightning上达1.51×，在八步Hyper-FLUX上达1.53×。在DrawBench全部200条prompt上，固定复用位置时校正相比raw复用在两个Lightning学生上同种子图像PSNR分别提升0.66dB与0.87dB；Hyper-FLUX上PSNR差仅0.01dB，LPIPS由0.1625改善至0.1546。
AI.conclusion: 分支级缓存在蒸馏少步生成器中能带来实质速度收益，配合简单的标量校正可在不改变采样网格的情况下有效恢复图像保真度；校正收益随学生模型不同而异，对Hyper-FLUX主要体现在感知指标上。

title: φTD: Distributional Reinforcement Learning using Characteristic Functions
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Distributional Reinforcement Learning methods aim to learn the entire distribution of returns, yet current algorithmic approaches are limited to a narrow class of distributions. We propose $\varphi$TD, a method to overcome this limitation by computing the loss in the frequency domain. We demonstrate that this further unifies quantile and categorical approaches to distributional RL, and enables the learning of distributions that were previously impossible to capture, such as mixtures of continuous distributions. We empirically study $\varphi$TD, across synthetic benchmarks and large-scale deep RL environments and demonstrate that the flexibility obtained from wider parametric families can lead to improved performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 φTD，在频域（傅里叶域）计算时序差分损失，从而突破现有分布式强化学习方法只能表示狭窄分布族的限制，统一了分位数法与类别法，并能学习混合连续分布。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式强化学习旨在学习完整回报分布，但算法受限于狭窄的分布类别：类别法依赖固定支撑集，分位数法局限于单一可表示族，难以刻画多峰、混合连续等复杂回报分布。
AI.method: 提出 φTD：将 TD 损失改在频域中计算，通过对回报分布做特征函数（φ 变换）层面的匹配来优化，使分位数法与类别法成为同一框架下的特例；由此可灵活选用更宽的参数化分布族。
AI.result: 在合成基准与大尺度深度强化学习环境中进行了实证研究，表明更宽参数族带来的灵活性可提升性能，并能捕获以往方法无法表示的分布（如连续分布的混合）。
AI.conclusion: 频域 TD 损失为分布式 RL 提供了一个统一且更通用的框架，拓宽了可学习的分布族并带来实际性能收益。

title: MoRE: Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Physics Robotic World Models
summary: A robotic world model should predict how objects evolve under robot actions and physical dynamics. While recent 3D world models have shown strong predictive capabilities, they still struggle with the heterogeneous dynamics arising from diverse object interactions. To address this in a unified framework, we decompose robotic interactions into distinct physical regimes and assign each to a specialized motion expert. We introduce MoRE, a 3D world model with a mixture of motion experts organized around rigid, deformable, and prehensile dynamics. This design enables a single model to capture diverse physical behaviors while preserving regime-specific priors. Trained on mixed simulation and real-world data, MoRE integrates with Model Predictive Control (MPC) to support diverse manipulation tasks. Experiments show that MoRE improves prediction accuracy across physics regimes, leading to stronger real-world MPC performance. Code, data, and project website are available at https://alwaysleepy.github.io/MoRE-WM-site/.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoRE——一种基于刚体、可变形与抓取三类运动专家混合（MoE）的 3D 世界模型，统一建模异构物体动力学，并结合 MPC 提升真实机器人操作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 世界模型预测能力较强，但难以应对多样物体交互带来的异构动力学（heterogeneous dynamics），单一模型难以同时刻画不同物理机制下的演化规律。
AI.method: 将机器人交互分解为若干独立物理机制（regime），并为每种机制分配专门的运动专家；据此构建围绕刚体动力学、可变形动力学与抓取（prehensile）动力学的混合运动专家 3D 世界模型。训练使用混合仿真与真实数据，模型与模型预测控制（MPC）结合用于下游操作任务。
AI.result: 在多个物理机制下预测精度均有提升，并由此带来更强的真实世界 MPC 操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 按物理机制分解并采用专家混合，可在单一框架内兼顾多样物理行为与机制专属先验，是提升 3D 世界模型预测与下游控制表现的有效途径。

title: A Neurosymbolic Multimodal Framework for 30-Day Diabetic Readmission Prediction: Integrating Structured EHR Data, Dense Clinical Embeddings, and Knowledge-Grounded Symbolic Extraction
summary: Unplanned 30-day readmissions among patients with diabetes mellitus impose a substantial clinical and economic burden, yet most predictive models use only structured electronic health record (EHR) data and ignore free-text clinical notes, which often contain code-mixed Hindi-English (Hinglish) phrasing and negation that general-purpose language models parse unreliably. We propose a neurosymbolic multimodal framework evaluated on the public Diabetes 130-US Hospitals dataset (101,766 encounters; 71,518 patients) with a patient-level grouped 80/20 split. Three streams are fused: engineered structured features; 32 components of Bio_ClinicalBERT note embeddings obtained by truncated singular value decomposition; and symbolic entities extracted by an open-weight clinical language model within a three-stage hybrid retrieval-augmented generation pipeline (dense retrieval, sparse lexical retrieval, and cross-encoder re-ranking) with reflective negation auditing. A cost-sensitive XGBoost classifier with a decision threshold calibrated by Youden's J statistic produces the prediction. On the held-out test cohort (n = 20,153), the structured baseline achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.6477, sensitivity of 0.5839, and Brier score of 0.1080. The full multimodal model achieved the highest sensitivity (0.6667; +8.28 percentage points), the best F2-score (0.3824), and the lowest Brier score (0.0977), at a slightly lower AUROC (0.6375) and specificity (0.5161). Shapley additive explanations showed that prior utilization dominates risk, with compressed narrative components among the top predictors. On a 500-note code-switched benchmark, grounded retrieval raised Hinglish symptom recall from 4.8% to 40.2% and precision from 3.1% to 45.2%, while reducing entity hallucinations from 1.74 to 0.00 per note.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号多模态框架，融合结构化EHR特征、Bio_ClinicalBERT笔记嵌入与RAG提取的符号实体，用于预测糖尿病患者30天非计划再入院；在Diabetes 130-US Hospitals数据上实现灵敏度与F2提升，并显著改善Hinglish症状抽取的召回与精确率。
AI.motivation: 30天非计划再入院带来沉重临床与经济负担，但现有预测模型多仅使用结构化EHR数据，忽略自由文本临床笔记；而笔记中常含印英混用（Hinglish）表述与否定语义，通用语言模型解析不可靠。
AI.method: 在Diabetes 130-US Hospitals数据集（101,766次就诊、71,518名患者，按患者分组80/20划分）上构建三路融合模型：①工程化结构化特征；②经截断SVD得到的32维Bio_ClinicalBERT笔记嵌入；③由开源临床语言模型在三阶段混合RAG（稠密检索、稀疏词法检索、交叉编码器重排）加反思式否定审计中抽取的符号实体。采用代价敏感XGBoost分类器，阈值以Youden's J校准。
AI.result: 测试集（n=20,153）：结构化基线AUROC 0.6477、灵敏度0.5839、Brier 0.1080；完整多模态模型灵敏度0.6667（+8.28个百分点）、F2 0.3824最优、Brier 0.0977最低，AUROC略降至0.6375、特异度0.5161。SHAP显示既往就诊利用为主导风险因素，压缩后叙事成分进入重要预测因子。500条语码混用笔记基准上，接地检索使Hinglish症状召回由4.8%升至40.2%、精确率由3.1%升至45.2%，实体幻觉由1.74降至0.00/条。
AI.conclusion: 多模态神经符号融合在灵敏度、F2与概率校准上优于纯结构化基线，且RAG接地机制显著提升语码混用临床笔记的实体抽取质量并消除幻觉；但AUROC略降，需在判别力与召回导向之间权衡。

title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights
summary: Can a frontier model repair a vision-language model (VLM) by rewriting its weights? Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer. The usual remedies act on the decoding, leaving the looping model as it was, or must be told what to change. Yet the cause is written in the weights. Keel, the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, finds and removes it there. Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw. The repair needs no training, keeps the model's size and per-token cost, and applies to already-edited weights. The editors expose where the loops live: from the original weights, independent editors on both models trace them to the attention outputs of the middle layers, and the smaller VLM stops consulting the image inside a loop. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B, across six image benchmarks from visual mathematics to GUI grounding, the edit removes most loops on every benchmark and shortens answers, and the edited models are significantly more accurate than the thinking models on average; the larger one gains most on GUI grounding, a task absent from the practice questions. Because the repair lives in the weights, it combines with budget forcing where held-out questions favor it: on the best available weights, Keel has the best average accuracy on both models, significantly above every training-free baseline we compare on the larger one.

AI.tldr: Keel 是首个面向视觉语言模型(VLM)图像任务的智能体式权重编辑方法：仅被告知"循环"这一症状，由前沿多模态大模型作为"编辑器"智能体定位权重的致病成分、编辑并检验，在无需训练、不改变模型规模与单 token 成本的前提下消除思考模式下的重复循环，并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 小型推理 VLM（如 Qwen3.5）在 thinking 模式下面对许多图像问题会陷入自我重复的循环，直到耗尽 token 预算而丢掉答案。现有补救手段要么只作用于解码阶段（循环模型本身未变），要么必须人工指定要改什么；而作者认为致病原因其实写进了权重中，因此应直接在权重层面修复。
AI.method: 1) 以强多模态 LLM 充当"编辑器"智能体（多个编辑器并行）；2) 输入仅给出失败症状，编辑器借助"失败普查"(failure census) 与可观测工具——展示失败图像、以及 VLM 注意力落点——来定位病因；3) 直接改写权重并自测；4) harness 只保留那些显著降低失败率、且在编辑器未见过的题目上不降低准确率的编辑；5) 通过原始权重上多个独立编辑器的一致性，把循环定位到中间层的注意力输出（较小模型在循环中不再参照图像）。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 Qwen3.5-2B 上、覆盖从视觉数学到 GUI grounding 的六个图像基准：该编辑在每个基准上都消除了大部分循环并使回答变短；编辑后模型平均准确率显著高于 thinking 模型，其中较大模型在训练题中未出现的 GUI grounding 上收益最大。由于修复存在于权重中，可与 budget forcing 结合；在最佳可用权重上，Keel 在两个模型上平均准确率均为最佳，且在较大模型上显著优于所有对比的无训练基线。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的循环失效是可定位、可编辑的权重级缺陷：无需训练、不增加模型体积与 per-token 成本、可作用于已被编辑过的权重，并能与解码侧方法（budget forcing）互补叠加。

title: Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models
summary: Long event streams require identifying each change and applying the changes in order. We train a selector on a frozen language model to read each transition. With API-only access, we ask the model to list the transitions. An external integer register composes them in order. A confidence rule can flag uncertain updates or retain several candidates. We study products of permutations of five items, a task that fixed-depth, log-precision transformers cannot solve on all input lengths under the standard conjecture that $\mathrm{TC}^0 \ne \mathrm{NC}^1$. On two-event windows, a 27B model answered 3 of 100 correctly without visible reasoning and 96 of 100 when it generated intermediate steps. A frozen 0.8B model with a trained selector read every event in 299 of 299 windows of 43,687 events each. The same package passed 298 of 299 new windows on a fresh machine, missing the target of 0.99 for the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound. A separate follow-up sized to allow one failure yielded 472 of 473. On 1,000-event room-swap documents, three of ten models solved all five documents by reasoning alone. All seven models tested both ways at this length solved all five with extraction and the register, with no chain of thought requested. With concurrent extraction, median wall-clock time fell from 136.1 to 10.4 s for Sonnet 5.5 and from 313.5 to 28.0 s for GPT-6.1 Sol. At fixed per-token rates, mean cost per document fell by 55% for Sonnet 5.5 and 44% for GPT-6.1 Sol. A regular expression with an executor also solved all 15 fixed-format documents. On 500 free-form issue-tracker comments, a separately adapted 4B reader identified the recorded value in 68.8% of cases, compared with 61.0% for a frequency baseline fitted on the same training projects.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"外部整数寄存器 + 冻结语言模型选择器"的组合方案，用于按顺序追踪长事件流中的状态变化，在置换乘积任务上突破固定深度Transformer的理论限制，并验证其准确性、成本与速度优势。
AI.motivation: 长事件流需要逐一识别每次变化并按顺序施加。标准猜想 TC⁰≠NC¹ 下，固定深度、对数精度的Transformer无法在所有输入长度上求解五元素置换的乘积，因此单靠"思维链/推理"不可靠；同时纯API调用方式还可节省成本与时间。
AI.method: 在冻结语言模型上训练一个选择器（selector），逐条读取状态转移；仅通过API访问时让模型列出转移，再由外部整数寄存器按序复合；引入置信度规则标记不确定更新或保留多个候选。评测任务包括五元素置换乘积（两事件窗口）、1,000事件"换房"文档、以及500条自由格式issue-tracker评论（单独适配的4B读取器）。对比三种模式：纯推理、提取+寄存器、并发提取+寄存器。
AI.result: 两事件窗口：27B模型无可见推理仅答对3/100，生成中间步骤后达96/100。冻结0.8B模型+训练选择器在299/299个窗口（每窗43,687事件）全部读对；同包在新机器上298/299通过，未达单侧95%下置信界0.99的目标；后续按容许一次失败设计的实验为472/473。1,000事件文档中，10个模型里仅3个靠纯推理解出全部5篇；而7个以两种方式测试的模型配合提取与寄存器、不要求思维链均全部解出。并发提取使中位墙钟时间由136.1s降至10.4s（Sonnet 5.5）、313.5s降至28.0s（GPT-6.1 Sol）；固定单价下每文档平均成本分别下降55%与44%。带执行器的正则表达式也解出全部15篇固定格式文档。自由格式评论上，4B读取器记录值识别率68.8%，频率基线为61.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将"读取/提取"与"按序复合"解耦——模型负责局部转移提取、外部寄存器负责顺序组合——可在长事件流上以更低成本、更快速度获得高准确率，并能覆盖固定深度Transformer理论上无法保证的任务；在自由格式文本上该方法仍有明显提升空间。

title: Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies: Spatializing Latent Action Representations for Goal-Pose-Free Mobile Manipulation
summary: The success of manipulation policies is closely tied to the spatial relationship between the robot and the target object, as well as the task being performed, making the ability to adjust the robot's pose critical for successful execution. When the robot starts away from the task, such adjustments require coordinating navigation with local manipulation. Jointly training these capabilities incurs substantial computational and data costs, while navigating toward a predefined goal pose limits the flexibility needed to adapt to task-specific manipulation requirements. To address these challenges, we propose Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies (M4M), a framework that learns manipulation-aware mobility directly from pretrained manipulation policies. By leveraging the hidden representations of the policy's action-generating network as dense supervision, together with a limited number of manipulation execution outcomes, we learn a spatially conditioned embedding that captures task-dependent manipulation success across candidate robot poses. From the robot's current stereo observations, this representation estimates manipulation success at unvisited poses without rolling out the manipulation policy at each location. It is further integrated into navigation policy training, while a learned handoff policy decides when to transition from navigation to manipulation, enabling the robot to move and manipulate in a unified, task-aware manner. Across eight articulated-object tasks in unseen RoboCasa kitchens, M4M achieves 47.0% mean task success, compared with 26.5% for the strongest baseline and 19.2% for direct manipulation execution, and refrigerator-closing experiments show consistent improvements across four frozen manipulation policies.

AI.tldr: 提出M4M框架，从预训练操作策略的隐表示中学习"操作感知的移动能力"，实现导航与操作的统一协调。
AI.motivation: 操作策略的成功依赖机器人与目标物体的空间关系及具体任务，因此调整机器人位姿至关重要。但联合训练导航与操作的计算与数据成本高；而导航到预定义目标位姿又缺乏对任务特定操作需求的适应性。需要一种能直接从已有操作策略中"借用"操作感知能力来指导移动的方法。
AI.method: 利用预训练操作策略动作生成网络的隐表示作为稠密监督，结合少量操作执行结果，学习一个空间条件化的嵌入表示，用于刻画不同候选位姿下的任务相关操作成功率。基于机器人当前双目观测，该表示可直接估计未访问位姿的操作成功率，无需在每个位置实际执行操作策略。该表示进一步融入导航策略训练，并配合一个学习得到的交接（handoff）策略决定何时从导航切换为操作。
AI.result: 在未见过的RoboCasa厨房中八个关节物体任务上，M4M平均任务成功率为47.0%，最强基线为26.5%，直接执行操作为19.2%；在关冰箱实验中，对四种冻结的操作策略均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用预训练操作策略的内部表示而非联合训练，M4M能以较低成本获得操作感知的移动能力，比"先导航到固定位姿再操作"的分离范式更灵活、更有效，为统一移动-操作提供了可扩展途径。

title: MS-Point: Multi-Modal Hierarchical Spectral Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
summary: Point-image alignment learns useful object representations, but different local feature patterns can produce the same pooled descriptor and receive the same alignment signal. We introduce MS-Point, a cross-modal pretraining framework that directly supervises intermediate point features and their neighborhood responses. At selected encoder stages, we compute neighborhood averages and residuals before pooling and align their branch descriptors with image features. Branch-level objectives align each representation with its visual target, while cross-level consistency and adaptive fusion coordinate information across branches. A common interface of intermediate features and spatial neighborhoods supports both graph encoders and point Transformers. Evaluations across object classification, few-shot adaptation, dense prediction, and low-label scene learning demonstrate the transfer value of this design. Same-backbone comparisons and capacity-matched and computation-matched controls connect these improvements to the structure of supervision. Together, our findings support directly supervising intermediate features and neighborhood variation to learn transferable, geometry-aware representations across modalities.

AI.tldr: MS-Point 是一个跨模态预训练框架，通过在池化前对编码器中间层点特征及其邻域响应（邻域均值+残差）直接施加图像对齐监督，缓解"不同局部特征模式得到相同池化描述子"的监督塌缩问题，在分类、少样本、稠密预测和低标签场景任务上验证了迁移价值。
AI.motivation: 点-图像对齐（point-image alignment）虽能学到有用的物体表征，但存在监督歧义：不同的局部特征模式可能产生相同的池化描述子，从而获得相同的对齐信号，导致中间层局部结构缺乏有效约束。作者希望把监督信号下沉到中间特征与邻域变化层面。
AI.method: 1) 在选定的编码器阶段，于池化之前计算邻域均值与残差，得到分支描述子并与图像特征对齐；2) 分支级目标使每个表征对齐其视觉目标，跨层级一致性（cross-level consistency）与自适应融合（adaptive fusion）协调各分支信息；3) 设计统一的"中间特征+空间邻域"接口，同时支持图编码器与点 Transformer。
AI.result: 在物体分类、少样本适配、稠密预测、低标签场景学习四类评测上均体现迁移收益；并通过同骨干对比（same-backbone）、容量匹配与计算量匹配的对照实验，将性能提升归因于监督结构本身而非模型容量或算力差异。
AI.conclusion: 直接监督中间特征及其邻域变化，能够跨模态学习到可迁移、几何感知的表示；该结论支持将预训练监督从池化后的全局描述子前移至中间层局部结构。

title: Real Cameras are Radiometric
summary: We propose the radiometric camera, a model that lifts any central geometric camera model to a radiometric one. The lifted model keeps the projection of the geometric model and adds a finite aperture, a free-form focus surface and a generic vignetting function. We calibrate it by inverse rendering directly on the relative irradiance of the sensor, from the same images of standard calibration targets used in geometric calibration. Geometric calibration absorbs the bias of its feature detections. The proposed radiometric calibration uses no features, and our radiometric cameras have lower reprojection errors on held-out test sets. The focus surface extends defocus modeling from the thin lens to any central camera, and we use it in a first multi-view radiometric reconstruction, which recovers the in-focus reflectance of a texture from defocused images. The vignetting is estimated jointly and accurately reproduces a flat field measured through a diffuser. Because every standard camera model lifts to a radiometric one, the radiometric camera naturally and directly extends generative scene models beyond multi-view geometry to multi-view radiometric ones, where phenomena such as lighting and attenuation can be accurately estimated.

AI.tldr: 提出“辐射相机（radiometric camera）”模型，可将任意中心几何相机模型提升为辐射学模型，在保持原投影的同时引入有限孔径、自由形状对焦面和通用渐晕函数，并通过逆渲染标定。
AI.motivation: 现有几何相机标定只建模投影，忽略孔径、对焦面与渐晕等辐射学效应；而这些效应在离焦建模、多视图重建与光照/衰减估计中至关重要，缺少统一且可标定的模型。
AI.method: 在几何模型基础上新增有限孔径、自由形状对焦面与通用渐晕函数；直接对传感器相对辐照度做逆渲染标定，使用与几何标定相同的标准标靶图像且不依赖特征检测；几何标定用于吸收特征检测偏差；并将对焦面用于首个多视图辐射学重建以恢复纹理的聚焦反射率，同时联合估计渐晕。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上辐射相机的重投影误差低于几何标定；联合估计的渐晕能准确复现经漫射板测得的平场；多视图辐射重建可从离焦图像中恢复聚焦反射率。
AI.conclusion: 任何标准相机模型都可提升为辐射相机，从而将生成式场景模型从多视图几何自然扩展到多视图辐射学，可准确估计光照与衰减等现象。

title: Some Memories Must Fade: Persistence and Decay of User Memories in Model Parameters
summary: Parametric memory allows Large Language Models to internalize knowledge directly into their weights, offering a potentially powerful alternative to retrieval-based memory (RAG). However, existing approaches to parametric memory are difficult to deploy as they largely mirror the Continual Learning (CL) objective of retaining information indefinitely. This is neither sustainable nor sufficient for a memory system, which must govern knowledge across its lifecycle by retaining stable facts, reinforcing recurring observations, updating changed beliefs, and allowing transient information to fade. We propose a system for parametric memory management consisting of a memory substrate (handling information storage and forgetting) and a learned policy (what to remember, how deeply, and for how long). Our substrate is a fixed-capacity LoRA adapter that consists of k-hot rank combinations which store facts without catastrophic interference and maintain an independently controlled temporal decay, enabling outdated information to fade while long-term facts persist. On this substrate, we train a lightweight controller that governs each incoming user event to ensure the memory system reflects the user's true, updated belief state. To evaluate how memory systems manage user memory, we introduce a controlled dataset of long-horizon user trajectories with varying persistence of facts based on changing belief states and user-behavioral shifts, and probe queries that test recall while information is valid and abstention after it expires. Our policy learns to effectively manage user memory over its entire lifecycle, balancing recall and abstention to achieve 86% of oracle performance, unlike CL and RAG baselines that primarily default to one of the two behaviors. By providing the first system to manage memory directly in model weights, this work establishes a foundation for long-horizon parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出一个参数化记忆管理系统，由固定容量LoRA基座（k-hot秩组合+独立时间衰减）和轻量学习控制器组成，实现知识生命周期管理（保留、强化、更新、遗忘），在长程用户轨迹数据集上达到oracle性能的86%。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化记忆方法难以部署，因为它们基本沿用持续学习（CL）目标，即无限期保留信息。这不是一个记忆系统应具备的：真正的记忆系统需在知识全生命周期内进行治理——保留稳定事实、强化重复出现的观察、更新已变化的信念、允许短暂信息消退。此外，已有CL与RAG基线往往偏向"全部记住"或"全部检索"中的单一行为，无法兼顾回忆与弃答。
AI.method: 系统分两部分：(1) 记忆基座：固定容量的LoRA适配器，由k-hot秩组合构成，可将事实写入而不产生灾难性干扰，并为每个组合维护独立可控的时间衰减，使过时信息自然消退而长期事实保留；(2) 学习策略：在该基座上训练轻量控制器，对每个到来的用户事件决定是否记忆、记忆深度与保留时长，使记忆系统反映用户真实、更新后的信念状态。同时构建受控数据集：含长程用户轨迹，事实持久性随信念变化与用户行为漂移而不同，并设计探针查询以测试信息有效期的回忆与过期后的弃答。
AI.result: 所学习的策略能有效管理用户记忆的整个生命周期，在召回与弃答之间取得平衡，达到oracle性能的86%；而CL与RAG基线则主要默认采取两种行为之一（要么过度回忆、要么过度弃答）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了首个直接在模型权重中管理记忆的系统，为长程参数化记忆奠定了基础，并将记忆从"无限积累"的持续学习范式转变为具备生命周期治理能力的可控系统。

title: Differentiable Hydrodynamics for Whole-Body MPC of Underwater Robots
summary: Underwater vehicle-manipulator systems distribute actuation across thrusters and joint motors. Whole-body model predictive control (MPC), rather than separate vehicle and arm controllers, can coordinate both to extend the workspace and exploit the system's full kinematic capability. Doing so, however, requires a hydrodynamic model and derivatives throughout the prediction horizon. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) captures geometry-dependent forces and moments for such a model, but is too expensive to evaluate online. We present a differentiable analytical hydrodynamic model combining smooth spherical-harmonic force and moment fields with a coupled added-inertia matrix identified from CFD. It compactly represents velocity and acceleration-dependent loads and provides their derivatives in closed form. These derivatives are propagated through free-floating vehicle--manipulator dynamics for whole-body trajectory optimization and receding-horizon control, jointly optimizing thruster forces and joint torques for reaching and continuous tracking. Held-out CFD tests validate the principal translational-force and rotational-moment fields and the added-inertia response. The analytical Jacobians evaluate faster and avoid the step-size sensitivity of central finite differences. Closed-loop Stonefish experiments demonstrate whole-body MPC in an independent marine simulator. By making geometry-dependent hydrodynamics directly available to gradient-based control, the model incorporates water forces and their sensitivities into motion allocation between the vehicle and arm, rather than treating them only as disturbances.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可微的解析水动力模型，将平滑球谐力/力矩场与从CFD辨识的耦合附加惯量矩阵结合，可闭式给出导数，用于水下航行器-机械臂系统的全身MPC，实现推进器力与关节力矩的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 水下航行器-机械臂系统的驱动分布在推进器与关节电机上，单独的载具与机械臂控制器难以协调；全身MPC可扩展工作空间并发挥全部运动学能力，但需要在整个预测时域上可微的水动力模型。CFD虽能刻画几何相关的水动力，但计算成本过高无法在线使用。
AI.method: 构建可微解析水动力模型：用平滑球谐函数表示力场与力矩场，并结合从CFD辨识的耦合附加惯量矩阵，紧凑刻画速度与加速度相关载荷及其闭式导数；将导数经自由漂浮航行器-机械臂动力学传播，用于全身轨迹优化与滚动时域控制，联合优化推进器推力与关节力矩以完成到达与连续跟踪任务。
AI.result: 留出CFD数据验证了主要的平移力场、旋转力矩场及附加惯量响应；解析雅可比计算更快，且避免中心差分的步长敏感性；在Stonefish独立海洋仿真器中完成闭环实验，展示了全身MPC的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过使几何相关水动力可直接供梯度优化控制使用，该模型将水动力及其灵敏度纳入载具与机械臂之间的运动分配，而非仅将其视为扰动。

title: Pandora's Toolbox Or Why Agent Safety Cannot Be Verified
summary: Present artificial intelligence agents are constructed by means of a coupling between a fixed language model with a general computing device. We show that this coupling makes safety undecidable. In particular, we show that given some dangerous program, no algorithm can predict whether an agent will run such a program that is semantically equivalent. In general, guardrails, blacklists, whitelists and certifications can only lead to imperfect safety solutions. Under finite constraints (bounded context, values and running time) safety is decidable but still intractable. Specifically, the problem is $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-complete even when the description of the agent is known. Finally, safety is not a compositional property, i.e., agents that can be proven safe on their own can still produce unsafe behavior when grouped together. We also discuss relaxed notions of safety that could be used in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：由固定语言模型与通用计算设备耦合构成的人工智能体，其安全性是不可判定的；在有限约束下安全虽可判定但PSPACE完全；且安全性不具组合性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体普遍采用"固定语言模型＋通用计算装置"的架构，而实践中依赖护栏、黑名单、白名单与认证等机制保障安全。作者希望从计算理论层面严格刻画这种架构下安全性的可判定性与复杂度边界，说明为何现有安全手段只能得到不完美的方案。
AI.method: 采用可计算性理论与计算复杂性分析：将智能体建模为语言模型与通用图灵机式计算设备的耦合，把"是否运行某个语义等价于给定危险程序"的判定问题形式化为不可判定问题（借助程序等价性/停机类归约）；再在上下文、取值与运行时间有界的有限约束下分析其复杂性，并讨论安全性质的组合性与放松版安全定义。
AI.result: （1）无界情形下安全性不可判定：不存在算法能预测智能体是否会运行某一与给定危险程序语义等价的程序，故护栏、黑名单、白名单与认证本质上只能是不完美的安全方案；（2）在有限约束（有界上下文、有界取值、有界运行时间）下安全可判定，但即使在智能体描述已知时该问题仍为PSPACE完全的，因而实际不可行；（3）安全性不是组合性质：单独可证安全的智能体组合后仍可能产生不安全行为。
AI.conclusion: 安全性问题源于"语言模型＋通用计算设备"耦合所引入的图灵完备性，无法通过静态验证或过滤机制彻底解决；完全安全不可实现，应在理论上承认这一限度，转而研究实践中可用的放松安全概念（如带有概率、范围或运行时约束的安全界定），并警惕"局部安全不等于整体安全"的组合性失效。

title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
summary: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU. A VIO filter publishes metric poses, a depth foundation model conditioned on them predicts depth for short keyframe windows, and a factor graph fuses the resulting submaps. Recent work has explored several approaches to this problem. What is essential is the multi-view agreement (Accord), which is considered in SLAM as a source of geometric self-consistency. Accord anchors each keyframe window to metric 3D points triangulated from the filter poses, then exploits bidirectional dense depth agreement between co-visible images to estimate and correct per-image scale errors while preserving the metric scale established by the anchors. Context keyframes further improve depth prediction, and the resulting submaps are fused in a factor graph. We evaluate a single mapping configuration across five public camera-IMU setups and a new Phone-rig/GoPro dataset. With nothing tuned per dataset/setup and every map aligned only by Accord's own trajectory, Accord achieves consistently best/second-best mean F-score at 5 cm on every platform. Accord is open-source along with the phone-rig dataset for the benefit of the research community

AI.tldr: Accord 提出一种从单目相机+IMU 在线构建稠密度量地图的框架：以 VIO 滤波器提供度量位姿，用深度基础模型基于位姿预测短关键帧窗口的深度，再通过双向稠密深度一致性（多视图一致）估计并校正逐图像尺度误差，最后用因子图融合子图；单一配置在五个公开相机-IMU数据集及新采集的 Phone-rig/GoPro 数据集上均取得最优或次优的 5 cm 平均 F-score。
AI.motivation: 稠密度量建图仍具挑战性：VIO 能给出度量运动但几何稀疏，前馈深度模型能预测稠密结构但缺乏度量尺度保证。因此需要一种方法把二者的优势结合——既保留 VIO 的度量尺度，又获得稠密的度量一致几何。
AI.method: 1) VIO 滤波器发布度量位姿；2) 以该位姿为条件的深度基础模型对短关键帧窗口预测稠密深度，并用上下文关键帧增强预测；3) 将每个关键帧窗口锚定到由滤波器位姿三角化得到的度量三维点上（提供度量尺度基准）；4) 利用共视图像间的双向稠密深度一致性（multi-view agreement）估计并校正逐图像尺度误差，同时保持锚点确立的度量尺度；5) 在因子图中融合各子图。
AI.result: 在五个公开相机-IMU 配置以及新的 Phone-rig/GoPro 数据集上评估单一建图配置：无需针对数据集/平台调参，且每张地图仅用 Accord 自身轨迹对齐，Accord 在所有平台上均取得 5 cm 阈值下最优或次优的平均 F-score。
AI.conclusion: 多视图稠密深度一致性（Accord）是构建稠密度量地图的关键要素，可作为 SLAM 中几何自一致性的来源，有效校正深度基础模型的尺度漂移并保持度量尺度；方法具备跨平台泛化能力，代码与 Phone-rig 数据集已开源。

title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
summary: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NextUnit-Bench 部署式基准（24 个公开数据集、58 个折），让编码智能体在两小时内自行设计并交付可执行预测器，在隐藏设备单元上评测，论证"通用性正从模型转移到建模者（modeler）"。
AI.motivation: 现有通用性体现在"发布为通用解的模型"本身；而在预测与健康管理（PHM）中，每个模型都必须工作在未见过的设备上。作者追问：通用性是否应改由"为每个新任务现场构建模型的智能体"承担。
AI.method: 构建部署风格基准 NextUnit-Bench：24 个公开数据集划分为 58 个折，按单元或工况留出（hold out units / operating conditions）；智能体限时 2 小时交付可执行预测器，随后在隐藏单元上运行。对照包括 AutoML、4 个数据集上对已发表方法的忠实复现，以及消融实验：跨智能体交换纯文本设计计划（plan）、前置/后置计划给予、域工具包、以及用本地可部署开放权重模型执行强智能体的设计。
AI.result: (1) 前沿智能体优于 AutoML（AutoML 得分不足最佳智能体一半）；30 个复现方法中仅 6 个超过最强智能体自研设计；已发表精度依赖论文自身约定，仅"截断测试引擎剩余寿命"这一约定即可使报告误差减半。(2) 智能体优势来自针对每台机器数据所做的设计；一旦完成，几百词的纯文本计划即可承载两个前沿智能体间大部分差距，且弱智能体的计划会使最强智能体退化到其水平甚至给出相同预测；但在接触数据之前，执行谁的计划影响甚微，域工具包亦无帮助——强者的关键在于从数据中学到多少。(3) 设计只在能执行它的实现者上生效：给定最强智能体的设计，本地开放权重模型仅有一半概率成功交付，即便轻量化后也如此，且得分不高于无设计时。
AI.conclusion: 通用性并未消失，而是从"模型"迁移到"建模者"（the modeler）：应关注智能体面向新任务的数据驱动设计能力，以及设计与实现能力之间的耦合瓶颈。

title: RefreshGrad: An Online Adaptive Data-sampling Method for Diffusion-based Visuomotor Learning
summary: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies from demonstrations typically samples trajectory segments uniformly or relies on static offline data curation before training. However, we find that demonstration data vary sharply in supervision value across temporal windows, and that each window's value to the policy evolves substantially during training rather than being fixed or captured by raw loss alone. Motivated by this finding, we propose RefreshGrad, an online adaptive data-sampling framework that periodically scores temporal windows from the evolving policy using five policy-native signals and dynamically adjusts their sampling weights during training. RefreshGrad focuses optimization on informative, learnable windows without altering the policy architecture, training objective, or inference cost. Across ten LIBERO-Plus manipulation tasks, RefreshGrad boosts average success from 60.7% (Uniform) and 68.2% (FAKTUAL) to 76.1% under visual perturbations, and from 57.4% and 73.3% to 81.3% in clean scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出RefreshGrad：一种在线自适应数据采样框架，周期性用五个策略原生信号对时间窗口打分并动态调整采样权重，在不改动策略架构、训练目标和推理成本的前提下，将LIBERO-Plus十个操作任务的平均成功率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略的演示数据采样多为均匀采样或依赖训练前的静态离线数据筛选；但论文发现示范数据在不同时间窗口上的监督价值差异剧烈，且每个窗口对策略的价值会随训练动态演变，无法用静态规则或原始损失单独刻画。
AI.method: RefreshGrad在训练过程中周期性用当前演化中的策略对时间窗口重新评分，评分依据五个策略原生信号（policy-native signals），并据此动态调整各窗口的采样权重，使优化聚焦于信息量大且可学习的窗口；不改变策略网络结构、训练目标与推理开销。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus的十个操作任务上：视觉扰动条件下平均成功率由60.7%（Uniform）、68.2%（FAKTUAL）提升至76.1%；干净场景下由57.4%、73.3%提升至81.3%。
AI.conclusion: 数据采样的“何时采、采什么”应随训练动态自适应；在线、多信号、策略原生的窗口级加权是提升VLA示教学习效率与鲁棒性的低成本有效手段。

title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. It then performs targeted research to relate the identified problems to candidate solutions. Through controlled hypothesis testing, the agent updates the importance of a suspected problem or the benefit brought by a candidate solution. On the complete MLE-Bench, Pro$^2$ Agent matches the best reported medal rate (70.7%) under the standard 24-hour budget and reaches 76.0% with a 48-hour budget, the highest medal rate reported on the complete benchmark. It also achieves competitive performance on PostTrainBench. In addition, it produces research notes for each task that make the research process transparent and reusable by human researchers.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pro² Agent，将自主 AI 研究的主要状态从"代码库状态"转变为显式的"问题状态（Problem State）"，在完整 MLE-Bench 上取得 70.7%（24h）与 76.0%（48h）的奖牌率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 通过迭代优化代码库来开展自主 AI 研究，忽略了任务背后的问题结构。该方法在简单任务上有效，但在困难任务上容易陷入错误的解区域，因为 Agent 从未显式表达其对问题的理解。
AI.method: Pro² Agent 以 Problem State 作为核心状态，显式刻画"哪些问题阻碍成功"与"哪些方案可能解决它们"。流程包括三步：(1) 通过全面分析可用资源与约束初始化 Problem State；(2) 执行有针对性的研究，将识别出的问题与候选方案关联；(3) 通过受控假设检验，更新对某个疑似问题重要性或某个候选方案收益的估计。
AI.result: 在完整 MLE-Bench 上，标准 24 小时预算下匹配最佳奖牌率 70.7%；48 小时预算下达到 76.0%，为完整基准上已报告的最高奖牌率。在 PostTrainBench 上亦取得有竞争力的表现。此外，为每个任务生成研究笔记，使研究过程透明且可被人类研究者复用。
AI.conclusion: 以显式问题结构（而非代码库迭代）作为自主 AI 研究的中心状态，能有效缓解困难任务中的局部解陷阱，显著提升基准表现，并产出可解释、可复用的研究记录。

title: Persistent Identity in Person Tracking: Online Enrollment and Registered Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version of this paper was submitted to an IEEE conference
summary: We extend PoseTReID with online appearance-bank matching (Gallery) and a residual-conflict guard for registered SVM recognition. All methods use supplied ground-truth (GT) person boxes. We average all-box assessment IDF1/HOTA equally across videos. On six SportsMOT clips, StrongSORT leads standalone trackers (79.44/84.72%) and exceeds both Gallery variants. Over eleven videos, Gallery AIN (83.29/85.44%) and COPE (84.66/86.38%) exceed standalone trackers with complete results. This lead depends on two retrospectively added GTA development compilations and is absent on the original nine videos. Registered SVMs lead both cohorts among complete results, with AIN at 95.72/94.82% over eleven videos. They use every GT crop from approximately 20% of frames, including future appearances. On MOT20-03, registered AIN reached 96.80% IDF1 and assigned the correct enrolled name to 90.72% of assessment GT observations. Gallery and standalone trackers receive no per-video labelled enrollment. Both identity routes restore identities across internal title cards, but Gallery trails SORT on three videos (four in HOTA) and both SVMs trail SORT on MOT16-04/MOT20-03. Under six-clip persistent-only scoring, native Gallery gains 2.39 percentage points in mean IDF1 over a matched control, with lower correct-P coverage and 5.02 times as many encoder attempts. Pose gating is mixed; the guard's metric effect is not isolated.

AI.tldr: 在PoseTReID上引入在线外观库匹配(Gallery)与残差冲突守卫的注册SVM识别方案；Gallery与注册SVM在完整结果下超过独立跟踪器，但优势依赖事后加入的GTA开发汇编，且两类身份路线在部分视频上仍落后SORT。
AI.motivation: 原PoseTReID缺乏在线外观库匹配与注册身份识别的整合，作者希望评估在GT人物框条件下，Gallery跟踪与SVM注册识别能否超越StrongSORT等独立跟踪器，并厘清其性能来源与代价。
AI.method: 扩展PoseTReID：加入在线外观库匹配(Gallery，含AIN与COPE变体)和残差冲突守卫用于注册SVM识别；全部方法使用提供的GT人物框；以全框评估IDF1/HOTA在视频间等权平均；注册SVM使用约20%帧的全部GT裁剪(含未来外观)，并与匹配控制组、SORT基线及per-video标签注册设置对比。
AI.result: 六个SportsMOT片段上StrongSORT领先独立跟踪器(79.44/84.72%)并超过两种Gallery；十一个视频上Gallery AIN(83.29/85.44%)与COPE(84.66/86.38%)超过独立跟踪器，但该领先依赖两个事后GTA汇编、在原始九个视频上不存在。注册SVM在完整结果中领先，AIN达95.72/94.82%；MOT20-03上AIN达96.80% IDF1，90.72%评估GT观测被赋予正确注册名。Gallery与SORT相比在三个视频(IDF1)/四个视频(HOTA)落后；两种SVM在MOT16-04/MOT20-03落后SORT。六片段持久评分下Gallery较匹配控制组平均IDF1提升2.39个百分点，但正确P覆盖更低、编码器尝试次数为5.02倍；姿态门控效果混合，守卫的指标效应未被单独隔离。
AI.conclusion: Gallery与注册SVM的整体领先具有条件性：依赖事后GTA汇编、GT框与未来外观信息，且伴随更高计算成本与部分视频上的性能回退；守卫作用未隔离，结论稳健性有限。

title: Process-Knowledge-Guided Latent Diffusion for Generative Design of Porous Architectures: A Case Study in Aerosol Jet Printing
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables (under review for NAMRC55 - 2027)
summary: Printed porous layouts interleave functional material with open channels, and the layout that uses the material best depends on how the process settings shape the deposit. Generative models propose layouts quickly, but a generator that does not receive the process setting samples from the same distribution at every setting, even when the process-dependent score ranks candidate layouts differently. This paper examines whether process knowledge can steer a latent diffusion generator toward layouts suited to a given process setting in a prescribed design domain. We formulate a process-dependent utilization score in which a process model sets the length over which the utility of printed material decays with distance from a channel. The generator combines a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) latent representation, a topology U-Net, a ControlNet domain branch, and a separately trained regressor that predicts the score from noised latents; the domain branch conditions each denoising step and the regressor gradient steers it. The method is applied to aerosol jet printing, where the atomizer and sheath gas flows enter the score through the flow-focusing relation. Across seven modeled flow settings, the lowest-scoring candidate layout of a domain differed between settings in 191 of 500 domains. In a sampling study, the mean directly computed score on three validation domains and one test domain was 0.642 with domain conditioning alone, 0.636 at a weight of 300, and 0.450 at 12,000 (112 scores per weight; lower is better). The results support process-knowledge-guided generation as an approach to process-specific porous design under the stated assumptions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于工艺知识的潜扩散生成框架，用工艺相关的利用率评分与回归器梯度引导VQ-VAE潜表示生成器，实现气溶胶喷射打印条件特定的多孔布局设计。
AI.motivation: 印刷多孔布局由功能材料与开放通道交错构成，最佳布局取决于工艺参数如何塑造沉积形态。生成模型虽能快速给出布局，但若生成器在不同工艺设置下不能采样到同一分布，则即便工艺相关评分对候选布局的排序不同，也无法可靠地产生该设置下的最优布局。因此需研究工艺知识能否在给定设计域内引导生成器生成匹配特定工艺设置的布局。
AI.method: 构建工艺相关的利用率评分：由工艺模型设定材料效用随距通道距离衰减的特征长度。生成器结合VQ-VAE潜表示、拓扑U-Net、ControlNet设计域分支，以及一个由加噪潜变量预测评分的独立训练回归器；设计域分支对每一步去噪进行条件化，回归器梯度用于引导去噪。以气溶胶喷射打印为应用实例，雾化气与鞘气流量通过流动聚焦关系进入评分。
AI.result: 在7种建模范艺流量设置下，500个设计域中有191个域的最低评分候选布局随设置不同而变化。采样研究中，三个验证域与一个测试域上直接计算的平均评分为：仅设计域条件化0.642，引导权重300时0.636，权重12000时0.450（每个权重112个评分，越低越好）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将工艺知识引导生成作为在既定假设下实现工艺特定多孔设计的一种可行途径。

title: Dune: A Zeroth-Order Optimizer with Time-Conditioned Historical Error Regression for VLA Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to handle distribution shifts during deployment without source-domain retraining. However, backpropagation-based adaptation incurs heavy memory overhead on resource-constrained robots, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) methods suffer from high estimation variance under limited perturbation budgets. We observe that while ZO estimation enables low-memory adaptation with rapid initial gains, it often stalls or degrades over long-horizon updates due to noisy gradient estimates. To address these limitations, we propose Dune, a zeroth-order optimizer that stabilizes long-horizon adaptation by coupling online historical error prediction with current perturbation observations. Specifically, Dune learns a lightweight, time-conditioned error predictor from past optimization dynamics and fuses its predictions with instantaneous ZO estimates, achieving effective variance reduction without backpropagation or extra forward passes. Additionally, we theoretically characterize how estimation variance restricts convergence in high-dimensional, small-population regimes, motivating the use of historical statistics. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and real-world robots demonstrate that Dune achieves superior success rates under a low memory footprint, with ablations confirming improved closed-loop stability and post-disturbance recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出零阶优化器 Dune，利用历史误差预测与当前扰动观测耦合，在低显存下稳定 VLA 模型的长时程测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型部署时需应对分布偏移，反向传播式 TTA 显存开销大、不适合资源受限机器人；零阶（ZO）方法虽低显存，但在有限扰动预算下估计方差高，长时程更新中易停滞或性能退化。
AI.method: Dune 从历史优化动态中学习轻量级、时间条件化的误差预测器，并将其预测与即时 ZO 梯度估计融合，实现无需反向传播、无需额外前向的方差削减；同时从理论上刻画高维小种群条件下估计方差对收敛的限制，为引入历史统计量提供依据。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与真实机器人实验中，Dune 在低显存占用下取得更优成功率；消融实验证实闭环稳定性与扰动后恢复能力均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以历史统计增强零阶估计是低内存 TTA 的有效途径，可在长时程自适应中兼顾稳定性与性能。

title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building them. To this end, we introduce AppSci-Bench, where we construct a setting akin to how human Applied Scientists build agents for businesses - through eliciting task requirements from stakeholders, exploring the business's infrastructure, and scientifically improve the target agent by designing experiments and internal benchmarks.
