Cross-architecture experiments, visual naturalness ratings, and captioning/VQA transfer analyses further characterize its effectiveness and limitations. These findings reveal that familiar visual symbols from real-world environments can serve as shape-preserving carriers for coordinated targeted semantic attacks across imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出LoSA框架：在保持Logo外形轮廓不变的前提下，优化其内部外观与放置位置，实现对可见光-红外（VIS-IR）视觉语言模型的协同定向语义攻击，属黑盒评分式攻击。
AI.motivation: Logo在衣物与日用品上自然出现，其可识别形状与语义联想使其成为人们熟悉的视觉线索，易于融入真实环境且视觉上不显眼。作者由此提出：能否在不改变Logo原有轮廓的情况下，将其作为跨VIS-IR模态的协同定向语义攻击载体。该设定要求：在固定形状内产生富有表现力的对抗变化，同时兼顾两种模态在外观特征与模型响应上的差异。
AI.method: LoSA为基于评分的黑盒优化框架，保持Logo轮廓、联合优化内部外观与放置位置。具体包含：(1) 用等值线场（contour field）与低频图谱模态（graph spectral modes）构造内部颜色布局；(2) 用冻结的外观适配器（appearance adapter）耦合可见光与红外外观；(3) 用粒子群优化（PSO）联合优化共享设计参数。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，LoSA在同时达到Top-1定向攻击成功率方面一致优于所评估的基线；并通过跨架构实验、视觉自然度评分以及captioning/VQA迁移分析，进一步刻画了方法的有效性与局限。
AI.conclusion: 真实环境中的熟悉视觉符号可作为保持形状的载体，实现跨成像模态的协同定向语义攻击，说明该类物理可实现载体对多模态VLM构成实际威胁。

title: Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models
comment: Submitted to a journal. The journal info will be confirmed once the paper is accepted
summary: Combining fine-tuned models by composing their parameter updates has become a standard alternative to multi-task training. We formalize composability as a property of a collection of task vectors and prove that the excess loss of the merged model is controlled by an interference functional of the cross-task curvature overlap and the signed alignment of the updates. In the quadratic regime this functional equals the excess loss, giving a criterion that is necessary as well as sufficient and that measures the angle between task vectors in the curvature metric rather than the Euclidean one. Fine-tuning under a curvature-guided regularizer -- constructed from curvature statistics of the kind memory-efficient optimizers maintain -- keeps displacement in the base curvature metric below a ceiling set by the penalty coefficient at every iterate, at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ non-convex rate. Under a single Loewner comparison between the base statistic and the task curvatures, this control converts into a ceiling on the interference functional, inversely proportional to the penalty coefficient, so that the curvature term of the bound is controlled during training. A first-order term, present because regularized solutions are not stationary for the task loss, is not reduced in the same way. Experiments on an exact non-quadratic model confirm the budget and the ceiling, show the first-order term dominating for strong penalties, and find the curvature-guided penalty slightly better than an isotropic one. In a three-seed transformer study the functional is rank-correlated with merging degradation, but no more strongly than the Euclidean displacement norm.

AI.tldr: 该文将多任务微调模型的参数更新组合（任务向量合成）形式化为"可组合性"问题，证明合并模型的超额损失由跨任务曲率重叠与更新符号对齐构成的干涉泛函控制，并提出曲率引导正则化器以在训练中控制该泛函。
AI.motivation: 参数更新相加（任务向量合并）已成为多任务训练的标准替代方案，但缺乏理论刻画：什么条件下任务向量可组合、合并后损失退化由什么量决定、训练时能否主动控制这一退化，均不明确。
AI.method: 定义可组合性为任务向量集合的性质；将超额损失上界表示为干涉泛函（由跨任务曲率重叠与更新的有符号对齐构成）。在二次情形下证明该泛函等于超额损失，从而给出充要判据，并表明其衡量的是曲率度量下的夹角而非欧氏夹角。构造基于曲率统计（与内存高效优化器所维护的统计同源）的正则项，在标准 O(1/√T) 非凸收敛率下，保证每次迭代的位移在基准曲率度量下不超过由惩罚系数设定的上限；在基准统计与任务曲率间单一 Loewner 比较下，该控制转化为干涉泛函的上界（与惩罚系数成反比）。一阶项因正则化解对任务损失非驻点而存在，且不被同等削减。实验使用精确非二次模型与三随机种子 Transformer 研究进行验证。
AI.result: 非二次模型实验证实了位移预算与干涉泛函上限；强惩罚下由一阶项主导；曲率引导惩罚略优于各向同性惩罚。Transformer 实验中干涉泛函与合并退化呈秩相关，但相关性不强于欧氏位移范数。
AI.conclusion: 任务向量可组合性可由曲率度量下的干涉泛函刻画，曲率引导正则化能在训练中控制该泛函的曲率部分；但一阶项构成不可消除的残余，且在实际 Transformer 上该泛函相对欧氏位移范数并无预测优势。

title: Hindsight Self-Distillation: Teaching Robots to Act from the Present
summary: A robot must choose an action before it can see the outcome. In a recorded demonstration, later camera frames show what happened after the robot moved. Hindsight Self-Distillation (HSD) uses these later frames to teach a policy what to extract from current images. During training, a teacher sees both the current and later frames, while a student sees the current frames. They share a visual encoder and an action predictor. Each branch summarizes its images with a small set of feature vectors. These visual summaries supply all visual input to the action predictor. The teacher learns from demonstrated actions. For each noisy action sequence, the student learns from either the demonstration or the teacher's denoising prediction. It also learns to match the teacher's visual summaries. We analyze which aspects of the teacher's predictions the student can recover from its inputs. At deployment, the student encodes the current images once and reuses its summaries at every denoising step. HSD achieves average success rates of 98.50\% on LIBERO and 92.31\% on RoboTwin 2.0.

AI.tldr: 提出Hindsight Self-Distillation (HSD)：训练时让"看到未来帧"的教师把视觉摘要知识蒸馏给仅用当前帧的学生，部署时学生单次编码当前图像即可用于整个去噪过程，在LIBERO与RoboTwin 2.0上分别达98.50%与92.31%的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人在看到动作结果前必须选动作，但演示数据中后续相机帧隐含了"动作会带来什么"的信息。若能让策略在当前观测中提取出与未来结果相关的表征，即可提升动作预测质量；同时部署阶段又不能依赖未来帧，因此需要一种不增加推理开销的训练期利用事后信息的方法。
AI.method: 采用非对称双分支自蒸馏框架：教师分支同时输入当前帧与后续帧，学生分支只输入当前帧，二者共享视觉编码器与动作预测器。每个分支用一小组特征向量（视觉摘要）汇总图像，且动作预测器的全部视觉输入仅来自该摘要。教师以演示动作为监督学习；学生针对每条加噪动作序列，监督信号或来自演示动作、或来自教师的去噪预测，并被额外约束对齐教师的视觉摘要。文中还分析了教师预测中哪些部分可由学生输入恢复。部署时学生仅编码当前图像一次，并在每个去噪步复用该摘要。
AI.result: 平均成功率LIBERO 98.50%、RoboTwin 2.0 92.31%；分析表明学生对教师预测的可恢复性依赖于其输入所含信息，摘要对齐是迁移事后知识的关键；单次编码+摘要复用的设计避免了逐步重复编码的开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练期引入未来帧教师并以视觉摘要为蒸馏接口，HSD将"事后视角"的收益转移到纯当前观测的学生策略上，且不增加部署成本，在多个操作基准上取得高成功率。

title: Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models for Cyber Threat Intelligence: An Exploratory Study
comment: Accepted for publication in Computers and Electrical Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cyber threat intelligence (CTI) tasks, such as summarization and question answering. However, they may produce hallucinations, false or misleading content not grounded in the source text, which can mislead analysts and corrupt downstream security decisions. This paper presents an exploratory measurement study of hallucinations in LLM-based CTI. We introduce HalluVision, a reproducible framework that generates LLM outputs, extracts domain-specific entities using a fine-tuned named entity recognition model, and evaluates factual consistency using multiple similarity metrics. Using 4,940 real-world cybersecurity articles, we measure hallucinations in outputs from two commercial LLMs and one open-weight LLM. Measurements are validated against 100 human-annotated outputs and two established faithfulness detectors. Results show that semantic similarity aligns with human judgments, whereas entity-based metrics exhibit limited agreement. Differences between models are concentrated in question answering, while entity extraction quality limits what entity-level metrics can reveal.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于大语言模型（LLM）的网络威胁情报（CTI）任务中的幻觉进行探索性测量，提出可复现框架 HalluVision，基于 4,940 篇真实网络安全文章评估两个商用模型与一个开源权重模型的输出，发现语义相似度指标与人工判断一致，而实体级指标一致性有限。
AI.motivation: LLM 已广泛用于 CTI 的摘要与问答等任务，但其幻觉（不基于源文本的虚假或误导性内容）会误导分析师并污染下游安全决策；然而针对 CTI 领域幻觉的系统性测量尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出 HalluVision 可复现框架：生成 LLM 输出，使用微调的命名实体识别模型抽取领域特定实体，并采用多种相似度指标评估事实一致性；实验使用 4,940 篇真实网络安全文章，覆盖两个商用 LLM 与一个开源权重 LLM，并以 100 条人工标注输出和两个既有忠实度检测器作为验证基准。
AI.result: 语义相似度指标与人工判断一致；基于实体的指标与人工判断一致性有限；模型间差异主要集中在问答任务；实体抽取质量限制了实体级指标可揭示的信息量。
AI.conclusion: CTI 场景下的幻觉测量宜以语义层面的忠实度指标为主，实体级指标需以高质量领域实体抽取为前提；HalluVision 为可复现的领域幻觉评测提供了可行基线。

title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
summary: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.

AI.tldr: 提出VisualTalk-Bench基准与Avatar-O Agent，用于评估"问答驱动的虚拟人视频讲解"，并揭示内容正确性与视觉质量并不保证手势指向准确。
AI.motivation: 视频生成与虚拟人合成技术使"通过视觉化讲解回答用户问题"成为可能，但现有基准很少评估虚拟人是否真的指向其正在讲解的视觉内容（Avatar-Content Pointing），端到端生成器也难以做到手势与具体视觉目标对齐。
AI.method: 构建VisualTalk-Bench：覆盖金融、中英文教育场景，含800条精选参考视频与100条独立评测请求；从内容事实性、语音—视觉一致性、视觉质量、运动平滑度、虚拟人—内容指向五个维度评测。并提出模块化参考实现Avatar-O Agent，引入显式交互规划。对六个agent进行对比实验，并开展26名参与者的用户研究（比较四个agent）。
AI.result: 六种agent的实验显示事实精确度与视觉质量并不保证指向准确；26人用户研究中，Avatar-O Agent在视觉引导、感知指向准确性和讲解有效性三项上获得最高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 指向对齐是当前虚拟人讲解视频的独立关键瓶颈，需要显式交互规划；作者将公开数据与代码，为该任务提供评测与参考基线。

title: Inverse ECG Reconstruction via a Preconditioned Variational Quantum Linear Solver
summary: Inverse electrocardiography (ECG) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface measurements, enabling noninvasive mapping of cardiac electrical activity. However, the reconstruction requires solving dense and ill-conditioned linear systems, whose computational cost grows rapidly with the refined heart mesh. Quantum computing offers new opportunities for solving such systems. This paper presents a hybrid quantum-classical framework for inverse ECG reconstruction, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to apply a quantum linear solver to this problem. We first propose a Laplacian-regularized pre-encoding procedure to reduce the dimension of the system while improving its conditioning. Second, the resulting reduced system is encoded and solved using a coherent variational quantum linear solver (VQLS). Finally, we provide a rigorous theoretical proof establishing that the proposed framework preserves the exact solution of the original reconstruction problem throughout all stages of the computational process. Experimental results on a realistic heart-torso geometry demonstrate that our approach holds significant ability for accurate inverse ECG reconstruction. These findings highlight the potential of quantum solvers for noninvasive cardiac imaging, providing a foundation for further research into quantum-enhanced cardiac assessment and other healthcare applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将量子线性求解器用于逆心电重建，提出"拉普拉斯正则化预编码降维 + 相干变分量子线性求解器(VQLS)"的量子-经典混合框架，并给出该框架在全流程保持原问题精确解的理论证明，在真实心-躯干几何上验证了重建精度。
AI.motivation: 逆心电(ECG)需从体表测量反演心表面电位，以实现心脏电活动的无创标测；但该反演要求解稠密、病态的线性系统，且随心脏网格细化计算代价迅速增长。量子计算为求解此类系统提供了新途径。
AI.method: (1) 提出拉普拉斯正则化预编码步骤，在改善系统条件数的同时降低系统维度；(2) 将降维后的系统编码并用相干变分量子线性求解器(coherent VQLS)求解；(3) 给出严格理论证明，说明该框架在各计算阶段均保持原重建问题的精确解。
AI.result: 在真实的心-躯干几何模型上的实验表明，该方法具备准确进行逆心电重建的显著能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了量子求解器在无创心脏成像中的潜力，为量子增强的心脏评估及其他医疗应用研究奠定基础。

title: ECHO: In-Context Behavior foundation model for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
summary: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) acquire diverse skills through large-scale motion imitation and massively parallel reinforcement learning, yet broad behavioral capability does not ensure precise execution across physical conditions. Without distinguishing the underlying dynamics, policies may favor conservative compromises over environment-specific precision. We introduce ECHO, an in-context BFM that turns interaction experience into environment-specific control, separating general behavioral capability from dynamics-specific execution. Mixed and Annealed Sampling first establishes a behavior prior in a single pretraining stage by balancing targeted practice with broad motion coverage. Building on this prior, Context Representation and Residual Adaptation learns structured dynamics representations from interaction histories to guide residual corrections to the frozen prior, enabling adaptation without test-time parameter updates. Extensive experiments show that ECHO outperforms all baseline methods across diverse motions and physical conditions. Moreover, deployment on the Unitree G1 demonstrates whole-body teleoperation spanning extreme acrobatics and terrain interaction, alongside payload adaptation in manipulation and whole-body control. Page is available at https://mwondering.github.io/echo-bfm/

AI.tldr: ECHO 是一种上下文内（in-context）人形行为基础模型，通过分离"通用行为先验"与"动力学特化执行"，在不更新参数的条件下实现环境自适应控制。
AI.motivation: 现有行为基础模型（BFM）虽通过大规模动作模仿与并行强化学习获得广泛技能，但广泛的行为能力不等于在具体物理条件下的精确执行；若不区分底层动力学，策略往往倾向保守折中，牺牲环境专有的精度。
AI.method: ECHO 分两阶段：1）MixAnnealed Sampling（混合与退火采样）在单一预训练阶段平衡定向练习与广泛动作覆盖，建立行为先验；2）Context Representation and Residual Adaptation 从交互历史中学习结构化动力学表示，用于引导对冻结先验的残差修正，从而无需测试时参数更新即可自适应。
AI.result: 在多样化动作与物理条件下，ECHO 优于所有基线方法；在 Unitree G1 实机上实现涵盖极端技巧动作与地形交互的全身遥操作，并在操作与全身控制中展现负载自适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 将通用行为先验与动力学特化的残差自适应解耦，是一种可行且有效的框架，使基础模型在保持广覆盖的同时获得精确的物理条件专有执行能力。

title: Can an LLM Fix a Language Model Without Training It?
summary: Although an external language model can select and test repairs to another model's weights, behavior can also be recovered through fixed numerical edits. We assessed the value of interactive selection in a controlled study of Transformer repair. After inspecting predictions, activation summaries, and weight statistics, the editor selects projection recipes to apply to the target without gradient updates. We analyzed 20 recorded sessions involving five masked and causal language models, comparing the selected edits with fixed projections, scripted and matched-budget black-box search, and low-rank adaptation. Under the core two-layer fault, live selection matches black-box search on SmolLM2 and Qwen2.5. For Pythia, live selection achieves 65.62% completion accuracy, compared with 0% for black-box search and 66.15% for a fixed projection. Under a separate compound fault affecting attention and feed-forward weights, both scripted and LLM-guided selection increase the descriptive five-checkpoint mean from 24.89% to 71.25% using the same operator family. On unmodified checkpoints, scripted projection yields small gains or losses on a separate set of framed questions. The experiments identify cases in which feedback changes an edit decision, operator coverage accounts for recovery, or supervised adaptation performs better. Combined with measurements of parameter restoration and preservation, these comparisons establish the scope of controller-guided repair for the tested faults and completion tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文以受控实验研究"交互式选择"在Transformer权重修复中的价值：编辑者通过查看预测、激活摘要与权重统计来人工选择投影配方（无需梯度更新），并将其与固定投影、脚本化/等预算黑盒搜索及低秩适配(LoRA)进行对比，结果表明实时选择并非普遍优于固定编辑，其收益取决于故障类型与算子覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 已有工作显示外部语言模型可以挑选并检验对另一模型权重的"修复"，但行为是否也能通过固定的数值编辑（而非交互式搜索）恢复尚不清楚。作者希望检验交互式选择/反馈在权重修复中的实际贡献，界定"控制器引导修复"的适用范围。
AI.method: 开展Transformer修复的受控研究：编辑者在检查预测结果、激活摘要与权重统计后，为目标模型选择投影配方（projection recipe）并直接施加，不做梯度更新。共分析20次记录会话，涉及5个掩码语言模型与因果语言模型；对照组包括固定投影、脚本化选择、匹配预算的黑盒搜索以及LoRA。实验覆盖两类故障：核心两层故障（two-layer fault），以及同时影响注意力与前馈权重的复合故障（compound fault）。此外在未修改的checkpoint上用一组框定问题测量参数恢复度与保持度。
AI.result: 核心两层故障下，实时选择在SmolLM2与Qwen2.5上与黑盒搜索持平；在Pythia上实时选择达到65.62%完成准确率，黑盒搜索为0%，固定投影为66.15%。复合故障下，脚本化选择与LLM引导选择均将该描述性五checkpoint均值由24.89%提升至71.25%（同一算子族）。在未修改的checkpoint上，脚本化投影在另一组框定问题上仅有小幅增益或损失。实验同时指出反馈改变编辑决策、算子覆盖度解释恢复效果、以及监督式适配更优的具体情形。
AI.conclusion: 交互式选择的价值是有条件的：在许多情形下固定数值编辑已足以恢复行为，反馈带来的增益体现在特定故障与算子覆盖条件下；结合参数恢复与保持度测量，本文界定了控制器引导修复在所测故障与补全任务上的有效范围。

title: Beyond Resemblance: Image Fusion Reimagined
summary: Image fusion often lacks ground-truth fused images, forcing existing deep methods to indirectly define fusion objectives by requiring the fused image to simultaneously resemble multiple source images. However, the distinct imaging characteristics of different modalities can impose competing constraints on the fused result, potentially limiting the effective integration of their complementary information. To address this long-standing challenge facing the image fusion community, we propose ApexFuse, a novel generative image fusion paradigm that moves beyond source-resemblance constraints toward learning a general distribution of high-quality scene representations. Specifically, we develop a human-LMM-in-the-loop pipeline that leverages large multimodal generative models and iterative human feedback to translate abstract fusion objectives into reliable visual references, thereby defining the target distribution of ideal fusion outcomes. Through target-distribution-guided adaptation, we transfer the rich generative priors of pretrained FLUX to image fusion, enabling high-quality scene reconstruction conditioned on multimodal observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ApexFuse harmoniously integrates salient thermal targets, natural colors, and fine textures, achieving superior visual quality as well as semantic segmentation and object detection performance over previous source-resemblance methods. Moreover, ApexFuse exhibits remarkable cross-task generalization, extending from infrared-visible fusion to multi-exposure fusion, multi-focus fusion, and visible-depth fusion without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ApexFuse 提出一种超越"源图像相似性"约束的生成式图像融合范式：借助人-LMM 在环流程定义理想融合结果的目标分布，并以目标分布引导将 FLUX 生成先验迁移到图像融合任务。
AI.motivation: 图像融合缺乏真值融合图像，现有深度方法只能通过要求融合结果同时接近多张源图像来间接定义目标；但不同模态成像特性差异导致约束相互竞争，可能抑制互补信息的有效整合。
AI.method: 1) 构建 human-LMM-in-the-loop 流程，利用大型多模态生成模型与迭代人工反馈，将抽象融合目标转化为可靠视觉参考，从而定义理想融合结果的目标分布；2) 通过目标分布引导的自适应，将预训练 FLUX 的丰富生成先验迁移至图像融合，实现以多模态观测为条件的高质量场景重建。
AI.result: 实验表明 ApexFuse 能协调融合显著热目标、自然色彩与细节纹理，在视觉质量、语义分割和目标检测上优于既往源相似性方法；并具备显著跨任务泛化性，无需额外微调即可从红外-可见光融合扩展到多曝光融合、多聚焦融合与可见光-深度融合。
AI.conclusion: 以"学习高质量场景表示的一般分布"替代源相似性约束，是解决图像融合长期难题的有效途径；生成式先验结合人类反馈定义目标分布，可同时提升融合质量与跨任务泛化性。

title: FamilySpace: From Emergent Chemical Semantics to Controllable Crystal Generation
summary: Latent crystal generative models typically combine a variational autoencoder (VAE) for learning atom-wise representations with a flow model that transports a simple source distribution to the learned latent distribution. However, previous studies have mainly focused on the quality of generated crystals, leaving the structure and generative utility of the atom-wise latent space largely unexplored. In this work, we show that even a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations according to elemental families, with different families occupying largely separated regions of the latent space. We term this phenomenon emergent chemical semantics. This structure suggests that sampling from a family-specific latent region can bias the decoder toward atoms from the corresponding elemental family. Building on this insight, we propose FamilySpace, a framework for controlling the elemental-family composition of generated crystals. FamilySpace assigns each elemental family a distinct source component, forming a family-indexed multi-source distribution, and trains a flow model using source-target pairs matched by family. In inference, a user-specified family template selects the source component for each atom-wise representation, enabling direct control over the family composition of generated crystals. Experiments on MP-20 and MPTS-52 show that FamilySpace achieves competitive crystal-generation performance while matching prescribed elemental-family compositions. Moreover, selected family templates increase the fraction of generated crystals predicted to be stable or metastable, demonstrating that latent-space composition control can support targeted exploration of promising chemical regions without additional optimization techniques such as reinforcement learning. Code is available at https://github.com/hhw11/FamilySpace

AI.tldr: 晶体VAE的原子级隐空间会自发按元素族组织（涌现化学语义），据此提出FamilySpace：为每个元素族分配独立源分量，用族匹配的源-目标配对训练流模型，以用户给定的族模板控制生成晶体的元素族组成。
AI.motivation: 已有潜空间晶体生成模型（VAE+流模型）主要关注生成质量，忽视原子级隐空间的结构与生成效用，缺乏对生成晶体元素组成的可控性。
AI.method: 先揭示朴素晶体VAE的原子级隐表示按元素族（elemental family）自发聚类、族间区域显著分离，称为"涌现化学语义"；据此设计FamilySpace：为每个元素族设置独立源分量构成族索引的多源分布，用按族匹配的源-目标配对训练流模型；推理时由用户指定族模板为每个原子表示选择对应源分量，从而直接控制元素族组成。
AI.result: 在MP-20与MPTS-52上，FamilySpace在匹配指定元素族组成的同时取得有竞争力的晶体生成性能；特定族模板还能提升生成晶体被预测为稳定/亚稳的比例，表明无需强化学习等额外优化即可实现对有前景化学区域的定向探索。
AI.conclusion: 隐空间的语义结构可被显式利用为可控生成接口；对元素族组成的隐空间控制能有效引导晶体生成朝向目标化学区域，兼具生成质量与可控性。

title: Collision-Free Is Not Enough: Passage-Conditioned Navigation for Wheeled-Legged Robots
summary: A collision-free detour can still bring a legged robot to the next stair or ledge a few centimetres or degrees off, and a fixed locomotion skill, factory or learned, can stall or fall. Existing methods prevent this with a robot model or extensive trial and error, but on a new site with unknown skills neither is available, so they cannot be used. We find that a single 27-minute teaching session already supplies what these methods have to derive or learn: for every stair and ledge, one crossing the skill has completed. Our method, passage-conditioned navigation, makes the route remember how each transition was entered, not only where the path went. It stores each taught crossing as an event and, without training or a robot model, enforces it after every local replan: before each ledge, an entry gate makes the robot turn or back up and retry if it is more than 10 cm or 10° off the taught crossing. Under localization noise, with path, gait schedule, and sensing unchanged, this raises the share of disturbed ledge crossings that stay within these limits from 24.1% to 88.6%. In contact simulation with our learned policies, a robot pushed off course before stairs never falls in 180 climbs, against 9 falls when the stored direction is ignored; pushed 1.2 m away, it rejoins the route, ending on average 0.14 m from it (1.10 m without rejoining), and finishes as often as an undisturbed robot. This suits any robot with fixed skills that repeats a route over terrain transitions, as in inspection and patrol, where one wrong entry can end the task. We deployed it in competition on a real wheeled-legged robot: over 271 m of multi-obstacle terrain spanning 7.0 m of elevation, it completed all six runs, won third place at the 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge, which drew 2,999 submissions, and was the only finalist in its task to finish fully autonomously.

AI.tldr: 提出“通行走廊条件导航”（passage-conditioned navigation）：将一次教学示范中每处台阶/边缘的跨越方式存为事件，在每次局部重规划后强制执行“入口门”约束，使固定运动技能在扰动下仍能可靠通过地形过渡。
AI.motivation: 无碰撞绕行仍可能使足式机器人以几厘米或几度的偏差进入下一级台阶或边缘，导致固定（出厂或学习的）运动技能卡死或摔倒。现有方法依赖机器人模型或大量试错来防止这一问题，但在未知场地、技能未知时二者均不可得。
AI.method: 观察到单次27分钟教学即可为每个台阶/边缘提供一次成功跨越实例。方法将每次教学跨越记录为“事件”，在不训练、不用机器人模型的前提下，于每次局部重规划后强制执行：在每个边缘前设置“入口门”，若机器人偏离教学跨越超过10 cm或10°，则令其转向或后退并重试；路径、步态时序与感知保持不变。
AI.result: 定位噪声下，受扰动边缘跨越中保持在限差内的比例从24.1%提升至88.6%。接触仿真中使用学习策略：上台阶前被推离路线，180次攀爬零摔倒（忽略存储方向时为9次摔倒）；被推离1.2 m后能重新汇入路线，平均距路线0.14 m（不重汇为1.10 m），完成率与未受扰动时相当。实机部署于轮足机器人，271 m多障碍地形、7.0 m落差，六次运行全部完成，获2026全球开源AI挑战赛第三名（2,999份提交），且为该任务唯一全自主完赛的决赛队伍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于重复固定路线、跨越地形过渡的任意固定技能机器人，如巡检与巡逻场景（一次错误进入即可终止任务）；无需模型与训练，仅凭一次教学即可显著提升鲁棒性，并已在真实竞赛中验证。

title: Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

AI.tldr: 提出LAQ，一种latent-aware的4比特量化框架（W4A4KV4），通过保护未来预测（latent）的保真度来提升world action models在机器人端侧部署的性能，在LIBERO-Plus与真实机械臂上接近16比特模型表现。
AI.motivation: World action models（WAMs）先预测未来场景演化再据此条件化动作，端侧部署需要4比特权重、激活与KV cache（W4A4KV4）。现有4比特量化器只保护生成的动作，并按单步去噪估计敏感性，因而无法保证预测未来的保真度：一旦动作通路被保护，剩余动作误差主要来自被退化的未来预测，而没有任何方法刻意保护它。
AI.method: LAQ包含三部分：（1）reader metric，以未来误差对动作的影响来度量未来误差；（2）read count，按读取该舍入误差的去噪步数对每个舍入误差加权；二者共同给出激活与cache精度分配的闭式解；（3）gaze-guided refinement，在去噪循环与cache中对动作所关注的token进行第二次4比特量化。全部权重保持4比特，无高精度分支，无需逐任务重校准。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus上，Fast-WAM与Cosmos-Policy分别达到76.4%与83.3%平均成功率，与16比特模型相差在1.2个百分点内，且均高于配备16比特KV cache的基线。模型压缩3.8倍，整个策略峰值GPU显存降低2.3倍，推理速度较16比特模型快1.66倍。在真实AgileX PiPER机械臂上三个任务平均成功率47.0%，对比16比特模型52.0%，较QuaRot高30.0%。
AI.conclusion: 在WAMs中，保护预测未来（latent）的保真度是4比特量化的关键失效点；LAQ通过面向读取者（动作）的误差度量、按读取次数的误差加权以及gaze引导的二次精化，以纯4比特配置、无高精度分支的方式实现了接近16比特的精度，并在端侧带来显著的压缩、显存与速度收益。

title: Lossless Latent Diffusion Models
summary: We study the problem of training image diffusion models while preserving pixel-exact reconstruction. Prior works typically address this problem by directly modeling images in pixel space, requiring modifications to the diffusion training objective or model architecture. In this work, we introduce a different paradigm: rather than modifying diffusion models, we construct a lossless transformation that maps pixels into a representation more amenable to diffusion modeling. We term our approach the Lossless Latent Diffusion Model (LLDM). We construct LLDM using residual latent transformation and uneven latent scaling, and explain its effectiveness through a proposed metric, semantic rank priority (SRP). Empirically, LLDM substantially outperforms prior pixel-space diffusion models in generation quality and even surpasses several widely used lossy VAEs. Furthermore, we show that SRP is strongly correlated with downstream generative performance.

AI.tldr: 提出无损潜空间扩散模型（LLDM）：不改动扩散模型本身，而是构造一个像素无损的可逆变换，把图像映射到更适合扩散建模的潜表示，从而在保持像素级精确重建的同时显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有实现像素级精确重建的扩散模型通常直接在像素空间建模，需要对扩散训练目标或模型架构做修改，代价较高且效果受限。作者希望换一种思路：保持扩散模型不变，转而优化其所建模的表示空间。
AI.method: 构造一个无损（可逆）变换，将像素映射到更利于扩散建模的表示；具体由两部分组成——残差潜变换（residual latent transformation）与非均匀潜缩放（uneven latent scaling）；并提出语义秩优先级（semantic rank priority, SRP）指标用于解释该设计为何有效。
AI.result: 在实验中，LLDM 的生成质量大幅优于以往的像素空间扩散模型，甚至超过若干广泛使用的有损 VAE；同时 SRP 与下游生成性能呈强相关。
AI.conclusion: 无需修改扩散目标或架构，仅通过设计合适的无损潜表示即可兼顾像素精确重建与高质量生成；SRP 可作为衡量表示适配性的有效代理指标。

title: Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback
comment: Submitted to a journal and details will be confirmed once paper accepted
summary: Analyses of error feedback bound the memory buffer through a compressor contraction constant -- $r/p$ for the best rank-$r$ approximation of a $p$-dimensional spectrum -- which survives into the rate. We show it need not appear at all. When the compressed momentum is re-injected into the pre-compression accumulator, the previous compressed momentum $β_1 M_{t-1}$ is an admissible competitor in the projection, and the buffer obeys $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-β_1)\|G_t\|_F + γ\|E_{t-1}\|_F$, free of the dimensions $m,n$ and of the rank $r$. The argument uses only that the compressor is a metric projection onto a closed cone, so it covers top-$k$ selection as well as truncated SVD, holds for every selection from the projection set with no condition on singular-value crossings, and in its trajectory-tracking form assumes nothing about the gradients. In the two-stage template of the standard analyses it replaces a Stage-2 constant of order $p^2/r^2$ by one of order $1$, against $Θ(p/r)$ for the sharpest contraction-based bounds. Transferring the full rate costs a leakage term, which we bound by the step-weighted gradient mass $\sum_{u\le t}η_u\|G_u\|_F$ and show tight up to a factor $\sqrt{2}$; the price is an additive $O(\log^2 T)$ floor, not a slower rate. On BERT fine-tuning at rank ratio $32/768$ the feedback decay costs under $0.008$ validation $F_1$.

AI.tldr: 论文证明：当压缩动量被回注到压缩前累加器时，误差反馈界不再依赖压缩器的收缩常数 $r/p$、维度 $m,n$ 与秩 $r$，而仅满足 $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-\beta_1)\|G_t\|_F + \gamma\|E_{t-1}\|_F$，从而把标准分析中的 Stage-2 常数从 $O(p^2/r^2)$ 降至 $O(1)$，且理论无额外收敛速率损失。
AI.motivation: 现有误差反馈分析通过压缩器收缩常数（最优秩-$r$ 近似的 $r/p$）界定内存缓冲，该因子会渗入收敛速率，导致秩越小、维度越大时界越松。作者希望消除这一维度/秩依赖，得到更紧、更普适的压缩优化收敛理论。
AI.method: 利用压缩器仅为闭锥上的度量投影这一性质，将上一时刻压缩动量 $\beta_1 M_{t-1}$ 作为投影集内的可行竞争者，直接推出不含 $m,n,r$ 的误差递推；该论证覆盖 top-$k$ 选择与截断 SVD，且对投影集内任意选择成立、无需奇异值分离条件；轨迹跟踪形式对梯度不做假设。随后通过泄漏项（步长加权梯度质量 $\sum_{u\le t}\eta_u\|G_u\|_F$）把缓冲界传递到完整速率，并证明该泄漏界紧至 $\sqrt{2}$ 因子。
AI.result: 两阶段模板中 Stage-2 常数由 $p^2/r^2$ 量级替换为 $1$ 量级（对比收缩类紧界的 $\Theta(p/r)$）；泄漏项引入加性 $O(\log^2 T)$ 下限而非减慢速率；泄漏界最坏情形紧至 $\sqrt{2}$。BERT 微调在秩比 $32/768$ 下验证 $F_1$ 损失低于 $0.008$。
AI.conclusion: 误差反馈的维度依赖源于分析技巧而非算法本质：动量回注使缓冲界与秩、维度解耦，代价仅为加性对数项，实验损失可忽略，为低秩/稀疏压缩优化提供了更紧的收敛理论。

title: Design and Validation of a Telescopic Chassis-Assisted Stair-Climbing Mechanism for Powered Wheelchairs
summary: We propose a simple stair traversal mechanism that augments a four-wheel wheelchair with an auxiliary telescopic chassis actuator. The proposed mechanism provides the following key contributions during stair ascent: (A) enhanced safety by ensuring that either the front or rear wheels remain stationary at all times; (B) primary reliance of the required force and mechanical work on the telescopic chassis rather than the wheels; (C) insensitivity of the required force and mechanical work to stair inclination; and (D) reduced risk of wheel slip on steeper stairs. In addition, the telescopic chassis is expected to improve level-ground mobility by enabling tight turning with the shortest wheelbase and enhancing stability with the longest wheelbase.

AI.tldr: 提出一种为四轮轮椅加装辅助伸缩底盘执行器的简易爬楼机构，安全、低力、抗坡度、防滑，并兼顾平地转向与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 普通四轮轮椅难以安全爬楼：轮式爬楼存在前后轮同时悬空导致的失稳风险、所需驱动力与机械功大、受楼梯倾角影响明显，且在陡坡上易发生打滑。
AI.method: 在四轮轮椅上加装辅助伸缩底盘执行器（telescopic chassis actuator），构建阶梯越障机构；通过让前轮或后轮始终有一组保持静止的交替支撑策略，使所需力与机械功主要由伸缩底盘承担而非车轮。
AI.result: 爬楼过程中：(A) 任意时刻至少前轮或后轮保持静止，提升安全性；(B) 所需驱动力与机械功主要由伸缩底盘承担，而非车轮；(C) 所需力与功对楼梯倾角不敏感；(D) 降低陡梯上的车轮打滑风险。同时伸缩底盘可实现最短轴距的紧凑转向与最长轴距的高稳定性，改善平地机动性。
AI.conclusion: 该伸缩底盘辅助机构以简单结构同时实现安全爬楼与平地性能优化，具备安全、省力、抗坡度与防滑优势，可作为四轮轮椅爬楼能力的低成本增强方案。

title: Cyber-Physical RSI for AI-RAN: A Case Study
summary: Learned models for radio access networks (RANs) are often developed using simulation, yet their predictions can shift when exposed to physical propagation conditions, protocol behavior, and equipment implementations. This paper presents a cyber-physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework for AI-RAN that connects a task-oriented student model, an experiment-planning coach agent, a calibratable virtual environment, and a physical host agent. Physical measurements are organized as evidence for both model adaptation and subsequent experiment planning. We examine an implementation of the physical-feedback pathway using ping-pong handover as a case study. The system completes 12 physical executions organized into six baseline--candidate pairs, updates the student from measured outcomes, and evaluates the revised model on reserved physical configurations. In the observed short-window tests, increasing the time-to-trigger from 320 to 1280\,ms changes the ping-pong count from three to zero. The updated student achieves a grouped-validation mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.673 round trips/min, while a common three-configuration physical evaluation yields MAEs of 1.240 and 1.601 round trips/min for the pre-feedback and post-feedback models, respectively. These results characterize both the operational feedback loop and the parameter-dependent generalization behavior revealed by new physical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向AI-RAN的"信息物理递归自我改进(RSI)"框架，将任务型学生模型、实验规划教练智能体、可校准虚拟环境与物理宿主智能体闭环连接，并以乒乓切换为案例验证物理反馈通路。
AI.motivation: RAN学习模型多基于仿真训练，但面对真实传播条件、协议行为与设备实现时预测会漂移，需要让仿真模型通过物理实验反馈持续自我改进。
AI.method: 构建四组件RSI框架：任务型学生模型、实验规划教练智能体、可校准虚拟环境、物理宿主智能体；物理测量作为证据同时用于模型自适应与后续实验规划。以乒乓切换为案例，完成12次物理执行、组成6组"基线—候选"配对，用实测结果更新学生模型，并在预留物理配置上评估更新后模型。
AI.result: 短窗口测试中，time-to-trigger由320 ms增至1280 ms使乒乓次数由3降至0；更新后学生在分组验证上MAE为2.673 往返/min；常规三配置物理评估下，反馈前/后模型MAE分别为1.240与1.601 往返/min。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了可运行的物理反馈闭环，并揭示新物理实验所显现的参数依赖泛化行为——物理反馈并非必然提升精度，泛化受配置依赖影响。

title: CANDOR: Contrastive Self-Denoising Rewards for Label-Free Text-to-Image Post-Training
summary: Post-training text-to-image generators with reinforcement learning usually relies on external reward models that need annotated preferences or auxiliary evaluators and are prone to reward hacking. We show that the generator's own denoising accuracy, used by a recent intrinsic reward, is a poor proxy for prompt fidelity. Within a same-prompt group, this absolute self-confidence is dominated by image complexity and ranks correct samples above incorrect ones near chance. We introduce CANDOR (Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio), the log-ratio of unconditional to conditional denoising errors under shared noise probes, which measures how much the prompt helps the model denoise its own sample. It cancels prompt-independent difficulty that scales both errors and ranks the better of two same-prompt samples higher in 60% and 63% of pairs on compositional generation and text rendering. As the only Flow-GRPO reward for a flow-matching model, CANDOR improves text rendering, aesthetic and human-preference scores over the base model and a prior absolute self-confidence reward, with text-rendering and preference gains that stronger classifier-free guidance does not reproduce. On public Flow-GRPO adapters trained on external rewards, CANDOR further raises PickScore and ImageReward, so it can complement those rewards. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/candor.

AI.tldr: 提出CANDOR：用共享噪声探针下“无条件/条件去噪误差的对数比”作为内在奖励，替代外部奖励模型对文生图生成器做强化学习后训练。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的文生图后训练依赖需要标注偏好或辅助评估器的外部奖励模型，易被reward hacking。已有的“生成器自身去噪准确率”内在奖励是prompt保真度的劣质代理：同一prompt组内，这种绝对自置信度主要被图像复杂度主导，对正确与错误样本的区分接近随机。
AI.method: CANDOR（Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio）：在同一噪声探针下，计算无条件去噪误差与条件去噪误差的log-ratio，度量prompt对模型去噪自身样本的帮助程度；该比值可消去随prompt无关、同时放大两个误差的难度因子。作为Flow-GRPO中流匹配模型的唯一奖励使用，并与先前绝对自置信度奖励、更强CFG及公开Flow-GRPO适配器对比。
AI.result: 同prompt样本对中排名更优样本的准确率达60%（组合生成）与63%（文本渲染）；作为唯一奖励时在文本渲染、美学与人类偏好分数上优于基座模型与绝对自置信度奖励，且文本渲染与偏好增益无法由更强classifier-free guidance复现；在基于外部奖励训练的公开Flow-GRPO适配器上进一步提升PickScore与ImageReward。
AI.conclusion: 自去噪置信度不是prompt保真度的可靠信号；以空条件为参照的对比式log-ratio内在奖励无需外部奖励模型即可有效提升生成质量，并可与外部奖励互补。

title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including appendix. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/WeightCode
summary: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. WeightCode, a WSP framework, uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new computations into trained neural networks using task knowledge and their existing weights, without gradient-based training. Once installed, the new capabilities run independently of the language model. Given a grammar or eight demonstrations, weight programs enable previously unseen command compositions (0% to 99.8% exact match) and a new pickup action (0% to 98.4% success), while preserving the original command and navigation capabilities. On ImageNet, four weight programs achieve net gains of 8.84-17.62 points while preserving clean accuracy, outperforming the best of eight fine-tuning methods under matched examples, checks, and retention constraints. In a Vision Transformer, causal interventions show that installed noise-correction gates drive robustness gains, while their selective activation preserves clean accuracy. Rerun on five independently trained Vision Transformers without further language model calls, ten weight programs retain 83-110% of their source-network gains on average, whereas copying their fixed weight edits yields negligible gains. Six programs written for an already edited network add 5.23-14.50 points of contrast robustness while retaining the previously installed noise gain. Together, these results establish WSP as a new route to acquiring and accumulating capabilities in trained neural networks through reusable weight programs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Weight-Space Programming (WSP) 范式及 WeightCode 框架，用冻结的语言模型编写可执行"权重程序"直接读写/构造网络权重，在无梯度训练的情况下向已训练网络安装新能力，并验证其可迁移、可累积、可因果验证。
AI.motivation: 神经网络将能力编码于权重中，但如何在不重新训练的前提下、用显式任务知识扩展这些能力仍是根本性难题。现有微调需梯度优化、需数据、易遗忘原有能力；作者希望像写代码一样直接"编程"权重来安装新计算。
AI.method: WeightCode：由冻结的语言模型生成可执行权重程序，程序直接读取、构造或修改目标网络的权重，结合任务知识与现有权重把新计算植入网络，全程无梯度训练；安装完成后新能力运行不依赖语言模型。评测覆盖命令组合泛化（语法或八条示范）、新动作安装（pickup）、ImageNet 鲁棒性（对比八种微调方法，匹配样本、检查点与保持性约束）、ViT 上的因果干预、跨五个独立训练 ViT 的重跑实验，以及在已编辑网络上叠加新程序。
AI.result: 命令组合精确匹配由 0% 升至 99.8%，pickup 成功率 0%→98.4%，且保留原命令与导航能力；ImageNet 上四个权重程序带来 8.84–17.62 点净提升并保持干净精度，优于八种微调中的最佳者；ViT 因果干预显示"噪声校正门"驱动鲁棒性增益且选择性激活保护干净精度；五个独立 ViT 重跑时十个程序平均保留源网络增益的 83–110%，而直接复制固定权重编辑几乎无增益；为已编辑网络编写的六个程序再增 5.23–14.50 点对比度鲁棒性并保留此前的噪声增益。
AI.conclusion: WSP 为在已训练神经网络中获取与累积能力开辟了新路径：权重程序可复用、可跨网络迁移、可叠加累积，且能力安装后脱离语言模型独立运行。

title: Learning-Based System Identification for DVL-Constrained AUV Localization
summary: Nowadays, most AUVs utilize Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) and inertial measurement units (IMUs) to achieve satisfactory dead-reckoning results. However, the DVL bottom lock may not be available in some scenarios, such as moving over a soft bottom or traveling further away from the seafloor beyond the DVL's range. As a result, the localization system solely reliant on the IMU data will experience significant drift. The relatively high cost of DVLs also inhibits multirobot or swarm operations. In this article, we present the results of using fully connected feedforward neural networks to predict vehicle velocity (surge, sway, and heave) for AUV localization. Approximation functions for the vehicle velocities are derived based on the generalized six degree-of-freedom dynamic equation and kinematics, proving that they are suitable for feedforward neural networks with measurable inputs. The neural networks are trained using field data collected using an AUV. An ablation study was conducted to investigate the impacts of hyperparameters, and the most effective models were selected using the Akaike information criterion. The selected neural network models are tested on three new sets of mission data collected on two different days. The quantitative results show that localization using vehicle velocities predicted by neural networks yields lower averaged root-mean-square distance errors and standard deviation compared to the DVL-aided dead-reckoning method. However, the extent of this improvement was found to depend on ocean current conditions. The promising results show that lightweight fully connected feedforward neural networks offer an attractive approach for inertial-based underwater localization when DVLs or their measurements are not available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用全连接前馈神经网络从可测输入预测AUV三轴速度（surge/sway/heave），替代DVL辅助以实现基于惯导的水下定位，并在多个新航次数据上验证其优于DVL辅助航位推算。
AI.motivation: AUV通常依赖DVL+IMU做航位推算，但DVL在软底质、超出量程（离底过远）等场景下会失去底跟踪；此时仅靠IMU会导致定位显著漂移。此外DVL成本较高，制约多机器人/集群作业。因此希望找到低成本、不依赖DVL测量的速度估计替代方案。
AI.method: 基于广义六自由度动力学方程与运动学推导车辆速度的近似函数，论证其适配以可测量为输入的前馈神经网络；用实测AUV现场数据训练全连接前馈网络预测三轴速度；通过消融实验分析超参数影响，并以Akaike信息准则（AIC）选择最优模型；在两天采集的三组新任务数据上测试，量化对比所提方法与DVL辅助航位推算的定位误差（平均RMSE与标准差）。
AI.result: 定量结果显示：使用神经网络预测速度进行定位，其平均RMSE距离误差与标准差均低于DVL辅助的航位推算方法；但改进幅度依赖于海流条件。最优模型由AIC在超参数消融中选出。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级全连接前馈神经网络为DVL不可用或其测量缺失情形下的惯性基水下定位提供了有吸引力的方案；性能受海流影响，提示后续需考虑环境自适应或海流补偿。

title: MambaLIFT: Reference-Based Mechanism-Aware Attribution for VMamba
summary: Attributing predictions of visual state-space models remains challenging because input-dependent selective dynamics couple feature selection, recurrent state propagation, and shared computational pathways. We introduce MambaLIFT, a reference-based, multiplier-first attribution framework for VMamba that propagates contributions through its computational graph using interaction-aware rules for selective-scan injection, recurrent memory, LayerNorm, and shared pathways. MambaLIFT decomposes the reference-relative class-logit difference, \(f_c(x)-f_c(x^0)\), by spatial position, VSS block, scan direction, and computational mechanism. Experiments on ImageNet-1K evaluate VMamba-T and VMamba-B, with hyperparameters selected on a calibration set and faithfulness assessed on a disjoint held-out evaluation set. MambaLIFT achieves numerical conservation to floating-point precision across audited attribution interfaces in both configurations. Under mean-colour pixel flipping, it achieves significantly higher mean faithfulness scores than MambaLRP on both configurations and the highest scores among the evaluated methods, including Integrated Gradients with matched references. Under blurred replacement, MambaLIFT is non-inferior to MambaLRP on VMamba-T and equivalent on VMamba-B, indicating that its advantage depends on the replacement protocol. Ablations on VMamba-T show that interaction allocation, temporal propagation, and pathway composition affect attribution maps. Mechanism-level analyses further show that exact relevance conservation does not imply additive effects under finite interventions: the mechanism decomposition accounts for the reference-relative logit difference but does not estimate intervention effects or establish causal validity.

AI.tldr: MambaLIFT：面向VMamba的基于参考、乘法优先的归因框架，沿计算图传播贡献并分解类logit差，在ImageNet-1K上实现浮点精度级守恒，平均颜色翻转下忠实度优于MambaLRP与IG，但优势依赖替换协议。
AI.motivation: 视觉状态空间模型（如VMamba）的预测归因困难：输入相关的选择性动态将特征选择、循环状态传播与共享计算路径耦合在一起，现有归因方法（如MambaLRP）难以准确刻画其贡献分配。
AI.method: 提出MambaLIFT——一种基于参考的、乘法优先（multiplier-first）的归因框架，针对选择性扫描注入、循环记忆、LayerNorm及共享路径设计交互感知的传播规则，将参考相对类logit差f_c(x)-f_c(x^0)按空间位置、VSS块、扫描方向与计算机制分解；在ImageNet-1K上评估VMamba-T与VMamba-B，超参在标定集选取、忠实度在独立留出集评估，并配合消融与机制级分析。
AI.result: 在两种配置的所有审计归因接口上达到浮点精度级数值守恒；平均颜色像素翻转下平均忠实度显著高于MambaLRP，并在所评方法（含匹配参考的Integrated Gradients）中得分最高；模糊替换下在VMamba-T不劣于MambaLRP、VMamba-B上相当。消融显示交互分配、时间传播与路径组合均影响归因图；机制分析表明精确相关性守恒并不意味有限干预下的可加效应。需注意其优势依赖替换协议，且机制分解不估计干预效应、不确立因果有效性。
AI.conclusion: MambaLIFT为VMamba类选择性状态空间模型提供了可分解、数值守恒的归因方案，在多维（位置/块/扫描方向/机制）上给出细粒度解释；但其忠实度优势受替换协议制约，机制级贡献不等同于干预因果效应，使用时需谨慎解读。

title: RemoteVLPG: How to Obtain a Specific VLM for Language-Guided Path Generation on Remote Sensing Images?
summary: We study how to obtain a task-specific Vision-Language Model (VLM) for language-guided path generation between start and end points on remote sensing images. We explore this question from three aspects. First, we implement three widely used architectural approaches and compare their performance. Second, we design a scalable method for constructing pre-training data and build an effective pre-training dataset with a degree of diversity. Methods trained on this dataset achieve promising zero-shot performance. Third, we construct three benchmarks that support stratified evaluation and design three metrics for path generation. We investigate this problem through extensive experiments. The results show that the zero-shot performance of methods trained on the constructed pre-training dataset can exceed that of some advanced commercial VLMs. Code and Dataset can be available at https://github.com/jzdang/RemoteVLPG

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向遥感图像的"语言引导路径生成"任务专用视觉语言模型（VLM），从架构对比、预训练数据构建、评测基准与指标三方面展开系统性探索。
AI.motivation: 现有通用/商业VLM难以直接胜任遥感图像上由语言指令驱动的起终点路径生成任务，且该方向缺乏统一的架构参照、可扩展的预训练数据与分层评测体系。
AI.method: 1) 实现并对比三种主流架构方案；2) 设计可扩展的预训练数据构造流程，构建具多样性的有效预训练数据集；3) 构建三个支持分层评估的基准，并设计三项路径生成评测指标；在此基础上开展大量实验分析。
AI.result: 基于所构建预训练数据集训练的方法展现出良好的零样本性能，其零样本表现可超过部分先进商业VLM；三种架构的性能差异得到对比性结论。
AI.conclusion: 针对遥感语言引导路径生成，任务专用VLM可通过合理架构选择与可扩展预训练数据构造获得强零样本能力，配套的分层基准与指标为后续研究提供评估基础；代码与数据集已开源。

title: Sequential Probability Assignment against Smoothed Adversaries with Unknown Base Measure
summary: Smoothed online learning has recently been studied as a way to bypass hardness results for the fully adversarial setting, which can be overly pessimistic. In this framework, the adversary is constrained to generate contexts from distributions having a bounded density with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$. Prior work makes the strong assumption that $μ$ is known to the learner, with notable exceptions including Block et al. (2024) and Blanchard (2025). In this paper, we study sequential probability assignment (a.k.a., online learning with log loss) with smooth, well-specified data in the more general setting where $μ$ is \emph{unknown}, without the Lipschitz condition imposed in the work of Block et al. (2024) and Blanchard (2025). We prove regret upper bounds against both adaptive and oblivious smoothed adversaries: the adaptive bound is controlled by empirical $\ell_\infty$ Hellinger entropy, while the oblivious bound improves this dependence to empirical $\ell_2$ Hellinger entropy, the notion that has been shown to characterize the complexity of learning with i.i.d. data (Bilodeau et al., 2023). Both bounds are obtained through algorithms based on truncated empirical Hellinger covers. We complement these results with a general lower bound, showing that our upper bounds are essentially tight for some natural classes, which implies a separation in the difficulty of smoothed online learning between regimes where $μ$ is known and where it is unknown.

AI.tldr: 本文研究未知基础测度 $\mu$ 下的平滑序列概率分配问题，在去除 Lipschitz 条件的更一般设定中给出了自适应与 oblivious 平滑对手的后悔上界，并证明其基本紧致。
AI.motivation: 全对抗设定下的在线学习硬性结果过于悲观，平滑在线学习通过限制对手生成数据分布的密度来规避这些困难。已有工作（Block et al. 2024、Blanchard 2025）大多强假设 $\mu$ 为学习者已知，少数例外则要求 Lipschitz 条件。本文旨在去掉这些限制，研究 $\mu$ 未知且无 Lipschitz 条件下、平滑且良设定数据的序列概率分配问题。
AI.method: 针对自适应与 oblivious 两类平滑对手，构造基于截断经验 Hellinger 覆盖的算法：自适应情形用经验 $\ell_\infty$ Hellinger 熵控制复杂度，oblivious 情形进一步改进为经验 $\ell_2$ Hellinger 熵。同时给出一般性下界，用于验证上界的紧致性并刻画两种情形之间的难度差异。
AI.result: 证明了针对自适应平滑对手的后悔上界由经验 $\ell_\infty$ Hellinger 熵控制；针对 oblivious 平滑对手的界将依赖改进为经验 $\ell_2$ Hellinger 熵——即刻画 i.i.d. 学习复杂度的量（Bilodeau et al. 2023）。下界结果表明，对某些自然函数类，上述上界本质上紧致。
AI.conclusion: 在 $\mu$ 未知、无 Lipschitz 条件的平滑序列概率分配设定下，用截断经验 Hellinger 覆盖可获得接近最优的后悔界；紧致性下界进一步揭示了平滑在线学习在 $\mu$ 已知与 $\mu$ 未知两种情形之间存在本质的难度分离。

title: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
summary: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: EAGLE 提出显式空间信念智能体，用蒸馏后的轻量 Swin 学生网络从部分观测预测单元级航拍特征嵌入与不确定性，构建空间信念张量，再由紧凑 CNN actor-critic 用 PPO 策略导航，在无 VLM 推理开销下取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 AGL 方法虽在目标模态对齐上表现良好，但将导航状态置于庞大的序列 Transformer 中，且依赖使用隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励，导致推理开销大、监督信号依赖特权信息。
AI.method: 离线训练：教师分支与无上下文学生 Swin 分支共享随机掩码部分拼图输入；教师关注 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 提取的冻结全场景上下文；两分支均接受掩码单元航拍特征重建与不确定性监督，学生额外蒸馏教师 stop-gradient 特征预测。蒸馏后丢弃 Qwen、缓存上下文与教师分支；学生从部分观测预测单元级嵌入与预测不确定性，与模态对齐目标嵌入、轨迹导出的访问掩码组合成空间信念张量。随后冻结学生，用 PPO 优化紧凑 CNN actor-critic。
AI.result: 在 MASA、xBD 零样本迁移、MM-GAG 零样本航拍目标划分上平均成功率分别为 78.1%、76.4%、76.8%，均达 SOTA，且推理阶段不使用 VLM 或缓存视觉 token。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 Qwen2.5-VL 的全场景先验蒸馏进轻量学生网络并显式构建空间信念，EAGLE 在保持零样本泛化能力的同时摆脱了推理时的大模型依赖，验证了"离线特权蒸馏 + 显式信念表示 + 轻量 RL"范式的有效性。

title: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
summary: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering, and retrieval-based multimodal data construction. We evaluate MatVerse on three representative materials-science benchmarks: our human-calibrated OmniMatBench, MatSciBench, and MaCBench. Results demonstrate consistent improvements after materials-specific post-training over the base model on all three benchmarks, alongside improved inference efficiency on calculation-intensive problems. These results show that targeted domain-specific post-training can effectively enhance scientific reasoning, materials knowledge understanding, and multimodal scientific capabilities of foundation models. MatVerse provides a unified language-and-vision interface for materials science and serves as a foundation for future AI-assisted materials research workflows.

AI.tldr: MatVerse 是基于 Intern-S2-Preview 经大规模材料领域后训练得到的材料科学多模态基础模型，在 OmniMatBench、MatSciBench、MaCBench 三个基准上均优于基座模型。
AI.motivation: 材料科学信息高度异构（文本知识、分子与晶体结构、表征数据、显微图像、构效关系），缺乏能统一理解与推理这些多模态表示的通用基础模型。
AI.method: 以 Intern-S2-Preview 为基座进行材料领域后训练；构建覆盖材料知识、科学推理、定量问题求解、结构理解与多模态科学解读的大规模多模态语料；设计统一数据构建流水线，包括教师引导的推理蒸馏、科学问题合成、一致性过滤与基于检索的多模态数据构建。
AI.result: 在自建人工校准的 OmniMatBench 及 MatSciBench、MaCBench 上，材料专项后训练相对基座模型均取得一致提升，并在计算密集型问题上提升推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 定向领域后训练可有效增强基础模型的科学推理、材料知识理解与多模态科学能力；MatVerse 提供统一的语言—视觉接口，可作为 AI 辅助材料研究工作流的基础。

title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role.
  However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full
  history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past
  experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that
  decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native
  video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this
  inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets
  the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation
  across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena,
  surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared
  methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above
  the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem and
  https://huggingface.co/donk111/ActMem.

AI.tldr: 提出ActMem，一种在单一视觉-语言骨干内将记忆推理与感知接地解耦的上下文记忆框架，用于长程机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强VLA存在两类缺陷：要么仅检索历史观测而不推理其含义，要么在共享上下文中对完整历史推理，从而挤占当前感知的容量。认知科学将二者视为不同系统：记忆重构过去经验以决定"做什么"，感知引导"如何做"。
AI.method: 基于具备原生视频理解能力的VLM构建：(1) 由带时间戳的交互历史推断当前子任务，并将该推理过程的隐状态保留为Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought（Memory CoT），用于条件化流匹配动作专家；(2) Perception Attention使动作专家可直接关注当前视图；(3) Efficient Memory CoT Inference在连续决策间复用计算以加速长历史推理，且不改变输出。
AI.result: RoboMemArena上任务成功率71.1%、完成成功率80.8%，较最强基线分别提升7.5与8.7个百分点；MIKASA-Robo平均成功率73.8%，为对比方法中最佳；真实世界在外生、内生与无痕记忆任务上平均成功率68.8%，高于最强记忆增强VLA 10.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦记忆推理与感知接地，并配合隐式记忆CoT与高效推理，ActMem在仿真与真实长程记忆任务上取得领先性能；代码与权重将开源。

title: Towards Autoregressive Neural Network Parameter Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently established a new paradigm in machine learning, demonstrating exceptional zero-shot generalization and complex reasoning capabilities. Concurrently, neural network parameter generation has emerged as a promising avenue for rapid task adaptation and model synthesis. Existing weight generation techniques, however, struggle to jointly learn the distribution of diverse models, to encode heterogeneous architectures within a single generator, and to generalize out of distribution. We therefore ask whether pretrained parameters can be encoded into a discrete domain so that the zero-shot generalization LLMs exhibit in text generation can be transferred to weight generation. Following this view, we propose an LLM-inspired approach, Instruction-Guided Parameter Generation (IGPG), that formulates network parameter generation as an autoregressive modeling problem. We first quantize pretrained weights with a VQ-VAE, then train a prefix-conditioned autoregressive generator over the resulting tokens. At inference, the generated weight tokens are mapped back to parameter space by the VQ-VAE decoder. We evaluate the framework across in-distribution generation, cross-dataset transfer, and cross-architecture settings. The proposed method achieves competitive performance in in-distribution generation and provides useful parameter initializations for held-out datasets and architectural configurations, improving downstream performance over random initialization after adaptation. These results suggest that discrete autoregressive modeling provides a promising framework for learning and transferring structure across collections of pretrained neural network parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文将网络参数生成形式化为自回归建模问题：先用VQ-VAE把预训练权重量化为离散token，再训练前缀条件自回归生成器，推理时经VQ-VAE解码回参数空间，实现了分布内生成、跨数据集迁移与跨架构参数初始化。
AI.motivation: 现有权值生成方法难以同时做到：联合学习多样模型分布、在单一生成器中编码异构架构、以及分布外泛化。作者希望借助LLM在文本生成中表现出的零样本泛化能力，把参数编码到离散域以实现可迁移的权值生成。
AI.method: 提出Instruction-Guided Parameter Generation (IGPG)：1) 使用VQ-VAE对预训练权重进行量化，得到离散token；2) 在token序列上训练前缀条件（prefix-conditioned）的自回归生成器；3) 推理时由生成器输出权值token，再经VQ-VAE解码器映射回参数空间。评估覆盖分布内生成、跨数据集迁移与跨架构设置。
AI.result: 在分布内生成上取得有竞争力的性能；对未见过的数据集与架构配置能提供有用的参数初始化，经下游适应后性能优于随机初始化。
AI.conclusion: 离散自回归建模为学习并迁移预训练神经网络参数集合中的结构提供了有前景的框架，表明LLM式的零样本泛化思想可迁移至权值生成。

title: Multiple-Camera Tracking of Rigid Objects
summary: In this paper we describe a method for tracking rigid objects using one or several cameras. The tracking process consists of aligning a 3-D model representation of an object with image contours by measuring and minimizing the image error between predicted model points and image contours. The tracker behaves like a visual servo loop where the internal and external camera parameters are updated at each new image acquisition. We study in detail the Jacobian matrix associated with this minimization process in the presence of both point-to-point and point-to-contour matches. We establish the minimal number of matches that are needed as well as the singular configurations leading to a rank-defficient Jacobian matrix. We find a mathematical link between the point-to-point and point-to-contour cases. Based on this link we show that the latter has the same kind of singularities than the former. Moreover, we study multiple camera configurations which optimize the robustness of the method in the presence of single-camera singularities, bad, noisy, or missing data. Extensive experiments done with a complex ship part and with up to three cameras validate the method. In particular we show that the tracker may well be used as a camera calibration procedure.

AI.tldr: 提出基于3-D模型与图像轮廓对齐的刚体跟踪方法，将跟踪视为视觉伺服回路，分析点-点与点-轮廓匹配下雅可比矩阵的最小匹配数与奇异构型，并给出多相机配置以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 需要一种在单目或多目条件下稳定跟踪刚体的方法，并理解其最小化过程中雅可比矩阵的秩亏与奇异配置，以便在噪声、缺失数据或单相机奇异情况下保持鲁棒。
AI.method: 将对象的三维模型表示与图像轮廓对齐，通过度量并最小化预测模型点与图像轮廓之间的图像误差；每帧更新相机内、外参数，构成视觉伺服回路；推导点-点与点-轮廓匹配下的雅可比矩阵，确定所需最小匹配数，刻画导致秩亏的奇异构型，并建立两类匹配的数学联系；进而设计优化鲁棒性的多相机配置。
AI.result: 给出了最小匹配数及奇异构型；证明点-轮廓情形与点-点情形具有同类奇异性；多相机配置可缓解单相机奇异、噪声与缺失数据问题；以复杂船体零件、最多三台相机的实验验证了方法，并表明该跟踪器可作为相机标定流程使用。
AI.conclusion: 该对齐式跟踪框架在理论与实验上均有效，点-轮廓与点-点匹配在奇异性上统一，多相机配置显著提升鲁棒性，且可兼作相机标定。

title: Multiple Criteria Decision Making Under XORness
summary: How should we make decisions under XORness? XORness is a class of uncertainty arising from indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy. We develop a multiple criteria decision making framework that preserves XORness throughout the decision process. We define XOR numbers and prove their fundamental arithmetic and algebraic properties. Building on these results, we extend the deterministic decision matrix to an XOR decision matrix and introduce a compatible normalization procedure. Further, we propose an additive XOR aggregation operator, which preserves indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy inherent in evaluations. In addition, we introduce an axiomatic XORness measure that quantifies the degree of uncertainty associated with global performance scores and develop a performance--XORness index to rank alternatives. We prove that this index induces a total preorder over the set of alternatives and identify the conditions for preserving dominance. The applicability of the developed framework is demonstrated through the risk assessment of cyberthreat scenarios in energy systems, and recommendations are derived using the XOR--weighted sum method.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在多准则决策全过程中保持"XORness"（由不确定性、排他性与犹豫性构成的不确定类）的决策框架，并在能源系统网络威胁风险评价中验证。
AI.motivation: 传统多准则决策方法通常在某个环节（如去模糊化、聚合或排序）消除不确定性，导致决策过程中的不确定性信息丢失；而XORness 这类兼具不确定性、排他性和犹豫性的特殊不确定性缺乏形式化刻画与全程保持的处理工具。
AI.method: 1）定义XOR数并证明其基本算术与代数性质；2）将确定性决策矩阵扩展为XOR决策矩阵，并给出兼容的归一化流程；3）提出可加性XOR聚合算子，保持评价中的不确定性、排他性与犹豫性；4）建立公理化XORness测度，量化全局性能得分的不确定程度；5）构建"性能—XORness"指数（performance–XORness index）用于方案排序，证明其导出全预序并给出保序（dominance）成立条件；6）采用XOR加权和法应用于能源系统网络威胁情景风险评估。
AI.result: 所构建的性能—XORness指数可证明在备选方案集上导出全预序，且明确了保持支配关系（dominance preservation）的条件；案例中该框架成功用于能源系统网络威胁情景风险评估，并通过XOR加权和法得到决策建议。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为XORness型不确定性提供了从数系、矩阵、聚合算子的公理化理论到排序指数与应用的完整MCDM体系，使不确定性在决策链条中得以保留而非被消除，具有理论自洽性与实践可操作性。

title: A Wolf in Sheep's Pixels: Visual Camouflage Attacks via HDR Gain Maps
summary: An image can pass automated safety checks while showing harmful content to its human viewer. We introduce DRJanus, a visual camouflage attack that exploits the gap between standard dynamic range (SDR) processing and high dynamic range (HDR) display. Automated systems often read only an image's SDR base, whereas HDR viewers reconstruct its appearance using an auxiliary gain map. DRJanus inverts this reconstruction to embed two independently chosen color images in a single JPEG, without querying or optimizing against the target model. It preserves the chosen SDR base exactly and reconstructs HDR targets at an average PSNR of 43.03 dB across 400 images. On a benchmark of 100 sexual-content images, DRJanus evades detection by all six tested commercial moderation services and nine vision-language models. Across five agents, each evaluated on 120 task cases per threat setting, attack success ranges from 31.67% to 100% for moderation evasion and from 95% to 100% for task manipulation. We also explore cross-view consistency checks as a mitigation. These findings expose a gap in visual trust: securing what a machine reads does not secure what a user sees. A demo is available at https://qshen0629.github.io/DRJanus/

AI.tldr: DRJanus 利用 SDR 处理与 HDR 显示之间的差异，将两幅独立选取的彩色图像嵌入同一张 JPEG：自动审核系统只读到 SDR 基图，HDR 显示器则重建出另一幅内容，从而在无需查询目标模型的条件下实现视觉伪装攻击。
AI.motivation: 图像可能通过自动化安全检测，却向人类观看者呈现有害内容。现有安全机制默认"机器所读"与"用户所见"一致，而 SDR 处理与 HDR 显示之间的差异打破了这一假设，形成可被利用的视觉信任缺口。
AI.method: DRJanus 是一种视觉伪装攻击：利用 HDR 图像由 SDR 基图加辅助增益图（gain map）重建外观的机制，对该重建过程求逆，把两幅独立选定的彩色图像同时编码进单个 JPEG 文件。攻击仅精确保持所选 SDR 基图不变，并在伽马端重建 HDR 目标，全程无需查询或针对目标模型做优化。作者还考察了跨视图一致性检查作为缓解措施。
AI.result: 在 400 张图像上，HDR 目标重建的平均 PSNR 为 43.03 dB，且 SDR 基图完全保持。在含 100 张性内容的基准上，DRJanus 绕过全部 6 个商用内容审核服务与 9 个视觉语言模型的检测。在 5 个智能体、每种威胁设定 120 个任务用例的评测中，审核规避成功率介于 31.67%–100%，任务操纵成功率为 95%–100%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了视觉信任层面的关键缺口：保障机器所读取的内容安全，并不等于保障用户所见内容安全；跨视图一致性检查可作为潜在缓解手段。

title: Is a Description Worth a Thousand Demonstrations? Specificity and Reliability of Task Descriptions in In-Context Learning
summary: A prompt for in-context learning (ICL) can describe a task in addition to, or instead of, demonstrating it through examples. Yet how task descriptions work remains poorly understood theoretically. Through the Bayesian view of ICL, we model descriptions as informative priors characterized by their specificity and reliability. We adapt the effective sample size (ESS) from Bayesian statistics, quantifying a description's predictive value as an equivalent number of demonstrations. For in-context linear regression, we show that a reliable description's ESS grows with its specificity and with the task's dimension. A description that may be irrelevant, however, gains little from its specificity unless demonstrations are given. In practice, do in-context learners use descriptions as a Bayes-optimal predictor would? Our experiments show that meta-trained Transformers come close to the Bayes-optimal ESS when tested on their training distribution. Pretrained language models, however, make too little use of highly specific descriptions when answering without reasoning; most of them closely match the Bayes-optimal predictor only when reasoning is enabled. These results extend the Bayesian analysis of ICL from demonstrations to descriptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文用贝叶斯视角把ICL中的任务描述建模为具有"特异性"和"可靠性"的信息先验，并借用有效样本量(ESS)量化描述的预测价值，在线性回归设定下给出理论刻画，并通过实验检验Transformer与预训练语言模型是否按贝叶斯最优方式利用描述。
AI.motivation: ICL的prompt既可以通过示例演示任务，也可以用自然语言描述任务，但"任务描述如何起作用"在理论上仍缺乏理解。已有ICL的贝叶斯分析主要针对demonstrations，描述这一维度尚未被纳入统一框架。
AI.method: (1) 基于ICL的贝叶斯观点，将任务描述建模为信息先验，用"特异性"（specificity）与"可靠性"（reliability）两个属性刻画；(2) 引入贝叶斯统计中的有效样本量(ESS)，把描述的预测价值折算为等价的示例数量；(3) 在in-context线性回归中理论推导ESS随特异性、任务维度以及描述可能不相关时的变化规律；(4) 实验上，将元训练的Transformer与预训练语言模型在有无推理(reasoning)条件下的表现与贝叶斯最优预测器的ESS进行对比。
AI.result: 理论上：可靠描述的ESS随其特异性提高、随任务维度增大而增长；若描述可能不相关，则在缺乏示例时特异性带来的收益很小。实验上：元训练Transformer在其训练分布上接近贝叶斯最优ESS；预训练语言模型在无推理作答时对高特异性描述利用不足，多数模型仅在启用推理时才与贝叶斯最优预测器吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将ICL的贝叶斯分析从demonstrations扩展到task descriptions，用ESS给出了描述价值的可量化理论刻画，并揭示出元训练模型接近最优、而预训练语言模型需依赖推理才能充分利用高特异性描述的行为差异。

title: Fast-JEPA: Advancing the Success-Latency Frontier for Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models predict the outcomes of action sequences, but comparing candidate plans through recursive rollout remains expensive at test time. We introduce Fast-JEPA, a latent world model planning framework that advances the success-latency Pareto frontier of predictive search. Fast-JEPA reorganizes predictive computation to support effective action-sequence search at low planning cost. It constructs a goal-directed plan to guide search and directly predicts the outcomes of complete candidates for efficient comparison, avoiding recursive state rollout during refinement. Across PushT, Reacher, Cube, and TwoRoom, Fast-JEPA achieves 96.50% average success rate with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT. Search-budget sweeps show that its competitive success and low latency extend across candidate counts and refinement depths. We further introduce DynaGoal, a benchmark for evaluating world-model planning under dynamic out-of-distribution conditions, execution deadlines, and controlled response delays. Fast-JEPA achieves average success rates of 73.83% on DynaGoal-Shift and 87.67% on DynaGoal-Deadline, demonstrating the practical value of low-latency predictive planning under changing control conditions and execution-time constraints. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sofilyzia/Fast-JEPA.

AI.tldr: 提出Fast-JEPA潜空间世界模型规划框架，通过重构预测计算降低规划成本，在保持高成功率的同时规划速度较INTACT快2.41x，并发布DynaGoal动态分布外规划基准。
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型虽能预演动作序列结果，但测试时通过递归rollout比较候选计划的代价过高，现有预测搜索在成功—延迟权衡上不够理想。
AI.method: Fast-JEPA重组预测计算以支持低成本的序列搜索：先构造目标导向的计划引导搜索，并直接预测完整候选序列的结果用于高效比较，从而在细化阶段避免递归状态rollout。此外构建DynaGoal基准，涵盖动态OOD条件、执行截止时间与受控响应延迟。
AI.result: PushT、Reacher、Cube、TwoRoom上平均成功率96.50%，规划较INTACT快2.41x；搜索预算扫描（候选数、细化深度）显示优势稳定。DynaGoal-Shift成功率73.83%，DynaGoal-Deadline成功率87.67%。
AI.conclusion: 直接预测整条候选序列结果、避免递归rollout的思路能有效推进成功—延迟帕累托前沿，在动态分布外与时限约束下仍具实用价值。

title: SiliconGym: A Versatile Reinforcement Learning Environment for Agentic EDA
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with electronic design automation (EDA) feedback is advancing large language models for hardware design and verification. Extending these gains to hardware-engineering agents requires environments that span tasks, preserve state across tool calls, and support large hierarchies alongside parallel rollouts. We present SiliconGym, the first versatile, cross-task and cross-toolchain RL environment for hardware design and verification. By decoupling versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring, SiliconGym scales from module-level RTL, testbench, and PPA tasks to multi-round repository repair and full-hierarchy SoC flows. Streaming dispatch overlaps tool checks with generation, finishing a 256-answer RL batch 21.9% faster than native ChipSeek. Using interchangeable open-source and commercial backends, we show that open-source-trained functional correctness transfers cleanly to commercial simulation, while paired netlist evaluation reveals when open-source PPA gains survive commercial synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SiliconGym——首个面向硬件设计与验证的多任务、跨工具链强化学习环境，通过版本化工作区、带预算的执行与验收门控打分实现从模块级到SoC全层级的可扩展RL训练。
AI.motivation: 现有基于EDA反馈的强化学习在LLM硬件设计与验证上取得进展，但要扩展到硬件工程智能体，仍缺乏能跨任务、跨工具调用保持状态、支持大规模层级设计与并行rollout的环境。
AI.method: 解耦三类机制：版本化工作区（versioned workspaces）、带预算的执行（budgeted execution）、验收门控打分（acceptance-gated scoring）；采用流式调度（streaming dispatch）将工具检查与生成重叠；后端可在开源与商业工具链之间互换。
AI.result: 覆盖模块级RTL、testbench、PPA任务，直至多轮仓库修复与全层级SoC流程；256条答案的RL批次比原生ChipSeek快21.9%；开源训练的功能正确性可干净地迁移到商业仿真；配对网表评估揭示了开源PPA收益在商业综合下何时得以保留。
AI.conclusion: SiliconGym为硬件工程智能体提供了可扩展、跨工具链的RL训练基础设施，并验证了开源→商业工具链的可迁移性，为PPA收益的商业可用性提供了实证判据。

title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出TuringPAI系列端侧物理AI模型：TuringPAI-VL（0.65B视觉语言基座）、TuringPAI-Drive（自动驾驶）与TuringPAI-Embodied（机器人操作），以共享视觉语言基础实现实用的端侧部署。
AI.motivation: 物理AI需要在有限车载/端侧算力下理解空间关系与动态环境并将观测转为动作，现有模型难以兼顾几何感知能力与端侧效率。
AI.method: TuringPAI-VL基于HybridViT-MLQ：卷积局部聚合+Transformer全局建模；Multi-scale Latent Queries在同一视觉Transformer内融合空间特征与观测历史，为语言模型提供紧凑结构化接口；训练结合通用VL数据与几何、跨视角、时序监督；该模型作为两个下游VLA模型的共享初始化。Drive沿用MLQ接口，Embodied面向操作任务。
AI.result: VL在定量几何感知上优于Qwen2-VL-2B；Drive使用MLQ接口，所有ADE/FDE指标与全token HybridViT基线差距在1.2%以内，内部仿真综合得分相当，基于XNRT在单颗NVIDIA Orin-X上以12Hz生成轨迹；Embodied在LIBERO四个套件上平均成功率96.8%。
AI.conclusion: 共享视觉语言基座可在实际端侧约束下同时支撑自动驾驶与机器人操作，验证了统一物理AI模型族的可行性。

title: Reinforcement-Aligned Probabilistic Weather Forecasting with Discrete Tokens
summary: Global medium-range weather forecasting must not only generate ensembles efficiently to characterize uncertainty in future states, but also serve downstream applications such as extreme-event warnings and cross-sphere coupled simulations. We introduce WeatherCraft, a framework that unifies probabilistic generation and reinforcement learning alignment through discrete weather tokens, bringing the GPT-style pretraining--post-training paradigm to global medium-range weather forecasting. A multiscale tokenizer represents atmospheric states as a coarse-to-fine token hierarchy, while a Transformer models causal dependencies across time and scale and predicts tokens within each scale in parallel. Direct sampling generates diverse ensembles, and exact token log-probabilities enable Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to maximize downstream task rewards without differentiating through evaluators or coupled models. On the ERA5 benchmark, WeatherCraft's eight-member ensemble mean reduces day-15 normalized RMSE by 17.6% relative to the strongest evaluated deterministic baseline and, with KV caching, achieves an approximately $18\times$ inference speedup over GenCast. Direct fair-CRPS adaptation improves ensemble probabilistic skill, while reward-based post-training improves forecasts of persistent land temperature extremes and coupled ocean heat extremes. This work establishes discrete autoregressive modeling as a general foundation for scalable, task-alignable Earth system foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出WeatherCraft框架，以离散天气token统一概率生成与强化学习对齐，把GPT式"预训练—后训练"范式引入全球中期天气预报。
AI.motivation: 全球中期天气预报既要高效生成集合以刻画未来状态不确定性，又要服务极端事件预警、跨圈层耦合模拟等下游任务；现有方法难以同时兼顾高效集合生成与面向下游目标的对齐优化。
AI.method: 多尺度tokenizer将大气状态表示为由粗到细的token层级；Transformer建模跨时间与跨尺度的因果依赖，并在每个尺度内并行预测token。直接采样生成多样化集合；利用精确的token对数概率，以GRPO最大化下游任务奖励，无需对评估器或耦合模型求导。
AI.result: ERA5基准上，8成员集合平均在第15天归一化RMSE较最强确定性基线降低17.6%；配合KV缓存相对GenCast实现约18倍推理加速；直接fair-CRPS适配提升集合概率技巧；基于奖励的后训练改善持续性陆地温度极端与耦合海洋热极端的预报。
AI.conclusion: 离散自回归建模可作为可扩展、可任务对齐的地球系统基础模型的通用基础。

title: Learning optimal gaits and styles for terrain-adaptive quadruped locomotion
summary: Animals use many different gaits to locomote at different speeds across varying terrains. A longstanding question in biology and robotics is: which gait is best? This question is most often addressed from an energy-efficiency perspective on flat terrain, leaving open how the answer depends on terrain and on the criterion optimized. Here we show that gait optimality is determined jointly by terrain, performance metric, and velocity. We use deep reinforcement learning and networks of abstract oscillators, modeling spinal central pattern generators, to learn 11 quadrupedal gaits across diverse challenging terrains, together with the locomotion style (base height, foot ground clearance, foot offsets) that each requires. A second policy then selects among them to optimize a user-specified criterion such as cost of transport, base stability, or joint smoothness. Across these performance metrics and within this repertoire, every gait is optimal under at least one terrain-metric-velocity combination. The framework adapts zero-shot to gait couplings and styles never seen during training, to terrains far beyond the training distribution, and to larger quadrupeds five times the training mass. With a single additional pitch-tracking reward term, the same gait couplings also support bipedal-mode locomotion. Our method provides a general and systematic way to produce expressive locomotion and to select the gait best suited to a given terrain and criterion. Project page: https://guillaume10.github.io/terrain-gaits.

AI.tldr: 该研究用深度强化学习结合抽象振子网络（模拟脊髓中枢模式发生器），在多种复杂地形上学习11种四足步态及其运动风格，并用第二层策略按用户指定指标（运输成本、基座稳定性、关节平滑度）选择最优步态。结果表明步态最优性由地形、性能指标与速度共同决定，每种步态在至少一种"地形-指标-速度"组合下最优，且框架可零样本泛化到未见过的步态耦合与风格、超出训练分布的地形及5倍质量的更大四足机器人，加一个俯仰跟踪奖励即可支持双足模式。
AI.motivation: 生物学与机器人学长期关注"哪种步态最好"，但以往多从平地能量效率角度回答，忽略了地形条件与优化准则的影响，缺乏系统性的量化框架。
AI.method: 采用深度强化学习与抽象振子网络（建模脊髓CPG）学习覆盖多样挑战地形的11种四足步态及其运动风格（基座高度、抬脚离地高度、足端偏移）；再用第二个策略在这些步态间按用户指定准则（运输成本、基座稳定性、关节平滑度）进行选择。
AI.result: 在所有性能指标与步态集合内，每种步态均在至少一种"地形-指标-速度"组合下最优；框架可零样本适应训练中未见的步态耦合与风格、远超训练分布的地形，以及质量为训练5倍的更大四足机器人；仅增加一个俯仰跟踪奖励项，相同步态耦合即可支持双足模式运动。
AI.conclusion: 步态最优性由地形、性能指标与速度共同决定，不存在普遍最优步态；该方法提供了系统生成多样运动并针对特定地形与准则选择最佳步态的通用途径。

title: Ask in the Crowd: Differentially Private LLM Inference via Dummy-Augmented Shuffling
summary:
Large language models are increasingly deployed as LLM-as-a-Service (LLMaaS), where user queries are sent to remote LLMs for inference, raising severe privacy concerns about the exposure of sensitive user inputs. Differentially private inference mitigates these risks by injecting noise into input embeddings. However, existing methods struggle to balance privacy and utility, as stronger privacy protection often leads to substantial accuracy degradation in LLM inference.
  In this work, we propose DP-SPD, a differentially private LLM inference framework that protects user queries by hiding the real query among client-generated dummy queries. All queries are randomly shuffled before being sent to the server, preventing direct identification of the user's true intent. To improve inference efficiency, we exploit the shared-prefix structure among queries and reuse transformer key--value (KV) caches during decoding. We analyze the privacy guarantee of DP-SPD and evaluate its utility on classification and generation tasks, as well as its privacy protection under QIA, EIA, and GPT-based attacks. Experimental results show that our method achieves strong inference-time privacy protection and near-plaintext utility while improving inference efficiency through shared-prefix KV-cache reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出 DP-SPD 差分隐私 LLM 推理框架：以客户端生成的假查询（dummy queries）隐藏真实查询，随机打乱后发送至服务器，并利用共享前缀 KV 缓存复用以提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Service 场景下用户查询需上传至远程模型推理，存在敏感输入泄露风险；现有基于输入嵌入加噪的差分隐私推理方法难以兼顾隐私与效用，隐私越强则下游推理精度下降越显著。
AI.method: 1) 客户端生成多条假查询，将真实查询混入其中以隐藏真实意图；2) 所有查询在发送前随机打乱，服务器无法直接定位真实查询；3) 利用查询间的共享前缀结构，在解码阶段复用 Transformer 的 key-value (KV) 缓存以降低计算开销；4) 对 DP-SPD 的隐私保证进行理论分析。
AI.result: 在分类与生成任务上评估效用，并在 QIA、EIA 及基于 GPT 的攻击下评估隐私保护效果；实验显示方法实现了较强的推理期隐私保护与接近明文的效用，同时通过共享前缀 KV 缓存复用提升了推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 以"假查询混入+随机打乱"替代输入嵌入加噪，可较好缓解隐私—效用权衡困境；结合共享前缀 KV 缓存复用，在保证隐私的同时维持近似无隐私处理的效用并提升推理效率。

title: SegAnyFruit: Learning Generalizable and Edge Deployable Fruit Instance Segmentation at Scale
summary: Deploying fruit instance segmentation in real agricultural settings requires generalizing across unseen species, orchards, and imaging conditions under strict onboard compute and annotation budgets. We introduce SegAnyFruit (SAF), a data construction and progressive training framework that distills foundation-model priors into lightweight, prompt-free segmenters. SAF combines generic mask pre-training, broad mid-training on automatically annotated web imagery from our curated WebFruits dataset, and human-verified agricultural refinement post-training on PaperFruits, together spanning 733K images and 9.66M whole-fruit masks across 165 fruit types. Across seven benchmarks, zero-shot SAF-RF-DETR-XL reaches 69.06 average mask AP50:95 (+4.76 over SAM 3) while remaining deployable on edge devices. SAF initialization also boosts few-shot to full-shot adaptation across five agricultural domains while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we systematically analyze training stages, data scale, model capacity, and generative augmentation, and validate our pipeline's transferability to underwater, cell, and human segmentation. We will release our datasets, code, and SAF models.

AI.tldr: SegAnyFruit (SAF) 提出数据构建+渐进式训练框架，将基础模型先验蒸馏为轻量、无提示分割器，在733K图像、9.66M整果掩码、165类水果上训练，零样本平均掩码AP50:95达69.06（超SAM 3 4.76），且可边缘部署。
AI.motivation: 真实农业场景部署水果实例分割需在严格机载算力与标注预算下，泛化到未见物种、果园与成像条件；现有基础模型（如SAM系列）精度高但依赖提示、计算重，难以边缘部署且缺乏农业领域广泛覆盖。
AI.method: 提出SegAnyFruit（SAF）数据构建与渐进式训练框架，将基础模型先验蒸馏到轻量、无提示（prompt-free）分割器中。三阶段训练：①通用掩码预训练；②基于自建WebFruits网络图像自动标注的大规模中训练；③基于PaperFruits人工校验数据的农业精调后训练。总计733K图像、9.66M整果掩码、165种水果。
AI.result: 在7个基准上，零样本SAF-RF-DETR-XL平均掩码AP50:95达69.06，较SAM 3提升4.76，同时可在边缘设备部署；SAF初始化在5个农业域上提升少样本至全样本自适应能力并缓解灾难性遗忘；系统分析训练阶段、数据规模、模型容量与生成式增强的作用，并验证流程可迁移至水下、细胞与人体分割任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过“数据构建+渐进蒸馏”可将基础模型能力高效压缩为可部署的农业专用分割器，实现强零样本泛化与低遗忘的领域自适应，且该范式具有跨领域可迁移性。作者将公开数据集、代码与SAF模型。

title: Design and Evaluation of Epira: An Automated Interview System for Case Investigation and Contact Tracing
summary:
Objective: Case investigation and contact tracing are labor-intensive. Web forms struggle when respondents need clarification before disclosing contacts, and open-ended chatbots may deviate from protocols. We developed and evaluated Epira, a protocol-controlled large language model (LLM) interviewer for multi-disease case investigation and contact tracing.
  Materials and Methods: Epira pairs LLM dialogue with a rule-based controller enforcing required questions, safety handoffs, and a structured case record, and adapts to new diseases by questionnaire upload. Local (Qwen2.5) and cloud (GPT-5.4) backends were tested.
