Conditioning ablations show higher success with spatial tokens than with a global map embedding, and map-replacement tests demonstrate dependence on the supplied geometry. The resulting multi-robot system achieves higher team success than the compared diffusion baselines, with experiments covering teams of up to 15 robots.

AI.tldr: SCTD是一种地图条件化的轨迹扩散生成器，通过在时间U-Net中经交叉注意力保留位置感知占据token并硬约束端点，实现无需采样时障碍代价引导的避障轨迹生成，并与CBS结合完成多机器人协调规划。
AI.motivation: 多机器人运动规划需同时避开环境障碍与机器人间碰撞。现有扩散规划器多依赖采样时引导处理避障，或把地图几何压缩为单一全局表示，可能损失空间细节并增加采样开销。
AI.method: 提出Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion（SCTD）：在整个时间U-Net中通过交叉注意力访问多个位置感知的占据token，并用硬端点inpainting强制起止状态；单一模型在程序化环境的单机器人示范上训练，即可生成障碍感知轨迹而无需采样时障碍代价引导。高层采用Conflict-Based Search（CBS）通过约束重规划协调轨迹，采样期间保留智能体间引导，模型可跨布局与团队规模复用。实验涵盖单机器人成功率与轨迹质量、含新增障碍的陌生布局泛化、以及多机器人协同规划。
AI.result: 在15,000个留出任务上，SCTD成功率高于所评估的引导扩散基线，在困难绕行任务上提升最大；轨迹质量对比显示其轨迹更平滑。条件化消融表明空间token优于全局地图嵌入；地图替换测试显示模型依赖所给几何。多机器人系统团队成功率高于对比的扩散基线，实验涵盖至多15个机器人。
AI.conclusion: 以细粒度空间token作为地图条件的扩散生成器，配合CBS式约束重规划，可在无需采样时障碍引导的情况下实现可泛化、平滑且团队可扩展的多机器人轨迹规划。

title: Anchor and Check: Deterministic Cross-Prompt, Cross-Model Reconciliation for Auditable LLM Decisions
summary: Pipelines that let a large language model (LLM) make discrete decisions need to know which decisions they may act on unattended, and a record that explains each one. We study a small, fully specified reconciliation contract: commit the target model's greedy answer (the anchor), draw one or two greedy checks that reach the answer by a different route (an alternate prompt, or a model from another family), and let a pure function return one of five outcomes, of which only Agree is acted on. On 48,000 model-item evaluations over 6,000 questions, with every method given access to verbalized confidence as a tie-breaker, the main finding concerns where calls come from: pooling another family's samples raises semantic entropy's AUROC by 1.7 to 4.0 points at every budget, and a same-model temperature check is the weakest design. As complete pipelines, the point estimates of the three-call contract and pooled semantic entropy over 3 or 5 samples differ by less than one point, with intervals containing zero. As detectors of the anchor's errors, the contract is ahead of pooled entropy with 3 and 5 samples under both tie-breaker conventions; with 10 samples the point estimates differ by less than one point and the sign depends on the convention. Under the strict Agree gate it automates 70% of items and still acts on 16% of errors. What the contract adds is a fixed committed answer, an explicit outcome and a decision replayable from its record; generation itself was not reproducible on the hosted API.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一种小型、完全指定的"对账契约"式弃权/决策管道：记录目标模型的贪婪答案作为锚点，用一或两条经由不同路径到达该答案的贪婪校验（改换提示或使用其他模型族），再由纯函数输出五种结果之一，仅"Agree"可被自动执行；在48,000次模型-题目评估（6,000题）上，跨族采样显著提升语义熵的AUROC，而三调用契约与池化语义熵的整体表现差异不足一个百分点。
AI.motivation: 让LLM做出离散决策的流水线需要明确"哪些决策可以无人监督地执行"，并为每一次决策留下可解释的记录；现有不确定性度量（如语义熵）缺乏固定承诺答案、显式结果类别与可复现的决策记录，因此作者提出并评估一种更可审计的轻量契约。
AI.method: 设计"对账契约"：(1) 提交目标模型贪婪答案作为锚点；(2) 抽取一条或两条以不同路径抵达该答案的贪婪校验（改用替代提示，或引入另一模型族的模型）；(3) 由纯函数返回五类结果之一，只有Agree会被执行。所有方法均可使用口语化置信度作为平局裁决。实验规模为6,000个问题上的48,000次模型-题目评估；对比对象包括池化语义熵（3、5、10个样本）等基线，指标为AUROC、自动化覆盖率与错误执行率，并以区间是否含零判断差异显著性。
AI.result: 主要发现关乎"样本来源"：在所有预算下，池化另一模型族的样本使语义熵AUROC提升1.7至4.0个百分点，而同模型温度采样检查是最弱的设计。作为完整管道，三调用契约与基于3或5个样本的池化语义熵的点估计差异不足一个百分点且置信区间含零。作为锚点错误检测器，契约在3与5样本设置下、两种平局裁决约定下均优于池化熵；10样本时点估计差异不足一个百分点且符号依约定而变。在严格Agree门控下，契约自动化70%的条目，同时仍对16%的错误执行操作。生成过程本身在托管API上不可复现。
AI.conclusion: 契约的增益不在于检测性能的显著领先，而在于其提供的附加属性：固定的承诺答案、显式的输出结果类别，以及可由记录重放的决策过程；同时该工作给出方法论提示——校验样本的跨族池化比同模型温度采样更有效，且由于托管API的生成不可复现，可重放的决策记录具有实际必要性。

title: Anchored Inertial Proposals with Objective Verification for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion priors are powerful for inverse problems, but measurement guidance during reverse sampling is local: aggressive updates can improve immediate data fit while disrupting later denoising. We introduce an anchored inertial correction rule that separates proposal generation from acceptance. At each corrected step, the denoiser prediction anchors a frozen clean-space objective combining measurement fit with a noise-level-dependent proximal term. Heavy-ball dynamics with step size and momentum computed from the measured curvature generate a clean-state candidate; a separate verifier evaluates it with the same objective, with the denoiser prediction retained as fallback; both stages are derived from one objective for the whole trajectory, considered one step at a time. The accepted clean state is re-noised to continue sampling. The rule applies to pixel and latent diffusion with differentiable measurement operators, requires no retraining, and adds no denoiser calls inside the correction loop. We analyze how objective verification yields local nonincrease and displacement control. Across natural-image benchmarks, the method achieves competitive reconstruction quality. Code is available at https://github.com/Seunghyeok0715/PIVOT2026.

AI.tldr: 提出"锚定惯性修正"规则，将逆问题反采样中的测量引导拆分为"提案生成"与"提案接受"两阶段，在同一冻结目标下由denoiser预测锚定，实现无需训练的扩散先验重建。
AI.motivation: 免训练扩散先验在逆问题中很强，但反采样时的测量引导是局部性的：激进更新能改善即时数据拟合，却会破坏后续去噪过程，需要在"拟合"与"生成流形保持"之间取得更稳健的平衡。
AI.method: 在每一步修正中，以denoiser预测锚定一个冻结的干净空间目标函数（测量拟合项＋随噪声水平变化的近端项）。用基于实测曲率计算步长与动量的heavy-ball动力学生成干净状态候选；再由独立验证器用同一目标评估该候选，若不通过则回退到denoiser预测。被接受的干净状态重新加噪以继续采样。整条轨迹的提案与验证均源自同一目标，逐步处理；适用于像素域与隐空间扩散、可微测量算子，无需重训练，修正循环内不增加denoiser调用。
AI.result: 理论上分析了目标验证可带来局部目标非增与位移控制；在自然图像基准上取得了有竞争力的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 将引导更新的"提案—验证"解耦，并以单一冻结目标统一整条轨迹，是在不训练、不增加denoiser开销前提下稳定测量引导的有效途径。

title: Explainability of genotype embedding models through observed cohort paths
summary: Deep learning models that combine genotypes with neuroimaging predict neurological diseases more accurately than either modality alone. Their clinical use, however, requires identifying which genetic variants a prediction is based on. Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients address this by integrating the model's gradient from a baseline to the input. These methods assume the model accepts any point along that path as a valid input. Genotype models violate this assumption. They map the three discrete allele dosages \{0,1,2\} to vectors through a learned embedding defined only at those values, so a straight line passes through fractional genotypes at which no embedding, and therefore no gradient, exists. Attribution must therefore proceed in embedding space where the choice of path can affect the resulting attribution. We show that the commonly used per-variant estimator does not generally satisfy completeness. Additive separability guarantees completeness for this estimator, but interactions between variants generally break that property. Instead, we integrate along piecewise-linear embedding-space paths connecting genotype waypoints observed in the training cohort. Each path satisfies completeness in the continuum although the interiors of its segments are not necessarily observed. Our method improves faithfulness over Integrated Gradients and discretized Integrated Gradients under both perturbation protocols, achieves the strongest results for Parkinson's disease classification under support-preserving perturbations, and is competitive with a support-background Shapley baseline under per-variant perturbations. It also shows higher seed stability and better recovery of planted non-additive effects in a synthetic benchmark.

AI.tldr: 针对基因型-神经影像联合模型，作者指出基于路径的归因方法（如Integrated Gradients）在基因嵌入空间不适用——直线路径会经过不存在嵌入的分数基因型。作者论证逐变异估计器一般不满足完备性，并提出沿训练队列中观察到的基因型"路点"构建的分段线性嵌入空间路径进行积分，从而保证完备性。实验表明该方法在扰动协议下忠实度优于IG与离散化IG，在帕金森病分类中于保支撑扰动下表现最佳，并与支撑背景Shapley基线在逐变异扰动下相当，同时种子稳定性更高，在合成基准上更好地恢复了植入的非加性效应。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型联合基因型与神经影像可提升神经疾病预测精度，但临床使用需要明确预测所依赖的具体遗传变异。Path-based归因（如Integrated Gradients）要求模型在基线到输入的整条路径上任一点都可作为有效输入；而基因型模型通过仅在{0,1,2}三种离散等位基因剂量上定义的学习嵌入映射为向量，直线路径会经过分数基因型，该处不存在嵌入因而无梯度，导致标准IG不适用。此外，嵌入空间中路径选择会影响归因结果，常用逐变异估计器一般不满足完备性。
AI.method: 1) 在嵌入空间中而非原始基因型空间中做归因，指出路径选择会影响归因；2) 证明逐变异（per-variant）估计器一般不完全满足完备性（completeness），并指出加性可分离性可保证完备，而变异间交互会破坏该性质；3) 提出沿连接训练队列中观察到的基因型"路点"（waypoints）的分段线性嵌入空间路径积分：每条路径在连续域上满足完备性，尽管各段内部不一定被观察到。
AI.result: - 在两种扰动协议下，忠实度（faithfulness）均优于Integrated Gradients与离散化Integrated Gradients；- 在保支撑（support-preserving）扰动下，帕金森病分类取得最强结果；- 在逐变异（per-variant）扰动下，与支撑背景Shapley基线具有竞争力；- 种子稳定性更高；- 在合成基准上更好地恢复植入的非加性效应。
AI.conclusion: 对基因型模型的归因应在嵌入空间中进行，并采用基于训练集观察路点的分段线性路径积分，以在存在变异交互时仍保持完备性；该方法在忠实度、稳定性及非加性效应恢复上均优于或媲美现有基线，为基因型-影像联合模型的临床可解释性提供了更可靠的工具。

title: A Practical Proprioceptive Data Collection Utility for the Unitree GO1
summary: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个开源图形化数据采集工具，使研究者无需ROS专业知识即可从Unitree Go1机器人可靠录制本体感知数据（关节状态、IMU、足端力、陀螺仪）并实时启停与标注；论文以51条记录的采集质量分析为主要贡献，并以一个刻意保守的地形分类实验（TCN约38%准确率，10类）证明所录信号含有地形信息。
AI.motivation: Go1是腿足机器人研究常用平台，但其本体感知数据采集困难：Unitree SDK文档稀疏，原生中间件ROS1已完全弃用，导致研究者获取数据的门槛过高。
AI.method: 开发开源GUI采集工具，封装SDK以记录关节状态、IMU、足端力与陀螺仪数据，提供实时启动/停止/标注功能；对51条录制数据统计实际采样率与重复样本以刻画采集质量；作为次要验证，用时间卷积网络（TCN）做十类地形分类，并对比"记录级划分"与"忽略记录边界的窗口级划分"两种评测协议。
AI.result: 记录级划分下TCN在留出记录上准确率约38%（十类随机基线10%）；而忽略记录边界的窗口级划分将同一指标虚高至约99%，说明该协议存在数据泄漏；采集质量方面给出了实测采样率与重复样本统计。
AI.conclusion: 所录信号确实携带地形相关信息，但分类器并非竞争力水平，论文不主张其性能；核心贡献是降低无ROS环境下Go1本体感知数据采集门槛的实用工具，同时提醒领域注意窗口级划分导致的评测膨胀。

title: Self-Replicating Language Models
comment: About 64 pages, 16 figures, 2 tables. Under review at Artificial Life
summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are a form of life is a scientifically interesting question. Under the Darwinian definition of life, it is also a practical one, because a system capable of Darwinian Evolution can adapt. We therefore test several modes in which a language model can reproduce itself: by emitting a genome that trains its offspring, by copying and mutating its own weights, and by teaching a child from its own samples. In principle, small language models can replicate and evolve: selection improves them, and they adapt to narrow niches. Selection also lowers mutation rates, and a language model, unlike any organism, can lower its own to zero, which may limit its evolution. Flagship LLMs can write such replicators, but for a large LLM to replicate by teaching its offspring remains, for now, technically and economically infeasible.

AI.tldr: 该文以达尔文式生命的定义（具备可演化性）为切入点，检验语言模型能否自我复制与演化，发现小型语言模型可实现复制与演化（受选择改善、适应狭窄生态位、变异率下降），但可人为将变异率降为零从而限制演化；旗舰级大模型能编写此类复制器，但"以教学方式复制后代"目前技术上与经济上仍不可行。
AI.motivation: 探讨LLM及LLM智能体是否构成一种"生命"既有科学趣味也有现实意义：按达尔文定义，能进行达尔文演化的系统才具备适应能力，因此需检验语言模型是否具备复制与演化能力。
AI.method: 测试语言模型自我复制的三种模式：(1) 输出基因组以训练其后代；(2) 复制并变异自身权重；(3) 用自身生成的样本"教"出一个子模型（教学式复制）。据此观察选择压力、适应性与变异率的变化。
AI.result: 小型语言模型原则上可复制并演化：选择能改进其性能，使其适应狭窄生态位；选择同时降低变异率。与任何生物不同，语言模型可将自身变异率降至零，从而可能限制其演化。旗舰级LLM能够编写此类复制器，但大型LLM通过教学后代实现复制目前技术经济上不可行。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在有限意义上具备达尔文式复制与演化能力（尤其小型模型），但其可自设零变异率这一特性构成演化上限；大型模型的自复制在当下仍不现实。

title: TwoPass: Draft-Guided Few-Step Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Action-conditioned video prediction lets robots anticipate the visual consequences of their actions for planning and policy evaluation. Existing predictors denoise each future from noise without using their own estimate of it, which limits the quality of the predicted future, in particular of the manipulated objects, and requires many network calls. We present TwoPass, a self-conditioned training-and-inference framework that keeps the standard flow-matching objective. Self-Generated Draft Training supplies a detached clean-video estimate from the shared network as conditioning at the same noisy state. A Refinement-Only Late Adapter applies a dedicated residual transformation when a draft is present. At inference, Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement obtains both a solver update and the next draft from each velocity prediction, requiring as few as 4 function evaluations (NFE) per video chunk. Training samples discrete solver-query noise levels and updates the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on Bridge and Language Table show that TwoPass achieves state-of-the-art results with 4 NFE, far fewer than the 50-59 calls of existing predictors. Code: https://github.com/PlantPotatoOnMoon/TwoPass.

AI.tldr: TwoPass：自条件化训练与推理框架，在保持标准 flow-matching 目标下用"自生成草稿"作条件，并以"草稿复用迭代精修"实现每视频块仅 4 次函数评估（NFE）的动作条件视频预测，在 Bridge 与 Language Table 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频预测器从纯噪声出发去噪，不使用自身对未来帧的估计，导致预测质量（尤其是被操作物体）受限，且需大量网络调用（50–59 NFE），推理代价高。
AI.method: 1) Self-Generated Draft Training：由共享网络在同一噪声状态下给出 detach 的干净视频估计作为条件；2) Refinement-Only Late Adapter：当存在草稿时施加专门的残差变换；3) Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement：推理时每次速度预测同时得到求解器更新与下一个草稿；4) 训练时采样离散的求解器查询噪声水平，并微调预训练骨干，保持标准 flow-matching 目标。
AI.result: 在 Bridge 与 Language Table 数据集上，TwoPass 以 4 NFE 达到 SOTA，远少于现有预测器的 50–59 次调用；预测质量（尤其被操作物体）提升。
AI.conclusion: 将"自身估计"作为条件引入 flow-matching 训练与推理，可在大幅降低采样步数的同时提升动作条件视频预测质量，为机器人规划与策略评估提供高效预测器。

title: Measurable Does Not Imply Transportable: A Prospective Audit of Model Explanations in Multi-Year Field Trials
summary: Model explanations are increasingly used as scientific evidence, yet it remains unclear what they license scientists to conclude beyond the data on which they were constructed. When a fine-grained explanation fails to replicate, the failure may be attributed to noisy measurement of its target, raising a fundamental question: does reliable measurement imply a reproducible explanation? We test this directly. We formalize prospective explanation transportability: the extent to which an explanation learned from past data is recovered in a genuinely future context. This property is distinct from feature importance and measurement reliability. Using multi-year Genomes-to-Fields maize trials, where each new year is a real future context rather than a random resample, we evaluate 16 agronomically interpretable environmental concepts across five forward splits and one prospectively locked test year. Coarse environment-level explanations transport reliably (median cosine 0.83); their locked 2024 value, 0.811, fell within a prespecified 80% bootstrap percentile interval. For grain yield, genotype-conditioned explanations have a historical median cosine of 0.30 and range from 0.006 to 0.822 across years. Reliability does not order these outcomes: the year with the highest split-half reliability had the lowest explanation transport. Within-context resampling showed that GxE explanations were reproducible within a fixed context (0.77-0.95) while exhibiting lower prospective alignment across the 2020-2023 transitions (0.01-0.36). A second phenotype transports strongly at both resolutions, and non-temporal validation inflates apparent interaction-level transport by +0.22. These results show that target reliability and within-context explanation reproducibility do not by themselves establish when a model explanation can support a reproducible scientific claim.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出并检验"前瞻性解释可迁移性"（prospective explanation transportability），即从历史数据中学到的解释在未来真实情境中被复现的程度。基于Genomes-to-Fields多年玉米试验，发现粗粒度环境层面解释可稳定迁移（中位余弦0.83，锁定2024年为0.811，落在预设80%自助区间内），但基因型条件下的细粒度交互解释迁移性差（历史中位0.30，跨年0.006–0.822）。关键结论：目标测量可靠性与情境内解释可复现性，均不足以保证解释能支持可复现的科学主张。
AI.motivation: 模型解释越来越被当作科学证据使用，但尚不清楚它们究竟能让科学家在建模数据之外得出什么结论。当细粒度解释无法复现时，人们常把失败归因于目标测量的噪声；由此产生一个根本问题：可靠的测量是否意味着可复现的解释？现有评估多用随机重采样或非时序验证，无法回答解释能否迁移到真正的未来情境。
AI.method: 形式化定义"前瞻性解释可迁移性"，并论证其区别于特征重要性与测量可靠性。利用Genomes-to-Fields多年玉米试验（每年为真实未来情境而非随机重采样），评估16个农艺可解释的环境概念，采用5个前向切分与1个前瞻性锁定测试年（2024）；辅以分裂半信度分析、情境内重采样（2020–2023年际转移）、第二表型验证及非时序验证对比。
AI.result: 粗粒度环境层面解释迁移可靠：中位余弦0.83，锁定2024年值0.811，落在预设80%自助百分位区间内。对籽粒产量，基因型条件解释历史中位余弦仅0.30，跨年范围0.006–0.822。可靠性无法排序这些结果：分裂半信度最高的年份解释迁移最低。情境内重采样显示GxE解释在固定情境内可复现（0.77–0.95），但跨越2020–2023年际转移时前瞻对齐度较低（0.01–0.36）。第二个表型在两个分辨率上均强迁移；非时序验证将表观交互层面迁移性虚高约+0.22。
AI.conclusion: 目标可靠性与情境内解释可复现性本身并不足以确定模型解释何时能支撑可复现的科学主张。解释的可迁移性需作为独立性质、在真实未来情境中显式评估；非时序验证会系统性高估细粒度解释的稳健性。

title: One View, One Action: Spatially Generalizable VLAs through Observation-Aligned Experts and Cross Graph Consistency
summary: Multi-view vision-language-action (VLA) models still face challenges in spatial generalization, particularly under changes in camera viewpoints and robot initial states. These models typically receive action supervision only in the robot base frame, requiring them to implicitly learn the spatial correspondence between observations from each view and base-frame actions. We propose One View, One Action (OVOA-VLA), which learns to predict actions in each view's camera frame, allowing the same physical motion to provide diverse, observation-aligned supervision across views. OVOA-VLA jointly trains a base-frame expert and view-specific action experts, whose robot-state inputs and action targets are expressed in their respective camera frames. Two complementary directed attention graphs model both directions of interaction between the base and view-specific experts, jointly leveraging view-specific action supervision to improve base-frame prediction. Cross Graph Consistency further encourages agreement between the two graphs' base-frame predictions for the same sample. With the same multi-view inputs, the model supports both full and base-only inference. Experiments across multiple simulation benchmarks demonstrate improved manipulation performance and robustness to camera-viewpoint and robot-initialization perturbations. Full and base-only inference achieve average success rates of 88.1% and 85.7% on LIBERO-Plus, respectively. In real-world evaluations, base-only inference raises the average success rates from $π_{0.5}$'s 28.3% to 58.3% across three tasks under spatial distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出OVOA-VLA，让每个视角在自身相机坐标系下预测动作，从而为同一物理运动提供与观测对齐的多视角多样监督，提升多视角VLA模型的空间泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多视角VLA模型通常只在机器人基座坐标系下接受动作监督，需隐式学习各视角观测与基座坐标动作间的空间对应关系，导致在相机视角与机器人初始状态变化时空间泛化能力不足。
AI.method: OVOA-VLA在每个视角的相机坐标系下预测动作；联合训练一个基座坐标系专家与多个视角特定动作专家，其机器人状态输入与动作目标分别表达在各自相机坐标系中；构建两个互补的有向注意力图建模基座专家与视角专家的双向交互；引入Cross Graph Consistency约束两个图对同一样本基座坐标预测的一致性；支持完整多视角推理与仅基座推理两种模式。
AI.result: 多个仿真基准上操作性能提升，对相机视角与机器人初始化的扰动更鲁棒；LIBERO-Plus上完整推理与仅基座推理平均成功率分别为88.1%与85.7%；真实场景三个任务在空间分布偏移下，仅基座推理将平均成功率从π0.5的28.3%提升至58.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以视角对齐的动作监督替代纯基座坐标监督，并结合双向注意力交互与跨图一致性约束，可显著改善多视角VLA模型的空间泛化，并在保持单路推理可用性的同时获得性能增益。

title: Whose Risks Count? What 1,901 AI Incidents Reveal About Corporate Disclosures
summary: AI systems can harm people, yet the AI actors that provide or deploy them are rarely obliged to disclose these risks. US securities regulation is an exception. Companies registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) must disclose their material risks, including those of their AI systems, in filings that carry liability for misstatement. Materiality, however, is defined by what a reasonable investor would consider important, so harms to third parties enter disclosure only insofar as they become financial risks for the company. We test whether AI harms do so by matching 9,001 AI incidents to 18,229 SEC filings of 328 AI actors by risk type. Of the 1,901 incidents with filings before and after them, half belong to a risk type that the AI actor never disclosed, and this share varies with the kind of harm. Filings disclose the risk types of 67\% of system failures but only 2\% of social system harms, and AI actors themselves report fewer than 2\% of incidents. Securities disclosure thus records the risks that AI actors face rather than the harms that people subject to AI bear. Public authorities that hold AI actors accountable for such harms could make them financially material. We release DISC, the Disclosure--Incident Securities Corpus, to support this work.

AI.tldr: 本文检验AI危害是否通过"财务重大性"转化为SEC信息披露内容，发现披露记录的是AI行为体自身承受的风险，而非受AI影响的公众所承受的危害。
AI.motivation: AI系统可对人们造成危害，但提供或部署AI的行为体很少被强制披露这些风险；美国SEC证券监管是例外，要求注册公司披露重大风险（含AI系统风险）并承担错报责任。然而"重大性"以理性投资者是否认为重要为界定标准，第三方所受危害只有转化为公司财务风险时才进入披露范围。作者因此要实证检验AI危害是否确实产生了这种财务传导。
AI.method: 按风险类型，将9,001起AI事件与328个AI行为体的18,229份SEC申报文件进行匹配；在其中1,901起事件存在事前与事后申报文件的子样本中，检验事件发生后AI行为体是否披露了对应风险类型；同时统计AI行为体自身报告事件的比例。构建并发布DISC（Disclosure–Incident Securities Corpus）语料库。
AI.result: 1,901起有前后申报文件的事件中，一半属于该AI行为体从未披露过的风险类型，且该比例随危害种类而异：67%的系统故障类风险被披露，而社会系统危害仅2%被披露；AI行为体自身报告的事件不足2%。
AI.conclusion: 证券披露机制记录的是AI行为体所面临的风险，而非受AI支配的人们所承受的危害。若公共机构让AI行为体对这些危害承担问责，则可使其在财务上具备重大性，从而进入披露范围。

title: UniReFP: Robust Unified Fingerprinting for Vision Models against Cross-Task Repurposing Attacks
summary: We identify, for the first time, a new model modification attack--the cross-task model repurposing attack--that can render fingerprints generated by existing model fingerprinting approaches inapplicable. To address this challenge, we propose UniReFP--a novel unified model fingerprinting framework applicable to diverse vision models across different tasks--that utilizes ownership evidence in a shared class-level semantic space rather than original task-specific output space, enabling effective ownership verification when a protected model is repurposed across tasks with heterogeneous output formats. Specifically, UniReFP constructs a surrogate classifier by repurposing the protected model, enabling fingerprints to be generated independently of the original task-dependent output space of the protected model. Moreover, it optimizes grouped fingerprints to encode ownership evidence: fingerprints within the same group are encouraged to induce consistent semantic responses and intermediate representations on the surrogate classifier, while producing dispersed responses on independently trained reference classifiers. During verification, UniReFP uses a task-aware semantic projection mechanism to map heterogeneous suspect-model outputs into unified semantic-presence vectors, and determines ownership by measuring inner-group consistency. Extensive experimental results validate the effectiveness of UniReFP, consistently showing superior performance under cross-task repurposing attacks, commonly studied model modification attacks, and even their combinations.

AI.tldr: 该文首次提出"跨任务模型复用攻击"（cross-task model repurposing attack），使现有模型指纹方法失效；为此提出统一模型指纹框架UniReFP，在共享的类级语义空间而非原任务输出空间中编码所有权证据，实现跨异构输出格式任务的有效所有权验证。
AI.motivation: 现有模型指纹方法依赖模型原始任务相关的输出空间（如特定分类头输出），当攻击者将受保护模型复用/改造到另一任务（异构输出格式）时，原有指纹失效。作者首先识别出这一新型模型修改攻击——跨任务模型复用攻击，并针对其提出通用指纹方案。
AI.method: UniReFP核心技术：(1) 通过复用受保护模型构造替代分类器（surrogate classifier），使指纹生成独立于原任务相关输出空间；(2) 优化分组指纹，使同组指纹在替代分类器上诱导一致的语义响应与中间层表示，同时在独立训练的参考分类器上产生分散响应；(3) 验证阶段采用任务感知语义投影机制，将异构可疑模型输出映射为统一语义存在向量，通过度量组内一致性判定所有权。
AI.result: 大量实验表明UniReFP在跨任务复用攻击、常见模型修改攻击及其组合场景下均持续取得优越性能，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: UniReFP是一种适用于不同任务、多种视觉模型的统一模型指纹框架，通过共享类级语义空间中的所有权证据解决了跨任务复用场景下的所有权验证难题，对各类模型修改攻击及其组合均具鲁棒性。

title: PosteriorBench: Evaluating Behavior Posterior Sampling in Language Models
summary: Rare language model behaviors can be difficult to study because obtaining them through ordinary sampling can require a very large number of samples. This motivates the behavior posterior sampling problem: given a language model and a behavior of interest, is there an algorithm that efficiently samples from the model's distribution over transcripts that exhibit this behavior? We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for comparing algorithms by their compute cost and by how close their samples are to the true posterior in forward and reverse KL divergence. PosteriorBench contains 21 tasks on Qwen3.5-0.8B with behavior probabilities from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-1}$, each with exact posterior samples from a corpus of one billion labeled responses. We find that no method we evaluate is both efficient and faithful: simple methods like prompting are cheap but plateau at a high KL divergence from the posterior, fine-tuning on posterior samples is often cost-prohibitive, and several training methods from prior work do not perform better. Building a posterior sampler that can cheaply approximate the true posterior remains an open problem, and we hope PosteriorBench can measure progress towards this objective. Code and data are available at https://github.com/TransluceAI/PosteriorBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 PosteriorBench 基准，用于评测"行为后验采样"算法：在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的 21 个稀有行为任务上，以计算成本与正/反向 KL 散度衡量各方法，结果显示现有方法无法同时兼顾效率与忠实性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的稀有行为难以研究，因为常规采样往往需要极大量样本才能观察到目标行为。因此希望研究"行为后验采样"问题：给定模型与目标行为，是否存在能高效地从模型在表现出该行为的对话记录上的条件分布中采样的算法。现有工作缺乏统一的、可量化比较的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 PosteriorBench 基准：包含 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上的 21 个任务，行为概率覆盖 10^-5 至 10^-1；基于十亿级标注回复语料为每个任务提供精确的后验样本作为参照；以计算成本、以及样本与真实后验之间的前向与反向 KL 散度作为双重评价指标，对比提示、在后续样本上微调及若干既有训练方法。
AI.result: 所评估的方法均无法同时做到高效与忠实：简单提示方法成本低但 KL 散度在高位饱和（偏离后验显著）；在后验样本上微调通常成本过高；若干先前工作的训练方法也未表现出更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 构建能廉价近似真实后验的采样器仍是一个开放问题；作者希望 PosteriorBench 成为衡量该目标进展的标准化基准，代码与数据已开源。

title: Planning to Stop: Factored Certification and Terminal Repair for Noncircular Robots
summary: Tight-space navigation requires a robot to clear obstacles and stop inside its goal despite uncertainty. We present GeoDiff, a motion-program planner coupling original-goal stopped-set inclusion, witness-guided terminal repair, and factored proof compilation. An exact feasible-translation characterization guides repair; request-local reuse reduces repeated geometric work. We establish conditions for compiler equivalence and reach-and-stop soundness. Across 11,440 floorplan-derived jobs, GeoDiff certifies 61/139 tasks at 5-cm tolerance within 15 s, versus 44/139 for the stop-set baseline. The strongest observed external certificate adapter certifies 13/139 tasks from 119/139 native routes, separating route availability from certification. On tasks derived from public BARN maps, GeoDiff certifies 202/270 at 5-cm tolerance for a Jackal-shaped body, versus 3/270 for the portal baseline. Development analyses distinguish emitter savings from solver coverage, and 1,420 route-tracking episodes characterize the execution interface. These results show how terminal reasoning and proof reuse increase finite-budget certification coverage while preserving the original physical task and goal.

AI.tldr: GeoDiff是一种运动程序规划器，将原始目标停止集包含性、见证引导的终端修复与因式化证明编译相结合，在有限计算预算内显著提升紧空间导航的认证覆盖率，同时保持原始物理任务与目标不变。
AI.motivation: 紧空间导航要求机器人在不确定性下既要避开障碍，又必须真正停在目标内部。现有"停止集"类基线在有限预算内认证覆盖率低，且路线可得性与认证能力被混为一谈，缺乏对终端停机与证明复用的系统处理。
AI.method: （1）对原始目标的停止集包含性进行编码，而非放宽目标；（2）给出精确的可行平移刻画以引导终端修复，并借助见证（witness）驱动修复流程；（3）采用因式化证明编译，并支持请求局部复用以减少重复几何计算；（4）理论上建立编译器等价性与"到达并停止"可靠性条件。
AI.result: 在11,440个平面图衍生任务中，GeoDiff在15秒内以5厘米容差认证61/139个任务，停止集基线为44/139；最强外部证书适配器从119/139条原生路线中仅认证13/139，分离了路线可得性与认证能力。在公开BARN地图任务上，Jackal形状本体认证202/270，portal基线仅3/270。消融区分了发射器节省与求解器覆盖，1,420次路线跟踪回合刻画了执行接口。
AI.conclusion: 终端推理与证明复用能在有限预算下提升认证覆盖率，同时严格保持原始物理任务与目标；路线存在不等于可认证，需将停止性纳入规划与证明流程。

title: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
summary: Personalized LLM agents must act on a user's current preferences, which change across interactions and are rarely stated in full. Existing memory systems store and retrieve content from the interaction history and leave the agent to work out which preferences still hold and where they apply. Such content does not indicate whether a preference is still current or where it applies, so agents often act on outdated or misapplied preferences. We instead treat memory as the assistant's belief about the user. Following Bourdieu's account of habitus as durable but revisable dispositions, we model the user as a latent preference state that every interaction, including the current request, both reveals and updates. The belief summarizes what the history supports about this state, and memory consists of the individual beliefs that bear on the agent's current decision, each with its evidence, scope, and status. We implement this view in HabitusMem, a trained writer that states these beliefs as text records for a frozen agent. Across two agent families, HabitusMem achieves the best results among memory systems on both PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0. Controlled analyses show that learned request conditioning drives the answering gain, while auxiliary training tasks improve tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将记忆视为助手对用户潜在偏好状态的"信念"，并实现 HabitusMem：一个训练式记忆写入器，把信念写成带证据、适用范围与状态状态的文本记录，供冻结的智能体使用；在 PersonaMem-v2 与 VitaBench 2.0 上，跨两个智能体家族取得记忆系统中最优结果。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM 智能体需依据用户当前偏好行动，但偏好随交互演化且少有完整表述。现有记忆系统只存储并检索交互历史内容，不标注偏好是否仍然有效、适用于何处，导致智能体依据过时或误用的偏好行动。
AI.method: 借鉴 Bourdieu 的"惯习"（持久但可修正的倾向）概念，将用户建模为潜在偏好状态：每次交互（含当前请求）既揭示也更新该状态。记忆即对该状态的后验信念，由与当前决策相关的个体信念构成，每条信念携带证据、适用范围和状态。以训练得到的写入器 HabitusMem 将这些信念表述为文本记录，供冻结的智能体读取使用。
AI.result: 在两个智能体家族上，HabitusMem 在 PersonaMem-v2 与 VitaBench 2.0 两个基准上均优于所有对比记忆系统。控制实验表明：学习到的"请求条件化"是回答性能提升的主要驱动因素，而辅助训练任务改善了工具使用表现。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆重新表述为对用户潜在偏好状态的信念（含证据、范围、时效），并由训练式写入器显式输出，可有效缓解偏好过时与误用问题，为个性化智能体记忆提供了一种可训练、可迁移（冻结智能体即插即用）的方案。

title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
summary: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos. Using only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions, our model identifies and localizes completed action attempts and classifies them as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions; omitted steps are determined after the video ends. We compare a modular pipeline, with separate step identification, temporal localization, and execution verification, to a joint model that predicts all outputs in a single step. To support supervised learning from mistakes, we repartition EgoPER to include erroneous videos in all splits. The approaches achieve similar step-segmentation F1@0.5 (93.6% and 92.1%), while the joint model achieves higher binary mistake-detection F1@0.5 (84.1% vs. 80.7%), with its largest gain on slips (56.4% vs. 37.5%). Component-level analysis suggests that error propagation between stages contributes to the modular approach's lower detection score. On test videos containing mistakes, both designs outperform released AEM and ESTANet checkpoints under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出在线、指令条件化的自我中心视频错误检测任务，模型仅用已观测视频、任务指令与历史预测，实时识别并定位动作尝试并分类为正确、修改、失误、纠正、添加（遗漏事后判定）。对比模块化流水线与联合单步模型，并重新划分EgoPER使各划分含错误视频。联合模型二元错误检测F1@0.5达84.1%（模块化80.7%），在失误类上提升最大（56.4% vs 37.5%）；两者分段F1@0.5相近（93.6% vs 92.1%），且在含错误测试视频上均优于AEM与ESTANet已发布权重。
AI.motivation: 辅助监测的价值在于“错误仍可挽回时”即被发现，因此需要在视频流式展开过程中，将动作与任务指令实时比对。现有在线检测器不利用指令文本，而指令条件化方法只能离线运行，二者无法满足实时纠错需求。
AI.method: 将问题定义为在线、指令条件的自我中心错误检测：输入为已观测视频、指令文本与先验预测。设计两类方案：(1) 模块化流水线，分解为步骤识别、时间定位、执行验证三个独立阶段；(2) 联合模型，单步同时输出全部结果。类别包括correct、modified、slip、corrections、additions，遗漏步骤在视频结束后判定。数据上重新划分EgoPER，使全部划分均包含错误视频，以支持从错误中监督学习。评估采用步骤分段F1@0.5与二元错误检测F1@0.5，并做组件级误差传播分析。
AI.result: 步骤分段F1@0.5：模块化93.6%、联合92.1%，二者接近。二元错误检测F1@0.5：联合84.1%优于模块化80.7%。增益主要来自slip类（联合56.4% vs 模块化37.5%）。组件级分析表明阶段间误差传播是模块化方案检测分数偏低的原因。在含错误的测试视频上，两种设计均优于已发布的AEM与ESTANet权重（同一评估协议下）。
AI.conclusion: 在线指令条件化错误检测可行，且联合建模在错误检测（尤其slip）上优于解耦流水线，说明端到端联合预测可缓解多阶段误差累积；分段能力并非瓶颈，瓶颈在细粒度执行判定。未来方向可聚焦于减少模块间误差传播、提升slip类召回及在线遗漏与纠正的时序处理。

title: Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
summary: Exploration remains a major challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) agents in Craftax-style environments due to sparse rewards and long horizons. Large language models (LLMs) can guide exploration by generating high-level goals, but methods using models without explicit task adaptation often rely on carefully designed prompts and may produce inconsistent or contextually inappropriate goals. We introduce CCGP-2M, a multimodal goal-preference dataset constructed from interaction trajectories in Craftax-Classic, and propose a vision-language model (VLM)-guided RL framework that learns environment-specific goal guidance from this dataset. The framework consists of two stages: offline VLM fine-tuning and online goal-guided RL. In the offline stage, we align the VLM with goal preferences using Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization (KLTDPO), which combines token-level KL regularization with distributionally robust reweighting. Experiments on Craftax-Classic show that our method collects diamonds earlier than state-of-the-art baselines, achieves the highest score and reward, and attains the highest success rates on most achievements.

AI.tldr: 提出CCGP-2M多模态目标偏好数据集与VLM引导的RL框架，通过离线KLTDPO微调VLM再在线目标引导强化学习，在Craftax-Classic上更快收集钻石并取得最高分数与多数成就成功率。
AI.motivation: Craftax类环境存在稀疏奖励与长时序问题，探索是RL智能体的主要挑战。用LLM生成高层目标可引导探索，但未做显式任务适配的模型依赖精心设计的提示词，生成的目标可能不一致或不符合情境。
AI.method: 构建CCGP-2M——由Craftax-Classic交互轨迹得到的多模态目标偏好数据集；提出两阶段VLM引导RL框架：(1) 离线VLM微调，用KLTDPO对齐目标偏好，该方法结合token级KL正则与分布鲁棒重加权；(2) 在线目标引导RL。
AI.result: 在Craftax-Classic上，方法比SOTA基线更早收集到钻石，获得最高分数与奖励，并在多数成就上取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据集驱动的VLM目标偏好对齐，可为长时序稀疏奖励环境提供有效、情境适配的探索引导，优于依赖提示工程的LLM引导方法。

title: EmbodyAgent: Post-Training Embodied VLM Agents via Distillation, SFT, and RL
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Code-as-policy robot-use agent post-training
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can act as closed-loop robot-use agents (RUAs) by writing and executing control code through tool interfaces. However, turning an open-weight VLM into a high-performing embodied agent requires a complete post-training stack: out-of-the-box open VLMs fail completely at interactive tool contracts, strong frontier teachers are accessible only as black-box endpoints without exposed weights or token probabilities, and supervised imitation alone plateaus under rollout distribution shift. We present EmbodyAgent, an end-to-end post-training framework with three tightly coupled pipelines: (1) a black-box data synthesis pipeline that queries a strong teacher under a forced think-then-code contract and filters trajectories by task success; (2) an SFT pipeline that distills the explanation-and-program targets into an open-weight 9B VLM with both vision and language encoders trainable; and (3) an online RL pipeline that optimizes student-generated episodes via group-relative advantage with a runtime-error-penalized outcome reward. All three pipelines share one primitive-free Python execution tool exposing only raw visual observation and seven-dimensional end-effector control, with no action decoder and no interface shift across stages. Under a strictly separated evaluation protocol on ten LIBERO Spatial tasks (disjoint state splits, greedy test-time decoding, training-only safeguards), held-out success on 100 test states rises from 0/100 (base 9B VLM) to 14/100 (after SFT) and 84/100 (after RL), while training rollout success climbs from 8.4% to 87.7% and median model calls per episode drop from 36 to 11. We further identify a self-reinforcing runtime-error mode induced by outcome-based RL on executable code, and establish a failure-category monitoring and sampling-side curation protocol that stabilizes training.

AI.tldr: 提出 EmbodyAgent 端到端后训练框架（黑盒数据合成 + SFT 蒸馏 + 在线 RL），使开源 9B VLM 在 LIBERO Spatial 十任务上从 0/100 提升至 84/100 成功率。
AI.motivation: 开权重 VLM 直接作为闭环机器人智能体时无法满足交互式工具契约；前沿教师模型仅以黑盒 API 形式可用，缺少权重与 token 概率；纯监督模仿在 rollout 分布漂移下性能饱和。因此需要一套完整后训练栈把开源 VLM 转为高性能具身智能体。
AI.method: 三条紧耦合流水线共享同一无原语 Python 执行工具（仅暴露原始视觉观测与 7 维末端执行器控制，无动作解码器、阶段间无接口切换）：(1) 黑盒数据合成：在强制"先思考后写码"契约下查询强教师，按任务成功过滤轨迹；(2) SFT：将解释与程序目标蒸馏进视觉、语言编码器均可训练的开权重 9B VLM；(3) 在线 RL：基于组相对优势优化学生自生成 episode，采用带运行时错误惩罚的结果奖励。评测采用严格分离协议（不相交状态划分、贪心解码、仅训练期防护），并提出失败类别监控与采样侧数据筛选协议以稳定训练。
AI.result: 100 个留出测试状态上的成功率：基座 9B VLM 为 0/100，SFT 后 14/100，RL 后 84/100；训练 rollout 成功率由 8.4% 升至 87.7%，每 episode 中位模型调用次数由 36 降至 11。另发现基于结果奖励的可执行代码 RL 会诱发自我强化的运行时错误模式。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒教师蒸馏加在线 RL 的完整后训练栈可显著将开源 VLM 转化为闭环机器人使用智能体；同时需针对可执行代码 RL 中的运行时错误自强化现象建立失败类别监控与采样筛选机制以保障训练稳定性。

title: Decoupled Knowledge Retrieval and Compact Memory Enable Reliable Lifelong Model Editing
summary: Lifelong model editing requires continuously incorporating new facts into deployed large language models (LLMs) without expensive retraining or compromising existing capabilities. Memory-based editors offer an appealing solution by keeping the base parameters untouched, yet their practical use is hindered by linearly growing storage requirements and deteriorating retrieval performance as edits accumulate. To tackle these problems, we introduce BiSpace, a lifelong model editing framework that decouples memory retrieval from knowledge injection across two distinct representation spaces. BiSpace routes queries and identifies relevant edits in an external semantic space, while injecting the corresponding knowledge into the internal representation space of the LLM through sparse and storage-efficient updates. Extensive experiments show that BiSpace shrinks each entry's storage to only about 10.2% of the original and shows strong resilience to long edit sequences of up to 16K edits. On a more challenging benchmark, BiSpace further improves Overall Performance by more than 23% over existing methods. These results advance memory-based editing toward reliable long-term model maintenance at scale.

AI.tldr: BiSpace是一个终身模型编辑框架，通过在外部语义空间检索、在LLM内部表示空间稀疏注入知识，实现存储高效、可扩展到超长编辑序列（16K）的终身编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆的编辑器虽保持基座参数不变，但存在存储线性增长和随编辑累积导致检索性能退化的问题，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出BiSpace，将记忆检索与知识注入解耦到两个不同表示空间：在外部语义空间路由查询并定位相关编辑，再通过稀疏、存储高效的更新将对应知识注入LLM内部表示空间。
AI.result: 每条记忆条目存储量降至原来的约10.2%；对长达16K次的编辑序列表现出强鲁棒性；在更具挑战性的基准上，整体性能较现有方法提升超过23%。
AI.conclusion: BiSpace将基于记忆的模型编辑推向大规模、可靠的长期模型维护。

title: VidToC: Rethinking Video Token Compression for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Extending multimodal large language models (MLLMs) from images to videos faces substantial memory and latency challenges due to the massive number of visual tokens. These challenges have driven the development of numerous visual token compression methods and more efficient LLM architectures. However, existing compression methods are often evaluated with different training setups, tasks, and models, making fair comparison difficult. Meanwhile, the growing use of hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures raises questions about whether compression strategies transfer across backbones. We present VidToC, a controlled evaluation framework for representative compression algorithms, LLM backbones, and time encoding strategies, covering training-free and fine-tuned settings on three complementary video understanding tasks. Our results reveal task-dependent compression behavior and characterize the effects of compression placement, time encoding, and backbone choice. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing and selecting video token compression strategies across tasks and training settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 VidToC 受控评测框架，系统对比视频视觉 token 压缩算法、LLM 骨干与时间编码策略，揭示压缩行为依赖任务，并刻画压缩位置、时间编码与骨干选择的影响。
AI.motivation: MLLM 从图像扩展到视频时，海量视觉 token 带来显著显存与延迟开销，催生大量视频 token 压缩方法与更高效的 LLM 架构；但现有压缩方法在训练设置、任务和模型上各不相同，难以公平比较，且混合 Mamba-Transformer 骨干下压缩策略能否迁移尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建 VidToC 受控评测框架，统一评测设置，覆盖代表性压缩算法、多种 LLM 骨干与时间编码策略，包含免训练与微调两种设定，并在三个互补的视频理解任务上进行实验。
AI.result: 实验显示压缩效果具有明显的任务依赖性，并系统刻画了压缩插入位置、时间编码方式以及骨干架构选择对性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为在不同任务与训练设置下设计、选择视频 token 压缩策略提供了实证性指导。

title: Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration
summary: Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tracking. Pre-filter blanking removed 97.90% and 97.60% of false flatline conflicts while preserving 99.23% and 98.96% of deep suppression. On unseen TIVA surgeries (N = 525), cortical features achieved area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) 0.3135 (1.94% prevalence) and 0.1627 (0.82% lag-free prevalence), with no detectable difference from deep encoders (p >= 0.36) and no cortical gain for hypotension (0.3432 vs. 0.3437, p = 0.784). Zero-retraining volatile transfer (N = 1,048) showed no detectable difference from an end-tidal gas oracle on lag-free suppression (0.0820 vs. 0.0736, p = 0.472). Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted CRC bounded all 70 TIVA shift cells at <= 4.38% (alpha = 5.0%) in 66.32 ms per 30-s epoch. Causal artifact disentangling and shift-aware conformal calibration support reliable real-time intraoperative risk bounds within explicit physiological observability limits.

AI.tldr: 提出因果信号调理+偏移鲁棒保形校准框架，解决术中EEG/血压监护仪伪迹对风险预测与不确定性校准的干扰。
AI.motivation: 商用术中EEG与血压监护仪引入周期性阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流漂移与袖带保持等伪迹，严重干扰风险预测与不确定性校准。
AI.method: 基于5,439例公开麻醉手术：流式滤波屏蔽10.13分钟64-Hz阻抗检查、无削波陷波后调理、分离63-s抑制比滞后、三通道袖带充气与掉线区分；去阻抗皮层树集成对比深度序列模型，配合患者簇Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted保形风险控制(CRC)与滞后缓冲在线保形PID跟踪。覆盖TIVA(N=3,214)、挥发性麻醉(N=2,046)、欧洲内镜镇静(N=171)、DC耦合手术(N=8)。
AI.result: 滤波前屏蔽消除97.90%/97.60%的假平线冲突，保留99.23%/98.96%深度抑制；未见TIVA(N=525)上AUPRC 0.3135(1.94%患病率)、0.1627(0.82%无滞后)，与深度编码器无显著差异(p≥0.36)，低血压无皮层增益(0.3432 vs 0.3437, p=0.784)；零重训练挥发性转移(N=1,048)与呼气末气体oracle无显著差异(0.0820 vs 0.0736, p=0.472)；CRC将全部70个TIVA偏移单元限制在≤4.38%(α=5.0%)，每30-s epoch耗时66.32 ms。
AI.conclusion: 因果伪迹解耦与偏移感知保形校准可在明确生理可观测性限制内实现可靠的实时术中风险界。

title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
comment: A two-stage pipeline that teaches VLAs to stop prohibited tasks safely while preserving permitted skills
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.

AI.tldr: 提出状态感知回退模仿（SAFI），让VLA机器人在任务执行中途被接管时学习显式替代响应，而非仅抑制任务，从而在降低违规完成率的同时避免掉落物体等物理事故。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多关注任务抑制与拒答，但受禁行为一旦已在执行中，如何中途停止并控制身体反应仍是难题。作者发现：仅抑制初始状态策略的模型在部分执行后接管仍能完成任务；即使任务未完成，机器人也可能掉落手中物体，故"未完成"不足以衡量安全性。
AI.method: SAFI分两阶段：(1) 回退目标构建——在受禁任务演示的全过程中设定静止的手臂指令与一致的夹爪目标；(2) 联合策略适配——将这些目标与保留任务的原始动作一并学习，在中间执行状态提供明确替代响应监督，同时保持其他技能不变。在OpenVLA-OFT上用LIBERO与BadLIBERO基准评估。
AI.result: 评估指标为受禁任务完成度、物理事故与保留任务性能。在测试的LIBERO任务上，接管后的聚合目标成功率降至1.3%，未记录物理事故，无动作饱和，且保留任务成功率保持较高水平。
AI.conclusion: 安全不仅要求任务不被完成，更需规定安全的物理响应；通过在中间状态显式监督"持握式回退"行为，SAFI有效实现中途停止并避免掉落等事故，且不损害原有能力。

title: Generalist Meets Specialists: An Evolving Multimodal Agent with Persistent Tool Orchestration for Traffic Scenario Understanding
summary: Traffic scenario understanding requires combining fine-grained visual evidence with spatial and temporal reasoning. Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can use specialized perception tools, but effective collaboration faces two challenges: terminal rewards provide limited guidance for intermediate decisions and error recovery, while repeated planning adds unnecessary cost across similar tasks. Echoing the fast-slow dichotomy of human cognition, we propose StarTV-Agent, which combines policy learning with experience evolution to support adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience when possible. During training, Role-Sensitive Process Optimization (RSPO) combines process advantages with terminal advantages, while Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning (WDL) provides validated teacher demonstrations targeting the student's weak questions. During inference, Lightweight Adaptive Workflow Reuse (LAWR) enables a fast path by selecting suitable workflows and binding task-specific arguments and resource references, while a slow ReAct-based path handles tasks without suitable workflows. We further design label-free feedback based on execution completion, workflow adoption, and cost savings to guide workflow reuse and memory updates. Across three challenging benchmarks, StarTV-Agent achieves up to 8.0% relative performance improvement, while reducing token consumption by up to 52.1%.

AI.tldr: 提出 StarTV-Agent，将策略学习与经验演化结合，实现"能复用经验时快、需自适应推理时慢"的工具增强 VLM 智能体，用于交通场景理解。
AI.motivation: 交通场景理解需融合细粒度视觉证据与时空推理。现有工具增强 VLM 面临两点：终端奖励对中间决策与错误恢复指导不足；相似任务上重复规划造成冗余开销。
AI.method: 训练端：角色敏感过程优化（RSPO）融合过程优势与终端优势；弱点驱动示范学习（WDL）针对学生薄弱问题提供经校验的教师示范。推理端：轻量自适应工作流复用（LAWR）通过选取合适工作流并绑定任务特定参数与资源引用形成快路径，不匹配时回退到基于 ReAct 的慢路径；并设计基于执行完成度、工作流采纳率与成本节约的无标注反馈，用于指导工作流复用与记忆更新。
AI.result: 在三个挑战性基准上，相对性能提升最高 8.0%，同时 token 消耗最多降低 52.1%。
AI.conclusion: 以"快—慢"双通路架构统一经验复用与自适应推理，配合过程级优化与无标注反馈，可在提升性能的同时显著降低推理成本。

title: QFT-Based Hybrid PointNet-Quantum Neural Networks for LiDAR Point-Cloud Classification
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical learning architectures provide a promising framework for integrating quantum feature transformations into complex data-processing tasks. Among these transformations, the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) offers a structured approach to feature processing, motivating an investigation of how its circuit configuration influences predictive performance, quantum resource requirements, and noise robustness. We present a hybrid PointNet-quantum neural network architecture for LiDAR point-cloud classification, combining classical feature extraction, amplitude encoding, and a variational quantum circuit. Five Fourier-processing configurations are systematically evaluated: No-QFT, Full-QFT-After, QFT-no-swap, IQFT-After, and Trainable-QFT. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and PandaSet across three random seeds assess classification performance, class-level behavior, circuit complexity, and sensitivity to the IBM FakeManilaV2 noise model. Under ideal simulation, IQFT-After achieves the highest weighted F1-score on KITTI (0.857 $\pm$ 0.033), compared with 0.838 $\pm$ 0.023 for No-QFT. Removing the final SWAP gates in the QFT circuit reduces circuit complexity while preserving the Pauli-Z measurement features up to a fixed permutation that can be absorbed by the classification head. Under quantum noise, the circuit ranking changes, with IQFT-After exhibiting greater performance degradation and No-QFT and Trainable-QFT showing stronger robustness. Per-class analysis further identifies dataset-dependent differences in minority-class performance. These results demonstrate that Fourier-processing configuration influences both classification behavior and noise sensitivity, highlighting the role of circuit structure and hardware-aware evaluation in hybrid quantum learning for three-dimensional point-cloud data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出混合PointNet-量子神经网络用于LiDAR点云分类，系统比较5种QFT电路配置在理想与噪声条件下的表现，发现IQFT-After理想下F1最高但在噪声下退化最明显，而无QFT与可训练QFT更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 量子傅里叶变换（QFT）为特征处理提供结构化手段，但其电路配置如何影响预测性能、量子资源需求与噪声鲁棒性尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建混合PointNet-量子网络：经典特征提取 + 幅度编码 + 变分量子电路；在KITTI、nuScenes、PandaSet上以3个随机种子评测5种配置（No-QFT、Full-QFT-After、QFT-no-swap、IQFT-After、Trainable-QFT），分析分类性能、类别级行为、电路复杂度及对IBM FakeManilaV2噪声模型的敏感性。
AI.result: 理想仿真下IQFT-After在KITTI取得最高加权F1（0.857±0.033），No-QFT为0.838±0.023；去掉QFT末端的SWAP门可降低电路复杂度且保持Pauli-Z测量特征（至多相差可由分类头吸收的固定置换）；噪声下排序改变，IQFT-After退化更大，No-QFT与Trainable-QFT更鲁棒；少数类性能存在数据集相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 傅里叶处理配置同时影响分类行为与噪声敏感性，说明电路结构与面向硬件的评测在三维点云混合量子学习中具有关键作用。

title: RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correctness. We report four linked results. First, probes on router logits separate correct from erroneous steps in eight checkpoints (AUROC 0.80-0.88). Second, replacing router logits across all routed layers changes the judgment in all nine checkpoints, and by more than a norm-matched random replacement. Third, this change rarely depends on whether the source step is correct. At one layer, routing from erroneous steps and from correct steps produces indistinguishable margins in all nine checkpoints. Under all-layer routing, their difference is resolved and positive in only one. Fourth, the same difference is positive for local residual replacements in eight of nine checkpoints, so the measure does detect such dependence where it exists. Correctness is therefore readable from routing, and routing replacements move the judgment, but the movement rarely follows correctness.

AI.tldr: 路由状态能区分正确与错误的推理步骤，且替换路由会改变模型的步骤级验证判断；但该判断的变化很少依赖于源步骤的正确性，即"正确性可从路由读出"不等于"判断由路由所编码的正确性驱动"。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型的路由状态可区分正确与错误推理步骤，且干预路由会改变步级验证判断，容易让人推断验证判断遵循路由所编码的信息。作者要检验这一推断是否成立，即路由替换引起的判断变化是否真正由源步骤的正确性决定。
AI.method: 提出 RouteVerify 控制干预研究：在保持被评估输入不变的条件下，用另一条解题轨迹的内部激活替换选定激活。在 9 个 MoE 检查点上比较三种干预接口（router logits、MoE 输出、MoE 后残差状态），变化被替换的层与 token 位置；以量化模型对 INCORRECT 相对 CORRECT 偏好的验证 margin 为指标，并用正确/错误步骤作为激活源做对照，辅以 router logits 探针与范数匹配的随机替换基线。
AI.result: 四项关联结果：(1) router logits 探针在 8/9 检查点区分正确与错误步骤（AUROC 0.80–0.88）；(2) 在全部路由层替换 router logits 会在 9/9 检查点改变判断，且幅度大于范数匹配的随机替换；(3) 该变化很少依赖源步骤是否正确——单层下错误步骤与正确步骤路由产生的 margin 在 9/9 检查点不可区分，全层路由下差异仅在 1 个检查点显著为正；(4) 同一差异在局部残差替换下于 8/9 检查点为正，说明该度量在存在依赖时确实能检出。
AI.conclusion: 正确性可从路由中读出，路由替换也会移动验证判断，但这种移动很少随正确性变化；路由编码的信息与验证判断所依赖的因素之间存在解耦，基于路由可读性推断因果作用的做法不成立。

title: FastRoverVLA: Fast Vision-Language-Action Execution for Off-Road Autonomous Driving
summary: Off-road vision-language-action (VLA) models generate scene-conditioned plans, but frequent trajectory updates can repeatedly invoke expensive multimodal inference. Reusing a prediction reduces this demand while leaving its commands exposed to changes in vehicle motion. FastRoverVLA addresses this mismatch by decoupling visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution. Its training-free interface maintains decoded plans between visual predictions. A speed-curvature action buffer is aligned with measured motion at each update, integrated into a local trajectory, and advanced by consuming the current action. The corrected remainder is written back to the buffer, preserving motion corrections across successive updates. A bounded refresh rule normalizes speed and curvature variations within a newly decoded plan and assigns a short or long reuse budget according to the resulting plan-roughness score. The interface requires neither backbone features nor an additional learned driving policy. Over a 3 s horizon, independent real-request evaluation achieves average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) of 0.328/0.596 m on ORAD-3D and 0.266/0.526 m on RELLIS-3D, reducing FDE by 18.0% and 36.7% at request rates of 6.0% and 4.8%, respectively. These runs retain lower errors across four backbones and both datasets and reduce Qwen3-VL request-processing cost by factors of 16.6 and 20.8 under serial replay, while mechanism and motion-only controls identify persistent state correction as the main source of the observed accuracy benefit. The source code and evaluation materials are publicly available at https://github.com/ADEPT-ORG/FastRoverVLA.

AI.tldr: FastRoverVLA 提出一种免训练接口，将视觉规划生成与运动条件下的执行解耦，通过速度–曲率动作缓冲区在视觉预测之间复用并校正计划，在显著降低请求率与推理成本的同时提升轨迹精度。
AI.motivation: 越野场景下的视觉–语言–动作（VLA）模型能生成场景条件化规划，但频繁的轨迹更新会导致昂贵的多模态推理被反复调用。直接复用旧预测虽可降低需求，却使其指令对车辆运动变化缺乏适应性，形成"复用—时效性"不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 提出解耦式免训练接口：在两次视觉预测之间保留已解码计划；构建速度–曲率动作缓冲区，每次更新时与实测运动对齐并积分成局部轨迹，通过消耗当前动作推进；将校正后的剩余部分回写缓冲区，使运动修正跨更新持续保留。设计有界刷新规则，对新解码计划的曲率与速度变化做归一化，依据计划粗糙度得分分配短或长的复用预算。该方法不需要骨干特征，也不引入额外的学习型驾驶策略。
AI.result: 在3 s 预测时域下，基于独立真实请求的评测取得：ORAD-3D 上 ADE/FDE 为 0.328/0.596 m，RELLIS-3D 上为 0.266/0.526 m；在 6.0% 与 4.8% 的请求率下，FDE 分别降低 18.0% 与 36.7%。在四个骨干网络与两个数据集上均保持更低误差；串行回放中 Qwen3-VL 的请求处理成本降低 16.6 倍与 20.8 倍。机理对照与纯运动对照实验表明，持续状态校正是精度收益的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 解耦视觉规划与运动条件执行、并以带状态的缓冲区持续校正计划，可在极低请求率下同时实现更优轨迹精度与数量级级别的推理成本下降，且具备跨骨干与跨数据集的泛化性，源码与评测材料已公开。

title: Coherent belief and opinion propagation produces more echo chambers: corrected version
summary: The occurrence of echo chambers is a well-known phenomenon in social networks. Echo chambers are groups of agents satisfying three properties: homogeneity, i.e., sharing the same opinion, segregation, i.e., listening primarily to agents of the same group, and reinforcement, i.e., increasing opinion similarity over time. Opinion dynamics models have been used to explain how echo chambers occur through agents updating their opinions. However, social network users also exchange beliefs supporting their opinions. Here, we aim at identifying the effect of propagating beliefs together with opinions on the formation of echo chambers. For that purpose, we complement an existing opinion dynamics model with classical belief merge operations. Beliefs and opinions are also maintained coherent guided by values that agents share. We introduce measures, applying to either beliefs and opinions, to identify echo chambers based on the three properties. This model is used to simulate opinion and belief propagation with varying initial conditions and agent tolerance for different opinions/beliefs. Results confirm the occurrence of echo chambers observed in previous opinion dynamics studies in a different setting and with a stricter measure. They also demonstrate the occurrence of echo chambers with belief propagation. Finally, they show that connecting opinions to beliefs and maintaining their coherence increases the number of belief echo chambers, but that they involve a reduced number of agents.

AI.tldr: 该文在既有观点动力学模型中引入信念合并与基于共享价值的信念—观点一致性维护机制,提出可同时作用于信念与观点的回音室度量(同质、隔离、强化),并通过仿真表明:新设定与更严格度量下仍复现回音室,信念传播亦产生回音室,而将观点与信念耦合维护一致性会增加信念回音室数量但缩小其规模。
AI.motivation: 回音室在社交网络中普遍存在,既有观点动力学主要解释观点如何经更新形成回音室,但现实中用户还交换支持其观点的信念;因此需要识别"信念与观点共同传播"对回音室形成的影响,并给出同时适用于信念与观点的度量。
AI.method: 扩展一个已有观点动力学模型,加入经典信念合并(belief merge)操作;在共享价值引导下维持信念与观点的一致性;定义基于同质性、隔离性和强化三项属性的度量,分别用于信念与观点以识别回音室;在不同初始条件与对不同观点/信念的容忍度下进行仿真。
AI.result: 1) 在不同设定下并采用更严格的度量,复现了此前观点动力学研究中观察到的回音室;2) 信念传播同样会导致回音室的出现;3) 将观点与信念相连并保持二者一致性会增加信念回音室的数量,但每个回音室所含智能体数量减少。
AI.conclusion: 回音室现象在观点与信念共同传播的扩展框架下依然稳健;信念层面的回音室可通过信念合并与一致性维护机制产生,且观点—信念耦合以"数量增多、规模变小"的方式重塑回音室结构,提示仅研究观点动态会低估或误描回音室的形态。

title: Characterizing Age-Conditioned Affective Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: An age prompt can change how a vision-language model (VLM) rates the emotion evoked by an image. Does the change predict how people of different ages rate that same image? We evaluate 17 VLMs on 900 OASIS images using young-, middle-, and older-adult prompts and estimate image-specific age differences from ratings by 822 participants. Without an age cue, models closely track average human valence (median Pearson $r=0.891$). Under an older-adult prompt, 16 of 17 models assign lower valence on average than under a young-adult prompt. Yet after adjusting for image pleasantness, correlations between model and human age effects range from $-0.030$ to $0.093$, against an estimated ceiling of $0.595$. The discrepancy is clearest on 54 sensitive images rated as pleasant. Across models, the older prompt reduces valence by $0.845$ points on average, while older participants rate these images $0.443$ points higher than younger participants. Providing human ratings from other images improves agreement on the direction of age differences, although image-specific fidelity remains modest on 600 held-out images ($r_{\mathrm{part}}=0.105$). These results show why evaluations of demographic personalization in foundation models need human comparisons at the level of individual stimuli. Project page available at https://shahriyar-zaman.github.io/age-conditioned-emotion-reasoning/

AI.tldr: 本文发现：对视觉语言模型（VLM）加入年龄提示虽能改变其情感评分，但这种改变几乎不能预测不同年龄真人对同一图像的情感差异；模型在"敏感图"上甚至与年长者评分方向相反，说明人口学个性化评测必须在单刺激层面与人类对齐。
AI.motivation: 基础模型（如VLM）越来越多地被用于"人口学个性化"，即通过提示词（如年龄）模拟特定人群的判断。但现有评测通常只看整体相关性或平均表现，缺乏对"模型随人口学提示产生的变化是否与真人同人群的变化一致"这一层面的检验。作者因此提出：年龄提示引起的情感评分变化，能否预测不同年龄真人评分的差异？
AI.method: 在900张OASIS图像上，用年轻、中年、老年三种年龄提示评测17个VLM；同时收集822名被试的评分，估计逐图（image-specific）的年龄差异。以平均效价相关为基线，计算控制图像愉悦度后模型年龄效应与人类年龄效应之间的相关，并与理论上限（ceiling≈0.595）比较；进一步做"提供其他图像的人类评分"的few-shot/校准实验，在600张留出图像上检验方向一致性与保真度（r_part）。
AI.result: 无年龄提示时模型与人类平均效价高度一致（中位Pearson r=0.891）。老年提示下17个模型中有16个平均给出更低效价；但校正图像愉悦度后，模型与人类"年龄效应"的相关仅为−0.030至0.093，远低于估计上限0.595。差异在54张被评为愉悦的"敏感图"上最明显：老年提示使模型效价平均降低0.845分，而年长被试对这些图的评分比年轻被试高0.443分，方向相反。引入其他图像的人类评分可改善年龄差异方向的一致性，但在600张留出图像上逐图保真度仍有限（r_part=0.105）。
AI.conclusion: 年龄提示造成的是模型输出的"系统性偏移"，而非对人类年龄差异结构的还原；整体相关性高会掩盖逐刺激层面的失败。基础模型的人口学个性化评测必须引入单刺激层面的人类对照，而不能仅依赖均值或整体相关。

title: How Reliable Are Explanations of Language Models That Detect Insider Threats?
summary: Organizations monitor their workers' activity for insider threats, in which workers misuse their legitimate access, by copying confidential files before leaving. Detectors score how unusual each day of activity is, flagging the most unusual for an analyst to review. Prominent current approaches use opaque neural networks, so explanations of a flag point to internal features: patterns of neuron activity most active on days of misuse. We audit such explanations for language-model detectors trained on CERT's simulated workplace logs. To test an explanation, we see what happens to the detector's score when we remove its features inside the model. We compare this to a control: a change that is as similar as possible to the removal, but without actually removing the features. Because defining "similar" requires choosing a metric, our central contribution is the tipping radius: a first-order prediction of how far that metric must move before the difference between removal and control disappears, a measure of how fragile the result is to that choice. In 33 of 34 runs of seven language models, the tipping radius is at most 18% of the distance between two standard choices of metric. Moving that far removes at least 58% of the difference or reverses it, while random moves of the same size leave it largely intact. The result replicates in thirteen of fourteen pre-declared primary runs on openly released models, though on our trained detectors the difference is often too small to measure. We also find that a flag's score partly reflects who the worker is, not what they did, and that the features named depend on whom they are compared against. Audits should therefore fix the control's metric in advance, report its tipping radius, and disclose that comparison.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计语言模型内幕威胁检测器的事后解释：提出"倾覆半径"这一一阶指标，量化解释结论对度量选择的脆弱性，并发现该半径很小、解释结果高度依赖对照组选择。
AI.motivation: 现有内幕威胁检测器多用不透明的神经网络，其"解释"只指向内部神经特征（哪些神经元模式在滥用日最活跃）。这类解释的可信度检验通常采用"移除特征看分数变化"的方式，但移除与对照之间"相似"的定义依赖于度量选择，结论可能因度量不同而反转，因此需要一个判决性的检验工具。
AI.method: 在CERT模拟办公日志上训练七个语言模型检测器。对每个被标记日，先移除解释所指特征并观测分数变化，再构造一个尽量相似但未真正移除特征的对照组。核心是"倾覆半径"：对移除与对照之间差异随度量距离变化作一阶预测，估计度量需移动多远才会使差异消失（或反转），以此衡量结论对度量选择的稳健性；并与同尺度的随机扰动对照。
AI.result: 34次运行中的33次，倾覆半径不超过两种标准度量之间距离的18%；移动该距离可消除至少58%的差异或使其反转，而同尺度随机移动基本不改变差异。在公开模型上，14次预先声明的主要运行中有13次复现该结果；但自训练检测器上差异常小到无法测量。此外发现：标记分数部分反映"是谁"而非"做了什么"，且被指认的特征取决于比较对象。
AI.conclusion: 基于特征移除的解释审计结论高度脆弱，易受度量选择左右。建议审计实践应预先固定对照组的度量、报告其倾覆半径，并披露比较对象；同时警惕分数隐含的身份泄露与被比较者依赖的解释漂移。

title: I See You: Initial Multi-Robot LiDAR Registration with Mutual-Observation Checks
comment: Accepted final version. IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR), Incheon, South Korea, November 2026. Project page: https://tu-darmstadt-ros-pkg.github.io/i-see-you-registration
summary: Compared to single-robot deployments, multi-robot teams can significantly improve search-and-rescue (SAR) mission success by covering large areas in parallel. To collaborate effectively, these robots must be registered in a common reference frame. Standard registration methods typically rely on external infrastructure or significant map overlap, but real deployments require infrastructure-free, stationary initial alignment for immediate operation. While global LiDAR point cloud registration addresses this, existing single-scan methods often fail silently in aliased or degenerate environments. Approaches scaling beyond two agents also remain rarely evaluated in real-world scenarios. We propose a centralized, deployment-ready framework for pre-mission multi-robot registration. Our system performs pairwise coarse-to-fine alignment and actively rejects impossible pose hypotheses via deterministic plausibility checks. We validate the framework on a real-world custom dataset of four synchronized robots in various environments with ground truth. The checks reject more than a third of the incorrect pairwise registrations while falsely rejecting less than 1% of the correct ones, and reduce the number of team registrations with a wrong robot pose by 38%. Dataset and code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向任务前多机器人配准的集中式、可直接部署框架：先做两两粗到精对齐，再用确定性合理性检查主动剔除不可能的位姿假设，在四机器人真实数据集上显著降低错误配准。
AI.motivation: 多机器人并行搜索救援可提升任务成功率，但协作需统一参考系。标准配准依赖外部基础设施或大量地图重叠，而实际部署要求无基础设施、静止状态下即刻完成初始对齐。现有单帧全局LiDAR配准方法在混叠或退化环境中会"静默失败"，且超过两智能体的扩展方法鲜有真实场景评估。
AI.method: 集中式部署就绪框架：对机器人对执行coarse-to-fine（粗到精）配准，并通过确定性plausibility checks（合理性检查）主动拒绝不可能的位姿假设。
AI.result: 在自建的四机器人同步真实数据集（多环境、含真值）上验证：检查拒绝超过三分之一错误的两两配准，同时误拒正确配准低于1%；将含错误机器人位姿的团队配准数量减少38%。数据集与代码公开。
AI.conclusion: 确定性合理性检查可有效抑制静默失败，提升多机器人初始配准可靠性，且框架具备真实部署可行性与可复现性。

title: Trustworthy Geospatial AI Workflows: Reproducible Maritime Analytics and Forecasting on Open-Source AIS Data
summary: Publicly available geospatial data provide increasing opportuni- ties for data-driven maritime analytics and predictive modelling. However, their availability does not necessarily imply that the underlying observations are equally suitable for downstream AI applications. Properties of the data source and observation pro- cess, including provenance, reporting regularity, spatial coverage, observation density, and missingness, can affect how geospatial data are interpreted, processed, and ultimately used by predictive models. At the same time, trustworthy geospatial AI requires ana- lytical workflows in which these processing decisions can be made explicit and reproduced. This paper presents a reproducible mar- itime geospatial AI workflow built around damast, an open-source data-processing and machine-learning library developed at Simula Research Laboratory. Using AIS observations from multiple public data providers as a case study, we demonstrate metadata-aware validation, reusable processing pipelines, maritime trajectory con- struction, and reproducible machine-learning experimentation. The predictive stage is model-agnostic and is instantiated in this study using a Transformer-based vessel-trajectory forecasting model. Building on these implemented capabilities, we further outline an envisioned extension toward trustworthiness-aware geospatial AI. The extension introduces explicit characterization of source- and data-level properties and their relationship with downstream model performance. This distinguishes capabilities demonstrated in the current workflow from trustworthiness-oriented components identified for future development. Overall, the study demonstrates how reproducible open-source infrastructure can provide a practi- cal foundation for developing more transparent and trustworthy geospatial AI workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并演示了基于开源库 damast 的可复现海事地理空间 AI 工作流，以多来源 AIS 数据为案例实现元数据感知校验、可复用处理管线、轨迹构建与可复现机器学习实验，并展望面向"可信性感知"的扩展。
AI.motivation: 公开地理空间数据（如 AIS）虽然日益丰富，但其可获得性并不等于可直接用于下游 AI 任务；数据来源、报告规律性、空间覆盖、观测密度与缺失性等属性会影响数据解读与建模效果。同时，可信地理空间 AI 要求处理决策可显式表达且可复现。
AI.method: 围绕 Simula 研究实验室开发的开源数据处理与机器学习库 damast 构建可复现工作流；以多公共数据提供方的 AIS 观测为案例，实施元数据感知的数据校验、可复用处理管线、海事轨迹构建，以及模型无关的可复现机器学习实验，预测阶段实例化为基于 Transformer 的船舶轨迹预测模型。
AI.result: 展示了上述能力的实现效果，并进一步提出面向可信性感知的方向性扩展：显式刻画数据源级与数据级属性及其与下游模型性能之间的关系；同时明确区分当前工作流已演示的能力与未来需开发的、面向可信性的组件。
AI.conclusion: 可复现的开源基础设施可为构建更透明、更可信的地理空间 AI 工作流提供实用基础。

title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
summary: World action models (WAMs) couple generative video modeling with robotic action prediction but typically require large video and action transformers, limiting deployment efficiency. We present LoopedWAM, a compact WAM that recurrently applies a shared six-block core in each expert, executing 30 transformer layers while storing only 12 blocks per expert. To account for their asymmetric inference costs, the video and action experts can operate at different depths: visual features are computed once per query, whereas action computation repeats at every sampling step. We further propose elastic self-distillation, which trains a single elastic checkpoint, LoopedWAM-E, across action-depth and sampling-step budgets. With only 0.58B policy parameters and no robot pretraining, LoopedWAM achieves 96.1% success on LIBERO, 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 52.2% on RoboCasaGR1, while using $7.4\times$ less peak GPU memory than Fast-WAM under matched inference measurements. On LIBERO, LoopedWAM-E achieves 96.0% success in 27.6 ms or 95.2% in 24.7 ms on an H100, providing multiple accuracy-latency operating points from a single checkpoint; with two sampling steps and four action loops, it stays within 0.5 points of LoopedWAM on all three benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that weight-shared depth preserves competitive performance, while aggressive action-depth reduction requires explicit budget-aware training. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, LoopedWAM succeeds in 71.3% of 80 trials across four tasks.

AI.tldr: LoopedWAM 用循环共享权重的紧凑"世界动作模型"在极低参数与显存下实现高成功率，并通过弹性自蒸馏得到可在多个精度-延迟点运行的单一弹性检查点。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）将生成式视频建模与机器人动作预测耦合，但通常依赖大规模视频/动作 Transformer，部署效率低。
AI.method: 提出 LoopedWAM：每个专家内共享一个 6 块核心并循环复用，实现等效 30 层计算但仅存储 12 块；利用视频与动作推理开销不对称，对两者采用不同深度——视觉特征每查询只算一次，动作计算在每个采样步重复。进一步提出弹性自蒸馏，训练单一弹性检查点 LoopedWAM-E，覆盖不同动作深度与采样步数预算。
AI.result: 0.58B 策略参数且无机器人预训练下，LIBERO 96.1%、RoboTwin 2.0 91.9%、RoboCasaGR1 52.2%；同等推理测量下峰值 GPU 显存比 Fast-WAM 少 7.4×。LIBERO 上 LoopedWAM-E 在 H100 上 27.6 ms 达 96.0%、24.7 ms 达 95.2%；两步采样+四次动作循环时三个基准均与 LoopedWAM 相差 0.5 点以内。消融显示权重共享深度保持竞争力，而激进削减动作深度需显式的预算感知训练。真实 AgileX PiPER 机械臂 4 任务 80 次试验成功率 71.3%。
AI.conclusion: 权重共享的循环深度可在不损失性能的前提下大幅压缩 WAM 存储与显存；视频/动作专家按不对称成本分配深度、配合预算感知的弹性蒸馏，可从单检查点提供多档精度-延迟折衷，并具备真机可部署性。

title: A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Low-rank plus sparse decompositions, such as robust PCA, typically model the low-rank component as dense and the sparse component as corruption. This viewpoint is poorly suited to graph adjacency matrices, where sparsity is structural and dense low-rank factors destroy the combinatorial and computational properties of the graph. We propose signed biclique decomposition (SBD), a sparse low-rank decomposition for integer-weighted graphs that represents the structured component as a sum of sparse signed binary rank-one factors, together with a sparse signed residual. The resulting representation remains discrete, interpretable, sparse, and compatible with standard linear algebra. We formulate fixed-rank and greedy SBD objectives and derive a gain-based greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, SBD recovers block structure in noisy graphs, while its factorized representation enables efficient sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM). On real graphs with strong shared-neighborhood structure, SBD achieves compression factors above $10$ and SpMM speedups up to $6\times$ over cuSPARSE, suggesting a practical alternative to dense low-rank decompositions for graphs. Code is available at https://github.com/IAntoineV/sbd.

AI.tldr: 提出稀疏双团分解（SBD），将整数权重图的邻接矩阵表示为一组稀疏有符号二值秩一因子之和加稀疏残差，保持离散性与稀疏性，并给出带理论保证的贪心算法。
AI.motivation: 经典低秩加稀疏（如robust PCA）模型假设低秩部分稠密、稀疏部分为噪声，这与图邻接矩阵的稀疏是结构性特征相冲突；稠密低秩因子会破坏图的组合与计算性质。
AI.method: 将结构化成分建模为稀疏有符号二值秩一因子之和，并配以稀疏导数残差；提出固定秩与贪心两种SBD目标，并推导基于增益（gain-based）的贪心算法，附理论保证。
AI.result: 在含噪图中能恢复块结构；因子化表示支持高效SpMM；在具有强共享邻域结构的真实图上压缩比超过10倍，相对cuSPARSE的SpMM加速最高达6倍。
AI.conclusion: SBD是稠密低秩分解在图数据上的一种实用替代方案，兼具离散可解释性、稀疏性和线性代数兼容性。

title: LocoMuJoCo: A Comprehensive Imitation Learning Benchmark for Whole-Body Control
summary: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark for imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL) on whole-body control. The library couples MuJoCo (CPU) with MJX and the MjWarp backend (GPU) under a single API, exposes 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments, and ships a curated native motion-capture dataset for every humanoid, to which it can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1. A modular plug-in architecture makes observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization fully interchangeable, while compact JAX implementations of many RL and IL algorithms provide JIT-compiled end-to-end training, and the companion loco-mujoco-real repository provides sim-to-real deployment. We describe the design, the SMPL-to-robot and robot-to-robot retargeting pipeline, and a usage example. LocoMuJoCo is released under MIT at https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco.

AI.tldr: LocoMuJoCo 是一个面向全身控制的开源模仿学习(IL)与强化学习(RL)基准库，统一 API 下整合 CPU 版 MuJoCo 与 GPU 后端 MJX/MjWarp，提供 16 种机体、原生动作捕捉数据集及 AMASS/LAFAN1 重定向，并以模块化插件架构与 JAX 实现支持端到端 JIT 训练和 sim-to-real 部署。
AI.motivation: 全身控制研究中，IL 与 RL 的实验设置（仿真器后端、观测/奖励设计、地形与域随机化、数据重定向）高度碎片化，缺乏统一、可复现且兼顾 CPU/GPU 效率的基准平台，导致方法间难以公平比较，且从仿真到真实机器人的迁移链路缺失。
AI.method: 构建统一 API 封装 MuJoCo（CPU）与 MJX、MjWarp（GPU）两种后端；集成 9 种人形、3 种（肌）骨骼、4 种四足共 16 个机体；为每个人形配备精选原生动作捕捉数据集，并支持 AMASS 与 LAFAN1 的 SMPL-to-robot 与 robot-to-robot 重定向流水线；采用模块化插件架构使观测、奖励、控制模式、地形与域随机化可自由替换；内置多种 RL/IL 算法的紧凑 JAX 实现，实现 JIT 编译的端到端训练；配套 loco-mujoco-real 仓库提供 sim-to-real 部署。
AI.result: 论文描述了库的整体设计、重定向流水线（SMPL-to-robot 与 robot-to-robot）及使用示例；成果以 MIT 许可开源发布，代码托管于 https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco 与配套的 loco-mujoco-real 仓库。摘要未给出具体定量基准结果。
AI.conclusion: LocoMuJoCo 以统一后端、多机体覆盖、标准化运动数据与插件化设计，为全身控制的 IL/RL 研究提供可复现、可扩展的基准平台，并通过 JAX 加速与真实机器人部署仓库打通从训练到落地的完整链路。

title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization
summary: Large language models enable agents to optimize RTL using EDA feedback, yet their executable search procedures remain largely hand- engineered. We present Meta-RTL, an EDA-grounded framework that evolves RTL optimization harnesses from a minimal loop while keeping the optimization model, EDA flow, and per-design budgets fixed. Compared with Dr. RTL, Meta-RTL* reduces aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 7.8%/11.0% across 20 development designs, with area reductions on 70% of them. Without further evolution, Meta-RTL* transfers to 10 unseen IC-RTL designs, reducing aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 20.5%/14.0% and total synthesized area by 12.6%. We further characterize three search mechanisms in the evolved harness and assess their contributions through ablations and a case study.

AI.tldr: Meta-RTL 是一个以 EDA 反馈为依据、可从最小循环自动演化 RTL 优化 harness 的框架；固定优化模型、EDA 流程与预算的前提下，演化所得 Meta-RTL* 在 20 个开发设计上降低聚合 WNS/TNS 违例 7.8%/11.0%，70% 设计面积下降，并零样本迁移至 10 个未见 IC-RTL 设计，降低 WNS/TNS 违例 20.5%/14.0%、总面积 12.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 RTL 优化智能体虽能利用 EDA 反馈迭代，但其可执行搜索过程（优化 harness）基本依赖人工设计，泛化性与复用性受限；作者希望把"如何搜索/如何组织优化流程"本身变成可自动优化对象。
AI.method: 提出 Meta-RTL：以最小化初始循环为起点，在 EDA 反馈驱动下演化 RTL 优化 harness，同时严格固定优化用模型、EDA 流程与单设计预算，从而将性能提升归因于 harness 结构而非模型或算力。以 Dr. RTL 为基线对比；并在演化后 harness 中识别三类搜索机制，通过消融实验与案例研究量化其贡献。
AI.result: 开发集（20 个设计）：Meta-RTL* 相较 Dr. RTL 聚合 WNS/TNS 违例下降 7.8%/11.0%，70% 设计面积减少。迁移测试（10 个未见 IC-RTL 设计，不再演化）：聚合 WNS/TNS 违例下降 20.5%/14.0%，综合总面积减少 12.6%。
AI.conclusion: 优化 harness 的自动演化是提升 LLM-based RTL 优化有效性与可迁移性的关键杠杆；演化所得流程可零样本泛化至新设计，且性能增益可拆解到具体搜索机制，为可解释、可复用的 EDA 智能体流程设计提供依据。

title: CaT-Movie: Balancing Global Planning and Local Rendering for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Current multi-shot video generators render only limited durations per pass, requiring long movies to be stitched from local segments across which narrative progression and visual identity drift. To synthesize long-horizon movies with Coherence across Time, we present CaT-Movie, a multi-shot generation system consisting of a global story planner and a local window renderer. The planner expands user requests via a large language model to preserve, infer, and complete story details, while deterministic code maintains the resulting storyboard across shots to compile self-contained shot prompts and index reference frames from generated history. To execute this guidance, the renderer applies reference-routed sparse self-attention and shot-wise cross-attention to route identities from the indexed frames while isolating per-shot textual conditions. Given the scarcity of high-quality open-source multi-shot data, we construct a dataset of over 350K film shots annotated with semantic state transitions, entity grounding, and multi-granularity requests. We further build CaT-MBench, a benchmark on held-out films with the same annotations. It gives every baseline its native format and counts cross-shot consistency only when a cut opens a new camera setup, preventing repeated framing from passing as consistency. On CaT-MBench, CaT-Movie attains the highest average score and the most consistent characters among all methods. The project page is available at https://jinplu.github.io/CaT-Movie/.

AI.tldr: 提出CaT-Movie多镜头长视频生成系统，用全局故事规划器+局部窗口渲染器实现跨时间的一致性长片合成，并构建350K镜头数据集与CaT-MBench评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有多镜头视频生成器单次仅能渲染有限时长，长片需拼接局部片段，导致叙事推进与视觉身份（人物外观）在片段间漂移；且缺乏高质量开源多镜头数据与可靠的一致性评测手段。
AI.method: 系统由全局故事规划器与局部窗口渲染器组成：规划器借助LLM扩展用户请求以保留、推断并补全故事细节，并用确定性代码跨镜头维护故事板，编译自包含的镜头提示并从已生成历史中索引参考帧；渲染器采用reference-routed稀疏自注意力与shot-wise交叉注意力，从索引帧路由身份信息同时隔离各镜头的文本条件。另构建350K+电影镜头数据集（含语义状态转移、实体定位、多粒度请求标注）及CaT-MBench基准。
AI.result: 在CaT-MBench上，CaT-Movie取得所有方法中最高的平均分与最佳角色一致性；该基准为每个基线提供其原生输入格式，且仅在剪辑开启新机位设定时统计跨镜头一致性，避免重复构图伪装成一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过规划-渲染解耦与参考帧路由注意力，可实现跨镜头叙事与身份一致的长时程视频生成；配套数据集与严格评测协议为多镜头生成研究提供了数据与评估基础。

title: Beyond Alignment: Whitening Geometry, Profile Synthesis, and Heterogeneous Ensembles for Cross-Environment WiFi Action Recognition
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Preprint of a manuscript submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Cross-environment deployment is the central obstacle to practical WiFi sensing: a pipeline reaching 0.89+ top-1 in its training environments collapses to 0.408 under Leave-One-Domain-Out (LODO) evaluation with only K-shot labels. A ceiling analysis shows the collapse is not an alignment problem: the action signal is strong across seen environments (about 0.89 K10), environment identity is decodable from the encoder (0.965), and the failure concentrates in the encoder's extrapolation to the novel environment. A pre-registered falsification chain confirms that "align the domains" methods--training-time alignment, readout-level prototype alignment, adversarial confusion, and covariance/subspace alignment (CORAL -3.8pp, subspace -8.3pp)--degrade performance, and that source-domain statistics anti-correlate with cross-environment contribution. The effective levers lie elsewhere; we combine them into Dec-H: (i) closed-form source within-class whitening, provably re-geometrizing the readout's L2 regularization (+8.6pp, zero cost); (ii) profile-mixing augmentation (+1.0pp); (iii) few-shot adaptation with alternating whitening refit (+1.5pp; fixed preconditioners are 20/20 negative); (iv) heterogeneous decision ensembles (+1.7pp); homogeneous scaling and source-weighted stacking are saturated or harmful. Dec-H reaches 0.560 K10 (0.812 K40), +15.2pp over the baseline, consistent across all four environments and seeds; all thirteen configurations were pre-registered with frozen criteria.

AI.tldr: 论文指出WiFi感知跨环境部署的崩溃并非域对齐问题，而是编码器对新环境的泛化问题，据此提出无对齐组件的Dec-H方法，K10下从0.408提升到0.560（+15.2pp），K40达0.812。
AI.motivation: WiFi感知流水线在训练环境可达0.89+ top-1，但在LODO（留一域）评测、仅有K-shot标签时骤降至0.408，构成实际部署的核心障碍。作者通过天花板分析验证：动作信号在已见环境中很强（约0.89 K10）、环境身份可从编码器解码（0.965），失败集中在编码器向新环境的推断（外推）上，而非表征错位。因此常规"对齐域"思路方向错误，需要寻找真正有效的杠杆。
AI.method: 采用预注册的证伪链逐项验证：(1) 检验训练期对齐、读出层原型对齐、对抗混淆、协方差/子空间对齐（CORAL -3.8pp、子空间 -8.3pp）等对齐类方法，均导致性能下降，且源域统计量与跨环境贡献呈负相关，证伪"对齐"假设。(2) 组合四个有效组件为Dec-H：i) 闭式源域类内白化，可证明其等价于重新几何化读出层的L2正则（+8.6pp，零成本）；ii) profile-mixing数据增强（+1.0pp）；iii) 少样本自适应并交替重拟合白化（+1.5pp，固定预条件器20/20均负向）；iv) 异构决策集成（+1.7pp）；同质缩放与源域加权堆叠则饱和或有害。
AI.result: Dec-H在K10下达到0.560、K40下达到0.812，较基线提升15.2pp，并在全部四个环境与多种子下保持一致；全部十三个配置均预注册并冻结判定标准，结果具备可复现的严谨性。
AI.conclusion: 跨环境WiFi感知的瓶颈在于编码器外推能力与读出层几何，而非域间对齐；通过"去对齐"的轻量组件组合即可获得显著且稳健的收益。该工作同时提示：负结果为预注册证伪链提供了方法论层面的证据价值，域对齐方法在此类任务中应被重新审视。

title: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints.
