We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有限预算下的"暴露感知信息路径规划"(EA-IPP)问题，将标量场建图的信息增益与机队暴露指数之间的权衡建模为标量化双目标信念状态MDP，并采用参数共享PPO（分散执行者+集中式机队critic）离线训练、在未见场域上评估。
AI.motivation: 现有IPP方法在运动或资源约束下优化信息量，但未考虑对高场强区域的暴露约束；而移动传感代理在未知标量场建图时需限制自身处于高场强（如雷达、羽流、野火）区域的暴露。
AI.method: 将EA-IPP建模为标量化双目标信念状态MDP：以归一化GP信息增益与归一化测量导出的机队暴露指数进行权衡；采用参数共享的PPO框架，分散式actor与集中式机队critic，离线训练后在未见场域测试，基线含非学习信息基线与非暴露感知基线。
AI.result: 在radar、plume、wildfire三类场族上，EA-IPP代理取得所评估基线中最低的GP重建RMSE，同时D-optimal信息量保持在非学习信息基线的10%以内；最低场暴露分别比非暴露感知基线低约34.6%、20.1%和27%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该框架能在几乎不牺牲建图信息质量的前提下显著降低机队暴露，验证了将暴露约束纳入IPP的可行性与泛化性（跨未见场族）。

title: Explainable AI for Solar PV Power Forecasting: From Model Selection to Trustworthy, Reproducible Deployment
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Code and results available from the corresponding author on request
summary: Machine learning (ML) is now a standard tool for forecasting the output of solar photovoltaic (PV) plants, yet published accuracy figures are often hard to compare and harder to trust. Many studies validate with random splits, report no reference forecast, and present feature attributions without saying what they can and cannot show. This paper reviews the main families of ML methods for PV power forecasting and resource assessment, from tree ensembles to deep and foundation models, and sets out a reproducible workflow that combines automated model search with explainable AI. The workflow is then tested on an openly available dataset: a 16.32 kWp plant in Porto, Portugal, forecast one day ahead from a 4 km numerical weather prediction grid. Over a full test year, the best models reach a normalised root mean square error (nRMSE) of 11.6% of installed capacity, about half the error of smart persistence. The choice of input features changed accuracy far more than the choice among strong algorithms, and shuffled cross-validation was mildly optimistic. After conformal calibration, the nominal 80% prediction intervals covered 81.7% of observations, against 64.5% before. SHAP rankings stayed stable when the model was retrained on different periods but shifted when correlated inputs were removed, so attributions should be read as properties of a model rather than of the plant. The paper closes with practical lessons and open problems, including deployment on edge hardware and the effect of a changing climate.

AI.tldr: 该文综述光伏功率预测的机器学习方法，提出"自动模型搜索+可解释AI"的可复现工作流，并在葡萄牙波尔图16.32 kWp电站数据上验证：最优模型nRMSE为装机容量的11.6%，约为智能持续法的两倍精度。
AI.motivation: 现有光伏预测文献的精度数字难以横向比较、可信度低：多用随机划分验证、缺少参考基准预测（reference forecast）、且对特征归因能说明什么缺乏界定。因此需要一个可复现、含基准与解释性规范的研究流程。
AI.method: 综述从树集成到深度模型与基础模型的主要ML方法族；构建结合自动化模型搜索与可解释AI（SHAP、保形预测校准）的可复现工作流；在公开数据集上测试——葡萄牙波尔图16.32 kWp电站，基于4 km数值天气预报网格做提前一天预测，覆盖完整测试年。
AI.result: 最优模型nRMSE为装机容量的11.6%，约为智能持续法误差的一半；输入特征选择对精度的影响远大于强算法之间的差异；打乱式交叉验证略偏乐观；保形校准后名义80%预测区间覆盖率由64.5%提升至81.7%；SHAP排序在模型换时段重训时稳定，但去除相关输入后发生偏移。
AI.conclusion: 归因结果应被理解为模型属性而非电站的物理属性；论文给出实践教训与开放问题，包括边缘硬件部署与气候变化的影响。

title: DAWN: Robust Neural Blind Deconvolution via Alternating Wiener Guidance
summary: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to jointly recover a sharp image and blur kernel from a single degraded observation. Under nontrivial and high noise, which is common in photography and scientific imaging such as microscopy, BID remains particularly challenging, as existing methods suffer from noise overfitting and inaccurate kernel estimation. Existing training-data-free learning methods for BID, such as those based on the deep image prior (DIP), often utilize external guidance by including model-based estimates as additional loss terms, which underexploits the information these estimates carry especially under nontrivial noise. To address these challenges, we propose DAWN, a training-data-free DIP framework that alternates between injecting model-based estimates directly into the model input and refining this imperfect estimate with the network's own prior. To provide more reliable kernel estimates for these injections, we apply autoencoding regularization to both the image and kernel networks. On natural and scientific images under varying levels of Gaussian and Poisson noise, DAWN outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both image and kernel quality (achieving up to +4.5 dB over the next best baseline on the Levin dataset at $σ= 0.1$). Without any training images, DAWN remains highly competitive with a state-of-the-art diffusion model on FFHQ, despite the latter being trained on a massive number of in-distribution images.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练数据的DIP框架DAWN，通过交替将模型估计注入网络输入并用网络自身先验 refinement，并对图像与核网络施加自编码正则，在强噪声下显著提升盲图像去卷积的图像与核质量。
AI.motivation: 盲图像去卷积（BID）是病态逆问题，在摄影和显微成像等场景常见的非平凡高噪声下，现有方法易出现噪声过拟合与核估计不准。现有无训练数据方法（如基于DIP）多以额外损失项形式引入模型估计作为外部引导，未能充分利用这些估计所携带的信息。
AI.method: DAWN：无训练数据的DIP框架，在“将模型估计直接注入模型输入”与“用网络自身先验精化该不完美估计”之间交替进行；为提供更可靠的核估计用于注入，对图像网络和核网络同时施加自编码正则。
AI.result: 在多种强度的高斯与泊松噪声下、自然与科学图像上，图像与核质量均优于SOTA；在Levin数据集σ=0.1时较次优基线最高提升+4.5 dB。无任何训练图像情况下，在FFHQ上仍与在海量同分布图像上训练的SOTA扩散模型高度可比。
AI.conclusion: 将模型估计以输入注入而非仅作损失项的方式，配合图像与核双网络的自编码正则，是无训练数据BID在强噪声下兼顾图像与核精度的有效范式，且无需外部训练数据即可逼近大规模预训练生成模型的表现。

title: Interpretable Prototype-Conditioned Adaptation for Weather Forecasting
comment: 38 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://zhixuanli.github.io/projects/li2026protocast
summary: Data-driven weather forecasting requires distinguishing local states and their temporal evolution. However, learned patterns remain implicit in neural forecasters, making their influence difficult to interpret. Failing to distinguish local evolution can lead to similar forecasts for locations that develop differently, increasing prediction error. This motivates explicit references for distinguishing and interpreting local patterns. Prototypes provide explicit pattern references, but sample- or task-level conditioning leaves open how to adapt to distinct locations and variable groups. To deal with this problem, we design ProtoCast, which uses group-specific prototype banks to adapt local features while accounting for cross-variable dependencies. Specifically, (1) we combine each group's historical features and temporal change with forecast context from cross-variable attention for evolution-aware prototype matching. (2) Sparse mixtures of prototype-specific low-rank operators tailor corrections to each group and location. A gated attention block then exchanges the corrected features across groups before prediction. Each group's correction decomposes into explicit prototype contributions before this fusion. (3) We jointly train the forecasting network and operators from scratch and refit each group's prototypes before every training epoch. Slot tracking preserves prototype-operator associations, making each prototype's contribution to local corrections more interpretable. Experiments on GlobalForecast and TyphoonTracking show improved forecasting accuracy, while prototype deletion links local feature contributions to changes in prediction error. This work advances the development of more accurate and interpretable data-driven weather forecasting models. Project page: https://zhixuanli.github.io/projects/li2026protocast

AI.tldr: ProtoCast 是一种面向数据驱动天气预报的模型，通过分组原型库（group-specific prototype banks）显式刻画局部状态及其时序演化，并结合稀疏混合的原型低秩算子（prototype-specific low-rank operators）对局部特征做可解释修正，在 GlobalForecast 与 TyphoonTracking 上提升精度并实现原型删除式可解释性验证。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动天气预报需要区分局部状态及其时间演化，但神经预报器学到的模式是隐式的，难以解释；若不能区分局部演化，发展轨迹不同的地点会得到相似预报，从而增大预测误差。因此需要在样本级/任务级条件化之外，引入能自适应不同地点与变量组的显式模式参考。已有原型方法仅在样本级或任务级条件化，未解决"如何针对不同地点与变量组进行适配"的问题。
AI.method: 提出 ProtoCast，采用分组原型库自适应局部特征并建模跨变量依赖：(1) 演化感知原型匹配——将每组历史特征与时间变化量，同来自跨变量注意力的预报上下文结合，用于原型匹配；(2) 稀疏混合的原型专属低秩算子，为各变量组与各地点定制修正；随后由门控注意力块在预测前跨组交换修正后特征；在融合之前，各组的修正可分解为显式的原型贡献；(3) 端到端从头联合训练预报网络与算子，并在每个训练轮次前重新拟合各组原型；通过槽位跟踪（slot tracking）保持原型—算子关联，使每个原型对局部修正的贡献可解释。
AI.result: 在 GlobalForecast 与 TyphoonTracking 两个基准上预报精度均有提升；原型删除实验将局部特征贡献与预测误差变化建立了对应关系，验证了解释性。
AI.conclusion: ProtoCast 通过"演化感知原型匹配 + 稀疏低秩算子修正 + 组间门控融合 + 槽位跟踪"的显式原型机制，在提升数据驱动天气预报精度的同时提供了可解释性，推动了更准确、更可解释的数据驱动气象预报模型的发展。

title: Reasoning on Call: Efficient Agentic Robot Control for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Large multimodal models can support long-horizon robot manipulation, but frequent model calls incur substantial latency and token costs. The central challenge is determining when agent assistance or intervention is needed and whether errors require correcting robot execution, subtask planning, or both. To address this problem, we propose RoC (Reasoning on Call), an efficient framework that coordinates a low-level policy and a high-level reasoning agent through an online task-state monitor. The monitor combines temporal visual observations with ordered interaction memory to jointly estimate progress within the active subtask and predict its successor. These predictions guide event-triggered agent review for coordinated execution repair and plan revision. Verified outcomes govern memory updates and subtask transitions, allowing routine execution to remain with the policy while reasoning focuses on decisions requiring additional assessment. On RMBench, RoC improves task success rate by 24.0 percentage points and reduces token consumption by 65.3% compared with the strongest agent-based baseline. It also outperforms the strongest policy-based baseline by 15.1 percentage points in task success rate. Real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness across three long-horizon manipulation tasks. Overall, RoC supports efficient agent intervention and coordinated recovery across execution and planning for long-horizon robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoC（Reasoning on Call）框架，用在线任务状态监控器协调低层策略与高层推理智能体，实现事件触发式的智能体介入，在长程机器人操作中兼顾成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型可支撑长程机器人操作，但频繁调用模型带来显著的延迟与 token 开销。核心难点在于：判断何时需要智能体辅助或介入，以及错误应归因于机器人执行层修正、子任务规划修正，还是两者兼需。
AI.method: 采用低层策略 + 高层推理智能体的分层架构，引入在线任务状态监控器：融合时序视觉观测与有序交互记忆，联合估计当前子任务内的进度并预测其后继子任务；据此触发事件级的智能体复核，进行执行修复与规划修订的协同；经核验的结果用于更新记忆并驱动子任务切换。
AI.result: 在 RMBench 上，相较最强智能体类基线任务成功率提升 24.0 个百分点，token 消耗降低 65.3%；相较最强策略类基线成功率提升 15.1 个百分点。真实世界三个长程操作任务实验进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoC 将常规执行交由策略、将推理集中于需额外评估的决策点，可实现高效智能体介入以及执行与规划的协同恢复，适用于长程机器人操作。

title: One Schedule Does Not Fit All: Adaptive Inference Schedules for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models typically use a fixed denoising schedule across workloads. We show that the cheapest schedule that preserves quality depends on the task, model, and sampler. We propose Task-Calibrated Denoising Allocation (TCDA), a deployment rule with an explicit error guarantee. Given candidate samplers, paired calibration data, a utility tolerance, and guardrails against degeneration, TCDA uses simultaneous one-sided bootstrap bounds to certify which candidates meet both the utility and guardrail criteria. It deploys the cheapest certified candidate or falls back to the full schedule. The probability of deploying an infeasible schedule is asymptotically at most alpha. Candidates include early prefix decoding, state-reusing continuation, reduced time grids, and confidence-threshold decoding. Across seven datasets and two model families, TCDA certifies reductions in denoiser evaluations by factors of 3.4 on XSum and 2.0 on WMT14 for ELF-B; 8.0 on WMT14 and 4.1 on GSM8K for LLaDA-8B; and 1.33 on OpenWebText for both ELF-M and ELF-L. A validation protocol fixed before generation confirmed every selection on fresh seeds. Across 500 calibration splits, false certification remained below 2% in every setting at a nominal level of 5%. Certified schedules vary across tasks and model scales. Trajectory measurements suggest that when decoded tokens commit is more informative for schedule selection than the remaining latent discretization error. We also find that the ELF reference sampler draws its time grid at random, so reproducible schedule comparisons for unconditional generation require fixing the grid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Task-Calibrated Denoising Allocation（TCDA）：一种带有显式错误保证的部署规则，用配对校准数据与单侧 bootstrap 同时置信上界，从候选采样器中认证满足效用容忍度与防退化护栏的“最便宜”去噪调度，否则回退到完整调度，并证明部署不可行情形的概率渐近不超过 α。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通常在所有工作负载上使用固定的去噪调度，但保持质量所需的最便宜调度实际上依赖任务、模型和采样器。因此需要一个可部署、可认证、带统计保证的调度选择方法，而不是经验性地削减去噪步数。
AI.method: TCDA 的输入包括：候选采样器（如 early prefix decoding、state-reusing continuation、reduced time grids、confidence-threshold decoding）、配对校准数据、效用容忍度和防退化护栏。方法用 simultaneous one-sided bootstrap bounds 对每个候选同时检验效用与护栏两项标准，认证全部通过者，并部署其中计算成本最低的候选；若无候选通过则回退到完整调度。理论保证为部署不可行调度的概率渐近上界为 α。实验覆盖七个数据集与两个模型家族（ELF-B/M/L、LLaDA-8B），并采用生成前固定好的验证协议在新种子上复核，另做 500 次校准切分的假认证率评估。
AI.result: TCDA 认证的去噪器评估次数缩减：ELF-B 在 XSum 上 3.4×、WMT14 上 2.0×；LLaDA-8B 在 WMT14 上 8.0×、GSM8K 上 4.1×；ELF-M 与 ELF-L 在 OpenWebText 上均为 1.33×。预注册验证协议在新鲜种子上确认了全部选择。500 次校准切分中，名义水平 5% 下各设置假认证率均低于 2%。认证得到的调度随任务与模型规模变化。轨迹测量表明，已解码 token 的“确定程度”（commit 时点）比剩余潜变量离散化误差对调度选择更具信息量。另外发现 ELF 参考采样器随机抽取时间网格，因此无条件生成的可复现调度比较需固定网格。
AI.conclusion: 最省的去噪调度并非普适常量，而是任务、模型与采样器相关；TCDA 提供了一种带统计保证、可回退的实用部署流程，在多个设置下实现 1.33×–8× 的去噪器评估缩减且假认证率受控。调度选择应优先依据 token 提交（commitment）信号，而非剩余离散化误差；无条件生成实验须固定 ELF 的时间网格以保证可复现性。

title: Physical Laws without Physics Loss? Probing Learned Dynamics in Video World Models through Forced Response
summary: Do video world models learn physical laws without a physics loss, or merely imitate motion? Overall motion and appearance scores cannot settle it. We investigate this through nonlinear forced response: an excitation shakes the support of a suspended object. We introduce dual visual-numeric conditioning and adapt six image-to-video backbones to predict this motion using only the flow-matching loss. Wan predicts motion accurately and generalizes to unseen excitations, objects, poses, and scenes. Counterfactual tests suggest capabilities beyond replaying training videos. But what laws have they learned? We design three tiers of tests using Taylor expansions of the dynamics and geometry. All six reproduce the linear response, including resonance; five capture higher-order dynamics, including nonlinear softening. Remarkably, softening is barely present in training: only 0.74% of the swing's squared displacement. Extensions to a double pendulum and a rocking block show sustained dynamics are learned more faithfully than brief impacts. Yet learned dynamics may fail to appear when state estimation or propagation goes wrong. We turn these tests and findings into strategies to improve video training and generation.

AI.tldr: 该文通过"非线性受迫响应"实验检验视频世界模型是否真正学到物理规律，而非简单模仿运动；六个图像到视频骨干仅用流匹配损失即可复现线性响应与高阶非线性动力学，但动力学是否显现受状态估计与传播影响。
AI.motivation: 整体运动与外观指标无法判断视频世界模型是否在无物理损失条件下学到物理定律，还是仅模仿运动，因此需要一个可判别性的物理探究框架。
AI.method: 以受迫悬摆的非线性受迫响应作为测试平台，激励作用于悬挂物体的支撑端；提出视觉-数值双重条件（dual visual-numeric conditioning），将六个图像到视频骨干仅用流匹配损失适配到该任务；并基于动力学与几何的泰勒展开设计三级测试，扩展到双摆与摇摆块。
AI.result: Wan 能准确预测运动，并可泛化到未见激励、物体、姿态与场景；反事实测试表明其能力超出训练视频回放。六个模型均复现线性响应（含共振），其中五个捕捉高阶动力学（含非线性软化），而软化在训练数据中仅占摆动平方位移的0.74%；双摆与摇摆块实验显示持续动力学比短暂冲击被学得更忠实；但状态估计或传播出错时，学到的动力学可能不显现。
AI.conclusion: 视频世界模型可在无物理损失下习得部分线性与高阶动力学结构，但动力学可靠显现依赖状态估计与传播正确；作者据此提出改进视频训练与生成的策略。

title: X Hedging: towards an eXplainable artificial intelligence option Hedging framework
summary: We propose X Hedging, an alternative to the Deep Hedging framework that addresses computational and explainability limitations of neural-network-based hedging strategies. Deep Hedging leverages neural networks to learn flexible hedging policies but relies on opaque models and typically requires large training datasets, which can complicate interpretation and limit its effectiveness in data-constrained settings. X Hedging takes a step toward addressing these limitations by replacing neural networks with tree ensemble methods, specifically LightGBM, to estimate hedging strategies. This design provides a computationally efficient alternative while preserving strong hedging performance and moving toward more user-centered explainability. To integrate LightGBM into a reinforcement-learning-style hedging framework, we introduce an optimization approach that sequentially trains tree-ensemble models while introducing stochasticity through random training orders. In controlled experiments, X Hedging achieves performance comparable to Deep Hedging while offering greater user-centered explainability, improved computational efficiency, and substantially higher robustness when training data are limited. The numerical results demonstrate that tree-ensemble methods provide an effective computational alternative to neural networks for data-driven dynamic hedging.

AI.tldr: 提出 X Hedging，用 LightGBM 树集成替代神经网络实现动态对冲策略，在保持 Deep Hedging 同等对冲性能的同时提升可解释性、计算效率与少数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Deep Hedging 依赖不透明的神经网络模型并通常需要大规模训练数据，导致策略难以解释、在数据受限场景下效果受限，存在可解释性与计算两方面的局限。
AI.method: 以树集成方法（具体为 LightGBM）替换神经网络来估计对冲策略；为将其嵌入强化学习式对冲框架，设计了一种顺序训练树集成模型的优化方法，并通过随机训练顺序引入随机性。
AI.result: 在受控实验中，X Hedging 的对冲表现与 Deep Hedging 相当，同时具备更强的以用户为中心的可解释性、更高的计算效率，并在训练数据有限时表现出显著更高的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果表明，树集成方法可作为神经网络在数据驱动动态对冲中的有效计算替代方案。

title: PUPPET: Physical-Unified Platform for Presence, Embodiment, and Teleoperation
summary: Remote access to robotics hardware does not by itself guarantee usable experimental data. A teleoperated trial can complete the task and still produce an incomplete or inconsistent record. PUPPET aims to solve this problem by presenting a cyber-physical framework that opens a physical robotics laboratory through a continuously synchronized VR replica of the robot, stranding environment, and task objects. In addition, PUPPET integrates a trial validation pipeline built into the experimental workflow. We evaluated PUPPET in a within-subject study with 30 participants, who performed the same table-to-shelf object-transfer task in person, through 2D teleoperation, and through PUPPET. VR reduced post-learning completion time by 27.7% over 2D (68.7,s vs. 95.0,s), statistically indistinguishable from in-person execution (72.1,s). It also produced more validation-ready (85.6% vs. 66.0%) and intervention-free (89.7% vs. 67.2%) trials. With PUPPET we show that modality shapes the remote task performance and the reusability of the resulting experimental record.

AI.tldr: PUPPET 是一个通过网络物理框架，用持续同步的机器人、杂乱环境与任务物体的 VR 复刻体开放真实机器人实验室，并把试验数据校验管线嵌入实验流程；30 人被试内实验显示，VR 相比 2D 遥操作显著缩短任务时间、提升数据可用性，且与现场执行无统计差异。
AI.motivation: 远程访问机器人硬件并不等于能获得可用的实验数据：一次遥操作试验即便完成了任务，仍可能产生不完整或不一致的实验记录。因此需要同时解决"远程可操作性"与"实验记录可复用性"两个问题。
AI.method: 提出 PUPPET 网络物理框架：构建与真实机器人、杂乱的（stranding）环境和任务物体持续同步的 VR 复刻环境以远程开放物理实验室；并在实验工作流中集成试验校验（trial validation）管线。采用被试内设计，30 名参与者分别以现场、2D 遥操作、PUPPET 三种方式完成同一"桌面到货架"的物体转移任务。
AI.result: 学习后完成时间：VR 为 68.7 s，比 2D 遥操作的 95.0 s 快 27.7%，与现场执行的 72.1 s 在统计上无差异。数据质量方面，VR 产生更多"可校验通过"的试验（85.6% vs. 66.0%）和更多"无需人工干预"的试验（89.7% vs. 67.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 交互模态不仅影响远程任务表现，也影响所得实验记录的可复用性；同步 VR 复刻加内嵌校验管线的设计可让远程实验在效率与数据质量上接近现场实验。

title: The Price of an Explanation: What Demanding Verifiable Artifacts Costs, and What It Buys Back
comment: 8 main pages, 3 main figures. 19 pages total. Accepted in NeurIPS 2026 AI4Science Workshop
summary: Generative models produce many candidate solutions but provide no intrinsic signal by which to rank them. One mitigation is to demand a \emph{verifiable artifact}: a program that can be executed against the available evidence. A common concern is that requiring executable verification incurs costs in both solution quality and computational budget. We measure these two costs on the $120$-task ARC-AGI-2 evaluation set. Demanding a verifiable artifact from an LLM reduced the score from $93$ to $68$ of $120$ tasks ($77\%$ to $57\%$). Of those $25$ tasks, $21$ were reached by no program-producing configuration we ran, at any budget, by sampling or by search; yet for $27$ of the $28$ tasks that only the answer-only arm solved, some program arm held a program that reproduced every demonstration and still failed the test. The bottleneck is obtaining an explanation that \emph{generalizes}, not finding one. A short evolutionary search over two already-sampled programs, at no additional model cost, beats best-of-$2$ sampled code by $9.2 \pm 1.4$ tasks, and over a single sampled program beats $1$-shot sampling by $9.9 \pm 1.3$. Moreover, because a program can be checked against the training examples, any program-producing protocol can terminate early once a task is explained: under the same stopping rule, best-of-$n$ sampling declines up to $38\%$ of its budget and the evolved arm up to $49\%$, whereas an answer-only baseline cannot terminate early. Applying the same methodology to decoder synthesis for quantum error correction yields interpretable decoders evaluated against a certified panel of published decoders on held-out exam shots.

AI.tldr: 要求LLM产出可执行验证的程序化答案（verifiable artifact）会在ARC-AGI-2上带来质量与算力双重代价：分数从93/120降至68/120，但瓶颈在于获得可泛化的解释而非找到解释；对已采样程序做短程进化搜索可在零额外模型开销下反超best-of-2采样9.2±1.4题，且程序化协议支持基于训练样例的早停，节省38%–49%预算。
AI.motivation: 生成模型会产生大量候选解，却缺乏内在信号对其进行排序。一种缓解方式是要求解以"可验证工件"（可在现有证据上执行的程序）的形式给出。学界普遍担忧：强制可执行验证会在解质量和计算预算两方面付出代价。本文旨在定量测量这两项代价，并探究其来源与可行的替代方案。
AI.method: 在ARC-AGI-2的120题评测集上进行对照实验：对比"仅答案"（answer-only）与"产出程序"（program-producing）两种协议，并在不同预算下尝试采样与搜索配置。进一步提出对两个已采样程序进行短程进化搜索（evolutionary search），不增加额外模型调用成本；并将"程序可对照训练样例检查"这一特性用于早停（early stopping）。最后将该方法迁移至量子纠错的解码器合成任务，在留出考试样本上与经认证的已发表解码器面板对比。
AI.result: 要求可验证工件使分数从93/120降至68/120（77%→57%）。丢失的25题中有21题在任何预算、任何采样或搜索的程序化配置下都未被触及；但在仅答案组独解的28题中，有27题存在某个程序组程序能复现全部示范样例却仍在测试上失败——说明瓶颈是获得"可泛化"的解释。进化搜索在无额外模型成本下比best-of-2采样多解9.2±1.4题，比单程序1-shot采样多9.9±1.3题。在相同停止规则下，best-of-n采样可节省最多38%预算，进化组最多49%，而仅答案基线无法早停。
AI.conclusion: 可执行验证的代价主要不是搜索不到解释，而是难以获得能泛化的解释；对已有样本做轻量进化组合即可在零额外推理成本下显著提升并支持早停，从而部分抵消验证带来的开销。该方法具有跨领域可迁移性，在量子纠错解码器合成上产出了可解释解码器并通过留出考试样本的认证评估。

title: RelGeo: Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration for Frozen Diffusion Correspondence
summary: Frozen diffusion descriptors retrieve strong semantic correspondence candidates, yet cosine nearest-neighbor matching can select incorrect locations despite valid high-ranking alternatives. Across DIFT-SD2.1 and DiTF-FLUX on SPair-71k, AP-10K, and SOCO (CC, SOC, Cross-SOC), 41-69% of Top-1 errors retain a PCK@0.10-valid match among the original Top-5 spatial peaks, revealing a persistent candidate-selection bottleneck. We find that descriptor rankings and current-pair relational evidence can favor different candidates: reciprocal diffusion Query/Key associations and pretrained RoMa transport exhibit distinct, partly complementary preferences. To incorporate this evidence into matching decisions, we introduce RelGeo, a Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration framework expressing heterogeneous relations as shared source-target coordinates. Spectral Relational Coordinates (SRC) encode reciprocal diffusion affinities, while Warp Identity Coordinates (WIC) encode reliability-weighted bidirectional transport endpoints. Their inner products augment frozen descriptor similarity while preserving full-domain cosine nearest-neighbor matching without additional semantic-correspondence training. RelGeo improves all ten evaluations by an average of 5.51 PCK@0.10 points; fixed-candidate reranking and pair-misalignment controls corroborate improved selection and dependence on current-pair relational alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出 RelGeo 框架，用成对关系校准（SRC/WIC）增强冻结扩散描述子的相似度，在不额外语义训练的前提下提升候选选择，十个评测平均提升 5.51 PCK@0.10。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散描述子能检索出强语义对应候选，但余弦最近邻匹配会在 Top-5 空间峰值中已存在有效匹配（PCK@0.10 有效）的情况下仍选错位置：DIFT-SD2.1 与 DiTF-FLUX 在 SPair-71k、AP-10K、SOCO（CC/SOC/Cross-SOC）上 41–69% 的 Top-1 错误仍保留原 Top-5 内的有效匹配，说明瓶颈在候选选择而非候选生成。此外，描述子排序与当前成对关系证据偏好不同候选：互惠扩散 Query/Key 关联与预训练 RoMa 传输的偏好互有差异且部分互补。
AI.method: RelGeo（Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration）将异质关系表达为共享的源-目标坐标：Spectral Relational Coordinates (SRC) 编码互惠扩散亲和度；Warp Identity Coordinates (WIC) 编码按可靠性加权的双向传输端点。两者内积用于增广冻结描述子相似度，保持全域余弦最近邻匹配，且无需额外的语义对应训练。通过固定候选重排序与成对错位对照实验验证。
AI.result: 全部十项评测均提升，平均 +5.51 PCK@0.10；固定候选重排序证实选择能力改善；成对错位对照表明增益依赖当前成对的关系对齐。
AI.conclusion: 语义对应中的主要瓶颈是描述子匹配的候选选择而非候选质量；将互补的成对关系证据以坐标化内积形式注入冻结描述子相似度，可即插即用地稳定提升匹配精度。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Self-supervised Vision Backbones Survives Distribution Shift in Radar Micro-Doppler HAR
summary: Micro-Doppler radar enables contactless, privacy-preserving human activity recognition (HAR), but deployment robustness remains underexplored. We compared full fine-tuning, frozen probing, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using subject-disjoint in-distribution cross-validation and few-shot cross-age, cross-orientation, and cross-dataset transfer. Full fine-tuning suffered negative cross-dataset transfer, while frozen features under-adapted on cross-orientation. Only PEFT avoided both failures. We paired DINOv3 with all-layer principal-singular-direction adaptation (PiSSA), to our knowledge the first application of a self-supervised image foundation backbone to radar micro-Doppler HAR. DINOv3-PiSSA ranked first among PEFT methods in every evaluated setting. Under our protocol, its Small variant matched the in-distribution accuracy of the prior Base-size PEFT state of the art using 4.5x fewer total parameters, with only 3% trainable. It surpassed a size-matched variant of that baseline in every evaluated setting, with transfer gains increasing with shift severity: 2.1, 6.6, and 8.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations attributed improvements to both pretraining and adapter recipe, with the pretraining contributing most under compound shift. Code and protocol are available at https://github.com/KeryanChelouche/udoppler-ssl.

AI.tldr: 论文系统评估了微多普勒雷达人体活动识别(HAR)的部署鲁棒性，比较全量微调、冻结探测与参数高效微调(PEFT)，发现只有PEFT能同时避免跨数据集负迁移与跨朝向欠适应；并提出DINOv3+PiSSA方案，在各设定下均排名第一。
AI.motivation: 微多普勒雷达HAR具备非接触、隐私保护优势，但现有工作对模型部署鲁棒性（跨受试者、跨年龄、跨朝向、跨数据集等分布偏移）探索不足，不同微调范式的失效模式尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用受试者不重叠的分布内交叉验证，并结合少样本跨年龄、跨朝向、跨数据集迁移，对比全量微调、冻结探测与PEFT。将自监督图像基础骨干DINOv3与全层主奇异方向适配（PiSSA）结合，据称为该骨干在雷达微多普勒HAR上的首次应用，并进行消融分析。
AI.result: 全量微调出现跨数据集负迁移，冻结特征在跨朝向上欠适应，仅PEFT规避两类失效。DINOv3-PiSSA在全部评测设定中位居PEFT方法首位；Small变体以4.5倍更少总参数（仅3%可训练）达到此前Base规模PEFT SOTA的分布内精度；相比同规模基线在三种迁移设定分别提升2.1、6.6、8.9个百分点，且偏移越严重增益越大。消融表明改进来自预训练与适配器配方，复合偏移下预训练贡献更大。
AI.conclusion: PEFT（尤其DINOv3-PiSSA）是兼顾参数效率与部署鲁棒性的优选范式，自监督预训练在强分布偏移下价值显著；论文公开了代码与评测协议以支持可复现研究。

title: Alignment Drives Reuse: Learning Generalizable Robot-Use Agents from Heterogeneous Experience
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.

AI.tldr: UniCraft通过对齐异构机器人交互（统一坐标约定、传感与控制接口、任务规范格式），使跨3个基准、6种本体的交互经验共同提升共享技能集，训练中提升未见任务成功率，训练后可在4种新本体和5个新智能体模型上零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型具备广泛泛化能力，但机器人操作中的可比泛化仍困难。本体、任务表述、几何约定与动作接口的异构性使交互经验在不同基准与硬件间碎片化，无法累积为统一技能。
AI.method: 提出UniCraft框架：以一致的坐标约定表征场景几何，对齐不同机器人的感知与控制接口，将不同基准的任务组织为规范化格式；使交互反馈联合优化共享技能与负责技能选择与组合的编排策略，全程无需演示数据、不更新模型权重。混合3个基准、6种本体的任务，每个智能体模型采集2700条学习轨迹。
AI.result: 训练阶段（第1–3轮）在未见场景与任务上的汇总成功率提升：LIBERO-PRO 9–28个百分点，RoboTwin 2.0 10.8–13.3，RoboCasa365 3.1–14.4。训练后冻结所学技能，在robosuite与RoboDojo上实现向4种新本体、5种额外智能体模型的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 跨基准、跨本体的异构交互可通过对齐机制汇聚为单一共享技能集，显著改善分布外泛化，并支持冻结技能条件下的本体与智能体模型零样本可迁移性。

title: From Cases to Criteria: Reusing Evaluation Knowledge for Task-Specific Rubric Generation
summary: Query-specific rubrics make LLM evaluation more fine-grained and transparent, and generating high-quality rubrics requires both identifying the target query's evaluation scope and specifying concrete checks. Historical rubrics provide reusable evaluation experiences, yet existing approaches reuse either complete query-rubric cases or aggregated criteria and dimensions without explicitly connecting recurring evaluation requirements to their criterion-level evidence and source-query context. This can preserve irrelevant task details or lose the broader evaluation structure. In this paper, we introduce RubricDuo, which organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared concepts, local concepts, criteria, and queries, where reusable evaluation requirements across queries are abstracted by shared concepts. Given a target query, RubricDuo first combines concepts relevant to the target query with retrieved historical cases to draft a rubric with broad coverage. It then revisits each draft criterion, retrieves concept-linked historical criteria and their source queries, and adapts applicable evidence to refine the criterion. Experiments on RubricBench and HealthBench demonstrate that RubricDuo achieves the overall best performance among the evaluated automatic methods in both alignment with human-authored rubrics and downstream LLM judging.

AI.tldr: 提出 RubricDuo，将历史 query-rubric 对组织为"评分标准知识图谱"（关联评估维度、共享概念、局部概念、准则与查询），通过"概念+历史案例起草 → 概念链接准则回溯细化"两阶段流程，为查询生成高质量、细粒度的评分细则，在 RubricBench 与 HealthBench 上取得优于现有自动方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 查询特异的评分细则（rubric）使 LLM 评估更细粒度、更透明，但其生成需同时识别目标查询的评估范围并给出具体检查项。历史 rubric 是可复用的评估经验，然而现有复用方式存在两类缺陷：一是直接复用完整的 query-rubric 案例，会带入无关任务细节；二是仅复用聚合后的准则/维度，会丢失更上层的评估结构。二者的共同问题在于未将"反复出现的评估需求"与其准则级证据、来源查询上下文显式关联起来。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Rubric Knowledge Graph：将历史 query-rubric 对组织为包含评估维度、共享概念（shared concepts）、局部概念（local concepts）、准则（criteria）与查询（queries）的知识图谱，跨查询可复用的评估需求由共享概念抽象表征；2) 起草阶段：对目标查询，融合相关概念与检索到的历史案例，生成覆盖范围较广的初版 rubric；3) 细化阶段：逐条复查初版准则，检索概念链接的历史准则及其来源查询，将适用证据迁移适配以精修该准则。
AI.result: 在 RubricBench 和 HealthBench 两个基准上，RubricDuo 在与人工撰写 rubric 的一致性、以及下游 LLM 评判效果两方面，总体表现优于所对比的各类自动方法。
AI.conclusion: 以概念为桥梁、在准则级粒度上显式连接历史评估经验与来源查询上下文，是复用 rubric 知识的有效范式，可在保持覆盖广度的同时提升准则的具体性与相关性；该框架为查询特异评分细则的自动生成提供了可扩展方案。

title: What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks
summary: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. Changing the sampling schedule reveals further differences official scores miss. In controlled physical systems with known outcome probabilities, our metric favors the true distribution over collapsed predictions. In short, a world model should be judged not only by how closely one video matches what happened, but by how faithfully its predictions represent what could have happened.

AI.tldr: Physics-IQ等视频世界模型评测指标将单条生成视频与单条真实录像对比，导致评分可被"生成多样性坍缩"刷高；作者提出Kernel Physics-IQ，通过对生成分布与真实分布做核匹配来消除该激励，实验证明两步行采样使五个图像到视频模型的Kernel Physics-IQ均下降（CogVideoX官方分+0.055而本指标-0.131）。
AI.motivation: 论文以"风暴可北可南时，取中间路径的预报在平方误差下反而优于任一可能路径"的悖论类比：当场景存在多个合理未来时，用单条生成视频与单条录像比较会奖励"向均值收缩/多样性坍缩"的预测。现有Physics-IQ只使用一条参考录像，因而可能给模糊、提前停止运动的低多样性视频更高物理分数，无法区分"预测准确"与"分布失真"。
AI.method: 1) 给出精确的数学分解，说明在单参考样本设定下Physics-IQ分数在期望上包含对生成未来间方差缩减的奖励项；2) 提出Kernel Physics-IQ，在期望意义上去除该激励，用核（MMD式）双样本匹配比较生成分布与参考分布，仅需每个条件两个独立样本；3) 在五个图像到视频模型上比较不同去噪步数与采样调度；4) 在已知真实结果概率的受控物理系统中验证指标性质。
AI.result: 两步行采样在全部五个图像到视频模型上降低Kernel Physics-IQ；CogVideoX上官方分数提高0.055，而Kernel Physics-IQ下降0.131，方向相反，证实官方分数可被低多样性/低步数视频抬高。改变采样调度时，Kernel Physics-IQ揭示出官方分数所遗漏的模型差异。在结果概率已知的受控物理系统中，该指标偏好真实分布而非坍缩预测。
AI.conclusion: 评价世界模型不应只看单条视频与已发生事实的接近程度，还应衡量其预测对"可能发生之事"的分布刻画是否忠实；Kernel Physics-IQ以极小采样成本提供了无偏（期望意义）的分布级评测准则。

title: LIFT: Latent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Cell Fate Dynamics with Single Cell Snapshots
summary: Lineage tracing links cell states through clonal ancestry, but does not generally identify unique source-descendant pairings. Learning from such data therefore requires a model of conditional outcomes, rather than only the terminal population distribution. We introduce LIFT, a latent flow framework for probabilistic cell-state generation from lineage-informed couplings. Variational inference encodes alternative outcomes in a latent space, while a conditional prior enables sampling from the initial state alone. A Mean Flow decoder predicts future cell state directly, requiring one decoder evaluation per sampling, which makes it convenient to predict cell fate through large scale Monte-Carlo sampling. This construction combines a representation of one-to-many relationships with efficient sampling and an analysis of conditional prediction error. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate LIFT's ability to recover both population distribution and cell fate probabilities.

AI.tldr: LIFT是一个潜在流（latent flow）框架，用于从谱系信息耦合（lineage-informed couplings）中进行概率性细胞状态生成，学习条件性命运分布而非仅末端群体分布。
AI.motivation: 谱系追踪（lineage tracing）通过克隆祖先连接细胞状态，但一般无法识别唯一的源-后代配对，因此只能提供"耦合"信息。从这类数据学习不能只建模终端群体分布，而需建模条件结果（即给定初始状态时未来状态的概率分布，一对多关系）。
AI.method: 提出LIFT：变分推断将多种替代结果编码到潜在空间；条件先验（conditional prior）使仅凭初始状态即可采样；采用Mean Flow解码器直接预测未来细胞状态，每次采样仅需一次解码器评估，便于大规模蒙特卡洛采样预测细胞命运；并对条件预测误差进行分析。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，LIFT能够同时恢复群体分布与细胞命运概率（cell fate probabilities）。
AI.conclusion: LIFT将一对多关系的表示、高效采样与条件预测误差分析相结合，为谱系信息数据下的概率性细胞命运预测提供了有效框架。

title: Beyond the Sink Interpretation: Radial Attention in Flow-Based VLA Policies
summary: Prior work calls the high attention on the first and last action tokens of a flow-based VLA policy a radial action sink, and uses these tokens to set the execution horizon. In language models, a sink is a token with high incoming attention, a small value, and little effect on the output. We test whether that profile holds, not the horizon rule, in one $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint on five RoboCasa tasks. The two endpoints receive 5.4% of action-key mass, 1.4 percentage points above their uniform share, and rotary positional encoding produces this excess: directly in shallow layers and through upstream action-token RoPE deeper in the network. The endpoints do not fit the sink profile. Their value norms stay near the action-token mean in all 18 layers. On 250 paired episodes, masking them or zeroing their values changes success by less than 4 points, and replacing their value directions with those of another observation lowers it by 3.2 to 7.2 points across three donors, whereas the same replacement on two non-endpoint tokens in the executed prefix lowers it by 28.4 points. The token that does fit the sink profile on mass and value norm is the prefix BOS; on this checkpoint, zeroing its value raises success in two paired runs, by +13.2 points (95% CI [+7.0, +19.4]) and +6.0 points ([+0.2, +11.8]). Inside the action chunk, a relative-offset routing profile estimated on other tasks keeps 75% of action-token spread and keeps closed-loop success on three held-out tasks (42.7% against a 38.7% baseline), while uniform or shuffled routing drops success to 3-4%. High attention mass alone does not tell what a token does.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了流式VLA策略中首末动作token是否真的符合语言模型中"attention sink"（高入度注意力、值范数小、对输出影响小）的定义。结果发现：端点确实获得超额注意力（5.4%，比均匀份额高1.4个百分点），且该超额由RoPE造成；但其值范数正常，掩码/置零其值对成功率影响<4个点，替换其值方向仅降3.2–7.2个点，远小于非端点token的28.4个点下降——说明端点并非sink。真正符合sink特征的是prefix BOS，置零其值反而在两个配对实验中将成功率提升+13.2和+6.0个点。此外，基于相对偏移的路由策略可保留75%的动作token散布并在留出任务上维持闭环成功率（42.7% vs 38.7%基线），而均匀或打乱路由会崩溃至3–4%。结论：注意力质量本身不能说明token的功能。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将流式VLA策略中首末动作token的高注意力称为"radial action sink"，并据此设定执行horizon。但语言模型中sink的定义包含三项特征（高入度注意力、值范数小、对输出影响小），作者希望检验端点是否真的满足这一完整画像，而非直接接受基于注意力的horizon规则。
AI.method: 在一个π0.5检查点、五个RoboCasa任务上进行实证分析：(1) 测量首末端点占动作key注意力的比例，并通过逐层分析定位RoPE（旋转位置编码）的贡献（浅层直接作用、深层通过上游动作token的RoPE间接作用）；(2) 在全部18层比较端点值范数与动作token均值；(3) 在250对配对episode上进行因果干预：掩码端点、置零端点value、替换端点value方向（3个donor观测），并与非端点token对照；(4) 检验prefix BOS的注意力质量与值范数，并做置零value的配对实验；(5) 在动作chunk内部测试基于相对偏移的路由profile在其他任务上估计后迁移到三个留出任务的闭环表现，对照均匀/打乱路由。
AI.result: 端点获得5.4%的动作key注意力质量，仅比均匀份额高1.4个百分点，该超额可归因于RoPE。端点不符合sink画像：18层中值范数均接近动作token均值；掩码或置零其value使成功率变化<4个点；用其他观测的值方向替换端点value仅下降3.2–7.2个点（三个donor），而同样操作作用于执行前缀中的两个非端点token则下降28.4个点。真正符合sink画像（注意力质量与值范数双指标）的是prefix BOS，置零其value在两个配对运行中反而提升成功率+13.2个点（95% CI [+7.0, +19.4]）与+6.0个点（[+0.2, +11.8]）。相对偏移路由profile在其他任务上估计后，保留75%的动作token散布，并在三个留出任务上维持42.7%闭环成功率（基线38.7%），而均匀或打乱路由仅3–4%。
AI.conclusion: 高注意力质量本身并不能说明token的功能：首末动作端点虽获得超额注意力，但并不承担sink角色，其对输出影响远小于普通token；真正的sink出现在prefix BOS，且移除其value反而改善性能。因此，基于注意力质量设定的执行horizon规则缺乏因果依据，分析VLA中的注意力结构需要结合值范数与因果干预，而非仅看注意力分配。

title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
summary: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. A code-coverage analysis of vLLM further shows that the evaluated live, replayed, and synthetic workloads are complementary in this configuration: each exercises Python serving paths not reached in the measured runs of the others. In a case study rolling out four large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on llm-d, experiments show that the target models reached about half the optimal concurrency, and correspondingly about 60% of the throughput, on captured workloads compared with public traces. We open-source the relevant tools and release a trace dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端的智能体式LLM服务评测流水线，用实验为各阶段设计选择提供依据：回放录制轨迹可稳定复现每会话token负载，回放/实时/合成三类工作负载在vLLM代码覆盖率上互补，并在llm-d上四款大型MoE模型案例中揭示公共轨迹会高估最优并发与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 企业正将agentic工作负载从闭源API迁移到自建开源权重模型部署，因此需要覆盖小规模测试、容量规划、预生产到生产的全生命周期验证。但现有上线评估多用临时工具，其准确性鲜有校验，缺乏可复现、可信的端到端评测方法与设计依据。
AI.method: 构建端到端agentic LLM服务评测流水线，并实验性验证各阶段衔接的设计选择：(1) 对比回放录制轨迹与实时重跑对每会话负载的复现精度（P95输入token偏差）；(2) 对vLLM做代码覆盖率分析，比较实时、回放、合成三类工作负载所触达的Python服务路径；(3) 在llm-d上部署四个大型MoE模型做上线案例研究，比较捕获工作负载与公共轨迹下的最优并发与吞吐。同时开源工具并发布轨迹数据集。
AI.result: P95下回放的输入token为原始记录的1.18倍以内，而实时重跑达4.98倍，说明少量录制会话即可给出可重复的每会话token负载。代码覆盖率分析显示，该配置下实时、回放与合成工作负载各覆盖彼此未触达的Python服务路径，具有互补性。案例研究中，目标模型在捕获工作负载上仅达到约一半的最优并发、约60%的吞吐（相对公共轨迹）。
AI.conclusion: 回放录制轨迹是可靠且可重复的负载复现手段，优于实时重跑；多类工作负载应组合使用以提升覆盖；公共轨迹会显著高估实际部署的并发与吞吐容量，容量规划须基于自采轨迹。作者开源工具与轨迹数据集以支持可复现评测。

title: AesDistill: Distilling Generative Aesthetics for Image Color Enhancement
summary: Image color enhancement aims to improve visual appeal, but previous methods often learn to reproduce ground-truth expert targets. These targets reflect the preferences of a few experts and cover a limited range of aesthetic choices. Matching them does not ensure stronger aesthetic quality across different tastes and scenes. By contrast, large generative models learn rich visual knowledge from large image collections and often produce vivid, appealing image edits. However, direct generation can change the source image's semantic structure along with its colors. In this paper, we introduce AesDistill, a framework for distilling generative aesthetics into image color enhancement. We use 4 leading open-source large generative models to produce 64,644 edited images as teacher targets at a cost of about 3,360 H100 GPU-hours, forming the AesDistill Dataset. AesDistill also includes AesDistill Student, a 1.13M-parameter model that learns teacher color changes through confidence-weighted supervision while preserving the source image's semantic structure. We evaluate AesDistill with 12 aesthetic and 4 image-quality assessment models. Every teacher's targets rank above the FiveK and PPR10K expert target means in the joint assessment. Across both datasets, AesDistill Student outperforms all 20 baseline methods and ranks directly behind the 4 teachers. These results demonstrate that distilling aesthetics from generative models enables a compact student to outperform methods trained on expert targets.

AI.tldr: 提出AesDistill框架，将大型生成模型的"生成式美学"蒸馏到图像色彩增强任务中，构建含64,644张教师编辑图像的AesDistill数据集，并训练仅1.13M参数的学生模型，在12个美学与4个图像质量评估模型上超越20种基线方法，仅次于4个教师模型。
AI.motivation: 以往色彩增强方法以复现专家标注的ground-truth为目标，但这些目标只反映少数专家偏好、美学选择范围有限，难以保证在不同品味与场景下都具有更高的美学质量。大型生成模型从海量图像中学到丰富视觉知识并能产生生动、具吸引力的编辑，但直接生成会改变源图像的语义结构及颜色。
AI.method: 构建AesDistill框架：使用4个领先开源大型生成模型作为教师，以约3,360 H100 GPU小时的成本生成64,644张编辑图像构成AesDistill数据集；训练AesDistill Student（1.13M参数小模型），通过置信度加权监督学习教师的色彩变化，同时保持源图像语义结构。
AI.result: 在12个美学评估模型和4个图像质量评估模型上评测：每个教师的目标在联合评估中均高于FiveK与PPR10K专家目标的均值；在两个数据集上，AesDistill Student优于全部20种基线方法，排名紧接4个教师之后。
AI.conclusion: 从生成模型蒸馏美学的思路可使紧凑的学生模型超越基于专家目标训练的方法，验证了生成式美学作为色彩增强监督信号的有效性。

title: A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals
summary: Data-driven monitoring based on milling force can enable advanced manufacturing services including process optimization and condition monitoring. However, industrial implementation is often hindered by costly and intrusive hardware and large training data requirements. This paper therefore presents a hybrid approach using machine-internal signals and machining metadata to enable force-based monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors. Commonly available machine signals have relatively low sampling rates and cannot directly represent high-frequency milling-force variations, especially at higher spindle speeds. Instead of learning the complete force signal, which would increase model complexity, data requirements, and overfitting risk, a supervised machine-learning model predicts only the average milling force from selected machine-signal features and machining parameters. This low-frequency estimation parameterizes a static milling force model that reconstructs the force behavior over one spindle revolution. Although the static model does not reproduce all dynamic effects, it captures the force distribution, load levels, and angular regions of highest tool engagement. The approach is evaluated on one milling machine across varying process parameters, engagement conditions, cutting tools, and two workpiece materials. Dynamometer measurements are required only for development and validation. Ridge regression achieves an $R^2$ of $0.984$ and $0.991$ for average-force prediction on the test data ($\bar{F}_x$ and $\bar{F}_y$). The reconstructed force behavior over one spindle revolution achieves an $R^2$ of $0.962$ and $0.982$ ($F_x$ and $F_y$) compared with the reconstruction based on measured force features. The method provides a cost and computationally efficient basis for process monitoring, tool condition assessment, and process optimization on existing machines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合方法：用机床内部低采样率信号与加工元数据训练监督模型预测平均铣削力，再以该低频估计参数化静态铣削力模型，重建单转内的力分布，实现无附加传感器的力基监测。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的铣削力监测依赖昂贵且侵入式的测力仪，并需大量训练数据，制约其在老旧机床上的工业落地；且常用机床内部信号采样率低，无法直接表征高频力变化（高转速下尤甚）。
AI.method: 不学习完整力信号（避免模型复杂度、数据需求与过拟合），仅由选定机床信号特征与切削参数经监督学习预测平均铣削力；以该低频估计作为静态铣削力模型的输入参数，重建一个主轴回转周期内的力行为。采用岭回归。在单台铣床上跨不同工艺参数、接触条件、刀具及两种工件材料评估；测力仪数据仅用于开发与验证。
AI.result: 平均力预测测试集 R² 为 0.984（F̄x）与 0.991（F̄y）；单转力重建相对基于实测力特征的重建，R² 为 0.962（Fx）与 0.982（Fy）。静态模型虽不重现全部动态效应，但能刻画力分布、载荷水平及高刀具接触的角度区间。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为现有（brownfield）机床上的过程监测、刀具状态评估与工艺优化提供了低成本、低计算负担的基础。

title: SpecFlow: Flow Matching in the Acceleration Spectrum for Multi-Agent Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Multimodal trajectory forecasting must cover diverse future behaviors without sacrificing dynamical coherence. Most generative forecasters evolve frame-wise positions directly, leaving the relationships among position, velocity, and acceleration implicit. We present SpecFlow, a conditional flow-matching framework that treats the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients of future accelerations as its generative state. SpecFlow learns a transport from Gaussian noise to acceleration spectra and reconstructs velocity and position through fixed analytical integration initialized by the last observed state. A joint phase-space objective supervises all three kinematic levels. To represent destination uncertainty without future information, an endpoint predictor produces candidate destinations and confidence scores solely from observed context, and the highest-confidence candidate conditions the spectral denoiser. Alternating attention over trajectory hypotheses and agents captures multimodality and interaction. Under best-of-20 evaluation, SpecFlow achieves average minADE/minFDE of 0.15/0.22 on ETH/UCY, 0.69/0.86 at four seconds on NBA, and 7.38/11.57 on SDD. It establishes state-of-the-art results across all five ETH/UCY scenes and achieves the lowest four-second ADE on NBA with a tied-best FDE, while remaining competitive on SDD. Together, these results demonstrate that acceleration-spectrum flow matching provides an effective structured generative state across smooth pedestrian motion, coordinated multi-agent sports dynamics, and heterogeneous outdoor trajectories. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SpecFlow 以未来加速度的 DCT 系数作为生成状态，用条件流匹配从高斯噪声生成加速度频谱，再经解析积分重建速度与位置，在 ETH/UCY 全部五个场景取得 SOTA，并在 NBA、SDD 上具备竞争力。
AI.motivation: 多模态轨迹预测需兼顾未来行为的多样性与动力学一致性。多数生成式预测器直接生成逐帧位置，使位置、速度、加速度之间的关系保持隐式，容易产生动力学不相容的轨迹。
AI.method: 提出条件流匹配框架 SpecFlow：(1) 以未来加速度的离散余弦变换（DCT）系数作为生成状态，学习从高斯噪声到加速度频谱的传输；(2) 通过以上一观测状态为初值的固定解析积分重建速度与位置；(3) 采用联合相空间（phase-space）目标同时监督位置、速度、加速度三个运动学层级；(4) 不用未来信息，仅由观测上下文训练终点预测器输出候选终点与置信度，取置信度最高者作为频谱去噪器的条件；(5) 使用轨迹假设与智能体之间的交替注意力建模多模态性与交互。
AI.result: best-of-20 评测下，ETH/UCY 平均 minADE/minFDE 为 0.15/0.22，NBA 四秒 0.69/0.86，SDD 为 7.38/11.57；在 ETH/UCY 全部五个场景达到 SOTA，NBA 四秒 ADE 最优、FDE 并列最优，SDD 保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 加速度频谱流匹配是一种有效的结构化生成状态，可同时适用于平滑行人运动、多智能体协同的体育动态以及异构户外轨迹。代码将公开。

title: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of the MATH lvl5 dataset, ROAM-GRPO implementation increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.

AI.tldr: 提出 ROAM-GRPO，在标准 GRPO 中引入“off-mode”分支：对已充分解决的问题额外采样多样化解法，经 LLM 评判逻辑有效性与差异性后自蒸馏回策略，以缓解 SFT+RLVR 造成的输出多样性塌缩并提升 pass@k。
AI.motivation: SFT 与 RLVR 组合虽已成为复杂推理后训练的主流流程，但会导致策略塌缩到低多样性模式：重复采样输出近乎相同，pass@k 随 k 增大收敛甚至退化。因此需要在训练中显式激励对不同推理策略的探索，提升评测阶段输出的创造性。
AI.method: ROAM-GRPO 作为 GRPO 的增强：在训练中检测已良好解决的问题，将其转入独立的“off-mode”轨道；在该轨道上提示模型生成与既有模式不同的解题策略，由 LLM judge 校验其逻辑有效性与差异性，再将通过校验的解法自蒸馏进策略，从而在保持正确性的同时拓宽策略支撑集。
AI.result: 在 MATH level 5 数据集的 1000 题子集上训练 Qwen3.5-2b，ROAM-GRPO 使峰值 pass@16 提升 4.7%，并在困难评测集上把正确解嵌入的余弦距离扩大约 1.5–2 倍，表明输出多样性显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 将“已解问题”用作多样性探索的入口、并以 judge 过滤加自蒸馏固化新策略，是一种低代价的 GRPO 增强手段；实验显示其同时改善 pass@k 峰值与解空间的分散程度，为缓解后训练的多样性塌缩提供了可行路径。

title: LG-FiLM: Local-Global Mixture-of-Experts Modulation for RAW-to-RGB Reconstruction
summary: An image signal processor does more than reconstruct an image. It also has to decide how strongly to denoise, how to balance color, and which tone curve maps the scene onto the display, and these settings depend on the scene itself, the curve that suits a backlit sky is not the one that suits an indoor portrait. Most neural ISPs learn a single fixed transformation and apply it to every scene. We instead make the adaptation an explicit part of the network. Our model, LG FiLM, keeps one shared encoder decoder and places a small mixture of affine experts at its bottleneck; the experts scales, shifts, and mixing weights are predicted from local neighborhood evidence together with a global scene descriptor. Reconstruction stays in a single shared pathway and only the processing mode is switched. We evaluate LG FiLM on three datasets, Fujifilm UltraISP, Zurich RAW to RGB, and a COCO derived benchmark built with an inverse ISP. The model reaches the best reconstruction fidelity of the compared entries on the primary benchmark and transfers to the other two.

AI.tldr: 提出 LG FiLM：在共享编解码器瓶颈处放置小型仿射专家混合（scale/shift/混合权重由局部邻域证据与全局场景描述子预测），将场景自适应显式嵌入网络，实现单一共享重建通路下仅切换处理模式。在 Fujifilm UltraISP、Zurich RAW-to-RGB 与 COCO 派生基准上，主基准取得最优重建保真度并成功迁移至另两个数据集。
AI.motivation: ISP 不仅重建图像，还需决定降噪强度、色彩平衡与色调曲线，这些设置随场景变化（逆光天空与室内人像所需曲线不同）。现有神经 ISP 多学习单一固定变换并应用于所有场景。
AI.method: 单一共享编码器-解码器；瓶颈处设置小型仿射专家混合（FiLM 式），其缩放、平移与专家混合权重由局部邻域证据结合全局场景描述子共同预测；重建始终走共享通路，仅切换处理模式。
AI.result: 在 Fujifilm UltraISP、Zurich RAW to RGB 及基于逆 ISP 构建的 COCO 基准上评估；主基准上重建保真度优于对比方法，并具备向另两个数据集的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将场景自适应作为网络的显式组成部分，可在不牺牲共享重建通路的前提下实现按场景切换的处理模式，并获得更优的重建保真度与跨数据集泛化性。

title: DTS: Delta-Based Tile Scoring for Efficient Long-Context Sparse Attention
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at DATE 2027. Emre Uğur and Jiawen Qi contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly need to process long documents and codebases, making long-context attention a major prefill bottleneck. Block sparse attention reduces computation by skipping unimportant blocks of the attention matrix, but scoring blocks accurately can itself be expensive. We propose Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS), a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method for sparse block attention. DTS selects query and key anchors according to local vector changes, using fewer representatives in redundant regions while retaining more detail in heterogeneous regions. To accelerate anchor selection, parallel delta packing partitions the query and key sequences into tile-aligned chunks and performs bounded local scans over these chunks concurrently. The selected tiles are then computed using the original query, key, and value vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, DTS keeps average RULER and LongBench scores within 0.10 percentage points of full attention, with RULER evaluated up to 128K tokens. At 128K tokens, DTS reduces measured scoring-pipeline latency by 38% compared with XAttention. On four NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it achieves a 3.3$\times$ prefill speedup over a PyTorch full-attention baseline using FlashAttention-2 at 512K tokens.

AI.tldr: DTS是一种免训练、内容自适应的稀疏块注意力分块打分方法，通过基于局部向量变化的锚点选择与并行增量打包加速打分，在近乎无损精度的前提下显著降低长上下文预填充延迟。
AI.motivation: LLM需要处理长文档与代码库，长上下文注意力成为预填充主要瓶颈。块稀疏注意力可跳过不重要的注意力块，但准确给块打分本身开销很大，因此需要一种低成本且准确的分块打分策略。
AI.method: 提出Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS)：依据局部向量变化选择query和key锚点，在冗余区域用更少代表、在异质区域保留更多细节；为加速锚点选择，采用并行增量打包，将query/key序列划分为与tile对齐的chunk并并发执行有界局部扫描；被选中的tile仍用原始Q、K、V计算。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct上，RULER（最高128K）与LongBench平均分与全注意力的差距在0.10个百分点以内；128K时打分流水线延迟较XAttention降低38%；4×H100上512K tokens相对FlashAttention-2全注意力基线预填充加速3.3倍。
AI.conclusion: DTS以免训练方式实现了高精度、低开销的稀疏注意力打分，是可落地的长上下文预填充加速方案。

title: TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://tacinno.github.io
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 TacInno，将与视觉和已执行动作无关的“触觉新息”作为纯训练监督信号，提升视觉-触觉-动作（VLA）模型在接触密集操作中的表现，且部署时不增加额外模块。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-触觉 VLA 中加入触觉输入收益不稳定，部分模型几乎不依赖触觉，因为大量触觉变化（如夹爪闭合时的凝胶形变）可由视觉观测与执行动作预测出来，导致触觉信息冗余、监督信号不显著。
AI.method: 提出 TacInno：以视觉观测与已执行动作为条件，用 TacInno tokenizer 将未来触觉变化压缩为离散码，从而隔离出视觉与动作无法解释的接触动力学（触觉新息）；策略 TacInno-VLA 仅学习预测该离散码，作为辅助训练目标，部署时不引入任何预测模块。
AI.result: TacInno-VLA 在六个仿真任务上平均成功率 87.5%，四个真实任务上 70.5%，分别比最强视觉-触觉基线高 10.7 与 9.0 个百分点；消融实验验证了视觉与动作条件、多帧编码及辅助码预测各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以触觉新息作为监督信号，可有效提升接触密集操作性能，为视觉-触觉 VLA 提供了一种轻量、免部署开销的触觉利用范式。

title: GaussTrans: A Gaussian Interface Framework for Multi-Layer Refractive Transport
summary: We investigate surface modeling of multi-transparent interfaces to achieve accurate light transmission. The interplay of errors in geometric structure, light paths, and observation results during the reconstruction of transparent media with a high number of layers makes this a challenging problem. Some existing techniques address the reconstruction of transparent scenes by reducing the number of layers or simplifying light paths; however, this limits their direct applicability to high-order transparent scenes. We propose GaussTrans, a compact framework for light transport in high-order transparent scenes, consisting of three components: Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces, Transport-Coupled Refinement, and Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection. Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces use a hybrid approach combining Gauss surfaces and fields to reconstruct different interfaces. Transport-Coupled Refinement reduces coupling errors by evaluating the entire light path. Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection combines primitive support regions to reduce errors in the intersection of interfaces and rays. In experiments on datasets such as RefRef, GaussTrans achieves significantly higher accuracy with relatively low spatial storage requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出GaussTrans框架，用于高阶（多层）透明界面的表面建模与精确光线传输重建，在RefRef等数据集上以较低存储实现更高精度。
AI.motivation: 多层透明介质重建中，几何结构、光路与观测结果三类误差相互耦合，层数越多越难处理；现有方法通过减少层数或简化光路来规避，难以直接用于高阶透明场景。
AI.method: GaussTrans由三部分组成：(1) Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces，用高斯面与场的混合表征重建不同界面；(2) Transport-Coupled Refinement，通过评估完整光路降低耦合误差；(3) Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection，结合图元支撑区域减少界面与光线求交误差。
AI.result: 在RefRef等数据集上，GaussTrans精度显著优于对比方法，且空间存储需求较低。
AI.conclusion: 混合面-场表征+全光路耦合优化+图元引导求交是重建高阶透明界面的有效紧凑方案。

title: TRACE: Attribute Execution for Sequential Image Editing
summary: Given an image and successive user instructions, sequential image editing should return an updated image that satisfies each new request and preserves earlier requirements that remain active. This lets users develop a result without repeatedly restating or repairing their decisions. The difficulty is that a retrieved image can contain a valid color on an obsolete surface, while the current image may lack the newly requested material. Neither reference selection nor a precise object mask alone specifies how to reconcile attributes occupying the same region. We present TRACE, which separates the continuing attribute from its visual carrier and prioritizes local appearance operations under complete-request checks. Active-goal binding identifies what should persist, carrier selection supplies suitable current or newly generated pixels, and tonal calibration reduces tinting near highlights and shadows. Experiments across frozen editors, independent visual readers, new source images, and complete sequential benchmarks support joint color-material recovery and show how local execution preserves the surrounding scene.

AI.tldr: TRACE 将"持续生效的属性"与其"视觉载体"解耦，在完整请求校验下优先执行局部外观操作，实现顺序图像编辑中颜色—材质的联合恢复并保住周边场景。
AI.motivation: 给定图像与连续指令的顺序编辑需同时满足新请求与仍生效的旧请求，避免用户反复重述或修补决策。难点在于：检索到的参考图可能在已作废的表面上带有有效颜色，而当前图像可能缺少新请求的材质；仅靠参考选择或精确目标掩码都无法规定如何在同一区域调和属性冲突。
AI.method: 提出 TRACE 框架，将属性与其视觉载体分离，并以完整请求检查约束局部外观操作：①主动目标绑定（active-goal binding）判定哪些需求应持续保留；②载体选择在"当前像素"或"新生成像素"之间提供合适载体；③色调校准减轻高光与阴影附近的色偏。
AI.result: 在冻结编辑器、独立视觉阅读器、新源图像以及完整顺序基准上的实验支持颜色—材质的联合恢复，并表明局部执行能保持周边场景不被破坏。
AI.conclusion: 顺序编辑应显式区分"持续属性"与"载体像素"，并在完整请求满足的校验下采用局部化外观编辑；该思路在跨编辑器、跨基准设置下具有良好泛化性。

title: Gradient Boosting with Kolmogorov-Arnold Units for Interpretable Regression beyond Pairwise Interactions
summary: Interpretable models for tabular regression, such as the explainable boosting machine (EBM), restrict a prediction to main effects and pairwise interactions so that every part of it can be plotted. When the target depends on three or more inputs jointly, this restriction costs accuracy, and a black-box model with post hoc explanations becomes the usual fallback. Here we present MJBoost, a gradient boosting method whose weak learner is a single Kolmogorov-Arnold unit $g(\sum_p φ_p(x_p))$ with penalized spline inner and outer functions. Each unit is fitted in closed form by alternating penalized least squares, starting from principal Hessian directions of the residual, and categorical and missing inputs enter the units directly. Because a unit depends on each input only through one inner function, the fitted model has an exact functional ANOVA decomposition into main effects, pair effects and a higher-order remainder, which one-dimensional convolutions compute. On synthetic targets of interaction order three to six, the test error of MJBoost is up to 13 times lower than that of EBM, and its decomposition recovers the true variance share of every order to within 0.04. On the 35 regression tasks of the OpenML-CTR23 benchmark, it has a lower test RMSE than EBM on 21 tasks and a higher one on 2 (geometric-mean RMSE -29.1%). On these tasks the main and pair effects of the fitted model explain a median 0.992 of its variance, so the model reads as plots where the data allow, and the decomposition measures the higher-order part where they do not. With Newton steps the same algorithm classifies: on 32 binary tasks of OpenML-CC18 its test log-loss is on par with that of EBM, and on 11 multiclass tasks its mean log-loss is lower than that of EBM on 8 and than that of tuned LightGBM on 7.

AI.tldr: 提出MJBoost：以单个Kolmogorov-Arnold单元为弱学习器的梯度提升方法，可精确做函数ANOVA分解，兼顾高阶交互精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: EBM等可解释表格回归模型只允许主效应与二阶交互，当目标依赖三个及以上输入联合作用时精度下降，只能退回黑箱模型加事后解释。
AI.method: MJBoost的弱学习器为单一Kolmogorov-Arnold单元 g(Σφ_p(x_p))，内外函数均用带惩罚样条；单元以残差的主Hessian方向为初值，通过交替惩罚最小二乘闭式拟合；类别与缺失输入直接进入单元；因每个单元对每个输入只经一个内函数，模型具有精确的函数ANOVA分解（主效应、二阶效应与高阶余项），由一维卷积计算。
AI.result: 在三至六阶交互的合成目标上，测试误差较EBM最多低13倍，分解恢复各阶真实方差份额误差在0.04以内；OpenML-CTR23的35个回归任务中21个优于EBM、2个更差，几何平均RMSE降低29.1%，主效应与二阶效应中位解释0.992的方差；OpenML-CC18的32个二分类任务log-loss与EBM相当，11个多分类任务中8个优于EBM、7个优于调参LightGBM。
AI.conclusion: MJBoost在保持可解释性的同时有效捕获高阶交互：数据允许时以图呈现，不允许时用分解量化高阶部分；经Newton步可扩展至分类，性能与EBM相当或更优。

title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
summary: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了 Awaken-Human 大规模第一人称立体视频数据集（约5万小时，同步全身人体运动，覆盖100+技能），并提出人形机器人视觉-语言-动作模型 Awaken-HI，通过共享动作专家同时预测原始人体运动与重定向机器人动作，实现从人到人形机器人的 loco-manipulation 技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人要让机器人在家庭与工作场所承担日常劳动，而现有第一人称视频数据集虽覆盖大量活动，却缺少大规模、同步的全身运动数据，难以支撑 loco-manipulation（移动操作）技能的学习与规模化训练。
AI.method: 构建 Awaken-Human 数据集：约50,000小时第一人称立体视频，配合同步全身人体运动数据，覆盖100余种技能。在此基础上提出 Awaken-HI（Humanoid Intelligence）VLA 模型：由一个共享动作专家联合预测原始人体运动与重定向后的机器人动作，并直接以人体轨迹监督该共享动作专家。
AI.result: 人体轨迹直接监督共享动作专家时，技能从人到人形机器人的迁移更有效；增加人体预训练数据可按经验缩放律降低留出集的机器人动作预测误差，并提升下游真机任务的平均成功率。全量语料预训练加 T800 适配后，Awaken-HI 在8个单项任务上平均成功率 93.75%，在单项与长时程评测中均优于 GR00T N1.7 与 π0.5；同一策略可泛化到机器人后训练未见过的物体及熟悉物体与新目的地的组合。
AI.conclusion: 以大规模同步第一人称人体运动数据为预训练来源，并通过共享动作专家将人体运动直接作为监督信号，是提升人形机器人 loco-manipulation 技能迁移与泛化能力的有效范式，且性能随人体数据规模呈可预测的缩放规律。

title: From AI Surrogate to Engineering Tool: Toward Production Use of Fiber-Orientation Prediction in Crash CAE
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at IAAI-27 (AAAI 2027), with technical appendices. 10 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables
summary: Crash simulations of glass-fiber-reinforced plastic parts are highly sensitive to the fiber-orientation field supplied to the material model. In conventional workflows, that field comes from resin-flow analysis, which requires molding-specialist support and takes about 25 hours of work per part. We previously proposed a surrogate model that addresses this bottleneck by predicting the orientation field in about 3 minutes. This paper reports the implementation, validation, and operational design that turned the model into an engineering tool for Honda design workflows. We present staged validation from 2D plates to production parts, evaluation against a predefined engineering angular-error criterion, and the expert review that approved design use in March 2025; the system has since been transferred to the crash-safety group and is in initial, limited use in directed fracture-prediction scenarios. The developed system combines injection-gate setting support for cases in which gates are unknown (90% gate-count accuracy, mean position error 11% of flow length), voxelization, surrogate inference, automatic mapping to the crash CAE model, and report generation in a single GUI. The complete orientation-preparation workflow takes about 0.1 hours, a 99.6% reduction from the conventional 25-hour flow-analysis route, and can be run directly by crash CAE engineers without molding-specialist support. As evidence of practical impact, component-level crash analysis using the predicted orientation field reduced the absolute peak-force error from 19.0% with an isotropic baseline to 11.4%, while confining predicted fracture to the test-observed region. The deployment lesson is that a surrogate model alone is not enough for practical adoption: gate-setting support, automatic data conversion, and shareable reporting are what make the model usable as a design tool.

AI.tldr: 该文报告将预测玻纤增强塑料纤维取向场的替代模型工程化为本田碰撞设计工具的落地工作：分阶段验证、门控评审通过、工作流耗时从25小时降至0.1小时，碰撞峰值力误差由19.0%降至11.4%。
AI.motivation: 碰撞仿真对输入材料模型的纤维取向场高度敏感，而传统取向场来自树脂流动分析，需模流专家支持且每个零件约耗时25小时，构成流程瓶颈；且仅有替代模型不足以被工程实际采纳。
AI.method: 在既有替代模型（约3分钟预测取向场）基础上进行实现、验证与运行设计：构建集成浇口设定辅助（未知名浇口时90%浇口数量准确率、位置误差为流动长度的11%）、体素化、替代模型推理、自动映射至碰撞CAE模型与报告生成的统一GUI；开展从2D平板到量产件的分阶段验证，并按预设工程角度误差准则评估，经专家评审后于2025年3月批准设计使用。
AI.result: 完整取向准备流程约0.1小时，较传统25小时流程降低99.6%，可由碰撞CAE工程师独立运行；采用预测取向场的部件级碰撞分析将绝对峰值力误差由各向同性基线的19.0%降至11.4%，且预测断裂局限于试验观测区域。系统已移交碰撞安全组，在定向断裂预测场景中初步有限使用。
AI.conclusion: 部署经验表明，替代模型本身不足以支撑实际应用，浇口设定支持、自动数据转换与可共享报告才是使其成为设计工具的关键要素。

title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA) weights images by their similarity to the original post text while preserving contributions from images with low literal similarity. Summing the branch classification scores integrates contextual semantics with visual evidence. Experiments on the multi-image MMSD3.0 benchmark show that SEAF outperforms all compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SEAF双分支框架，用选择性语义增强与视觉证据融合进行多图多模态讽刺检测。
AI.motivation: 多模态讽刺检测需要文本、视觉与上下文证据，多图时图像提供互补线索；MLLM生成的辅助信息混杂有用背景知识与冗余视觉描述，需选择性利用。
AI.method: 为生成字段分配不同角色：实体背景增强语义输入，图像描述提供对齐统计。语义分支融合原文、冻结MLLM背景与OCR文本；对齐视觉分支融合全局与局部视觉特征及跨模态、跨图相似度统计；提出Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA)，按图像与原文相似度加权并保留低字面相似图像的贡献；两分支分类分数相加。
AI.result: 在MMSD3.0多图基准上优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 双分支选择性语义增强与视觉证据融合可有效提升多图多模态讽刺检测性能。

title: Power Setpoint Tracking for Large-Scale EV Charging: Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning with Self-Tuning Constraint Prices
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Transportation Electrification
summary: In power setpoint tracking (PST), an operator follows a purchased charging profile without overloading shared transformers or undercharging vehicles. PST is cast as a constrained Markov decision process that minimizes tracking error subject to overload and mean user-satisfaction constraints. Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning (TC-CPL) extends soft actor-critic with proportional-integral Lagrange-multiplier updates from measured violations, a residual on the incumbent dispatcher that is warm-started from its demonstrations, and a transformer-aware encoder shared by all ports. It observes no departure times or states of charge. Simulations (five seeds, 100 paired days) compare it with the incumbent, Round-Robin. On a 600-port, 122-substation district, raw overload falls from 3.59 to 0.0017 kWh/day (overloaded seed-days from 77% to 0.4%), and absolute tracking error falls by 27%. Delivered energy rises by 16%, and satisfaction rises from 0.959 to 0.989. On a 42-kW transformer with household load, overload falls from 1.86 to 0.0014 kWh/day and satisfaction rises from 0.974 to 0.985, but absolute tracking error is 22% higher. Against hand-set fixed multipliers, self-tuning is statistically indistinguishable on the district. On the single transformer, it raises satisfaction by 0.011 at similar overload, but a short sweep found a better-serving fixed pair. The overload multipliers stay below their cap.

AI.tldr: 论文提出变压器约束充电策略学习（TC-CPL），在无出发时间、无荷电状态观测条件下，用Transformer感知编码器与比例-积分拉格朗日乘子自适应更新，将变压器过载降到近零并显著降低跟踪误差。
AI.motivation: 功率设定点跟踪（PST）要求运营商在不超过共享变压器容量、不使车辆欠充的前提下执行购电充电曲线。现有派驻调度器（incumbent）在过载与用户满意度约束下难以兼顾，且实际部署中通常无法获得车辆出发时间与荷电状态信息。
AI.method: 将PST建模为带约束的马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），目标为最小化跟踪误差，约束为变压器过载与平均用户满意度。TC-CPL以软演员-评论家（SAC）为骨干：①基于实测违约量进行比例-积分（PI）型拉格朗日乘子在线更新；②在派驻调度器输出上学习残差，并由其示范数据热启动；③采用所有端口共享的Transformer感知编码器，仅依赖可观测特征（不使用出发时间与荷电状态）。
AI.result: 仿真为5个随机种子、100个配对日。600端口、122座变电站区域：原始过载从3.59降至0.0017 kWh/天（过载种子-日占比77%→0.4%），绝对跟踪误差下降27%，交付能量增加16%，满意度由0.959升至0.989。42 kW含家庭负荷变压器：过载从1.86降至0.0014 kWh/天，满意度0.974→0.985，但绝对跟踪误差高22%。与人工设定固定乘子相比，区域场景下自整定在统计上无显著差异；单变压器场景满意度提升0.011且过载相当，但简短扫描找到了服务更优的固定乘子对。过载乘子始终低于其上限。
AI.conclusion: TC-CPL在无出发时间与荷电状态观测的条件下，实现了近乎消除变压器过载并降低跟踪误差，具备实际可部署性；自整定机制在区域规模上与人工调参相当，在单变压器上略优于固定乘子但并非最优，说明PI式乘子更新有效但仍有改进空间。

title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断性基准 Mind2Act World（5 域 30 任务、3 难度 × 2 场景共 180 配置），分 Mind/Act/Mind2Act 三视图评估认知推理、物理执行及其闭环组合，并配套诊断框架将失败归因到三者；最强智能体 Mind 52.7%、Act 39.0%，Mind2Act 仅 12.0%。
AI.motivation: 具身智能需同时具备基于历史的认知推理、精准及时的物理执行、以及通过环境反馈将二者组合的能力。现有基准要么在同一任务内同时评推理与执行，要么完全分离评估，缺乏对"组合"能力的检验，因而无法判断失败究竟源于推理、执行还是二者的组合。
AI.method: 构建 30 个仿真操作任务，覆盖 5 个真实应用域，每任务 3 个难度等级与 Clean/Random 两种场景，共 180 种配置；任务组织为三视图：Mind（基于过去观测做决策）、Act（精准及时执行）、Mind2Act（闭环中动作结果引导后续决策）。另设计诊断工具（diagnosis harness），将失败片段归因于 Mind、Act 或组合，并为系统生成 profile card。
AI.result: 评测多模态智能体、VLA 与世界动作模型（WAM）：单视图能力无法迁移到 Mind2Act。最强智能体 Mind 52.7%、Act 39.0%，Mind2Act 仅 12.0%。分析显示最强智能体可保持任务状态但难以维持持续接触，端到端策略能执行已训练动作但几乎不保留任务状态。
AI.conclusion: 单一视图的能力不代表组合能力；通过环境反馈将推理与执行组合起来是当前具身智能的主要开放问题。

title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
summary: Simulation-driven design of real engineering components has to meet three conditions at once. It runs on few solves, since a nonlinear finite-element simulation of a 3D part takes hours; its design space has many values, the hundreds to thousands of values of the part's CAD model; and a better design often needs a redesign, coordinated changes of the part's proportions rather than local polishing of its surface. Automated optimisers meet at most two of these conditions. Classical optimisers, Bayesian or derivative-free, need a person to cut the design down to a few parameters, and on all the values they need far more solves; industrial shape optimisers move every surface node of the mesh in one solve per cycle, but only in small steps that polish rather than redesign. We ask whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can meet all three by joining what it knows with what the simulation shows. GPT-6 Astra edits a magnesium stent through a CAD geometry parametrisation of about 1,650 values, with a budget of 15 simulations; every proposal is built in CAD, meshed and simulated with large-deformation plasticity and contact, and the LLM reads the full results of every solve. Within that budget it lowered the objective, a high percentile of the strains in the stent's bends, by 32%; on the same budget, the industrial shape optimiser Tosca improved the original design by a tenth and then stopped improving. An earlier GPT-6 Astra design, 25% lower in the same objective, was checked in an independent, higher-fidelity model of the full deployment with crimping and damage: it was 14% less strained than the original after the full chain, and its most damaged spot began to fail later and carried 63% less damage at full expansion. LLMs can thus join their learned knowledge with simulation data to adjust more than a thousand design values and reach valid designs with real improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用通用大语言模型（GPT-6 Astra）在约1650维CAD参数空间、仅15次仿真预算下完成镁合金支架的重设计，使弯折处应变高分位数目标降低32%，显著优于工业形状优化器Tosca（约10%），且改进在更高保真度的压握-损伤全流程模型中仍成立。
AI.motivation: 真实工程部件的仿真驱动设计需同时满足三点：仿真昂贵（非线性3D有限元单次需数小时）、设计空间维度高（CAD模型数百至数千个参数）、改进往往需要“重设计”（比例协同调整）而非局部打磨。现有自动优化器最多满足其中两点：经典贝叶斯/无导数优化需人工降维且所需求解次数多；工业形状优化器每轮可动全表面节点但只能做小步长抛光式改进。作者因此探究LLM能否通过结合自身知识与仿真结果同时满足三者。
AI.method: 以GPT-6 Astra作为优化器，对镁合金支架进行CAD几何参数化（约1650个设计值）。总仿真预算仅15次。每个候选方案均在CAD中建模、划分网格并进行含大变形塑性与接触的非线性仿真，LLM读取每一次求解的完整结果并据此提出下一方案。对照组为工业形状优化器Tosca，预算相同。另对GPT-6 Astra早前一个目标值低25%的设计，在独立、更高保真度的全流程模型（含压握与损伤）中进行验证。
AI.result: 在15次仿真预算内，GPT-6 Astra将目标（支架弯折处应变的高分位数）降低32%；同等预算下Tosca仅改进约十分之一随后停滞。早前那个目标降低25%的设计，在全流程高保真模型中经压握后应变比原始设计低14%，最易损伤点起始失效更晚，全扩张时损伤量减少63%。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够将其习得知识与仿真数据结合，在高维（>1000）设计空间中调整参数，在极少求解次数下得到可行且具有实质改进的设计，为仿真驱动的高维重设计提供了一种新范式。

title: Minimal Memory for Correctable Visual Continuation
summary: Given past images and known actions, visual continuation generates future frames from one evolving scene state. Keeping this state revisable matters when an object reappears or a later view changes an earlier interpretation. Once past images cannot be replayed, a summary sufficient for current rendering can lose candidates needed after correction. We establish matching sparse and dense bounds on the bits needed for later correction under stable observations and bounded disagreement. For static streams at the stated smoothness and margin scales, correction incurs at least logarithmic overhead in one dimension and polynomial overhead in higher dimensions. Coherent Archive Memory (CAM) stores geometric summaries with exact updates under clipped expansion and coordinate assignments, then uses historical existence constraints to select one state for all requested frames. Exhaustive photographic tests show strict worst-truth image-risk gains from joint witnesses, while controlled neural continuations recover positions hidden in the current view.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"视觉延续"任务中场景状态的可修正性，建立了记忆位数的稀疏/稠密匹配界，并提出相干档案记忆（CAM）方法
AI.motivation: 视觉延续需从演化中的场景状态生成未来帧。当目标重现或后续视角改变先前解释时，状态须可修正，但过去图像不可重放时，仅够当前渲染的摘要会丢失纠错所需候选
AI.method: 在稳定观测与有界分歧假设下建立纠错所需记忆位数的稀疏界与稠密界；提出相干档案记忆（CAM），以裁剪扩张与坐标分配下的精确更新存储几何摘要，并用历史存在性约束为所有请求帧选取单一状态
AI.result: 静态流在给定平滑度与间隔尺度下，纠错开销一维至少对数级、高维为多项式级；穷举摄影实验显示联合见证带来严格最坏真值图像风险增益，受控神经延续可恢复当前视图隐藏的位置
AI.conclusion: 可修正记忆固有纠错开销，CAM 通过几何摘要与历史存在性约束在理论与实验上验证了联合见证的有效性

title: Seeing Beyond the Obvious: Complementary Semantic Guidance for Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning
summary: Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning (SalSPML) assigns each image its most salient positive label, leaving other classes unlabeled. Existing methods construct class-level Salient Prototypes from observed positives to guide the recognition of unobserved classes. However, since salient annotations favor visually prominent instances, these prototypes may not fully capture the visual diversity of hidden positives, resulting in insufficient positive supervision. To address this limitation, we propose CoST, a Coverage-guided Complementary Soft-Target Refinement framework that supplements Salient Prototypes with complementary class-semantic information. Specifically, CoST identifies semantically relevant candidates from unknown classes by leveraging task-learned category information and image-text semantic correspondence. The selected candidates are then aggregated into class-wise Coverage Prototypes to complement the semantic representations provided by Salient Prototypes. Furthermore, we introduce a ranking-based selective refinement strategy that identifies classes receiving stronger semantic support from Coverage Prototypes and selectively enhances their soft targets while preserving the base soft targets for the rest. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CoST, with strong performance gains over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CoST框架，用语义覆盖原型补充显著原型，并配合基于排序的选择性软标签细化，缓解SalSPML中正类监督不足的问题。
AI.motivation: SalSPML仅标注每张图像最显著的正类，现有方法以观测正类构建类级显著原型来指导未观测类识别；但因显著标注偏向视觉突出实例，原型难以覆盖隐藏正类的视觉多样性，导致正监督不充分。
AI.method: 1）利用任务学习到的类别信息与图文语义对应关系，从未知类中筛选语义相关候选，聚合成类级"覆盖原型"（Coverage Prototypes），补充显著原型的语义表示；2）引入基于排序的选择性细化策略，识别从覆盖原型获得更强语义支撑的类别，仅对其软标签进行增强，其余类保留基础软标签。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验验证了CoST的有效性，相较现有基线取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以语义覆盖原型与选择性软标签细化互补显著原型，可有效缓解SalSPML的正监督不足，是一种通用且有效的改进范式。
