title: An Open-Source ROS 2 Framework for Shared Control in Surgical Teleoperation: Integrating the Haply Inverse3 with the da Vinci Research Kit
summary: Surgical teleoperation deprives surgeons of touch, forcing visual inference of tissue forces; the commercial platforms now restoring force feedback remain closed, preventing open research on haptic shared control. This paper provides a system contribution: it presents an open-source, ROS 2-native framework that integrates the compact, three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) Haply Inverse3 haptic device with the da~Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). The framework includes a novel mapping strategy that combines 3-DOF translational device input with separately tracked VerseGrip orientation into 6-DOF patient-side manipulator commands. Two virtual-fixture-inspired guidance modes serve as reference implementations to evaluate the framework in a within-subjects user study on a teleoperated hot-wire benchmark task in simulation, and the architecture is further demonstrated on physical dVRK hardware. Relative to unassisted manual control, linear guidance significantly reduced both the number of wire contacts and the task completion time, whereas the progressive-stiffness guidance produced consistent but statistically non-significant trends in the same direction. Subjective ratings of workload, agency, and satisfaction showed favorable descriptive trends for the guidance modes. The results demonstrate the feasibility of haptic shared control with a compact device coupled to the dVRK and provide an openly available, reproducible platform for future research. They further suggest that simpler linear feedback may be more robust for inexperienced operators than more complex profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个开源、原生支持ROS 2的框架，将紧凑型3自由度Haply Inverse3触觉设备与dVRK（da Vinci Research Kit）集成，实现手术遥操作中的力反馈与触觉共享控制研究。框架采用新颖映射策略：3自由度平移设备输入结合单独跟踪的VerseGrip姿态，生成6自由度患者侧机械臂指令。在仿真热丝基准任务中开展被试内用户研究评估两种虚拟夹具式引导模式，并在实体dVRK上演示系统。
AI.motivation: 手术遥操作剥夺了外科医生的触觉，只能通过视觉推断组织受力；现有恢复力反馈的商业平台为闭源系统，阻碍了触觉共享控制的开放研究。因此需要一个可复现、开放的平台来支持该方向研究。
AI.method: 系统贡献型工作：构建开源ROS 2原生框架，集成3自由度Haply Inverse3触觉设备与dVRK；设计将3自由度平移输入与单独跟踪的VerseGrip姿态融合为6自由度患者侧机械臂指令的映射策略；实现两种受虚拟夹具启发的引导模式（线性引导与渐进刚度引导）作为参考实现；在仿真遥操作热丝基准任务上开展被试内用户研究，并在实体dVRK硬件上演示架构。
AI.result: 与无辅助手动控制相比，线性引导显著减少了导线接触次数并缩短了任务完成时间；渐进刚度引导呈现同方向的一致趋势但未达统计显著。主观评分（工作负荷、能动性、满意度）对引导模式呈有利的描述性趋势。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明将紧凑型触觉设备耦合至dVRK实现触觉共享控制是可行的，并提供了一个开放可复现的研究平台；同时提示对缺乏经验的操作者而言，较简单的线性反馈可能比复杂力反馈曲线更稳健。

title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
summary: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出System-One RSI框架：高频在线OODA内环用决策模型+决策树实现免推理模型的亚秒级动作输出，低频离线外环由推理智能体团队迭代改进提示词与决策树、并从交互记录中蒸馏监督信号训练模型，将学到的区分固化为"外部肌肉记忆"。
AI.motivation: 推理模型具备强多模态任务理解能力，但显式 deliberation 导致决策延迟，难以满足亚秒级实时控制需求；而快速决策模型虽能进入响应窗口，却难以通过提示与少样本示例获得新任务所需的细粒度经验。
AI.method: 受教练式运动学习启发，构建双环结构。内环为高频在线OODA循环：决策模型将视觉观测与任务问题映射为结构化判断，决策树将其转换为带时序的动作，全程不调用推理模型。外环为离线递归自我改进循环：推理智能体团队修订决策模型提示与决策树、采集交互记录、由记录导出监督信号、训练并部署更新参数；改进后的系统返回环境生成下一轮经验。仅需少量真实回合，无需专家示范、环境修改、沙箱或并行仿真。
AI.result: 在Snake、Zenless Zone Zero与Black Myth: Wukong上以27B决策模型验证：Snake平均得分由1.30提升至7.35；Zenless Zone Zero某评估场景中位完成时间下降8.4%；Black Myth: Wukong某战斗场景中，闪避策略平均存活时间为静止基线的11倍，进攻策略在评估配置下胜率由0%升至66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将慢速推理能力与快速反应控制解耦，通过离线递归自改进把推理层的经验沉淀为外部化的"肌肉记忆"，可在极少真实交互、无专家示范与仿真加速的条件下显著提升实时多模态决策性能，为低延迟具身/游戏控制提供可行范式。

title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
summary: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/VC-VQA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VC-VQA，一个面向视觉中心知识推理的大规模基准，系统评估多模态大模型在细粒度视觉知识获取与多阶段推理上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多将视觉信息仅当作实体识别工具，推理主要依赖文本外部知识，未能显式建模视觉信息的来源（内部图像 vs. 外部图像）及其介入阶段（检索前 vs. 检索后），难以真实反映视觉中心的知识推理能力。
AI.method: 构建VC-VQA基准：按视觉信息来源与介入阶段设计任务，要求模型检索外部视觉证据、在检索前识别视觉线索，并对检索到的知识进行定位、验证或与内部图像匹配；同时构建带可追溯文本与视觉证据的受控多模态知识库。在无外部知识、给定证据、知识库检索、开放网络搜索四种设置下评测21个代表性MLLM。
AI.result: 实验得出三点结论：当前模型在视觉中心知识推理上仍表现不佳；细粒度视觉知识获取是主要瓶颈；智能体式检索体现出多步规划与跨模态知识整合的价值。
AI.conclusion: VC-VQA为多模态大模型的视觉中心知识推理提供了更具挑战性的评测基准，代码与数据集已开源。

title: Policy Improvement-Guided Replay for Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires models to acquire new capabilities while retaining performance on previous tasks. A stability-oriented perspective common in conventional continual learning emphasizes knowledge preservation and interference mitigation. Complementing this perspective, we revisit CRL for vision-language models through policy improvement, a fundamental principle of RL, to preserve acquired performance gains. Using the performance difference lemma, we characterize historical performance changes through the current policy's expected advantages on historical task distributions, motivating replay of historical prompts with the current policy. To allocate limited replay memory, we propose Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which contrasts likelihood gains on correct responses from the final task policy with likelihood reductions on incorrect responses from the initial policy. Our analysis links correct-response likelihood gains to reference-policy advantages under an idealized KL-regularized optimal update and provides an endogenous-reward interpretation for general policy updates. CoLiR estimates scores from finite training rollouts and cached log-likelihoods, selects prompts at task boundaries, and replays them uniformly during subsequent training, with KL regularization restricted to replayed prompts. Memory construction only requires a small amount of additional cross-policy scoring but no additional response generation. Across three Qwen3-VL model sizes on MRCL, CoLiR achieves the highest mean final accuracy and mean task accuracy among the compared methods while maintaining competitive new-task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文从强化学习"策略改进"原理出发重新审视视觉-语言模型的持续强化学习(CRL)，用性能差引理将历史性能变化刻画为当前策略在历史任务分布上的期望优势，从而论证需用当前策略回放历史提示；据此提出对比似然回放(CoLiR)，在任务边界以"最终策略对正确回答的似然增益 vs 初始策略对错误回答的似然下降"对比打分选样，并在后续训练中均匀回放、仅对回放提示施加KL正则，无需额外生成回答。
AI.motivation: 常规持续学习以稳定性为导向，强调知识保持与干扰抑制；作者希望补充一个以"策略改进"为核心的视角，用RL第一性原理来守住已获得的性能增益，并解决回放记忆容量有限时"该回放哪些历史提示"的分配问题。
AI.method: (1) 用performance difference lemma把历史任务的性能变化表示为当前策略在历史任务分布上的期望优势，得到回放历史提示的理论动机；(2) 提出CoLiR打分：对比"最终任务策略在正确回答上的似然增益"与"初始策略在错误回答上的似然下降"；(3) 理论分析：在理想化KL正则最优更新下，将正确回答似然增益与参考策略优势相联系，并给出一般策略更新的内生奖励解释；(4) 工程实现：用有限训练rollout与缓存的log-likelihood估计得分，在任务边界选样，后续训练中均匀回放，KL正则仅作用于回放提示；记忆构建只需少量跨策略打分，不增加额外回答生成。
AI.result: 在MRCL基准上，跨Qwen3-VL三种模型规模，CoLiR在平均最终准确率与平均任务准确率上均为对比方法中最高，同时新任务性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以策略改进（而非仅稳定性）为视角设计回放选择，可在有限记忆下有效保留CRL中的性能增益；CoLiR以低额外开销（无需额外生成）实现更优的稳定性—可塑性平衡。

title: JARVIS: An Agent That Designs, Builds, and Tests Circuit Boards on Its Own
summary: Power electronics is central to the energy transition, but developing new hardware still relies on human-led design, fabrication, testing, and iteration. We present JARVIS, an embodied AI agent that autonomously closes this loop for circuit boards. JARVIS maintains machine-specific capabilities and constraints, scans its workspace using a robot-mounted 3D scanner, and constructs an executable digital twin in which it rehearses robot motions, fabrication steps, and circuit behavior before consuming materials. A single text instruction initiates the physical experiment. Using unmodified desktop equipment, the agent coordinates a robot arm, a PCB printer that deposits conductive silver ink and solder paste, and a pick-and-place machine. It verifies progress using cameras and sensors, then tests the fabricated circuit with an OPAL-RT real-time simulator and an oscilloscope. Based on the measurements, JARVIS diagnoses deviations from the design and generates a revised design in KiCad for subsequent rehearsal. In a demonstration involving a 60 Hz notch filter for grid-connected converter sensing, JARVIS completed a first-run experiment in 2 h 39 min without human intervention, achieving 50.6 dB attenuation at 60 Hz. Its digital-twin rehearsal identified five issues before fabrication, including a test criterion that would have incorrectly rejected a functioning board. During execution, the agent also resolved encountered faults autonomously. These results demonstrate an integrated agent-driven workflow for physical design, fabrication, measurement, and iterative improvement of power-electronic circuitry. To our knowledge, JARVIS is the first system in power electronics in which an agent closes the physical design-build-test-learn loop for circuit boards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JARVIS——一个可在电路板上自主闭合"设计—制造—测试—学习"物理闭环的具身AI智能体，用单条文本指令驱动机械臂、PCB打印与贴片设备完成60 Hz陷波滤波器实验，2小时39分钟内无人干预实现60 Hz处50.6 dB衰减。
AI.motivation: 电力电子是能源转型的核心，但新硬件开发仍高度依赖人工完成设计、制造、测试与迭代，周期长、效率低。作者希望用具身智能体取代这一人工闭环，实现端到端的自主硬件开发。
AI.method: JARVIS 维护机器专属的能力与约束知识；通过机器人搭载的3D扫描仪感知工作空间，构建可执行数字孪生，在消耗材料前预演机器人运动、制造步骤与电路行为。单条文本指令即可启动物理实验；智能体在使用未经改装的桌面设备条件下协调机械臂、沉积导电银墨水与焊膏的PCB打印机、贴片机；用相机与传感器验证进度；用OPAL-RT实时仿真器与示波器测试电路；依据测量结果诊断设计偏差，并在KiCad中生成修订设计以供下一轮预演。
AI.result: 在面向并网变流器采样用的60 Hz陷波滤波器演示中，JARVIS 在2小时39分钟内完成首轮实验且全程无人干预，60 Hz处衰减达50.6 dB。数字孪生预演在制造前发现5个问题，其中包括一条会错误拒收合格板卡的测试判据；执行过程中智能体还自主解决了遇到的故障。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，JARVIS 提供了面向电力电子电路物理设计、制造、测量与迭代改进的一体化智能体驱动工作流，据作者所知是电力电子领域首个由智能体闭合电路板物理"设计—构建—测试—学习"闭环的系统。

title: When Agents Play Differently: Localizing Human--Agent Behavioral Divergence with Conditional Distributional Testing
summary: Evaluating whether artificial agents behave like humans requires comparing not just average outcomes but entire behavioral distributions across diverse contexts. We propose a stratified framework that computes nonparametric discrepancy statistics within contextual cells, and discovers subgroup rules identifying where agent behavior departs from human play. We show that session-level metrics dominated by win/loss outcomes offer little signal beyond mean comparisons, whereas process-level metrics such as move efficiency reveal genuine behavioral differences. Applied to a commercial match-3 game, it uncovers patterns invisible to aggregate metrics: a playtesting bot is diverging substantially from humans in certain game modes, while showing no detectable divergence in others. We release our implementation as open source to support reproducibility and adoption.

AI.tldr: 提出分层非参数框架，在上下文单元格内计算差异统计量并挖掘子群规则，识别智能体与人类行为偏离的具体场景；发现结果层指标信号有限，过程层指标（如走法效率）才揭示真实差异。
AI.motivation: 评估人工智能体是否"像人"不能只看平均结果，而需在多样上下文下比较完整的行为分布；聚合指标可能掩盖局部偏离。
AI.method: 构建分层评估框架：按上下文划分单元格，在单元格内计算非参数差异统计量，并通过子群规则发现定位智能体行为偏离人类的具体条件；对比会话级（胜负结果）与过程级（走法效率）指标的信息量。
AI.result: 会话级指标在均值比较之外几乎无额外信号；过程级指标可检出真实行为差异。应用于商业三消游戏时，发现测试机器人(simulated)在某些游戏模式下与人类显著偏离，而在其他模式下无明显偏离——这些模式在聚合指标下不可见。
AI.conclusion: 行为分布的分层比较优于聚合均值比较，过程级指标与子群规则发现是评估智能体类人性的有效手段；实现已开源以支持可复现与推广。

title: D3-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Dynamic Mode Decomposition
summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images and videos, but every sampling step requires a full network evaluation. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing or forecasting network outputs across steps, but common approaches use per-model calibrated skip criteria or maintain per-layer prediction histories. We present D3-Cache, which applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to Diffusion sampling: it fits DMD to a short history of exact velocities and forecasts only the velocity that the scheduler consumes. A horizon-aware gate decides when to skip: whenever the network is evaluated, its output is compared with the forecast for that step, and the larger the error, the sooner the network is evaluated again, up to a cap on consecutive skipped steps. D3-Cache requires no training or per-model offline calibration curve and adds negligible memory. It shares one history length and risk tolerance across the four evaluated models. On four state-of-the-art image and video models, D3-Cache achieves speedups of 2.6-3.8x with high fidelity to the base model output.

AI.tldr: D3-Cache将动态模态分解（DMD）应用于扩散采样，对精确速度的短历史进行拟合，仅预测调度器所需的速度，并配合"误差越大、下次评估越早"的horizon-aware门控决定跳过时机，实现免训练、免逐模型标定的缓存加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer生成质量高但每个采样步都需完整网络前向，代价昂贵。现有免训练缓存方法依赖逐模型标定的跳过准则或维护逐层预测历史，泛化性与工程成本不佳。
AI.method: D3-Cache对最近若干步的精确速度序列做DMD拟合，仅预测调度器下一步所需的速度（而非全部层输出）。触发重算采用horizon-aware门控：每次真实评估后，将网络输出与该步预测比较，误差越大则下一次评估越早，并设连续跳过步数上限。方法无需训练、无需离线标定曲线，额外显存开销可忽略，四个被评测模型共用同一历史长度与风险容忍度超参数。
AI.result: 在四个SOTA图像与视频模型上取得2.6–3.8倍加速，且输出与基础模型高度保真。
AI.conclusion: 用DMD对速度轨迹做时序预测并结合误差自适应门控，是无需校准、超参共享、低开销的通用扩散采样加速方案，在图像和视频任务上兼顾了加速比与保真度。

title: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models via Shadow Posterior Matching
summary: Few-step diffusion models are widely deployed for their efficiency. However, reinforcing them with black-box rewards, as is routine for multi-step models, faces two structural challenges. First, a few-step generator is a sampler rather than a score model, so its velocity is not the forward velocity of the generated distribution. Second, it must be anchored to the undistilled teacher, which shares no transitions with it. Existing few-step RL methods handle the latter with a marginal KL to the teacher, but each pays for the former in its reward credit. We propose Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM), which renoises generated samples into shadow inputs and obtains the credit from their shadow posterior. From the KL-regularized reward objective, we derive a regression loss that turns reward values into a reward direction while anchoring the generator's outputs to the teacher and aligning the shadow inputs with the deployed inputs. Applied to 4-step generators, SPM achieves higher rewards with less reward hacking than prior few-step RL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM)：将生成的样本重新加噪为"影子输入"，从影子后验中获取奖励信用，从而在少步扩散生成器上实现黑盒奖励强化，同时保持与未蒸馏teacher的锚定。
AI.motivation: 少步扩散模型因高效而被广泛部署，但用黑盒奖励对其进行强化存在两个结构性难题：(1) 少步生成器是采样器而非score model，其velocity并非生成分布的前向velocity；(2) 必须锚定到与其不共享转移的未蒸馏teacher。现有少步RL方法用对teacher的边缘KL处理后一问题，但都在奖励信用分配上为前一问题付出代价。
AI.method: SPM将生成样本重新加噪得到影子输入，并从影子后验中计算信用（credit）。从KL正则化的奖励目标出发，推导出一个回归损失：把奖励值转化为奖励方向，同时将生成器输出锚定到teacher，并使影子输入与部署时的输入对齐。
AI.result: 在4步生成器上，SPM相比先前的少步RL方法取得了更高奖励，且奖励黑客现象更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过影子后验匹配，SPM在不依赖前向velocity与共享转移的前提下，统一解决了少步扩散模型黑盒奖励强化中的信用分配与teacher锚定问题，在效率与对齐质量上优于现有少步RL方法。

title: ACE-Brain-0.7: Learning Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Embodied Agents
summary: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.

AI.tldr: 提出9B视觉语言模型ACE-Brain-0.7，融合空间grounding、任务理解与进度估计，在六项任务推理基准上平均76.5分，超过对比的闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 长时程具身任务需要基于观测到的执行状态进行可靠推理，而现有模型缺乏将空间感知与执行进度关联起来的能力，需要能结合任务级判断与观测进度/结果的统一模型。
AI.method: 构建370万问答对，从自我中心人类视频、机器人episode与仿真中提取执行监督，问题覆盖执行的不同阶段；在Qwen3.5-9B上结合任务、空间grounding与进度估计数据进行微调。
AI.result: 六项公开任务推理基准平均76.5，高于GPT-6 Astra（72.7）与Claude Opus 5.5（73.5）；空间grounding七项基准平均75.90，RefCOCOg上Acc@0.5达91.25；消融显示任务-only模型更有效利用视觉历史并更准确区分执行状态。
AI.conclusion: ACE-Brain-0.7有效结合空间感知与时间理解，实现执行grounded推理，性能可与闭源模型媲美。

title: ForeSeek: Foresight-Driven Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Long-form video understanding, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based video agents. However, the retrieval-driven nature inherent to these agents creates a significant bottleneck, forcing them to reactively fetch clips based on local saliency without a global temporal plan. To address this, we present ForeSeek, a foresight-driven video agent that transforms long-video reasoning from reactive retrieval into predictive exploration. Rather than blindly probing the timeline, ForeSeek forms visually grounded expectations over unseen temporal regions, verifies them through targeted observations, and continuously refines its search based on emerging evidence, where failed expectations serve as informative signals for principled backtracking. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training framework that equips MLLMs with foresight-guided reasoning and efficient decision making. Extensive experiments on five long-video benchmarks demonstrate that ForeSeek consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off of long-video reasoning, achieving competitive or superior accuracy while observing $2.5$--$4.4\times$ fewer frames than the strongest search-based agent. Code is available at https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek

AI.tldr: ForeSeek：把基于 MLLM 的长视频智能体从"反应式检索"转为"预测式探索"，通过形成对未观测时间区域的视觉锚定预期并验证/修正，配合两阶段训练，在五个长视频基准上以少 2.5–4.4 倍帧数取得相当或更优精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大模型的视频智能体本质上是检索驱动：只能依据局部显著性被动拉取片段，缺乏全局时间规划，导致长视频理解在效率与精度上形成瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出前瞻驱动的视频智能体 ForeSeek：不在时间轴上盲目试探，而是对未观测时间区域构建视觉锚定的预期（visually grounded expectations），通过定向观测验证预期，并依据新证据持续修正搜索；预期失败被作为可解释的回溯信号。同时设计两阶段训练框架，使 MLLM 获得前瞻引导推理与高效决策能力。
AI.result: 在五个长视频基准上，ForeSeek 稳定改善效率—精度权衡：相较最强的搜索式智能体，观测帧数减少 2.5–4.4 倍，同时取得相当或更优的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将长视频推理由被动检索转变为基于前瞻预期的主动探索，是提升 MLLM 视频智能体效率—精度权衡的有效范式。

title: LIFT: Lifting Language-Controlled Image Fusion to Free-Viewpoint 3D Scenes
summary: Multimodal image fusion traditionally generates a single fused image from paired observations at a specific viewpoint, limiting comprehensive scene perception and adaptability to diverse perceptual objectives. To overcome these limitations, we present LIFT, a novel framework for our proposed language-controlled 3D image fusion (L3D-IF) paradigm that extends multimodal image fusion from 2D images to free-viewpoint 3D scenes, enabling language-guided fusion tailored to diverse perceptual objectives. First, LIFT formulates Semantic Modality Binding (SMB), which interprets language instructions to identify semantic targets and their associated modality preferences and grounds these targets in corresponding regions of a shared Gaussian scene, establishing persistent semantic-to-spatial correspondences for consistent fusion control across viewpoints. Second, Language-Conditioned Gaussian Appearance (LCGA) is developed to achieve scene-wide multimodal appearance modeling by combining adaptive multimodal blending with language- and viewpoint-conditioned appearance refinement, enabling spatially adaptive realization of diverse fusion appearances while preserving source fidelity at pure-modality endpoints. Finally, we construct a Multi-View Language-Supervision (MVLS) dataset that associates language instructions and calibrated viewpoints with modulated fused images, providing effective supervision for learning instruction-dependent fusion from finite multi-view observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIFT achieves coherent multimodal fusion across continuous viewpoints, accurate semantic target localization, and consistent regional fusion control under diverse language instructions.

AI.tldr: LIFT提出语言控制的3D图像融合（L3D-IF）新范式，将多模态图像融合从2D扩展到自由视角3D场景，实现语言引导、可按需定制融合目标的高斯场景融合。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态图像融合只能在特定视角下由配对观测生成单张融合图像，难以覆盖完整场景感知，也无法适配多样化的感知目标。作者因此希望把融合从2D图像推广到自由视角3D场景，并用语言指令控制融合目标。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：（1）语义模态绑定SMB：解析语言指令识别语义目标及其模态偏好，并将目标定位到共享高斯场景的对应区域，建立跨视角一致的“语义—空间”对应关系；（2）语言条件高斯外观LCGA：结合自适应多模态混合与语言、视角条件的外观细化，实现全场景多模态外观建模，支持空间自适应融合，并在纯模态端点保持源保真；（3）构建多视角语言监督数据集MVLS，将语言指令与标定视角和调制后的融合图像关联，为从有限多视角观测学习指令相关融合提供监督。
AI.result: 实验表明LIFT可在连续视角上实现连贯的多模态融合，语义目标定位准确，并在多种语言指令下保持一致的区域化融合控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了L3D-IF范式，证明语言条件高斯表示可有效支撑自由视角、语义可控的多模态融合。

title: Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model
summary: Global Workspace Theory (GWT), a leading theory of consciousness, holds that information becomes conscious when it is broadcast to specialized processes that use it. Building a workspace into a network does not reveal what the trained network computes with it: a module that reports an answer may have combined a broadcast message with its own knowledge, or merely forwarded an answer computed elsewhere, and task accuracy and ablation cannot tell these apart. We introduce a causal protocol that identifies who computes when modules communicate. Its central test transplants a message from another input, chosen so that ignoring, relaying and recombining it predict three different answers. On networks built to relay or to recombine, the test assigns the right computation in every case. Among trained workspace models it finds all three outcomes: one leaves its broadcast nearly unused, and of two models that differ only in their training data, one relays and the other recombines. In AFGW, a language model whose modules communicate only through a learned workspace, a transplanted message yields the answer that recombination predicts in 97% of cases, and its content acts by redirecting what the receiver retrieves from its own memory. The tests carry over to other communication designs and to a known interface of a pretrained Transformer, turning GWT's central claim into a testable property of trained models.

AI.tldr: 提出因果协议，通过"消息移植"测试判定模块通信时是忽略、转发还是重组信息，从而检验全局工作空间理论的可测试性。
AI.motivation: 全局工作空间理论（GWT）认为信息被广播到专用进程即成为意识内容，但把工作空间嵌入网络后无法揭示训练好的网络实际用它计算什么：报告答案的模块可能将广播消息与自身知识结合，也可能仅转发别处算出的答案，而任务准确率与消融实验无法区分这些情形。
AI.method: 引入一个识别"谁在计算"的因果协议。核心测试是从另一输入移植一条消息，并精心选择该消息，使得"忽略、转发、重组"三种假设分别预测三种不同答案；在专门构建为转发或重组的网络上验证该测试的判别力。
AI.result: 在转发型与重组型网络上，测试对每种情形都能正确判定计算类型。在训练好的工作空间模型中观察到全部三种结果：一个模型几乎不使用其广播；两个仅训练数据不同的模型中，一个转发、另一个重组。在AFGW（模块仅通过学习到的工作空间通信的语言模型）中，移植消息在97%的情况下给出重组预测的答案，且其内容通过重定向接收方从自身记忆中检索的内容而起作用。
AI.conclusion: 该测试可迁移至其他通信设计以及预训练Transformer的已知接口，将GWT的核心主张转化为可对训练模型检验的属性。

title: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PhyDEX——一个面向"动态外在灵巧性"的抛掷基准，要求机器人推断物体质量、质心与摩擦，将物体抛至运动学可达范围之外的目的地；含35K轨迹（143小时）、9任务、100场景。评测GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA、ForceVLA三种VLA，成功率均低于3%，并指出预训练鲁棒性不足与"物理盲"两大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA基准主要评估夹爪与物体的接触式操作，忽略了重力、摩擦、惯性、质量分布等物理因素对物体与环境交互的影响，因而无法判断当前策略是真正理解物理，还是仅对训练数据做插值。作者以动态外在灵巧性为切入点，用抛掷任务弥补这一评测空白。
AI.method: 构建PhyDEX抛掷基准：机器人在运动学工作空间之外投送物体，需推断质量、质心与摩擦。数据由全自动可扩展流水线生成，结合抓取生成、运动规划与随机物理属性下的闭环抛掷优化。任务覆盖均匀、不规则与动态质量物体，目的地包括静态、多目标与移动目标。评测三个代表性VLA模型：GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA、ForceVLA，并进行消融与真实/人形机器人验证。
AI.result: 三个VLA模型成功率均低于3%。分析发现两大瓶颈：(1) 预训练模型鲁棒性有限，多数失败发生在抛掷动作之前；(2) "物理盲"，即提供真值物理属性后成功率约翻倍。在人形机器人与真实世界实验中观察到相同的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLA在需要物理推理的动态抛掷任务上表现极差，说明其更多依赖数据插值而非物理理解。PhyDEX可作为推动物理 grounded 机器人策略发展的评测平台。

title: Serialization Tax in Shared-Latent Exchangeable Decisions
summary: Accurate item probabilities can produce inaccurate group-level decisions. A system may score each item separately, yet act on whether enough hidden items succeed: show a slate, defer a panel decision, or inspect a batch. When items share an uncertain latent state, independent marginalization preserves means but removes dependence from the aggregate posterior. We call this error the serialization tax. For binary items sharing one success rate, classical convex-order comparisons give a more dispersed exact count law than any independent completion with the same total mean. We quantify variance and total-variation gaps, derive threshold separation under margin conditions, and connect posterior approximation to decision regret. Separate results cover non-binary outcomes, heterogeneous items, and sufficient posterior resolution. TaxScore identifies large hidden blocks with unresolved uncertainty near a decision boundary for routing to richer posterior heads. On pre-specified, hidden-target-free MovieLens 1M/10M audits, existing shared-latent heads improve high-score negative log-likelihood (NLL)/utility from 0.673/0.696 to 0.629/0.723 and from 0.670/0.691 to 0.639/0.715. Routing gives 0.006--0.012 full-population utility gains, with matched controls identifying their sources. Our code is available at https://github.com/SiminChang/Serialization-Tax-in-Shared-Latent-Exchangeable-Decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"序列化税"(serialization tax)这一误差：当多个条目共享不确定的潜在状态时，独立边缘化会保留均值但丢失聚合后验中的相关性，导致组级决策失准。作者用凸序比较量化其方差与全变差差距，推导阈值分离与决策后悔的联系，并提出TaxScore用于路由到更强的后验头，在MovieLens 1M/10M审计上验证了NLL与效用改进。
AI.motivation: 系统常对每个条目单独打分，但最终决策取决于"隐藏在条目中有多少成功"（如展示一个列表、推迟小组决定、检查一批物品）。这种聚合决策依赖条目间的相关性；而常见的独立边缘化尽管保持逐项均值不变，却抹去了聚合后验的依赖结构，造成组级决策偏差。
AI.method: 对二值条目共享单一成功率的设定，利用经典凸序(convex order)比较，证明精确计数分布比任何同均值的独立完成更分散；量化方差差距与全变差差距，在边际条件下推导阈值分离，并将后验近似误差与决策后悔相联系；另给出非二值结果、异质条目与充分后验分辨率的推广结果；提出TaxScore，用于识别决策边界附近具有未解不确定性的隐藏块，从而路由到更丰富的后验头。
AI.result: 在预先设定、无隐藏目标的MovieLens 1M/10M审计中，现有共享潜在头将高分负样本NLL/效用从0.673/0.696提升至0.629/0.723，从0.670/0.691提升至0.639/0.715；路由带来0.006–0.012的全人群效用增益，匹配对照实验确认了增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 独立边缘化在共享潜在状态下会系统性引入组级决策误差，该"序列化税"可通过凸序理论刻画并在实践中被量化与缓解；TaxScore提供了一种低成本的诊断与路由机制，实验证明共享潜在头与路由策略能显著改善概率校准与决策效用。

title: Slide2PPT: Native PowerPoint Reconstruction with Localization-Guided Refinement
summary: Image-to-slide reconstruction must recover both visual appearance and native object structure for subsequent editing. Yet visually faithful charts and tables may lack editable series and cells, and direct code generation couples content prediction to rendering implementation. We present Slide2PPT, a model-agnostic, training-free framework that equips both open- and closed-source vision-language models with native PowerPoint reconstruction capabilities. Through a unified typed interface, the model predicts object records while a fixed renderer materializes their native properties, enabling integration with different backbones without task-specific training or architectural changes. Localization-guided refinement then connects visual discrepancies to object records for correction. Regional updates preserve unselected records, while whole-slide updates address cross-region relationships. Record refinement and targeted object editing support structural and attribute-level changes, with rendered feedback governing iterative acceptance. To evaluate this framework across diverse reconstruction demands, we introduce Slide2PPT-Bench, covering controlled elements, real slides, and scientific figures. Evaluation separately measures file production, rendered agreement, and native-object availability. Experiments across open- and closed-source backbones demonstrate substantially more reliable PPTX generation than direct code generation, improved layout and text recovery on scientific figures, and native chart and table interfaces beyond geometric primitives.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、模型无关的Slide2PPT框架，通过统一类型化接口让视觉语言模型以"对象记录+固定渲染器"方式原生重建PowerPoint，并构建Slide2PPT-Bench进行分项评测。
AI.motivation: 图像到幻灯片重建需同时恢复视觉外观与原生对象结构以供后续编辑。但视觉上逼真的图表/表格可能缺乏可编辑的系列与单元格；直接代码生成则将内容预测与渲染实现耦合，导致可编辑性与泛化性不足。
AI.method: 1) 统一类型化接口：模型仅预测对象记录，由固定渲染器实例化其原生属性，从而适配开源/闭源骨干而无需任务特定训练或架构改动；2) 定位引导的细化：将视觉差异映射到对象记录进行修正；3) 区域更新保留未选中记录，整页更新处理跨区域关系；4) 记录细化与目标对象编辑支持结构与属性级修改，并以渲染反馈驱动迭代接受。
AI.result: 在开源与闭源骨干上的实验显示：PPTX生成可靠性显著优于直接代码生成；科学图形上的布局与文本恢复提升；并可提供超出几何基元的原生图表与表格接口。构建的Slide2PPT-Bench覆盖受控元素、真实幻灯片与科学图形，分别评测文件生成、渲染一致性、原生对象可用性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦"内容预测"与"渲染实现"是提升幻灯片原生可编辑重建的有效路径；免训练的模型无关框架可跨骨干泛化，且分项评测（文件生成/渲染一致/原生对象）比单一视觉相似度更能反映重建质量。

title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
comment: 15 pages (12 pages main text + references), 12 figures, 4 tables
summary:
Hybrid language models combine self-attention with recurrent layers whose in-place state updates restrict prefix reuse to exact saved positions. Saving states on a coarse grid wastes reusable prefixes, whereas existing fine-grained exact caches must cut the prefill forward pass at each mid-prompt checkpoint, adding scheduler steps that outweigh the reuse gains under load.
  We observe that across multi-turn chat, agent loops, document question answering, and tree search, prefix reuse almost always ends at structural boundaries predictable in advance, such as turn ends and known branch points. We present FrontierReplay, a prefix caching system that materializes exact checkpoints at these boundaries without cutting the prefill. While the forward pass runs uncut, FrontierReplay logs a short window of recurrent-layer inputs and invokes a cross-layer, state-only replay kernel to build the target state 6-37x cheaper per token than full recomputation without host synchronization. A frontier-aware retention policy prioritizes active anchors and proven branches while lending dead checkpoint slots to the attention KV cache.
  Across diverse hybrid architectures, model scales, and workloads, FrontierReplay delivers clear gains over existing exact caches, lowering median time to first token (TTFT) by 16-89% (up to 8.9x), raising 80% service-level objective (SLO) capacity by up to 1.73x, and improving goodput by up to 4.26x (3.67x at larger scales). Compared with approximate replay methods, FrontierReplay delivers up to 1.54x higher goodput while preserving exact task accuracy, avoiding the up to 17% accuracy drop suffered by approximation on long contexts.

AI.tldr: FrontierReplay 是一个面向混合架构（自注意力+循环层）的前缀缓存系统，在可预测的结构边界（轮次结束、分支点）物化精确检查点而不切断 prefill 前向，通过跨层、仅状态的重放内核重建循环状态，显著降低 TTFT、提升容量与 goodput，同时保持精确精度。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型中的循环层采用原地状态更新，使前缀复用只能限定在确切保存的位置上。粗粒度网格保存状态会浪费可复用前缀；细粒度精确缓存则必须在每个提示中间的检查点处切断 prefill 前向，增加的调度步骤在高负载下超过复用收益。因此需要一种既不牺牲复用粒度、又不切割前向计算的精确缓存方案。
AI.method: 作者观察到在多轮对话、智能体循环、文档问答与树搜索中，前缀复用几乎总在可预先预测的结构边界处结束（如轮次末尾、已知分支点）。据此提出 FrontierReplay：在前向不切割的情况下，于这些边界处记录一小段循环层输入窗口，并调用跨层、仅状态的 replay 内核来构建目标状态；该内核每 token 比完整重计算便宜 6–37 倍且无需主机同步。此外设计了 frontier 感知的保留策略，优先保留活跃锚点与已验证分支，并将失效检查点槽位借给注意力 KV 缓存。
AI.result: 在多种混合架构、模型规模与负载下，相较现有精确缓存：中位 TTFT 降低 16–89%（最高 8.9×），80% SLO 容量提升最高 1.73×，goodput 提升最高 4.26×（更大规模下 3.67×）。相较近似重放方法，goodput 最高高 1.54×，同时保持精确任务精度，避免了近似方法在长上下文上最高 17% 的精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 利用可预测的结构边界进行精确检查点物化、配合低成本跨层状态重放内核，可在不切割 prefill 的前提下实现细粒度前缀复用；FrontierReplay 在延迟、容量与吞吐上全面优于现有精确缓存与近似方法，且不损失精度。

title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

AI.tldr: PGX框架将长时程移动操作任务的时间与精度控制卸载给两个免训练经典组件（谓词状态机 + 世界坐标锁定），使VLA模型专注于阶段级技能动态，在3个仿真任务和Unitree G1真机任务上提升阶段推进与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能执行多样的单一操作技能，但在长时程移动操作（loco-manipulation）任务中仍表现不佳，原因是时序结构、技能与精度被紧耦合在单一单体模型中。
AI.method: 提出Physically Grounded Execution（PGX），将长时程任务分解为三层：(i) 基于谓词的状态机负责任务推进，用物理谓词门控阶段转换、触发恢复、协调导航与等待，共享谓词语义统一了离线示教分段、在线执行与阶段级评估；(ii) VLA技能仅在主动操作阶段内运行，采用平坦或分阶段训练的模型专注任务相关动作；(iii) 世界坐标锁定（WCL）通过基座站位保持、物体相对定位与世界锚定接触目标维持空间一致性。
AI.result: 在三个仿真任务与一个基于Unitree G1人形机器人的真实长时程移动操作任务上进行了大量实验，阶段推进效果与任务成功率均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将时序与精度控制外置给免训练的经典模块、保留VLA作为阶段级技能策略，PGX可有效解耦长时程移动操作中的耦合问题，是一种无需额外训练即可提升VLA长时程能力的模块化执行框架。

title: SEOYUN: Refusal-Inducing Exam Documents for AI-Glasses Pipelines
comment: 10 pages; research framework and analytical limits; no empirical efficacy results. Includes an author reflection in Korean in Appendix C
summary: Camera-equipped glasses can convert an examination page into a query to a vision-language model (VLM). Device detection addresses possession; a complementary question is whether an examination document can reduce the usefulness of an unauthorized capture. We present SEOYUN, an application-specific framework for refusal-inducing exam documents, with optical and encoder-level interventions as extensions. We use reverse jailbreaking to describe the direction of the objective: inducing abstention rather than bypassing refusal. Refusal induction and defensive visual prompt injection already have precedents; our contribution is a threat model, analytical limits, and an evaluation protocol for examination use. We distinguish refusal from correct-answer leakage, show why removing an added dummy option is not itself a reduction in the original answer space, and derive a sampling comparison under explicitly stated camera assumptions. The protocol separates digital, simulated, and physical inputs and requires held-out evaluation after subject-specific selection. A local CSAT candidate corpus and rendering harness have been prepared, but this version reports no model-performance measurements, physical validation, or human-subject results. Accordingly, SEOYUN is a research framework, not a validated defense or a basis for allegations against individuals.

AI.tldr: 提出SEOYUN框架：通过在试卷文档中嵌入光学与编码器级干预，诱导视觉语言模型对非授权拍摄的考卷查询产生“拒绝作答/弃答”，并给出威胁模型、分析边界与三阶段（数字/仿真/物理）评估协议；当前版本尚无模型性能、物理验证与人体实验数据。
AI.motivation: 带摄像头眼镜可将试卷直接变为VLM查询。既有“设备检测”只解决持有问题，无法应对拍摄后求助模型；作者关注互补问题——能否让被拍摄的试卷文档本身降低非授权抓取的可用性。同时指出“拒绝诱导”与“防御性视觉提示注入”已有先例，本文动机在于为考试场景建立威胁模型、分析极限与评测协议。
AI.method: 1) 提出“反向越狱（reverse jailbreaking）”概念以刻画目标方向：诱导模型弃答而非绕过其拒绝机制；2) 面向考试的专用框架SEOYUN，以文档层面干预为主，光学干预与编码器级干预作为扩展；3) 明确区分“模型拒绝作答”与“正确答案泄露”，并论证删除新增的干扰选项本身并不缩小原始答案空间；4) 在显式声明的相机假设下推导采样比较；5) 设计评估协议：分离数字输入、仿真输入与物理输入，要求按学科筛选后使用留出集评估；6) 已构建本地CSAT候选语料与渲染装置。
AI.result: 本版本为框架性/协议性报告，未报告任何模型性能测量、物理环境验证或人体被试结果；因此尚不能证明干预的有效性。理论层面的产出为威胁模型、分析性边界（含采样比较与答案空间论证）以及可复现的评测协议与实验准备（语料+渲染工具链）。
AI.conclusion: SEOYUN定位为研究框架，而非已验证的防御方案，也不能作为针对个人指控的依据；其价值在于为“拒绝诱导型考卷”确立概念、边界与评测规范，后续需补齐数字、仿真与物理三层的性能与有效性证据。

title: Calibrate in Context: Efficient Data-Free Quantization from Small Synthetic Pools
comment: 21 pages, 5 main figures. Supplementary material included
summary: We enable accurate low-bit recovery from small synthetic pools by improving both image synthesis and student preparation. A grid with lower local response error can incur greater error in the student's block context. Functional Grid Calibration (FGC) selects activation scales and integer offsets against full-precision responses constructed from the student's current block input. With weights fixed during calibration, FGC evaluates candidates only at their consuming operators, bringing block context to calibration at nearly local-scoring cost. For DeiT and ViT, progressive inversion updates the same images through increasingly deep teacher prefixes. With 1,000 images, the complete pipeline exceeds MimiQ's reported accuracy in all 18 W4A4/W5A5 settings across nine backbones. With 256 images, DeiT-S and ViT-S reach 68.20% and 66.90% ImageNet top-1 accuracy at W4A4 in 26-27 minutes on one RTX 5090. The pipeline outperforms strengthened 1K-image MimiQ by 13.03 and 24.36 percentage points at lower preparation cost and the same recovery-update count. The same low-budget checkpoints retain their advantage on ImageNetV2.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套改进“合成数据池 + 学生网络准备”的低比特恢复流程：功能网格校准（FGC）在块上下文下选择激活尺度与整数偏移，渐进反演（progressive inversion）用递增深度的教师前缀更新同一批图像；仅用256/1000张图像即可在W4A4/W5A5下超越MimiQ。
AI.motivation: 在极小合成图像池下实现精确的低比特（W4A4/W5A5）量化恢复，需同时改进图像合成质量与学生网络的量化准备；已有观察表明，局部响应误差更低的网格配置反而可能在学生网络的块级上下文中产生更大误差，说明局部最优的校准目标与真实块级目标不一致。
AI.method: 1) 功能网格校准（FGC）：以由学生当前块输入构造的全精度响应为参照，联合选择激活尺度与整数偏移；校准期间固定权重，仅在消耗算子处评估候选，从而以接近局部打分的代价把块上下文引入校准。2) 渐进反演：针对DeiT与ViT，用逐渐加深的教师前缀对同一批图像进行迭代更新，使合成图像与深层网络特征对齐。
AI.result: 在1,000张图像下，完整流程在九个骨干网络的全部18个W4A4/W5A5设置中均超过MimiQ报告的精度；在256张图像下，DeiT-S与ViT-S在W4A4下取得68.20%/66.90%的ImageNet top-1，单张RTX 5090仅需26–27分钟；相比强化的1K图像MimiQ在更低准备成本、相同恢复更新次数下分别领先13.03与24.36个百分点；低预算检查点在ImageNetV2上保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 将块级上下文纳入激活校准、并用渐进式教师前缀反演提升小规模合成池的信息量，可在极低数据与算力预算下实现高精度低比特量化；该方案在多种骨干、位宽设置及分布偏移（ImageNetV2）下均稳定优于强基线。

title: The Delayed Societal Cost of Unfairness
summary: Fair machine learning typically evaluates the societal costs of a decision policy -- the loss incurred by the decision-maker (DM) and the unfair distribution of costs among demographic groups of decision-subjects (DS) -- on static data, where reducing one often comes at the expense of the other. Yet decisions change the populations on which they act, and prior work has shown that fairness interventions designed on static data may fail to benefit, or even harm, the disadvantaged group over time. We investigate a complementary question: When can a policy that is Pareto-optimal on pre-deployment data be outperformed by a fairer policy once each is evaluated on the population it induces, reducing costs for one stakeholder without increasing them for the other? In a setting where qualification scores evolve in response to binary decisions and their outcomes, we show that under Rawlsian fairness, which never lowers any group's acceptance rate, placing sufficiently high weight on fairness reduces societal costs whenever accepting disadvantaged DS at the DM's break-even point leaves them in a state less costly to the DM than rejecting them. Under egalitarian fairness, which may lower the advantaged group's acceptance rate, this additionally requires the reduction in DM loss on the disadvantaged group to outweigh the increase on the advantaged group. Under both fairness notions, however, when DM loss is accuracy-based, improvements in the post-deployment population may arise from declining DS qualification, revealing that gains for the DM do not necessarily translate into better outcomes for DS. Our results show that policy-induced population dynamics can overturn apparent performance-fairness trade-offs, allowing fairer policies to reduce the delayed societal costs of decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在决策会改变受决策人群分布的动态场景下，静态数据上看似Pareto最优的策略，是否会被更公平的策略在各自诱导的后部署人群上反超。结论是在Rawlsian与egalitarian公平下，当满足特定条件时，给公平足够高权重可同时降低决策者与弱势群体成本；但当损失为准确率型时，决策者收益可能来自受试者资格下滑。
AI.motivation: 既有公平机器学习多在静态数据上权衡决策者损失与群体间成本分配，而决策会改变其所作用的人群，静态设计的公平干预随时间可能无益甚至伤害弱势群体。作者因此追问：一个部署前Pareto最优的策略，其成本在部署后是否可能被更公平的策略所超越——即在两个利益相关方之间实现Pareto改进。
AI.method: 设定资格分数随二元决策及其结果内生演化，比较在部署前数据上Pareto最优的策略与更公平策略在各自诱导的后部署人群上的延迟社会成本。考虑两类公平准则：Rawlsian（不降低任何群体的接受率）与egalitarian（可能降低优势群体接受率），并区分决策者损失的函数形式（含准确率型损失）。
AI.result: Rawlsian公平下，只要在决策者盈亏平衡点接收弱势受试者使其后续状态比拒绝时对决策者成本更低，给公平足够高权重即可降低社会总成本。Egalitarian公平还需额外条件：弱势群体上决策者损失的下降超过优势群体上的上升。但在两种公平准则下，当决策者损失为准确率型时，部署后的改善可能源于受试者资格分数的下降——决策者收益并不必然转化为受试者的更好结果。
AI.conclusion: 策略诱导的人群动态可以逆转表面上的性能—公平权衡，使更公平的策略降低决策的延迟社会成本。但对公平收益的评估须警惕：以决策者为中心的成本指标改善，未必代表受试者福利改善。

title: A Tutorial on Complementarity-Based Contact Models for Robotics
summary: Simulating rigid-body dynamics with contact is fundamental to robotics, from motion synthesis and control to mechanism design. Many widely used simulators rely on cone complementarity formulations, whose physical assumptions and numerical solution require substantial background. While excellent surveys, monographs, and course notes exist, they mostly address computational mechanics or computer graphics or document a single simulator. To the best of our knowledge, a self-contained pedagogical treatment for robotics, bringing these formulations and their solvers together with complete derivations and a unified notation, does not yet exist. This tutorial addresses this gap by connecting rigid-body dynamics, conic optimization, and frictional contact. In particular, we explain how complementarity conditions encode non-penetration and frictional dissipation, determining separation, sticking, and sliding without prescribed contact modes. We distinguish equivalent transcriptions from convex relaxations, showing how the latter can introduce artifacts such as lift-off and creep. We examine the existence and uniqueness of motion and contact forces, including the solver's role in selecting among multiple solutions. We then compare first-order and Newton-based methods, explain regularization and proximal strategies, and discuss trade-offs between computational cost, robustness, and physical fidelity. Connections to widely used simulators, optimal control, and differentiable simulation help readers interpret simulation results, choose suitable formulations and solvers, and develop their own contact dynamics routines.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇面向机器人学的刚性体接触动力学教程，统一推导锥互补（CCP）形式的接触建模与求解器，区分等价改写与凸松弛导致的伪影，并讨论解的存在唯一性、求解器选择及与其他领域的联系。
AI.motivation: 接触刚体仿真在机器人运动合成、控制与机构设计中不可或缺，主流仿真器多依赖锥互补形式，但其物理假设与数值求解门槛较高。现有综述、专著与讲义多侧重于计算力学或计算机图形学，或只针对单一仿真器，缺乏面向机器人学、完整推导、统一符号的自洽教学材料。
AI.method: 以互补条件编码非穿透与摩擦耗散，说明分离、粘着、滑移三类接触模式如何无需预设而自然确定；系统区分等价形式改写与凸松弛，并分析后者引入的抬升（lift-off）与蠕变（creep）伪影；讨论运动与接触力的存在性与唯一性，以及求解器在多重解间的选择作用；比较一阶方法与牛顿类方法、正则化与近端策略，并剖析计算代价、鲁棒性与物理保真度之间的权衡。
AI.result: 给出刚性体动力学、锥优化与摩擦接触的统一表述框架，阐明不同建模形式与求解算法在数值行为与物理真实性上的差异，并建立与常用仿真器、最优控制和可微仿真的对照关系。
AI.conclusion: 该教程填补了机器人学领域缺少自洽接触动力学教学资料的空白，可帮助读者正确解读仿真结果、选择合适的建模形式与求解器，并自行实现接触动力学程序。

title: Studying AI Act Mentions: A first look at the impact of the European Union's AI regulation on Hugging Face
summary: The European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) entered into force in August 2024, and its obligations apply in stages. Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models have applied since August 2025, and transparency rules since August 2026. These obligations affect developers who share and deploy models and applications on public platforms such as Hugging Face (HF), the largest platform for distributing AI artifacts. However, little is known about how practitioners respond to the regulation in practice. To address this gap, we conducted an empirical study of explicit references to the AI Act on HF. We collected over five million records, including repository cards, discussions, and commits from Models, Datasets, and Spaces, and identified over 1,500 records that explicitly mention the Act. Two coders manually labeled these records using a primarily closed coding approach, and we analyzed the resulting categories per source. We find that explicit references to the AI Act remain rare across all repository types. Repository cards mainly contain claims of compliance and responsibility, like ensuring compliance or assigning responsibility to downstream users, and some claim that the Act does not apply because the model is not a general-purpose AI model. Discussions are used to report alleged violations of the Act, while commits mainly update artifacts that support compliance. Overall, compliance statements focus on who is responsible rather than how compliance is achieved. We believe that this calls for direct platform support, e.g., automated checks and documentation templates, as well as clearer guidance on the scope of the AI Act.

AI.tldr: 通过对 Hugging Face 上超五百万条记录进行实证分析，发现对《欧盟人工智能法案》的显式引用仍然稀少（仅约1,500条），且合规声明多聚焦"责任归属"而非"如何合规"。
AI.motivation: 《欧盟人工智能法案》(AI Act) 于2024年8月生效并分阶段适用，其义务直接影响在 Hugging Face 等公共平台上共享和部署模型的开发者。然而，实践者如何回应这些监管要求仍缺乏了解，本文旨在填补这一实证空白。
AI.method: 收集 HF 上 Models、Datasets、Spaces 的仓库卡片、讨论与提交记录共超五百万条，筛选出1,500余条显式提及 AI Act 的记录；由两名编码者采用以封闭式为主的编码方法进行人工标注，并按来源分别分析各类别。
AI.result: 显式引用在所有仓库类型中均较为罕见。仓库卡片主要包含合规声明与责任声明（如确保合规或将责任转移给下游用户），部分声称因模型非通用目的AI模型而不适用该法案；讨论区多用于举报涉嫌违规行为；提交记录主要用于更新支持合规的工件。总体而言，合规表述集中于"谁负责"而非"如何实现合规"。
AI.conclusion: 现有实践反映平台层面支持不足，研究建议提供自动化检查与文档模板等直接平台支持，并出台更清晰的 AI Act 适用范围指南。

title: SkillLens: Action-Guided Dense Visual Dynamics for Proficiency Estimation
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, Project page: https://skill-lens.net/
summary: Human proficiency estimation is challenging because skill is a high-level and often subjective property that is not captured by action identity alone. Existing approaches leverage multimodal observations such as ego-exo video, gaze, pose, and inertial signals, but the gap between sensor-level evidence and abstract proficiency labels remains difficult to bridge. We present SkillLens, a proficiency estimation framework that uses atomic action descriptions as temporal guidance, rather than direct semantic supervision, to localize proficiency-relevant windows for dense visual-dynamics extraction. Each window is summarized into an action-dynamics feature and scored by a high-low prototype margin against higher- and lower-proficiency executions from the same activity-action category. Fusing these ego/exo PDM cues with a global ego-exo-gaze baseline through CORAL ordinal calibration, our method achieves 0.542 accuracy on Ego-Exo4D. Our project page is available at https://skill-lens.net/

AI.tldr: SkillLens 提出以原子动作描述作为时序引导（而非直接语义监督）来定位与熟练度相关的窗口，提取密集视觉动态特征，并用同活动-动作类内的高低熟练度原型间隔打分，最后经 CORAL 序数校准融合 ego/exo PDM 线索，在 Ego-Exo4D 上取得 0.542 准确率。
AI.motivation: 熟练度是高层且主观的属性，仅凭动作类别无法刻画；现有方法虽利用自我中心/外中心视频、注视、姿态与惯性等多模态观测，但传感器级证据与抽象熟练度标签之间仍存在难以跨越的语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 使用原子动作描述作为时序引导，定位熟练度相关的时间窗口；2) 对每个窗口提取密集视觉动态并汇总为动作-动态特征（PDM）；3) 以同一活动-动作类别内高、低熟练度执行作为原型，用高低原型间隔对特征打分；4) 通过 CORAL 序数校准将 ego/exo PDM 线索与全局 ego-exo-gaze 基线融合。
AI.result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上达到 0.542 的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以原子动作描述作为时序引导而非语义监督，可有效桥接传感器证据与抽象熟练度标签；结合原型间隔打分与序数校准的多模态融合，为细粒度人类熟练度估计提供了可行框架。

title: When Do Rankings Beat Signs? Gradient Direction Recovery under Even Nuisance
summary: Can ranking a batch of antipodal query pairs recover a gradient direction with fewer evaluations than using within-pair signs alone? We study fixed-center recovery in $d$ dimensions for a linear signal plus an unknown differentiable even nuisance, counting function evaluations and feedback rounds separately. Shared pair offsets create an information hierarchy: Mirror retains within-pair signs, Reverse couples reversed cross-pair orders to cancel offsets, and Full enforces all ranking inequalities. Relative shell variation is the nuisance range over the query sphere normalized by the linear-signal scale. When it is at most $c\varepsilon/\sqrt{d}$, Reverse localizes every consistent direction to angular accuracy $\varepsilon$ using $\widetilde{O}(d+\sqrt{d/\varepsilon})$ evaluations in one round at fixed confidence, without a variation bound supplied to the decoder. This matches a lower bound up to logarithmic factors, versus the $Θ(d/\varepsilon)$ one-round sign-only minimax cost on the same class. Over well-conditioned positive-definite quadratics with no common relative-curvature bound, the $R$-round minimax cost is instead $Θ(dR(\varepsilon^{-1/R}-1))$, even with cumulative rankings. We extend validity beyond exact evenness under supplied error bounds. Matched-endpoint experiments certify information beyond signs and short cycles. On two ridge tasks under joint evaluation and round caps, short-cycle recovery attains lower terminal mean gaps than the tested batch-capable controls. An additional optimization benefit from fitting the complete ranking remains unestablished.

AI.tldr: 论文研究对一批对跖查询对的排序能否比仅用对内向符号更省评估地恢复梯度方向，在固定中心、线性信号加未知可微偶扰动的设定下，区分函数评估数与反馈轮数进行刻画。结论：在相对壳层变化足够小时，跨对排序可将一阶符号法的 Θ(d/ε) 降为 Õ(d+√(d/ε)) 且单轮完成，并给出紧界与多轮极小极大成本。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是：对一批对跖查询对（x 与 -x）做整体排序，是否比仅利用对内的符号比较能更省函数评估地恢复梯度方向。作者希望在同一查询球面上，以共享的配对偏移构造信息层级，并在偶扰动（未知 nuisance）存在时，量化排序所携带的、超出符号的额外信息，同时把评估预算与反馈轮数分开计费，以适配低轮次、受限评估的实际场景。
AI.method: 对偶扰动的不同使用方式定义三种信息层级：Mirror 仅保留对内符号；Reverse 将反转的跨对顺序相互耦合，以抵消共享偏移；Full 强制所有排序不等式。以相对壳层变化度量 nuisance 范围（查询球面上 nuisance 变化幅度经线性信号尺度归一化）。在固定中心、线性信号加未知可微偶 nuisance 模型下做极小极大分析，推导上界并匹配下界（对数因子内），并分析良态正定二次函数下的多轮成本；进一步在给定误差界下放松严格偶性假设；辅以匹配端点实验与两个 ridge 任务（联合评估与轮数上限）。
AI.result: 当相对壳层变化不超过 cε/√d 时，Reverse 仅用 Õ(d+√(d/ε)) 次评估、单轮、固定置信度即可将每个一致方向定位到角度精度 ε，且解码器无需已知变化界；该结果与下界在对数因子内匹配，而同类问题上单轮仅用符号的极小极大成本为 Θ(d/ε)。对无共同相对曲率界的良态正定二次函数，R 轮极小极大成本为 Θ(dR(ε^{-1/R}-1))，即使允许累积排序亦然。在给定误差界下可把有效性推广到非严格偶性情形。匹配端点实验证实了符号之外的信息与短环；在两个 ridge 任务、联合评估与轮数上限下，短环恢复的终端平均 gap 低于所测可批处理对照。拟合完整排序带来的额外优化收益尚未确立。
AI.conclusion: 跨对排序（Reverse 短环耦合）确实能在偶 nuisance 下提取超出对内符号的信息，将单轮成本由 Θ(d/ε) 降至 Õ(d+√(d/ε)) 并达到下界；但这一优势对 nuisance 的壳层变化规模有明确门槛，且在正定二次函数等多轮设定下优势被轮数结构主导。完整排序的额外收益仍属开放问题。

title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
summary: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文对前沿多模态语言智能体在12个操作基准上的直接机器人控制进行系统性的"动作级"分析，提出意图锚定的评论框架AgentRoboCritic，揭示其成功与失败机制，并发布标注数据集与微调开源评论模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅报告回合级（episode-level）成功率，无法说明前沿智能体（如GPT-6 Astra）为何成功、在何处失败，缺乏对直接底层数值动作控制的细粒度诊断。
AI.method: 提出AgentRoboCritic意图锚定评论框架：策略智能体在执行每个动作时同时声明局部意图，评论器依据该意图评估动作结果与失败模式；在12个操作基准上开展动作级分析，并在400条人工标注动作基准上验证评论器，同时构建12,844条标注动作数据集并微调开源评论模型Muse-Glimmer-30B。
AI.result: 动作级分析表明前沿智能体具备局部执行失败的闭环恢复、跨多样场景的可靠语义落地、以及无任务特定适配的强零样本操作能力；同时暴露抓取与对齐等物理执行瓶颈，以及不同失败模式下恢复能力不均衡。评论器在400条人工标注基准上得到验证；微调后Muse-Glimmer-30B的失败模式准确率由32.58%提升至74.24%。
AI.conclusion: 动作级意图锚定评论可低成本、可扩展地诊断机器人智能体，弥补回合级成功率的不足；作者发布标注数据集与微调开源评论模型以支持后续低成本动作级分析。

title: Controlling the Humanoid Robot H1-2 With a Simulated Biologically Plausible Network
summary: Artificial Spiking Neural Networks have gained remarkable attention in the last few years due to their proven ability in simulating biological neural cultures and producing similar activity and trends. Nevertheless, whether they can be trained for humanoid locomotion while retaining biological plausibility and robust performance at once remains an open question. We study this problem by proposing a biologically inspired spiking network, trained by different learning schemes and tested on the H1-2 Unitree Humanoid. These schemes differ in how recurrent weights are trained. Ordered from most to least biologically faithful, they are: a fixed reservoir mimicking an in-vitro neural culture, where recurrent weights are kept frozen and only a linear readout is trained, the same network but with its synapses trained by reward-modulated spike timing dependent plasticity and eligibility propagation, and finally backpropagation through time as a non biological baseline for comparison. All schemes relied on distillation of a reinforcement learning expert policy with dataset aggregation. We show that e-prop reached 100% survival rate matching backpropagation through time, whereas both the fixed reservoir and the reward-modulated STDP, though the closest to biological cultures, plateaued at a much lower performance (~43.7% and ~11% survival). We explore in further detail which trends a real culture could and could not produce until now. Finally we demonstrate brief bipedal stepping on a full size humanoid H1-2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生物启发脉冲神经网络，用三种不同生物忠实度的方案（固定储层、奖励调制STDP+资格迹传播e-prop、BPTT）蒸馏强化学习专家策略，在Unitree H1-2人形机器人上测试双足运动，结果显示e-prop达到100%存活率，与BPTT持平。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络能模拟生物神经网络活动，但其能否在保持生物合理性的同时被训练完成人形机器人运动，并兼具鲁棒性能，仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 构建生物启发脉冲网络，按循环权重训练方式分为三类（由最生物忠实到最不忠实）：1）固定储层（模拟体外神经培养，循环权重冻结，仅训练线性读出）；2）以奖励调制的脉冲时序依赖可塑性(R-STDP)结合资格迹传播(e-prop)训练突触；3）时间反向传播(BPTT)作为非生物基线。所有方案均基于带数据集聚合的强化学习专家策略蒸馏。
AI.result: e-prop达到100%存活率，与BPTT持平；固定储层与R-STDP虽最接近生物培养，但性能大幅下降，分别约43.7%和约11%存活率。作者进一步分析了真实神经培养可产生与尚不能产生的活动趋势，并演示了全尺寸H1-2人形机器人的短暂双足行走。
AI.conclusion: e-prop类局部学习规则可在保持较高生物合理性的同时实现与BPTT相当的运动性能，而更贴近生物培养的固定储层与R-STDP方案性能受限，提示当前真实神经培养能力的局限。

title: Interpreting DeepStack-Style Vision-Language Models: Do Input or Deeper-Layer Visual Tokens Drive Answers?
comment: Includes the supplementary material. Code and numerical results: https://github.com/yucheng-du/interpreting-deepstack-style-vlms
summary: DeepStack-style vision-language models feed visual tokens to the language model at its input, and again at deeper layers. We call these the main entry and the later entries. What do the later entries add when the model already has the image? We give the entries versions that differ in one object's color and see which one the answer follows. On photographs, the original DeepStack follows the later entries, while Qwen3-VL-8B/32B follow the main entry. Does weakening the main entry give the later features more influence? On synthetic images, we keep this conflict and reduce color saturation at the main entry only. The unchanged later features gain a stronger effect on the relative scores of the two colors, in all four models, including Granite Vision. This holds even under mild desaturation, when accuracy without the conflict stays at 100%. To test whether later features can also correct errors, we degrade both entries and restore only the later ones. The same blur costs both Qwen models 50 percentage points of accuracy on stripe orientation. The 32B model recovers 48 points and the 8B model only 8. Accuracy with one clean entry predicted which entry each model can lose, and five of six tested predictions held on new GQA attribute questions. With the other entry zeroed, Qwen3-VL-8B loses only 0.3 points on its main entry alone, and DeepStack at most 3.45 points on either entry alone. In split inference on these questions, DeepStack can then send only its main-entry features at higher precision. This takes 49% fewer bytes than all entries at a shared precision, at similar accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文（预印本摘要）研究DeepStack式视觉语言模型中"后续视觉入口"（later entries）相对"主入口"（main entry）的功能：通过颜色冲突与饱和度/模糊干预发现，后续入口在原版DeepStack中主导答案、在Qwen3-VL中处于从属地位，但其影响可随主入口削弱而增大；且后续入口能纠正错误，并可用于降低分离式推理的通信量。
AI.motivation: DeepStack类VLM在语言模型输入层与更深层重复注入视觉token（主入口 vs. 后续入口）。模型既然已在输入处获得图像，后续入口究竟贡献什么尚不清楚；该问题关系到多入口视觉特征的可解释性与推理效率优化。
AI.method: 采用"条目版本冲突"探针：构造仅在某一物体颜色上不同的视觉版本分别送入不同入口，观察答案跟随哪个入口。实验1在照片上用原版DeepStack与Qwen3-VL-8B/32B比较主导性；实验2在合成图像上保持冲突并仅降低主入口颜色饱和度（含轻度去饱和、无冲突时准确率100%的设定），测量后续特征对两色相对分数的影响（含Granite Vision，共四模型）；实验3同时退化两入口再仅恢复后续入口（条纹方向模糊任务）以检验纠错能力；实验4用单入口干净时的准确率预测各模型"可失去"哪个入口，并在新GQA属性问题上验证6项预测；实验5在单入口置零条件下测准确率损失，并在分离式推理中对DeepStack主入口特征采用更高精度传输以量化字节节省。
AI.result: 照片冲突下，原版DeepStack的答案跟随后续入口，而Qwen3-VL-8B/32B跟随主入口。合成图像上，仅削弱主入口（含轻度去饱和）后，未改变的后续特征对两色相对分数的作用在四个模型（含Granite Vision）中均增强。纠错实验：同一模糊使两个Qwen模型在条纹方向任务上掉50个百分点，32B恢复48点、8B仅8点。单入口干净准确率可预测各模型可失去的入口，6项预测中5项在新GQA属性问题上成立。置零另一入口时，Qwen3-VL-8B仅损失0.3点（仅主入口），DeepStack在任一入口单独使用时最多损失3.45点。分离式推理中DeepStack仅以更高精度传输主入口特征，比全部入口统一精度少49%字节而准确率相近。
AI.conclusion: 后续视觉入口并非冗余：其影响权重依赖主入口质量，在主入口被削弱时增强；后续特征具备跨层纠错能力，且不同模型在入口依赖上存在系统性差异（可由单入口准确率预测）。这为VLM多入口设计的可解释性提供了因果探针方法，并支撑按入口重要性分配精度/带宽的分层传输策略。

title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
summary: Post-training low-rank compression of neural networks must not only approximate the original weights but also preserve the model's input-output behavior. Recent output-aware methods measure the compression error beyond the compressed layer, at the model output, weighting logit changes by the observed next token or by the model's predicted probabilities. We propose Complete-SVD, a method for large language models that minimizes the $L_2$ distance between the logits of the original and compressed models, weighting all logit changes equally. Linearizing the network around the original weights, together with a Kronecker-factored approximation, reduces this objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution. Its output-side factor is intractable to compute; we estimate it without bias from random probes, at a cost of $K$ backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. At matched settings with uniform ranks and WikiText-2 calibration, Complete-SVD achieves the lowest C4 and PTB perplexity in every setting, and at ratio 0.7 under LEMS rank allocation. Replacing the $L_2$ distance by the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL-SVD), with the same estimation framework, lowers calibration perplexity in most settings and raises downstream accuracy, but raises cross-corpus perplexity. Complete-SVD also improves IFEval instruction-following accuracy over the strongest prior output-aware methods throughout.

AI.tldr: Complete-SVD：面向LLM的训练后低秩压缩方法，以"在模型输出端等权最小化全部logit的L2距离"为目标，借助网络线性化与Kronecker分解近似化为有闭式解的加权SVD，并用随机探针无偏估计难以计算的输出侧因子，在相同设置下取得最低的跨语料困惑度与更好的指令遵循精度。
AI.motivation: 已有输出感知（output-aware）压缩方法在衡量压缩误差时，只对观测到的下一token或模型预测概率所对应的logit变化加权，忽略其余logit的变化，因而并非完整的输出行为保真。作者希望压缩不仅逼近原权重，更要在模型输出层面等权地保留全部logit，从而完整地保持输入-输出行为。
AI.method: 提出Complete-SVD：以原始与压缩模型logit之间的L2距离为目标，对全部logit变化等权处理；在原始权重附近对网络做一阶线性化，并结合Kronecker因子分解近似，将该目标化简为一个加权SVD问题，具有闭式解。其输出侧因子难以直接计算，故用随机探针进行无偏估计，每序列仅需K次反向传播，代价与词表大小和序列长度无关。另给出KL散度替代L2的变体KL-SVD，沿用同一估计框架。
AI.result: 在统一秩、WikiText-2校准的相同设置下，Complete-SVD在每种设置中都取得最低的C4与PTB困惑度；在LEMS秩分配下、压缩比0.7时亦然。KL-SVD在多数设置下降低校准困惑度并提升下游准确率，但跨语料困惑度上升。此外，Complete-SVD在IFEval指令遵循准确率上始终优于最强的现有输出感知方法。
AI.conclusion: 等权最小化全部logit的L2距离是一种有效且可计算的输出感知压缩目标：线性化+Kronecker近似使其获得闭式解，随机探针使其输出侧因子估计在计算上可行。L2目标在跨语料泛化上更稳健，KL变体在校准与下游任务上更优但跨语料表现变差，说明目标函数的选择需在保真与泛化间权衡。

title: Pareto-Optimal and Strategyproof Data-Sharing Between Competitors
summary: We study data-sharing among firms competing in the same market through the quality of their predictive models. We model firms' profit through two main components, precision and market share, where the former depends on the firm's own number of datapoints and the latter depends on the endowments of all firms. We characterize Pareto-optimal contracts as those in which at least one firm receives all of the other firms' datapoints. We then propose a parametric family of data-sharing contracts and show that, under any of them, the relative market shares of all firms remain constant, eliminating the negative effect of sharing data with competitors and equalizing all firms' gains relative to the no-sharing scenario. We further show that one contract within this family satisfies both Pareto-optimality and strategyproofness against firms attempting to under-declare the size of their initial endowment. Finally, using a real-world dataset, we empirically test the gain in profit for all firms under the contract described above, and show that data-sharing is particularly beneficial when the machine learning task is harder or when firms' initial endowments are closer to homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文研究同一市场中通过预测模型质量竞争的企业间数据共享问题，刻画Pareto最优契约并提出现实可行的参数化契约族及防策略性机制。
AI.motivation: 企业间共享数据可提升预测模型精度，但会改变相对市场份额，从而损害竞争者利益。作者希望设计兼顾效率（Pareto最优）与激励相容（防谎报）的数据共享契约。
AI.method: 构建利润模型：利润由精度与市场份额两部分组成，精度取决于企业自身数据量，市场份额取决于所有企业的禀赋。在此基础上刻画Pareto最优契约，并提出参数化数据共享契约族；进一步分析其中满足Pareto最优与策略-proofness的契约；最后用真实数据集实证检验利润增益。
AI.result: Pareto最优契约须使至少一家企业获得其他所有企业的数据点；所提契约族下所有企业相对市场份额保持不变，消除了共享带来的负面竞争效应，并使各企业相对不共享情形的收益均等化；其中一种契约同时满足Pareto最优性与对少报初始禀赋的策略-proofness；实证表明机器学习任务越难、初始禀赋越同质时，数据共享收益越大。
AI.conclusion: 数据共享契约可在保持市场份额结构不变的前提下实现帕累托改进，并具备抗策略性，为竞争企业间的数据合作提供了可行机制设计。

title: SteerTrace: Tracing How Target Attacks Steer World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict future videos and actions with one backbone, and their imagined future is often seen as a safety signal. We introduce SteerTrace, a targeted universal attack on WAMs that also traces its effect inside the model. One $\ell_\infty$-bounded (4/255) perturbation per model, shared across frames, tasks, and camera views, pushes the executed action toward an attacker-chosen target. On eight WAMs from four families (FastWAM, Faster-WAM, OpenWAM and LingBot-VA) on LIBERO and RoboTwin, it drives task success close to zero and moves the attacked action toward the target. Same-budget noise and BadWAM produce little action shift in the target direction. We use the signed targeted effect to measure how much of the effect each intervention removes or reproduces. Under the standard attack, restoring future tokens removes 61-94% of the targeted effect in the five models whose action experts attend to them. When the attack is constrained to keep the predicted future close to the clean prediction, the targeted effect can become more dependent on current-frame tokens. In three of these five models, restoring current-frame tokens removes 87-99% of the effect, compared with 9-15% for future tokens. In six models, restoring just 0.36% of the FFN neurons in layers 10-29 of the video expert removes 72-96% of the targeted effect. Residual directions 2-16 hold only 11-18% of the shift energy, yet removing them cancels most of the targeted effect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SteerTrace，一种针对世界动作模型（WAMs）的通用目标攻击：每模型仅需一个 ℓ∞ 有界（4/255）扰动，跨帧、任务与视角共享，即可将执行动作推向攻击者指定目标，并借助符号化目标效应量化各内部通路对该效果的贡献。
AI.motivation: WAMs 同时预测未来视频与动作，其"想象的未来"常被视为安全信号；然而这一安全假设是否可靠缺乏检验。作者希望揭示：单一微小扰动即可跨场景迁移并定向操控动作，同时厘清效果在模型内部的依赖通路，从而质疑"基于想象未来的安全信号"这一前提。
AI.method: 构造单个 ℓ∞ 范数受限（4/255）的通用扰动，对每个模型训练一次，跨帧、任务和相机视角共享，目标为把动作拉向指定方向。在四个家族共八个 WAM（FastWAM、Faster-WAM、OpenWAM、LingBot-VA）及 LIBERO、RoboTwin 基准上评测，与同预算随机噪声和 BadWAM 对比。用"符号化目标效应"作为度量，通过干预实验（恢复未来 token、恢复当前帧 token、恢复视频专家第 10–29 层中 0.36% 的 FFN 神经元、移除残差方向 2–16）测量各部件对效果的消除或复现比例。并设置"保持预测未来接近干净预测"的约束变体，考察效果依赖的迁移。
AI.result: 攻击使任务成功率降至接近零，动作显著向目标偏移；同预算噪声与 BadWAM 几乎不产生目标方向的动作偏移。标准攻击下，在五个动作专家会关注未来 token 的模型中，恢复未来 token 消除 61–94% 的目标效应。加入"未来接近干净预测"约束后，效果可更多依赖当前帧 token：其中三个模型中恢复当前帧 token 消除 87–99%，而恢复未来 token 仅消除 9–15%。六个模型中，仅恢复视频专家第 10–29 层 0.36% 的 FFN 神经元即消除 72–96% 的目标效应。残差方向 2–16 仅承载 11–18% 的偏移能量，但移除它们却可抵消大部分目标效应。
AI.conclusion: WAMs 对单一微小通用扰动高度脆弱，"想象的未来"不足以作为可靠安全信号；目标效应可通过多条内部通路（未来 token、当前帧 token、稀疏 FFN 神经元子集、低能量残差方向）被解释与干预，且能量占比与因果重要性不匹配，提示可解释性度量需区分"承载"与"必要"。

title: Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support
summary: Auto-bidding is a core algorithmic component in online advertising auctions. In practical cold-start settings, iterative training is commonly used to compensate for low-quality, narrowly supported historical data. Unfortunately, in iterative training, representative diffusion-based AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) methods fail to sustain extrapolation beyond the narrow data support and stagnate at a suboptimal level. In this paper, we theoretically attribute this stagnation to Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) collapse: the weak radial return signal is overwhelmed by a curvature-induced penalty. To break this stagnation, we propose \textbf{Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE)}, which introduces a guidance handoff: as the return signal collapses, scarcity subsequently takes over as an exploratory signal to elevate the SNR above a critical threshold. Specifically, ISGE iteratively alternates between a \emph{Judger} that assigns scarcity scores to trajectories and an \emph{Explorer} that performs guided generation of high-scarcity and high-return trajectories, thereby bootstrapping from the narrow support with such self-generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on the industrial AuctionNet benchmark demonstrate that ISGE, starting from cold-start datasets, effectively surpasses the performance of the Full-Dataset baseline within three iterations. Code is available at https://github.com/alimama-tech/ISGE

AI.tldr: 本文针对自动出价（auto-bidding）冷启动场景下基于扩散的AIGB方法在迭代训练中无法外推、停滞于次优水平的问题，从理论上将其归因于信噪比（SNR）崩塌，并提出迭代稀缺引导探索（ISGE）框架以突破该停滞。
AI.motivation: 在线广告自动出价在冷启动时历史数据质量低、支撑范围狭窄，需依赖迭代训练弥补；但代表性的扩散式AIGB方法在迭代训练中无法在狭窄数据支撑集之外有效外推，性能停滞在次优水平，亟需解决该停滞现象。
AI.method: 理论上将停滞归因于SNR崩塌：微弱的径向回报信号被曲率诱导的惩罚项淹没。据此提出ISGE，引入"引导交接"机制——当回报信号崩塌时，由稀缺性接管作为探索信号，使SNR回升至临界阈值以上。具体上，ISGE在"评判器（Judger）"与"探索器（Explorer）"之间迭代交替：Judger为轨迹分配稀缺性分数，Explorer在引导下生成高稀缺性与高回报的轨迹，从而以自生成轨迹从狭窄支撑集中自我引导（bootstrapping）。
AI.result: 在工业级AuctionNet基准上的大量实验表明，ISGE从冷启动数据集出发，仅需三次迭代即可超越全数据集（Full-Dataset）基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: ISGE通过稀缺性引导的探索信号弥补回报信号崩塌，有效突破扩散式AIGB在迭代训练中的外推停滞，实现冷启动条件下的高效自举与性能超越；代码已开源。

title: SenseAlign: Learning Decision-Aligned Predictive Representations for Active Urban Sensing with UAVs
summary: Active urban sensing orchestrates a mobile sensor fleet to proactively inspect a dynamic road network and gather critical information for system management. This problem simultaneously requires understanding the complex spatio-temporal evolution and making decisions with partial observations. In this work, we focus on active sensing in a large-scale urban road network with utilities grounded in dynamic traffic states, while prior work has rarely considered these factors jointly. We propose \emph{SenseAlign}, a Reinforcement Learning-based (RL) framework that learns decision-aligned predictive representations for coordinating an urban sensing drone fleet. SenseAlign first trains a privileged teacher agent that exploits future ground-truth traffic for optimal sensing choices. The student agent has an auxiliary branch that learns to predict future traffic with partial observations, in addition to the RL-trained actor and critic branches. During student learning, our framework matches the action distributions of the teacher under ground-truth and student-predicted future traffic, while keeping the teacher's observations unchanged. Such a design shapes the latent space for decision-making instead of prediction alone. At inference time, the student agent has no overhead as all this learning is done in training. We conduct comprehensive experiments with the real road network of central Barcelona containing 1570 road segments, and demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms the baselines on multiple utility formulations. The codebase will be made publicly available upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出SenseAlign——基于强化学习的主动城市感知框架，通过"特权教师+学生"预测表征对齐，协调无人机车队在大规模动态路网中进行主动感知。
AI.motivation: 主动城市感知需同时理解复杂时空演化并在部分观测下决策，而既有工作很少联合考虑动态交通状态驱动的效用、大规模路网与部分可观测决策。
AI.method: SenseAlign先训练可利用未来真实交通的特权教师智能体；学生智能体在RL的actor与critic分支外增加辅助分支，用部分观测预测未来交通。训练中在保持教师观测不变的前提下，对齐教师基于真实未来交通与基于学生预测未来交通两种情形下的动作分布，从而塑造面向决策（而非单纯预测）的隐空间；推理阶段无额外开销。
AI.result: 在巴塞罗那市中心真实路网（1570条路段）上开展实验，在多种效用设定下均持续优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 面向决策对齐的预测表征学习可有效支撑大规模动态路网下的无人机主动感知，且训练期设计不增加推理成本。

title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

AI.tldr: 提出双锚点协作智能体DACA，将3D视觉定位重构为语义-几何双锚点协同推理范式，通过闭环双向信息交换实现零样本3D-VG，在ScanRefer和Nr3D上大幅超越现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-VG智能体虽摆脱了对预处理点云的依赖，但采用单向流水线式工具调用架构，将语义理解与几何重建割裂，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。
AI.method: DACA包含两个互补专用工具：语义锚点工具持有目标的视觉语义特征，通过光流与VLM局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚点工具持有目标的三维空间几何特征，通过体素化与多关键点投影进行全局空间推理。二者经由标准化工具调用协议进行双向信息交换，自主决定下一步感知-动作，形成闭环优化。
AI.result: 在ScanRefer上零样本Acc@0.25达73.6%，Nr3D整体准确率70.4%，显著超越最新零样本3D-VG方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义-几何双锚点协同的闭环推理范式有效缓解流水线架构的误差累积问题，验证了双向工具协作在零样本3D视觉定位中的优越性。

title: Learning to Compare Neural Representations from Parameterized Computation Graphs
summary: Comparing internal representations across trained models is important for identifying corresponding layers and selecting components for model reuse. Yet, direct comparisons at inference require evaluating candidate models on known reference inputs and collecting their internal activations. In this paper, we study whether internal representation similarity measured across independently trained models can instead be learned to predict in unseen models from their parameterized computations. We introduce a framework that applies a graph metanetwork for mapping each internal site to an embedding derived from its upstream computations while accounting for hidden-coordinate permutation and internal attention-basis transformations. We analyze the structural properties of our estimators and derive conditional guarantees for layer retrieval and stitching candidate selection. Empirically, we find that the learned predictors support relation estimation and low-regret layer retrieval. They also select useful stitching connections while not being trained on stitching outcomes. This opens up a new way to study representation similarity directly from trained neural networks: representational relations learned across a collection of trained models can generalize to new computations, and that the predicted relations can guide candidate selection before direct measurement or adapter fitting for functional evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用图元网络从模型参数化计算中“学习”跨模型内部表征相似性，从而在无需对新模型做推理测量时预测层间对应关系，并用于层检索与拼接候选选择。
AI.motivation: 直接比较独立训练模型的内部表征需对候选模型在已知参考输入上做推理并收集激活，成本高且受限于目标模型可访问性。作者希望仅从其参数化计算预测表征关系，使层对应识别与模型复用组件选择在直接测量之前即可进行。
AI.method: 提出一个框架：用图元网络将每个内部站点映射为由其上游计算导出的嵌入，显式处理隐藏坐标置换与内部注意力基变换的不变性；分析估计器的结构性质，并给出层检索与拼接候选选择的条件性保证。
AI.result: 实验表明学得的预测器支持关系估计与低遗憾层检索；在未用拼接结果训练的情况下仍能选出有用的拼接连接。
AI.conclusion: 表征关系可从一组已训练模型中学习并泛化到新计算，预测关系可在直接测量或适配器拟合之前指导候选选择，为直接从训练好的网络研究表征相似性开辟新途径。

title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
summary: Post-training recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively improves a target capability, operationalized by a fixed anchor benchmark, through repeated intervention, training, and evaluation. Yet most loops use the anchor's aggregate score as their sole observation, so early gains give way to stalled progress and repetitive exploration. When this anchor-only feedback ceases to reveal actionable gaps, a plateau may reflect an exhausted observation rather than an exhausted capability. We introduce adaptive observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism of harness evolution that keeps the anchor objective fixed while adapting the active observation. At a plateau, a controller refines diagnostic granularity, escalates difficulty, and adds related tasks; validated increments are fused back into training, while every checkpoint remains evaluated against the anchor. Across eight independently optimized anchors in long-context reading comprehension and instruction following, AdaObs raises the mean score from $66.4$ to $73.7$ under a matched data budget, outperforming FixedObs, the anchor-only baseline. The evolved harness further improves the seven-task average on the independent PostTrainBench across two agent backends. These results identify observation adaptation as a missing mechanism of harness evolution for sustaining post-training RSI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应观测（AdaObs），一种"harness进化"的观测侧机制：在训练后递归自我改进（RSI）中固定锚点基准目标不变，仅动态调整观测方式，以突破由锚点聚合分数单一反馈造成的收益停滞。
AI.motivation: 训练后RSI循环通常仅用锚点基准的聚合分数作为唯一观测信号，早期增益很快被停滞与重复探索取代。作者指出，当锚点反馈不再揭示可行动的差距时，平台期可能源于"观测枯竭"而非"能力枯竭"，因此需要演化观测侧而非仅优化能力侧。
AI.method: AdaObs在平台期触发控制器进行三类观测调整：细化诊断粒度、提升难度、引入相关任务；经校验的增量被融合回训练数据，同时每个检查点仍以固定锚点评估。在长上下文阅读理解与指令遵循八个独立优化的锚点上，与仅锚点反馈的FixedObs在匹配数据预算下对比；并在独立基准PostTrainBench（七个任务、两种agent后端）上验证演化后harness的迁移效果。
AI.result: 匹配数据预算下，AdaObs将平均分从66.4提升至73.7，优于FixedObs基线；演化后的harness在PostTrainBench七任务平均分上于两种agent后端均进一步改善。
AI.conclusion: 观测适应是harness进化中支撑训练后RSI持续改进的缺失机制；平台期的瓶颈可能在于观测而非能力，固定目标、自适应观测可在不改变锚点的前提下持续产生可行动信号。

title: Verifying Before Enhancing: Target Evidence Chain Verification for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection is essential for early warning, surveillance, remote sensing, and space-based target perception. However, infrared small targets are typically tiny, weakly textured, and boundary-blurred, making them difficult to distinguish from complex backgrounds. Moreover, target-like background structures can produce salient responses across multiple scales, making response strength alone insufficient for reliable target discrimination. To address this challenge, we propose VBE-UNet, a Target Evidence Chain Verification Network that assesses candidate reliability beyond response magnitude through complementary evidence cues. Specifically, counterfactual background explanation models local target evidence, while joint evidence verification integrates cross-scale support and perturbation-based contribution verification to guide feature recomposition. The resulting reliability estimates guide selective feature refinement, promoting target-relevant responses while reducing unsupported background activations. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUDT-SIRST, and NUAA-SIRST demonstrate that VBE-UNet achieves superior detection accuracy and lower false-alarm rates compared with state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies and evidence reliability analysis further validate the effectiveness of the proposed verification framework.

AI.tldr: 提出VBE-UNet（目标证据链验证网络），通过反事实背景解释与联合证据验证两条互补证据线索评估候选目标可靠性，突破仅依赖响应强度的判别局限，在IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST、NUAA-SIRST上取得更高检测精度与更低虚警率。
