AI.motivation: 红外小目标尺寸极小、纹理弱、边界模糊，易与复杂背景混淆；且类目标背景结构可在多个尺度产生显著响应，导致仅凭响应强度无法可靠区分真实目标与虚警，需要引入响应幅度之外的证据进行判别。
AI.method: 构建"目标证据链验证"框架：(1) 反事实背景解释模块对局部目标证据进行建模；(2) 联合证据验证整合跨尺度支持度与基于扰动的贡献度验证；(3) 由可靠性估计引导特征重组与选择性特征精炼，增强目标相关响应、抑制缺乏证据支持的背景激活。
AI.result: 在IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST、NUAA-SIRST三个数据集上，检测精度优于现有SOTA方法且虚警率更低；消融实验与证据可靠性分析验证了验证框架各组成部分的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以"证据验证"替代"响应强度"作为候选可靠性判据的范式有效提升了红外小目标检测的精度与抗虚警能力，为复杂背景下的小目标判别提供了可解释、可组合的验证思路。

title: RL Can Only Reinforce What It Sees Succeed
summary: When a familiar rule stops working, an agent has to weigh what pre-training taught it against what it now observes. We ask how outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) changes this balance, in a puzzle world where both sides are known: small language models trained from scratch on games played by a Bayesian player, so that the prior and the right answer are exact. Base models hedge as their corpus did, and RL turns that hedging into decisions, in whichever direction the reward favours. But RL can only reinforce what it sees succeed. When the right action is rare, each run either learns it everywhere or not at all, and which runs take off is predicted before training by one count: the expected number of groups of attempts in which the action wins. About 35 such groups give even odds. The count holds for new and repeated problems and for groups of 4 to 256 attempts, and across learning rates, optimizers, GRPO variants and model sizes from 1.3M to 85M parameters, which move the threshold but not what is counted.

AI.tldr: 在“先验与正确答案均已知”的谜题世界中，结果奖励强化学习会把基座模型的“对冲”行为转成按奖励方向的决策，但RL只能强化它见过的成功：当正确动作罕见时，每次训练要么全面学会、要么完全学不会，而哪次训练会“起飞”可由训练前的单一计数预测——动作获胜的尝试组数的期望值，约35组时胜率为50%。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：当熟悉的规则失效时，智能体需要在预训练所学与当前观察之间权衡。作者希望厘清结果奖励强化学习（RL）如何改变这一权衡，且需要一个先验与正确答案都可精确已知的环境，从而排除歧义、做可控的因果分析。
AI.method: 方法：构造一个“谜题世界”，由贝叶斯玩家进行对局，并从小规模语言模型（1.3M–85M参数）从零训练，使预训练先验与最优答案均为精确已知。在此设定下施加结果奖励RL（含GRPO及其变体、不同优化器与学习率），比较基座模型的对冲行为与RL后的决策倾向，并统计“动作获胜的尝试组数”这一训练前可计算的量。
AI.result: 结果：基座模型像其语料那样对冲，RL按奖励方向把对冲转为决策，但只能强化其观察到的成功。当正确动作罕见时，单次训练呈全有或全无（学会或完全不学）；是否“起飞”可由训练前的一个计数预测——动作获胜的尝试组数的期望值，约35组对应50%成功概率。该计数对新问题与重复问题、4至256次尝试的组规模、不同学习率、优化器、GRPO变体及1.3M–85M参数规模均成立；这些因素只移动阈值，不改变被计数的对象。
AI.conclusion: 结论：RL在“先验 vs. 观察”的权衡中并非平滑地重新加权，而受探索-成功的稀有事件结构支配：其成败由可预训练的“成功组数”这一简单统计量决定，具有很强的跨设定普适性，提示可用训练前计数来预测RL能否改变模型行为。

title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
summary: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. Two tracks are ranked separately: in the Main track we run the submitted algorithms in a network-isolated sandbox with open-source dependencies only; in the Self-hosted track teams solve the instances on their own machines, with any software, within a timed window. Every solution is checked for feasibility, and a feasible solution scores the ratio of its objective to a frozen known reference, averaged over hidden instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FrontierOR 挑战赛与基准，考察 LLM 智能体能否为运筹优化问题自动设计可扩展到真实规模实例的算法；基准一次性评测显示最强模型仅在 39% 的大规模实例上达到与 Gurobi 相当（目标值差 1% 以内且不更慢）的水平。
AI.motivation: 运筹学（OR）算法高度依赖专家逐问题定制，新问题（路径、调度、网络设计）往往需数周专家工作才能在大规模下求解良好。LLM 智能体已能编写、测试与改进代码，但其能否设计出可扩展到真实规模实例的算法仍是开放问题，因此需要一个标准化的、多问题、隐藏实例的评测平台。
AI.method: 提出 FrontierOR 基准与挑战赛：基准含 180 个经审核的优化问题，覆盖 6 类应用与 5 类建模形式。挑战分两阶段：Stage 1 分周发布 60 道，每周 15 道；Stage 2 引入基准外的新问题及未见实例。设置两条独立排名赛道——Main 赛道在仅含开源依赖的网络隔离沙箱中运行提交算法；Self-hosted 赛道由参赛队在自有机器、任意软件、限时窗口内求解。所有解均做可行性校验，可行解按目标值与冻结参考解的比值计分，并对隐藏实例取平均。
AI.result: 在 FrontierOR 的一次性评测中，最强模型仅在 39% 的大规模实例上匹配 Gurobi（目标值差距在 1% 以内且速度不劣）；其余大规模实例上未能达到该水平。
AI.conclusion: 现有 LLM 智能体尚不能可靠地为真实规模优化问题设计出与专业求解器（Gurobi）相当的算法，亟需发展可一次处理多类优化问题的智能体工作流；FrontierOR 通过分阶段、双赛道、隐藏实例与可行性校验的评测协议，提供了可复现、抗过拟合的评价框架。

title: What's in the box? Revealing Object Layouts Inside Opaque Boxes via Contactless Vibration Excitation and Sensing
summary: Can we reveal what is inside an opaque box by observing its surface vibrations? Objects inside a box alter its mechanical response, providing cues about their hidden locations. We introduce a method that uses these cues to predict a box's 2D occupancy layout entirely remotely. A nearby speaker excites vibrations, which we measure on one visible wall using a grid of laser points and a camera measuring each point's speckle-pattern shifts. Our model, WhisperBox, learns to encode these vibrations into a latent representation and decode it into an occupancy map of the box's contents. The method requires no physical contact to excite or sense vibrations. We demonstrate layout recovery across various boxes and single- and multiple-object scenes, with generalization to unseen object instances, positions, orientations, and weights, as well as changes in laser placement and excitation source. Our analysis reveals that informative frequency bands need not coincide with the box's resonances and that the learned latent space captures object placement and supports arithmetic operations. These results demonstrate the potential of remote vibration sensing to infer spatial layouts hidden from view.

AI.tldr: 提出 WhisperBox，一种非接触式方法：用扬声器激励不透光箱体振动，以激光散斑阵列+相机测量可见壁面振动，学习潜在表示并解码出箱内物体的二维占据布局。
AI.motivation: 箱内物体改变箱体的机械响应，因而壁面振动隐含物体位置信息；希望完全远程地推断不可见内容的空间布局，且无需接触式激励或传感。
AI.method: 扬声器激发振动；在可见壁面网格化激光点上用相机测量散斑图案位移；WhisperBox 模型将振动编码为潜在表示，再解码为占据图。
AI.result: 在多种箱体和单/多物体场景中实现布局恢复，对未见物体实例、位置、朝向、重量以及激光布置与激励源变化具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 有信息量的频带不必与箱体共振重合；潜在空间编码物体位置并支持算术运算；远程振动传感可用于推断视野外的空间布局。

title: Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models
summary: Differentiable programming enables online calibration of numerical models by minimizing errors accumulated along simulated trajectories. This includes estimating physical parameters and training neural sub-models in hybrid configurations. Gradients are typically computed using adjoint methods, or backpropagation through time (BPTT), whose computational and memory costs grow with the length of the training window. This limits the duration and resolution of hybrid-model training, a major bottleneck for realistic geophysical applications. Approaches like truncated BPTT reduces memory use by discarding sensitivities across truncation boundaries, introducing gradient bias and neglecting long-range dependencies. We propose a class of gradient approximation methods that preserve the adjoint recurrence over the full trajectory while approximating only the pullback operators within it. Exact pullbacks are computed by automatic differentiation at sparse anchor states only. Between anchors, sensitivities propagate either through the identity (Zero-order) or through a reused, frozen pullback (Pullback Reuse). This approximation makes the parameter pullback constant within each chunk, allowing the gradient sum to factorize so that a single evaluation per chunk replaces one per time step. We evaluate both on three systems of increasing complexity, an incomplete Lorenz-63 model, a large-eddy closure for two-dimensional quasi-geostrophic turbulence, and bias correction in a multilayer quasi-geostrophic ocean model. Peak memory falls by up to an order of magnitude and runtime up to fourfold, with Pullback Reuse staying closest to the exact gradient direction. In all three cases, approximate gradients support hybrid-model training at comparable accuracy, showing that effective online learning does not require exact gradients.

AI.tldr: 提出一类梯度近似方法：在全轨迹上保持伴随递推，仅在稀疏锚点处用自动微分计算精确pullback，锚点之间用恒等映射（Zero-order）或复用的冻结pullback（Pullback Reuse）传播敏感度，使每个chunk内参数pullback为常数、梯度求和可分解，从而用一次评估替代逐步评估。在Lorenz-63、二维准地转湍流LES闭合、多层准地转海洋模式偏差订正三个系统上，峰值内存降低至多一个数量级、运行时间至多缩短4倍，Pullback Reuse最接近精确梯度方向，且近似梯度支持的混合模型训练精度相当。
AI.motivation: 可微编程在线校准依赖沿模拟轨迹累积误差最小化，梯度常用伴随法或BPTT计算，其计算与内存开销随训练窗口长度增长，限制了混合模型训练的时长与分辨率，是实际地球物理应用的主要瓶颈；截断BPTT虽省内存却丢弃截断边界的敏感度，引入梯度偏差并忽略长程依赖。
AI.method: 保持全轨迹上的伴随递推，仅对其中pullback算子作近似：精确pullback仅在稀疏锚点状态由自动微分计算；锚点之间敏感度经恒等映射（Zero-order）或复用冻结的pullback（Pullback Reuse）传播。该近似使每个chunk内参数pullback恒定，梯度求和可分解，单次chunk评估替代逐时间步评估。
AI.result: 在复杂度递增的三个系统（不完整Lorenz-63、二维准地转湍流的LES闭合、多层准地转海洋模式偏差订正）上评估：峰值内存最多下降一个数量级，运行时间最多缩短4倍；Pullback Reuse的梯度方向最接近精确梯度；三种情形下近似梯度均支持精度相当的混合模型训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅近似pullback而保留完整伴随递推，可在大幅降低内存与时间开销的同时维持训练质量，表明有效的在线学习并不需要精确梯度，为长窗口、高分辨率的混合地球物理模型在线校准提供了可行途径。

title: Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
summary: Developing generalizable, data-efficient machine learning (ML) models for advanced manufacturing remains challenging because experimental datasets are limited and process-property relationships vary across materials and operating conditions. In laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), melt pool width, depth, and melting mode (conduction, transition, or keyhole) govern process stability and defect formation. Conventional ML models typically use dimensional process parameters, which represent laser-material interactions only implicitly and may limit cross-material transfer. This study evaluates whether two physics-informed dimensionless features, normalized enthalpy and Peclet number, combining laser processing conditions with material thermophysical properties, improve melt pool prediction over raw process parameters. We systematically benchmark seven models: four classical ML methods (Gaussian process, support vector machine, random forest, and XGBoost) and three pretrained tabular foundation models (TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICLv2). Experiments span 316L stainless steel, IN625, IN718, and combined-material datasets, covering regression of melt pool width and depth and classification of melting modes. Dimensionless features yield comparable or superior predictive performance in most settings, with the largest gains in cross-material depth prediction (R^2 = 0.96). Tabular foundation models generally achieve stronger classification performance than classical baselines, particularly for multi-material datasets. These findings indicate that combining physically meaningful dimensionless representations with pretrained tabular models can improve data-efficient melt pool modeling and support more transferable process-window identification in LPBF.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了无量纲物理特征（归一化焓与Peclet数）相较原始工艺参数在LPBF熔池预测中的增益，并横向对比四种经典ML与三种预训练表格基础模型。
AI.motivation: 实验数据有限、工艺-性能关系随材料与工况变化，通用化与数据高效建模困难；传统模型使用有量纲工艺参数，仅隐式表达激光-材料相互作用，限制跨材料迁移。
AI.method: 以归一化焓与Peclet数两个物理信息无量纲特征融合工艺条件与材料热物性；基准测试7个模型——高斯过程、SVM、随机森林、XGBoost，以及TabPFN、TabDPT、TabICLv2；数据覆盖316L、IN625、IN718及混合材料数据集，任务包括熔池宽度/深度回归与熔化模式（传导/过渡/小孔）分类。
AI.result: 多数设置下无量纲特征性能相当或更优，跨材料深度预测提升最大（R^2=0.96）；表格基础模型分类性能总体优于经典基线，多材料数据集上尤明显。
AI.conclusion: 物理意义明确的无量纲表征结合预训练表格模型，可提升数据高效的熔池建模能力，并有助于LPBF工艺窗口的可迁移识别。

title: CGM: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing for Autism Stereotypy Detection
summary: Skeleton graph attention for autism video analysis weights joints by content alone, giving an erratic wrist the same standing as a still one. Stereotypy, however, is defined by how unpredictably movement unfolds rather than how much of it occurs: in our cohort, every amplitude-based kinematic descriptor falls in stereotyped clips, while windowed Sample Entropy of angular velocity alone rises (Hedges' g = +1.05). We compute this irregularity as a per-joint, per-frame tensor that structurally drives computation. The proposed chaos-guided graph attention and mixture-of-experts model (CGM) couples two mechanisms. First, a learned pairwise term added to the graph-attention logit concentrates attention on irregular joints and re-ranks the remaining edge weight toward jointly irregular pairs; its unconstrained coefficient neither vanishes nor inverts, and zeroing the tensor realigns attention in 94% of clips. Second, a gate conditioned on the same signal routes each frame to two of four experts, whose weights track frame-level irregularity. Under subject-grouped five-fold cross-validation on 116 clips, CGM reaches 0.930 balanced accuracy, exceeding the graph-attention baseline by +0.187; the component ordering replicates on the public MMASD dataset, and on held-out Panoptic Studio sessions, CGM keeps 0.86 specificity without retraining, against at most 0.35 for chaos-free baselines. In ablation, routing without irregularity yields no reliable gain, whereas chaos modulation alone contributes +0.132. A severity index from the same tensor reaches 0.87 split-half reliability, separates the cohorts with Hedges' g = +1.08, and stays consistent within children across therapy recordings, supporting video-only monitoring of stereotypy during intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混沌引导图注意力与专家混合模型（CGM），用逐关节逐帧的角速度样本熵张量驱动骨架图注意力和专家路由，在孤独症刻板行为视频识别上达0.930平衡准确率，并以同一张量导出可靠的行为严重度指标。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架图注意力仅按内容（幅度类运动学特征）为关节加权，使抖动的手腕与静止手腕权重相同；但刻板行为的本质在于运动展开的不可预测性而非运动量。作者观察到在本队列中所有幅度类描述子在刻板片段中都失效，唯有加窗角速度样本熵显著上升（Hedges' g=+1.05），因此需要让"不规则性"结构化地参与计算。
AI.method: 构造逐关节、逐帧的不规则性（混沌）张量，并设计两个耦合机制：(1) 在图注意力logit上加入学习到的成对项，使注意力聚焦于不规则关节，并将剩余边权重重新排序至共同不规则的关节对；(2) 以同一信号为条件的门控将每帧路由到4个专家中的2个。采用被试分组五折交叉验证（116个片段）评估，并在公开MMASD数据集及Panoptic Studio会话上检验泛化性，另做消融与严重度指标分析。
AI.result: CGM达0.930平衡准确率，较图注意力基线提升+0.187；成对项系数既未消失也未反向，将张量置零后94%片段注意力发生重排；专家权重随帧级不规则性变化。组件排序在MMASD上可复现；在未重训练的Panoptic Studio留存数据上特异性保持0.86，而无混沌基线至多0.35。消融显示：无规则性信息的路由无可靠增益，仅混沌调制即贡献+0.132。由同一张量导出的严重度指数分半信度0.87，组间区分Hedges' g=+1.08，且在儿童不同治疗录像间保持一致性。
AI.conclusion: 以运动不可预测性作为计算驱动信号，优于基于幅度的权重设计，可支持干预过程中仅凭视频的刻板行为监测。

title: Revealing Pathway Interactions in Network Computations with Complete Path Contribution
summary: Networks pass signals through many layers of interconnected units, so explaining what they compute means tracing how information travels from input to output and how pathways interact. Most existing approaches analyze only pairwise interactions between components such as units, layers or attention heads. Even when these measurements are combined post hoc into a circuit, they do not capture higher-order interactions along full causal chains (paths) from input to output, and so cannot address how exponentially many paths interact to construct network computation. This leaves a large set of mechanistic questions unanswerable, for example whether inhibitory pathways veto excitatory ones, and how the two combine to yield network decisions. To address this gap, we introduce Complete Path Contribution, a method to decompose the network output into mathematically complete contributions of individual paths to study path-level interactions directly and at scale. Partial summation then induces definitions of contributions for any circuit at any granularity level, with completeness guaranteed at every level. We further present an efficient algorithm that identifies the $k$ strongest paths without examining all of them, with runtime empirically linear in $k$ rather than exponential in depth. By applying Path Contribution to benchmark image classification networks, we quantify excitatory-inhibitory interactions and show how they collectively construct network decisions at a level of detail previously unmeasurable. Furthermore, in an interpretable model of the mouse retina, it reveals how dynamic receptive fields emerge from excitatory-inhibitory interaction motifs among pathways between different cell types in response to time-varying natural stimuli. Overall, Path Contribution reveals how a network's causal pathways interact at scale to transform input to output.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Complete Path Contribution"方法，将网络输出分解为各条完整路径的数学完备贡献，并给出仅需考查少量路径即可找出最强的k条路径的线性时间算法，用于大规模研究路径级（兴奋—抑制）交互。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法多只分析单元、层或注意力头之间的成对交互，即便事后拼成"电路"也无法刻画从输入到输出的完整因果链（路径）上的高阶交互，无法回答"指数级多的路径如何相互作用构造网络计算"以及"抑制性通路是否否决兴奋性通路"等问题。
AI.method: 1) 定义Complete Path Contribution，把网络输出精确分解为单条路径的贡献，分解在数学上完备；2) 通过部分求和（partial summation）为任意粒度、任意电路给出贡献定义，且各层级均保证完备性；3) 提出高效算法，不枚举所有路径即可找出贡献最强的k条路径，实测运行时间随k线性增长而非随深度指数增长；4) 在基准图像分类网络和可解释的小鼠视网膜模型上进行应用验证。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准网络上，定量刻画了兴奋—抑制交互及二者如何共同构造网络决策，细节程度此前无法测量；在小鼠视网膜模型中，揭示了在时变自然刺激下，不同细胞类型间通路的兴奋—抑制交互基序如何产生动态感受野。
AI.conclusion: Path Contribution在路径层面以可扩展的方式揭示了网络因果通路如何交互并将输入变换为输出，为路径级机制分析提供了完备且高效的框架。

title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
comment: https://twinlab-bench.github.io/ contains tasks and code. 33 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. LLM-agent benchmark for autonomous experimental design in digital twins of real labs (physics, chemistry, wet-lab biology, materials, engineering). 13 agents evaluated: Claude Fable 5.2 45.0, Opus 5.5 40.2, GPT-6.1-sol 31.7, plus DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and others
summary: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.

AI.tldr: 提出 TwinLab-Bench，用 52 个来自真实物理科学、生命科学与工程实验室的任务，评测 AI 科学家"自主设计实验"的能力；每个任务配一个 TwinLab agent 作为环境执行被测 agent 设计的实验，并按隐藏的真实实验记录打分。前沿模型表现仍差，最强模型平均分仅 45.0。
AI.motivation: AI agents 被期待充当 AI 科学家，需具备三层能力：正确执行给定计算流程、从给定设计空间中选择下一步测量、自主设计实验。现有基准只覆盖前两层（终端执行或从预定义候选中闭环选择），缺乏对第三层"自主设计实验"的可靠评测，而这要求实验能被真实执行且读数锚定真实实验室。
AI.method: 构建 TwinLab-Bench：52 个任务覆盖物理科学、生命科学、工程实验室，支持 100+ 种实验动作类型。每个任务配一个 TwinLab agent 充当环境，执行被测 agent 所设计的实验，读取实验室原始材料并调用由其记录构建的计算器；agent 报告与取自真实实验记录的隐藏答案比对评分。另设闭卷探针控制记忆背诵，并对比仅见任务描述的纯语言模型。
AI.result: 相比仅看任务描述的语言模型，TwinLab agent 几乎消除了偏离真实记录的读数和对重复请求的不一致回答；闭卷探针排除了靠记忆作答。任务对前沿模型仍很难，最强模型 Claude Fable 5.2 平均分仅 45.0，并对其失败模式做了实证分析。
AI.conclusion: 自主设计实验是当前 AI 科学家能力的薄弱环节，TwinLab-Bench 提供了以真实实验室记录为锚、可被可靠执行验证的评测框架，并揭示了前沿模型的具体失败点。

title: Towards High-Fidelity Learned Video Compression
summary: Professional video workflows operate at qualities that learned video codecs do not reach. We measure how much of a professional quality range a codec covers, from the lowest quality of the standard test conditions, VVC at QP 37, to the highest 4:2:2 grade of the production codec ProRes. To compare inter-frame coding alone, every codec receives original frames as references at the intra positions. On 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2 test sequences, four recent learned codecs cover 24 to 38% of this range. Their encoders are feed-forward networks with a fixed latent capacity, the number of latent values per sample, of at most 0.25, and removing their quantization raises the quality by at most 1 dB. We propose a learned inter-frame codec whose encoder searches, as the encoders of conventional codecs do. It searches block motion, which a learned network refines, and it searches among learned block transforms whose latent capacity ranges up to 1, selecting the partition, the skip decisions, and the quantized coefficients by a rate-distortion cost. Our codec reaches the upper end of the range on all six sequences. With all residual blocks fixed to 16x16, whose latent capacity is 0.25, the same codec covers 55% of the range, with or without quantization.

AI.tldr: 现有学习式视频编解码器质量无法覆盖专业制作码率区间；作者提出带搜索机制的帧间学习方法，通过搜索块运动与学习块变换实现完整覆盖专业质量范围。
AI.motivation: 专业视频工作流的质量水平远超现有学习式编解码器所能达到的范围，需要量化学习式方法在专业质量区间（从VVC QP37到ProRes 4:2:2最高等级）中的覆盖程度，并弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 在10位YCbCr 4:2:2序列上，为公平比较帧间编码，所有编解码器在帧内位置提供原始帧作参考。分析四款近期学习式编解码器的覆盖能力（前馈编码器、固定隐变量容量≤0.25、去量化增益≤1 dB）。提出一种编码器执行搜索的学习式帧间编解码器：搜索块运动并由学习网络细化，在隐变量容量高达1的学习块变换间搜索，通过率失真代价选择划分、跳过决策和量化系数。
AI.result: 四款学习式编解码器仅覆盖专业质量区间的24%–38%；去除其量化后质量提升最多1 dB。所提编解码器在全部六条序列上达到该质量区间的上限；当所有残差块固定为16x16（隐变量容量0.25）时，同一编解码器覆盖55%的区间，无论是否使用量化。
AI.conclusion: 借鉴传统编码器的搜索式编码策略（运动搜索、块变换/划分搜索、率失真优化）可显著扩展学习式编解码器的质量覆盖范围，使其达到专业级质量水平；固定容量的表示约束是现有学习式方法的主要瓶颈。

title: How Network Topology and Data Heterogeneity Shape Decentralized Learning: A Spectral Analysis
summary: Network topology influences decentralized federated learning through information mixing and the relative contribution of individual nodes. While existing analyses primarily focus on spectral mixing properties, they often assume doubly stochastic aggregation, overlooking topology-dependent influence under irregular communication networks. We develop a spectral framework that separates two complementary mechanisms: the dominant eigenmode determines the consensus trajectory and node influence, while non-dominant eigenmodes govern the propagation and attenuation of disagreement. Under uniform neighborhood averaging, we show that the stationary influence is proportional to node degree plus one and derive a bound relating model disagreement to spectral mixing and gradient heterogeneity. We then investigate how these mechanisms interact with the data distribution across nodes. Experiments across regular and heterogeneous network topologies reveal nearly identical learning dynamics under IID data, while network size and connectivity affect how unevenly distributed information is learned under non-IID data. For non-IID settings, we characterize how the distribution of data across nodes shapes the relative contribution of local information to consensus dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出谱框架，将去中心化联邦学习中拓扑影响分解为主导特征模态（决定共识轨迹与节点影响力）与非主导特征模态（决定分歧的传播与衰减），并揭示均匀邻域平均下平稳影响力正比于节点度加一。
AI.motivation: 现有拓扑分析多聚焦谱混合性质，且普遍假设双随机聚合，忽略了不规则通信网络中拓扑相关的节点影响力差异，缺少对影响力机制与分歧机制的统一刻画。
AI.method: 构建谱分解框架，把拓扑作用拆为两个互补机制；在均匀邻域平均下推导平稳影响力与节点度加一成正比的关系，并给出模型分歧与谱混合、梯度异质性之间的界；进一步分析两机制与节点间数据分布的交互。
AI.result: 在规则与异质拓扑上实验显示：IID数据下学习动态几乎一致；非IID数据下，网络规模与连通性影响信息被不均衡学习的程度，并刻画了数据分布对局部信息在共识动态中相对贡献的作用。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化FL的拓扑效应可归为共识与分歧两条通路：前者由主导模态决定并产生度相关的不平等影响力，后者由非主导模态控制衰减；数据异质性决定局部信息相对贡献，需将拓扑与数据分布联合考虑。

title: Similarity-based OSF Logic for Flexible SPARQL Query Answering
summary: We present an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature (OSF) logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs. Fuzzy OSF logic is a knowledge representation and reasoning language where feature symbols denote functions and sort symbols denote fuzzy sets. Sorts are organized in a fuzzy subsumption relation that extends to OSF terms, record-like structures representing classes of entities. The unification algorithm for these structures provides a calculus of fuzzy type subsumption. The latest release of fosf introduces support for similarity-based reasoning by extending the OSF language with a similarity relation among sorts, alongside a translation engine for compiling OSF terms into standard SPARQL. Queries expressed as OSF terms undergo fuzzy ontology-aware rewriting prior to translation. This process incorporates an OSF theory of sort definitions, feature domain and range declarations, and fuzzy subsumption and similarity relations through fuzzy OSF constraint normalization. This rewriting enables flexible query answering by returning approximate solutions, allowing queries that would otherwise be inconsistent with the underlying ontology to yield relevant results.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍模糊OSF逻辑推理机fosf的更新版本，新增基于相似性的推理与面向RDF知识图谱的柔性SPARQL查询应答能力。
AI.motivation: 原有fosf仅支持模糊OSF逻辑的推理，缺乏对RDF知识图谱的查询支持；且传统查询在严格本体约束下易出现不一致而无结果，需要能返回近似解的柔性查询机制。
AI.method: 在OSF语言中引入排序间的相似关系以支持相似性推理，并提供将OSF项编译为标准SPARQL的翻译引擎；查询在翻译前先经过本体感知的模糊重写，该重写利用排序定义、特征域与值域声明、模糊包含与相似关系，通过模糊OSF约束规范化完成。
AI.result: 实现了柔性查询应答，可返回近似解，使原本与本体不一致的查询也能获得相关结果。
AI.conclusion: fosf的新版本将模糊OSF推理与SPARQL查询翻译相结合，形成了支持相似性与本体感知重写的柔性查询框架。

title: SAM 3 Sees More Than It Detects: Promptable Concept Maps Beyond Categories
summary: Promptable segmenters answer what a thing is. Dense prediction tasks also ask class-agnostic questions, such as what stands out or hides, how light is blocked, transmitted or reflected, and where structure lies. Robots, surveillance systems and image editors build on their answers. We study promptable concept maps (PCM), which extend SAM 3's promptable concept segmentation from noun instances to maps of concepts named by short noun phrases such as `"transparent object", with "none" as an answer. PCM-Bench groups the standard test sets of seven such tasks by the question they ask. On it, we find that SAM 3 sees more than it detects. Its semantic path responds to many of these concepts, yet a low image-level presence score can block every detection of its instance path. We present UNVEIL, which trains a copy of SAM 3's semantic path for these maps, with LoRA on copies of its last blocks. A separate presence decoder learns from verified negatives whether a concept occurs. With one text phrase per query, UNVEIL maps region concepts such as salient and camouflaged objects, shadows, transparent objects and mirrors. The same weights map thin structures such as edges and skeletons as well as object categories. Run next to SAM 3, it leaves SAM 3's own outputs unchanged. On each of the seven tasks, UNVEIL reaches the highest score among the compared promptable models, including SAM 3's official fine-tuning and pipelines built on multimodal LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhuan-wu/UNVEIL.

AI.tldr: 提出"可提示概念图"(PCM)任务与PCM-Bench基准，揭示SAM 3"看得比检得多"的现象，并给出UNVEIL——复用SAM 3语义路径+LoRA微调+独立存在性解码器，在七类稠密预测任务上取得可提示模型中的最高分。
AI.motivation: 现有可提示分割器（如SAM 3）只回答"这是什么物体"（名词实例），而稠密预测任务常提出类无关问题：什么最突出、什么被遮蔽、光如何被阻挡/透射/反射、结构在哪里等。机器人、监控与图像编辑均依赖这些答案。作者希望把可提示概念分割从名词实例扩展到由短名词短语命名的"概念图"，并允许答案为"none"。
AI.method: 1) 定义任务PCM（promptable concept maps），并用PCM-Bench将七个稠密预测任务的标准测试集按其所提问题分组；2) 诊断：SAM 3的语义路径对许多此类概念有响应，但低图像级存在性分数(presence score)会阻断其实例路径的全部检测，即"看得比检得多"；3) UNVEIL：复制SAM 3语义路径，仅用LoRA微调其最后若干block，另设独立的存在性解码器，借助经核验的负样本学习概念是否出现；4) 每查询仅一个文本短语。
AI.result: 单一权重即可映射区域型概念（显著/伪装物体、阴影、透明物体、镜子）与细结构（边缘、骨架）以及普通物体类别；与SAM 3并排运行时不影响SAM 3自身输出；在全部七个任务上，其得分高于所比较的各类可提示模型，包括SAM 3官方微调方案与基于多模态大模型的流水线。
AI.conclusion: 可提示模型的价值不止于实例级"是什么"，通过将语义路径与实例路径解耦、单独建模图像级概念存在性，可在不损失原有能力的前提下把提示分割推广到广泛的类无关稠密预测任务。

title: Loss-Guided Tsetlin Machines: Making the Learning Objective Explicit
summary: The Tsetlin Machine (TM) has no explicit notion of a loss function. Its learning signal is fixed to an implicit, margin-based update rule (MBUR), with no way to choose an objective function suited to a specific task. This paper introduces Loss-Guided TM, which replaces MBUR with an explicit and swappable loss function. In our proposed method, clause feedback and weight updates are driven by the loss, while keeping the Tsetlin Automaton and clause logic unchanged. The approach incorporates cross entropy (CE), symmetric cross entropy (SCE), and asymmetric loss (ASL). We evaluate Loss-Guided TM across six datasets that span multiclass, multilabel, and binary classification tasks. With a suitable loss, Loss-Guided TM matches or improves accuracy and F1 over MBUR on five of the six datasets. The gains are greatest for the imbalanced multilabel datasets, where ASL improves macro F1 by up to 9 percentage points. With CE, Loss-Guided TM is also significantly better calibrated than MBUR on all six datasets, reducing calibration error by a factor of 3 to 11. A qualitative inspection shows that the clause-based global interpretability, examined at the per-class level on image and text data, is preserved when using the Loss-Guided mechanism. These results show that our explicit TM learning objective allows direct targeting of uncertainty calibration, data imbalance, and task structure, opening the TM to the broader literature on loss functions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Loss-Guided TM，用可替换的显式损失函数（CE、SCE、ASL）替代 TM 固定的 margin-based 更新规则，在不改动 Tsetlin Automaton 与子句逻辑的前提下实现任务定制化学习目标。
AI.motivation: Tsetlin Machine 缺乏显式损失函数概念，学习信号被固定为隐式的 margin-based 更新规则（MBUR），无法针对特定任务选择合适的目标函数，限制了其与主流损失函数文献的对接。
AI.method: 以显式、可替换的损失函数替代 MBUR：由损失驱动子句反馈与权重更新，同时保持 Tsetlin Automaton 和子句逻辑不变；引入交叉熵（CE）、对称交叉熵（SCE）与非对称损失（ASL）。
AI.result: 在覆盖多分类、多标签和二分类的六个数据集上评估：选用合适损失时，Loss-Guided TM 在六个数据集中的五个上匹配或超过 MBUR 的准确率与 F1；在不平衡多标签数据集上增益最大，ASL 使 macro F1 最多提升 9 个百分点；使用 CE 时在全部六个数据集上校准显著优于 MBUR，校准误差降低 3 至 11 倍；定性分析表明子句级全局可解释性（图像与文本数据的逐类检查）得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习目标使 TM 能够直接针对不确定性校准、数据不平衡和任务结构进行优化，从而将 Tsetlin Machine 开放给更广泛的损失函数研究领域。

title: Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes
comment: 28 pages, 9 pages of main text. 16 figures
summary: We present FAB (Fast and Accurate Body estimation), a human body estimator that jointly improves inference efficiency and body-recovery fidelity. Rather than predicting only parametric mesh-model parameters, FAB directly predicts human skeleton joints and dense surface points. In images, it predicts dense 2D and 3D body points alongside a parametric Momentum Human Rig (MHR) head, then fits SMPL in one learned pass followed by two Gauss-Newton steps. Its ViT-L student, FAB-L, distilled from a fine-tuned SAM 3D Body, runs in real time for one person on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, from detection to a fitted body, at 4.6x the speed of SAM 3D Body's eager-PyTorch body-only path, while improving accuracy on most camera-space benchmarks. The same network predicts heel, toe, hand, and knee contacts, which connect the body to the scene. FAB also estimates world-space motion, fuses static-scene depth around the visible person, and aligns body and scene using predicted contacts. For human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer, an in-model G1 head and FAB-Retarget, a motion-level retargeter that reads dense points or the fitted mesh, map motion to a Unitree G1. FAB-Retarget produces references that follow the person more closely than specialized retargeters including SOMA, GMR, UMR, and OmniRetarget, and substantially more closely than Fast SAM 3D Body retargeted with our sequence IK. Project page: https://www.jinkuncao.com/FAB.

AI.tldr: FAB 是一个直接预测骨架关节与稠密表面点的人体估计器，兼顾推理效率与重建保真度，并支持人体-人形机器人运动重定向。
AI.motivation: 现有人体估计方法（如 SAM 3D Body 类方案）主要预测参数化网格模型参数，推理效率低且难以直接提供稠密几何与接触信息，不利于与场景结合及真实到仿真的迁移。
AI.method: FAB 直接预测人体骨架关节与稠密表面点，同时在图像中预测稠密 2D/3D 人体点及参数化 MHR 头部，再通过一次学习式拟合加两步 Gauss-Newton 拟合 SMPL。ViT-L 学生模型 FAB-L 由微调后的 SAM 3D Body 蒸馏得到。网络还预测脚跟、脚趾、手、膝的接触点；结合世界坐标运动估计、可见人体周围静态场景深度融合，以及基于预测接触点的身体-场景对齐。面向人形机器人迁移，引入 in-model G1 头部与 FAB-Retarget 运动级重定向器，将稠密点或拟合网格映射到 Unitree G1。
AI.result: FAB-L 在 RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 上实现单人实时推理（从检测到拟合完成），速度约为 SAM 3D Body 仅身体路径（eager PyTorch）的 4.6 倍，并在多数相机空间基准上精度更优。FAB-Retarget 生成的参考运动比 SOMA、GMR、UMR、OmniRetarget 等专用重定向器更贴合真人运动，且显著优于 Fast SAM 3D Body 配合序列 IK 的结果。
AI.conclusion: FAB 通过稠密点预测与学习式参数拟合，在效率与保真度上同时取得提升，并将接触、场景对齐与运动重定向整合为统一流程，为真实到仿真的全身运动迁移提供了实用方案。

title: Client Exits - A Way to Increase LLM Transparency on the Client Side
summary: Textual recommendations generated by large language models (LLMs) can be difficult to inspect. This paper introduces \emph{Client Exits}, a lightweight mechanism for enriching LLM responses while separating semantic intent from client-specific presentation. The model inserts predefined, machine-interpretable markers into its output, and the receiving client decides whether and how to realize the corresponding enrichments. This allows supplementary information to be presented as graphics, text, speech, or other modalities without prescribing a concrete interface. We implement a prototype combining a finetuned Qwen model with a modified LibreChat client. Using the Question--Option--Criteria (QOC) approach including three XML-based client exits. We evaluate two QOC-oriented model variants trained on essentially the same examples, with client-exit annotations added for one variant. Across 100 test questions, the client-exit model includes all three markers in every response. An LLM judge, informed about the mechanism without being instructed to favor it, prefers this model's answers in 66\% of the comparisons. These results demonstrate successful marker generation on the evaluated test set and support the feasibility of client-controlled enrichment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Client Exits：让 LLM 在输出中插入预定义的机器可解释标记，由客户端决定是否及如何渲染为图形、文本、语音等富媒体，从而实现语义意图与呈现方式的分离，并验证了标记生成的可行性与评委偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的文本推荐内容难以被审阅与检查，且具体界面呈现往往被模型输出所预设，缺乏客户端层面的自主控制与模态灵活性。
AI.method: 设计轻量机制 Client Exits：模型在回复中插入预定义、机器可解释的标记，接收端客户端自行决定是否及如何实现相应增强。原型基于微调的 Qwen 模型与改造后的 LibreChat 客户端，采用 Question–Option–Criteria (QOC) 方法并定义三种基于 XML 的 client exit；对比两个 QOC 导向的模型变体（训练样本基本相同，仅其中一个加入 client-exit 标注）。
AI.result: 在 100 道测试题上，client-exit 变体在每条回复中都包含全部三种标记；在未被告知应偏向该机制的 LLM 评委对比中，该模型答案在 66% 的比较中被偏好。
AI.conclusion: 在所评测测试集上实现了成功的标记生成，验证了客户端可控增强（client-controlled enrichment）的可行性；但评测范围有限，尚需更大规模与真实用户验证。

title: AdaptReg: Skip-level FiLM Adapter for Task-Specific Adaptation of a Frozen Registration Foundation Model
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Paper for the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge (PSMA-PET/CT longitudinal registration), 4th place among 16 teams on the hidden test set
summary: Longitudinal PSMA-PET/CT registration is a key step in assessing treatment response in prostate cancer, and it requires more than generic alignment accuracy: the deformation must preserve lesion volume, so that measured changes in metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) reflect treatment response rather than registration artifacts. We propose AdaptReg, which adapts a frozen registration foundation model to such task-specific requirements through a lightweight trainable adapter branch with identity-preserving initialization. Keeping uniGradICON fully frozen, we apply FiLM-style per-voxel affine modulation ($γ$, $β$) to its decoder skip connections; the modulation is generated from anatomical semantic features of a frozen TotalSegmentator encoder and supervised by a lesion volume-preservation loss. On the official Codabench validation set (20 pairs), AdaptReg achieves DSC 0.7585, HD95 6.33 mm, MTV/TLG errors of 1.68%/2.11%, and 0.0022% non-diffeomorphic voxels, improving on the uniGradICON + instance optimization baseline by $+0.05$ DSC and reducing the MTV/TLG errors by 70.9%/67.7%. On the hidden official test set (160 pairs), AdaptReg achieves CT DSC 0.816, PET DSC 0.598, and MTV/TLG errors of 4.02%/3.46%, ranking fourth among 16 teams in the final PSMAReg evaluation. Code: https://github.com/shishuyue/AdaptReg

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaptReg：冻结配准基础模型 uniGradICON，用轻量适配器分支（基于冻结 TotalSegmentator 编码器生成 FiLM 逐体素仿射调制，注入解码器跳跃连接）并施加病灶体积保持损失，实现 longitudinal PSMA-PET/CT 配准中变形保持病灶体积，使 MTV/TLG 变化反映真实疗效。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌纵向 PSMA-PET/CT 配准是疗效评估的关键步骤，其需求超出一 般配准精度：形变必须保持病灶体积，否则 MTV 与 TLG 的变化会混入配准伪影，而非反映治疗反应。通用配准模型缺乏这类任务特定约束。
AI.method: 以冻结的 uniGradICON 为基础，仅训练轻量 adapter 分支且采用恒等保持初始化。将 FiLM 风格的逐体素仿射调制 (γ, β) 施加于解码器跳跃连接，调制参数由冻结 TotalSegmentator 编码器输出的解剖语义特征生成，并以病灶体积保持损失进行监督。
AI.result: 官方 Codabench 验证集（20 对）：DSC 0.7585，HD95 6.33 mm，MTV/TLG 误差 1.68%/2.11%，非微分同胚体素 0.0022%；相比 uniGradICON + 实例优化基线 DSC 提升 +0.05，MTV/TLG 误差降低 70.9%/67.7%。隐藏官方测试集（160 对）：CT DSC 0.816，PET DSC 0.598，MTV/TLG 误差 4.02%/3.46%，在 PSMAReg 最终评测 16 支队伍中排名第四。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量、恒等初始化的适配器将冻结配准基础模型对齐到“病灶体积保持”这一任务特定指标需求，可在几乎不损失形变合法性的前提下显著降低 MTV/TLG 度量误差，验证了基础模型参数高效自适应在疗效评估型配准中的有效性。

title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF), with inference available through our llama.cpp fork at https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp.

AI.tldr: 提出 NariQ，一种基于 trellis 编码的量化感知后训练量化方法，使用 BF16 模型在 agent 会话中生成的 token 作为校准数据，首次证明在 ≤3 bit/weight 下量化模型可在长程 agent 任务上追平全精度模型。
AI.motivation: 现有低比特量化方法多在短文本网页数据上校准、以困惑度（perplexity）评估，与实际长程 agentic 任务（10 万 token 以上上下文、多步工具调用）严重不匹配。例如 Qwen3.8-27B 在 ≤3 bit 的既有量化版本在 AIME 等短任务上与 BF16 持平，但在 DeepSWE 上仅解出 BF16 的 72%，说明校准/评估目标错位带来了实际性能损失。
AI.method: NariQ：trellis-coded（网格编码）的后训练量化（PTQ）方法；关键在于校准数据来自 BF16 模型在 agent 会话中自回归生成的 token，而非短网页文本，使校准分布对齐长程 agentic 推理的真实激活与上下文分布。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，NariQ 在 3.0 和 2.5 bit/weight 时于 DeepSWE、Terminal Bench 两个长程 agent 基准以及 AIME、RealWorldQA 上均与 BF16 持平；2.0 bit/weight 的 checkpoint 性能有所下降。作者称这是首批在长程 agentic 任务上与全精度版本持平的 ≤3 bit 量化。已发布 Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF 及 llama.cpp fork。
AI.conclusion: 量化方法的设计需与目标工作负载对齐：以 agent 生成数据校准、面向 agentic 基准评估，可在 2.5–3 bit 实现近乎无损的长程 agent 能力；2 bit 仍存在明显退化，是未来改进空间。

title: Actor-Predictor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning with Formal Specification Objectives
summary: One fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is enforcing temporal safety constraints, such as satisfying formal specifications. Existing methods often transform logic formulas into automata for state augmentation and reward shaping. However, this approach assumes that automaton construction is both feasible and tractable, which limits its applicability to small specifications and linear temporal logic (LTL). This paper proposes Actor-Predictor, a framework that learns a surrogate representation of logic progress without explicitly constructing an automaton. The predictor continuously estimates whether a partial trajectory will satisfy the formal specification in a later step, and its learned features are provided as auxiliary inputs to the actor, which is then optimized using GRPO and RWR. We show theoretically that, under sufficient predictive accuracy, the learned representation is equivalent to the automaton state. Experiments on grid world and robotic tasks in Isaac Lab demonstrate that Actor-Predictor outperforms automaton-based baselines on LTL-constrained tasks. It also performs well on non-regular formal specifications, such as $(a^n b^n)$, for which finite-automaton-based approaches are not applicable.

AI.tldr: 提出Actor-Predictor框架：不显式构造自动机，而用预测器学习形式规范"逻辑进度"的代理表示，作为actor辅助输入，理论上在预测足够准确时等价于自动机状态，并在LTL及非正则规范（如a^n b^n）任务上优于自动机基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习满足时序安全约束（如形式化规范）的方法通常将逻辑公式转为自动机做状态增广与奖励塑形，但该路线假设自动机构造既可行又可处理，因而只适用于小规模规范与LTL，难以扩展到复杂或非正则规范。
AI.method: 提出Actor-Predictor框架：训练一个预测器持续估计"当前部分轨迹在未来某步能否满足形式规范"，从而在不构造自动机的前提下学习逻辑进度的替代表示；将预测器学到的特征作为辅助输入提供给actor，并用GRPO与RWR优化策略。理论上证明在预测精度充分时，所学表示与自动机状态等价。
AI.result: 在网格世界与Isaac Lab机器人任务上，Actor-Predictor在LTL约束任务中优于基于自动机的基线；在有限自动机方法不适用的非正则形式规范（如(a^n b^n)）上同样表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 以学习式预测器替代显式自动机构造，可在保留自动机状态语义（理论上等价）的同时突破规范规模与表达力限制，为RL中的时序安全约束提供更具可扩展性的表示方案。

title: Driver Gaze Target Identification via Gaze Estimation and Structured Driving Scene Understanding
summary: Identifying a driver's gaze target provides object-level information for visual attention monitoring in intelligent vehicles. Gaze-zone classification and continuous attention localization provide limited information about the identity of the attended scene target. This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object- or region-level gaze targets from synchronized in-cabin driver images and forward-view road images. The framework comprises four components: MFGaze, which combines a Vision Transformer pretrained with a masked autoencoder (MAE) and head-pose conditioning through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM); panoptic scene understanding, which constructs a structured candidate set; polynomial ridge regression, which maps gaze features to 2D scene-image coordinates through individualized calibration; and entropy-driven target inference, which adaptively fuses boundary-distance geometry with class-level semantic priors. Experiments evaluate the framework using three public gaze datasets, a laboratory test using Cityscapes road scenes and self-collected gaze data, and the Look Both Ways (LBW) dataset. The complete framework achieves an overall Top-1 gaze target identification accuracy of 96.27% in the laboratory experiment. After sequence-specific calibration, it achieves Top-1 accuracies of 79.92% for task-relevant objects and 85.58% for the road class on LBW. MFGaze achieves the lowest mean angular errors among the compared methods, with 4.06$^\circ$, 4.23$^\circ$, and 10.52$^\circ$ on MPIIFaceGaze, ETH-XGaze, and Gaze360, respectively, and demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Sensitivity analyses show stable performance under hyperparameter perturbations. These results support the framework as a source of object-level gaze information for driver monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化框架，从车内驾驶员图像与前方道路同步图像中识别物体/区域级注视目标，整体Top-1准确率达96.27%，MFGaze模块平均角度误差最低（4.06°/4.23°/10.52°）。
AI.motivation: 现有注视区分类与连续注意力定位只能给出有限信息，无法确定被注视场景目标的身份；智能汽车视觉注意力监测需要物体级信息。
AI.method: 四组件模块化框架：(1) MFGaze——MAE预训练ViT结合头部姿态经FiLM进行特征级调制；(2) 全景场景理解，构建结构化候选目标集；(3) 多项式岭回归，通过个体化标定将注视特征映射到2D场景图像坐标；(4) 熵驱动目标推断，自适应融合边界距离几何与类级语义先验。评测涵盖三个公开注视数据集、基于Cityscapes与自采注视数据的实验室测试及Look Both Ways (LBW)数据集。
AI.result: 实验室实验中完整框架总体Top-1注视目标识别准确率96.27%；经序列特定标定后，LBW上任务相关物体Top-1为79.92%、道路类为85.58%。MFGaze在MPIIFaceGaze、ETH-XGaze、Gaze360上平均角度误差分别为4.06°、4.23°、10.52°，为对比方法中最低，并具备较强跨数据集泛化性；敏感性分析显示超参数扰动下性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为驾驶员监测中物体级注视信息的来源。

title: Budget Internalization: Fixed-Budget RLVR Trades Test-Time Scaling for In-Budget Accuracy
summary: Reasoning models often become more accurate when they can generate longer answers at test time. This behavior is known as test-time scaling. However, RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually trains them with a fixed rollout cap. We find that this cap changes model behavior, not only training cost. After training, models use few additional tokens beyond the training budget. They outperform the base models near that budget, but their accuracy stops improving and falls below the base model at larger budgets. The rollout cap thus becomes a learned constraint, that limits model's test-time scaling. We call this effect budget internalization. We observe it across Qwen3.5-4B, Gemma4-E2B, and Nemotron-3-Nano-4B and two reasoning training tasks: mathematical reasoning and diverse, procedurally generated problems. This effect also transfers from math training to science and coding tasks. Training-objective level ablations on Qwen3.5-4B show that most changes recover little test-time scaling. Stronger KL regularization and lower training-data truncation preserve more scaling, but stronger KL reduces in-budget accuracy. Forcing an answer on truncated training rollouts largely removes budget internalization, but also removes most of the in-budget gain. SFT on artificially truncated traces reproduces budget internalization, whereas SFT on naturally short traces does not, which shows that the effect is not specific to RL. This result links budget internalization to length-censored post-training rather than to an RL-specific objective term. Thus, a rollout cap does not only control training cost. It can trade low-budget gains for lower performance when additional inference compute is available.

AI.tldr: 论文发现 RLVR 中的 rollout 上限会成为一种“学到的约束”：模型训练后只使用接近训练预算的 token 量，在小预算下优于基座模型，但在更大推理预算下准确率停滞甚至低于基座，作者称之为 budget internalization（预算内化）。
AI.motivation: 推理模型的 test-time scaling 依赖生成更长的答案，而 RLVR 训练通常使用固定的 rollout 长度上限。已有工作多把该上限视为成本控制手段，忽视其对模型推理长度行为的塑造作用。作者希望厘清：rollout 上限是否改变了模型的 test-time scaling 能力，以及该现象是否源于 RL 特有的目标项。
AI.method: 在 Qwen3.5-4B、Gemma4-E2B、Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 上，于数学推理和程序化生成的多样化问题两类任务上训练，并测试向科学、代码任务的迁移；在 Qwen3.5-4B 上做训练目标层面的消融（KL 正则强度、训练数据截断程度、对截断 rollout 强制给出答案）；并与 SFT 对照：分别用人为截断轨迹与自然短轨迹做 SFT。
AI.result: 1）训练后模型额外使用的 token 很少超出训练预算，在预算附近显著优于基座，但在更大预算下准确率停止提升并低于基座；2）该效应在三个模型、两类任务上均出现，且从数学迁移到科学与代码；3）多数目标层消融几乎无法恢复 test-time scaling；更强 KL 和更低数据截断能保留部分 scaling，但强 KL 损害预算内准确率；对截断 rollout 强制作答可基本消除预算内化，但同时抹去大部分预算内收益；4）对人为截断轨迹做 SFT 可复现预算内化，而对自然短轨迹做 SFT 不会。
AI.conclusion: 预算内化源于“长度截断/删失式”的后训练（length-censored post-training），而非 RL 特有的目标项；rollout 上限不只是成本控制工具，它在低预算收益与高推理预算下的性能之间构成权衡。

title: HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
summary: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HumanCOIN，一个围绕人类意图构建的第一人称操作数据集，包含12,500小时、38类场景，通过L1注视（10,000h）、L2表面肌电（2,000h）、L3头皮脑电（500h）三层代理信号记录从决策到执行的意图通路。
AI.motivation: 现有第一人称操作数据集将"观测-动作对"视为原子单元，把动作的生成与执行压缩进策略网络权重，导致动作背后的意图状态不可观测。人类运动控制研究表明意图中介于观测与动作之间，并沿"决策→效应"通路留下可观测痕迹（注视先于手到达、肌负荷先于接触建立、皮层活动先于运动指令）。
AI.method: 构建三层次意图代理数据：L1注意力层由头带相机视频推断注视，暴露下一注意/抓取目标；L2发力层用臂带记录表面EMG，反映执行完成前的负荷预期；L3认知层记录头皮EEG，提供任务决策与监控的早期读出。高层级继承低层级全部代理信号。另提供多视角RGB、深度图与点云、6-DoF头部与手腕位姿、步级动作与物体标注；受控L3环境额外直接测量注视、手部位姿与手指运动学；同时发布时钟与标定数据以支持任意读取率的重新对齐。
AI.result: 数据集规模为12,500小时、38个场景类，三层分别为10,000h/2,000h/500h，覆盖从视觉定向到皮层准备的三级站点，使视觉-动作对背后的过程可在数据集规模上建模。
AI.conclusion: HumanCOIN将意图通路显式化并规模化记录，突破了传统观测-动作原子单元的不可观性限制，为意图建模（如预测性策略、人机意图对齐）提供了数据集级基础设施。

title: Rigel-Ladon: An Option-Count Law for a One-Pass Decision Encoder, Tested on Held-Out Option Counts and Held-Out Schemas
summary: Laya is a small neural network that reads a text, a question and K written options, and returns one probability per option in a single pass. We ask how its accuracy falls as K grows from 2 to 35 and whether that can be predicted. We score nested option sets (every K-option question contains the smaller ones) on four question pools, for the released model (Base) and our fine-tune (FT), and score every item against each single rival. FT trained on one 12-option topic question (in-family); a 12-option HR (department-routing) question is out-of-family. Logit accuracy (the log of correct over incorrect answers) is linear in log(K-1) with slope 0.68 to 0.88. Fitted on K up to 6, the law predicts K=7 to 12 within 0.6 points and K up to 24 within 1.2 (a log-linear rule: 1.6 and 6.7). Taking the slope from the topic question and measuring only two-option accuracy on HR predicts its other K within 0.3 points (FT) and 0.7 (Base). On a 35-label pool of five schemas the law fails (5 to 11 points). Independence of irrelevant alternatives is rejected: the gold-versus-rival log-odds shifts by +0.24 to +2.07 nats per doubling of K, yet pairwise answers reproduce K-way accuracy within 4.7 points. Order averaging (averaging over several orderings of the options), shortlists, a temperature law and calibrated prediction sets did not transfer (FT's 90% sets cover 84% on HR). 2 of 10 predictions made in advance held. Caveats: one model family and LLM-labelled synthetic text.

AI.tldr: Laya 单次前向即可对文本-问题-K 个选项评分，其 logit 正确率对 log(K−1) 呈线性（斜率 0.68–0.88），可用小 K 拟合外推，但在 35 标签多模式场景与 HR 跨家族场景下规律失效，IIA 被拒绝但成对比较仍能复现 K 路准确率。
AI.motivation: 研究多选项（K 从 2 增至 35）设置下小型判别式模型的准确率衰减规律及其可预测性，并检验该规律能否跨题目族、跨标签池迁移，同时检验选项集合无关性（IIA）等经典假设。
AI.method: 在四个问题池上构造嵌套选项集（每个 K 选项问题包含更小的子集），对 Base 模型与在 12 选项主题题上微调的 FT 模型逐项与每个单一对手评分；对比家族内（主题题）与家族外（HR 部门路由题）迁移；拟合 logit 准确率对 log(K−1) 的线性律，并检验仅用 2 选项准确率加斜率外推、log-linear 规则、顺序平均、短名单、温度律与校准预测集。
AI.result: logit 准确率对 log(K−1) 线性，斜率 0.68–0.88；用 K≤6 拟合可预测 K=7–12 误差 <0.6 点、K≤24 误差 <1.2 点（log-linear 规则为 1.6 与 6.7）；用主题题斜率加 HR 的 2 选项准确率预测其余 K，误差 0.3（FT）与 0.7（Base）点；35 标签五模式池上规律失效（5–11 点）。IIA 被拒（金标-对手对数几率每翻倍 K 偏移 +0.24 至 +2.07 nats），但成对答案仍能在 4.7 点内复现 K 路准确率。顺序平均、短名单、温度律、校准预测集均未迁移（FT 90% 预测集在 HR 仅覆盖 84%）。预先做的 10 项预测仅 2 项成立。
AI.conclusion: K 路准确率的衰减可用少量小 K 数据以 log(K−1) 线性律较精确外推，甚至可跨题目族借斜率迁移；但该律仅在标签池单一/同构时成立，在 35 标签多模式池显著失效，且 IIA 不成立。局限为单一模型家族与 LLM 标注的合成文本。

title: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. However, the VideoLLM also learns to answer from textual regularities of its training data, a shortcut that bypasses the video. The regularities behind the shortcut are hard to define at the data level, and the shortcut forms regardless of training epoch, data size, or backbone. The shortcut is hidden behind a rise in accuracy within the training distribution, yet it is not required for the rise and even costs SFT the gain the video offers under distribution shift. We therefore propose Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection (VETO), which intervenes on the fine-tuning update where the shortcut is written rather than on the data. VETO calibrates the subspace that the text alone occupies in the activations of the base model and projects the update onto its orthogonal complement. The VideoLLM is thus left to ground its answer in the full input, with the shortcut suppressed as it forms and never defined. Across seven VideoLLMs, VETO preserves the gain of SFT on the training distribution and suppresses the shortcut. On six benchmarks under shift it gains more than SFT and answers from the full input rather than the shortcut. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/VETO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VETO方法，通过对SFT更新做正交投影来抑制VideoLLM学习文本捷径，使其在分布偏移下更好地利用视频信息。
AI.motivation: VideoLLM在SFT阶段虽提升了视频推理能力，但同时学会依赖训练数据中的文本规律（捷径），绕开视频内容。该捷径难以在数据层面定义，且与训练轮数、数据规模、骨干网络无关，被训练分布内准确率上升所掩盖，并损害分布偏移下的视频收益。
AI.method: 提出Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection（VETO），干预微调更新而非数据。具体地，先在校准阶段确定基座模型激活中纯文本所占据的子空间，再将SFT更新投影到该子空间的正交补上。
AI.result: 在七个VideoLLM上，VETO保持SFT在训练分布上的增益并抑制捷径；在六个分布偏移基准上取得比SFT更大的提升，且答案依据完整输入而非捷径。
AI.conclusion: 通过在更新空间而非数据层面干预，VETO无需显式定义捷径即可在捷径形成时将其抑制，使VideoLLM真正基于视频证据进行推理。

title: Thermodynamically Consistent Neural Networks for a Universal Fluid Gibbs Free Energy Equation of State
summary: Over the past three centuries, many thermodynamics researchers have worked to develop fluid equations of state with both high accuracy and broad applicability, proposing various theoretical frameworks and models. Building on these efforts, this study uses Gibbs free energy as the starting point and introduces thermodynamically consistent neural networks to construct a fluid equation of state based on Gibbs free energy (GEoS). This approach establishes a novel machine learning framework that provides a unified representation of fluid states. GEoS performs well on the vapor- and liquid-phase density test sets, with average absolute relative deviations (AARDs) of 5.25% and 3.96%, respectively. It outperforms conventional volume-translated cubic equations of state and existing machine learning models, demonstrating its effectiveness. Further analysis using the UMAP dimensionality reduction method shows that most molecules in the test set belong to extrapolation systems, confirming the strong generalization ability of the model. Finally, the test results show that the PC-SAFT equation fitted using GEoS maintains high predictive accuracy, providing a reliable basis for its practical application in industry.

AI.tldr: 基于吉布斯自由能与热力学一致神经网络构建流体状态方程GEoS，实现统一物性表征，气相/液相密度AARD为5.25%/3.96%，优于体积平移立方方程与现有机器学习模型。
AI.motivation: 三百年间研究者致力于开发兼具高精度与广适用性的流体状态方程，但传统理论框架与模型在精度-通用性权衡上仍受限，需建立统一的流体状态机器学习表征框架。
AI.method: 以吉布斯自由能为出发点，引入热力学一致神经网络构建GEoS状态方程，形成统一表征流体状态的机器学习框架；采用UMAP降维分析测试集分子的分布与内/外推属性；并用GEoS拟合PC-SAFT参数检验其工业实用性。
AI.result: 气相与液相密度测试集AARD分别为5.25%和3.96%，优于体积平移立方状态方程及现有机器学习模型；UMAP分析表明测试集多数分子属外推体系，验证了模型的强泛化能力；由GEoS拟合的PC-SAFT方程保持高预测精度。
AI.conclusion: GEoS以热力学一致方式统一表征流体状态，具备高精度与强泛化能力，可为工业实际应用提供可靠基础。

title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.

AI.tldr: 提出O²LaF框架，用同一个预训练视频DiT初始化逆动力学与正动力学模型（"一个先验，两种动力学"），从无标注视频中学习可迁移的潜在动作，在少样本动作探测上取得SOTA，并支持跨视觉场景与跨本体的零样本动作迁移。
AI.motivation: 视频包含世界变化的信息，但缺少导致这些变化的动作标签。现有潜在动作学习虽能从视觉转移中恢复监督信号，但动力学几乎是从头学习的，未充分利用预训练视频模型的先验知识。
AI.method: 核心原则为"one prior, two dynamics"：以同一预训练视频DiT初始化两个模型并适配其不同角色——(1) 逆动力学：前馈式转移编码器，配备可学习的action queries；(2) 正动力学：因果的、动作条件化的视频生成器。通过控制信息访问并经由紧凑瓶颈进行端到端联合优化，学习可迁移的潜在动作；框架还可扩展到V-JEPA2等预测式表征先验。
AI.result: 在导航与机器人操作任务上，O²LaF在few-shot动作探测中刷新SOTA，并在跨视觉上下文与跨本体的零样本动作迁移上表现更强；使用V-JEPA2等表征先验时也达到有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明存在一种更广义的潜在动作学习范式：复用预训练视频模型来发现可迁移的动作并预测其后果，而非从零学习动力学。

title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
comment: Accepted at the 20th International Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning (NeSy 2026). Conference version: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TEaW3pdZOZ
summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) often answer questions from incomplete records. Missing information might be interpreted as unknown or false, depending on the completeness of the source. Current evaluations fail to distinguish these two aspects, as they are usually interwoven with other reasoning demands. We present ClosureBench, a benchmark that tests whether LLMs follow the stated rules for dealing with missing information. Every base scenario is tested under OWA, CWA, and LCWA, and only the treatment of missing information changes between variants. ClosureBench provides a verified base benchmark as well as agent extensions for action choice, source scope, and updates. A model is considered correct on a base scenario only if it provides correct answers in all of its closure variants. Across 960 instances, overall accuracy can mask substantial closure mistakes. Models achieve overall accuracy from 71.18% to 99.86% across replicated runs, but their core switch accuracy, measured on the scenarios whose gold label actually changes with the contract, varies between 18.23% and 99.31%. Large discrepancies emerge under LCWA. For example, some agents choose unknown despite the prompt indicating that missing information should be treated as false. Our findings demonstrate that evaluations of AI agents should not only measure whether agents can reason over existing facts but also whether they use the appropriate assumption when information is absent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ClosureBench 基准，在与其它推理需求解耦的条件下检验 LLM 智能体是否遵守关于"缺失信息"的不同封闭假设（OWA/CWA/LCWA）规则；结果显示整体准确率会掩盖显著的封闭性错误，核心"切换"准确率最低仅 18.23%。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的 AI 智能体常在记录不完整的情况下作答，缺失信息可能被理解为"未知"也可能被理解为"假"，但现有评测无法区分这两种处理方式，因为该能力通常与其它推理要求纠缠在一起，缺乏针对性测量。
AI.method: 构建 ClosureBench：每个基础场景均在 OWA（开放世界假设）、CWA（封闭世界假设）与 LCWA（局部封闭世界假设）三种变体下测试，变体间仅改变对缺失信息的处理规则；提供经校验的基础基准，以及面向动作选择、来源范围与信息更新的智能体扩展。仅当模型在该场景所有封闭变体上均回答正确，才判定其在该基础场景上正确；并单独统计"金标签随契约实际改变"的场景上的核心切换准确率。
AI.result: 在 960 个实例上，整体准确率 71.18%–99.86%（多次重复运行），但核心切换准确率仅 18.23%–99.31%，整体准确率可掩盖明显的封闭性错误；LCWA 条件下差异尤为突出，例如部分智能体在提示明确要求将缺失信息视为"假"时仍输出"未知"。
AI.conclusion: 对 AI 智能体的评测不应只考察其能否在既有事实上推理，还应考察其在信息缺失时是否采用恰当的假设；需将封闭性处理作为独立、可分离的评测维度。

title: GeoPillars: A Large-Kernel Pillar Detector for Single-Sweep LiDAR Under Point Sparsity, and a Decomposition of Its Gain
summary: GeoPillars is a pillar-based 3D detector for single-sweep LiDAR under a hard budget of eight points per 0.4 m pillar, a budget that discards 46.6% of in-range points. It adds geometric pillar features, grouped vector attention within each pillar, a learned absolute positional prior on the bird's-eye-view (BEV) grid, a large-kernel backbone, auxiliary surface-normal supervision and a full-resolution detection head. Trained on 123k synthetic CARLA scans and evaluated on cars, it reaches 81.33 BEV AP@0.7, 13.76 points above CenterPoint at the same input budget and 1.91 points above CenterPoint at its native, denser budget. These are in-distribution figures, because the validation split is per-frame rather than scene-disjoint. A rung-by-rung decomposition shows that the new components explain little of the gain. Raising the detection-head resolution alone recovers 10.19 of the 13.76 points, the joint change of encoder, backbone, neck and positional prior adds 3.37, and the normal-supervision branch adds 0.20, which is within run-to-run variation. With heading reversals folded out, orientation error is similar for all seven models, although GeoPillars reverses headings about half as often as a resolution-matched baseline. It is also the slowest of the seven models. Evaluated zero-shot on 6,743 real nuScenes keyframes, no model transfers, and each retains 3.7% to 12.2% of its CARLA accuracy. A collection defect left LiDAR intensity constant, so every model learned from geometry alone. Code and checkpoints are publicly available.

AI.tldr: GeoPillars是一个在每根0.4米柱仅8点的严格预算下工作的单帧LiDAR pillar式3D检测器，其81.33 BEV AP@0.7的提升主要来自检测头分辨率，而非所提出的多个新模块。
AI.motivation: 在极端点数预算（每0.4 m pillar 8点，丢弃46.6%范围内点）下提升单帧LiDAR 3D检测性能，并检验各设计组件的真实贡献。
AI.method: 在pillar框架上叠加几何pillar特征、pillar内分组向量注意力、BEV网格上的可学习绝对位置先验、大核骨干、辅助表面法向监督与全分辨率检测头；在123k合成CARLA扫描上训练，并做逐级消融（rung-by-rung）对比七种模型，同时进行nuScenes零样本迁移测试。
AI.result: BEV AP@0.7达81.33，比同预算CenterPoint高13.76点、比其原生稠密预算高1.91点；但13.76点中10.19点仅由提升检测头分辨率获得，编码器/骨干/neck/位置先验联合贡献3.37点，法向监督仅0.20点（处于run-to-run波动内）。折叠航向反转后各模型朝向误差相近，GeoPillars反转频率约为分辨率匹配基线的一半，但速度最慢。nuScenes零样本迁移全部失败，仅保留3.7%–12.2%精度；数据采集缺陷使强度恒定，模型仅依赖几何。
AI.conclusion: 所谓新组件对性能提升解释力有限，增益主要源于输出分辨率；验证集为逐帧划分而非场景独立，结果仅为分布内指标；跨域迁移不可行。结论对"复杂模块带来增益"的叙事构成反证，提示需重视分辨率基线与场景级划分评估。

title: Invertible Transport Between Sample-Only Distributions via Projected Characteristic Functions
summary:
Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models. These sample-only priors cannot be used directly in likelihood-based normalizing flows, which require evaluating the prior density. We propose Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning an invertible map between a data distribution and a prior specified only through samples.
  Our method aligns distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations. To address the non-uniqueness of the transport map, we introduce an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations while preserving endpoint alignment.
  We benchmark PCF on controlled transports, sample-efficiency studies, and high-dimensional alignment tasks. PCF matches the accuracy of kernel MMD on the controlled benchmark and on raw-pixel MNIST--USPS at a cost linear in the batch size, and it is more sample-efficient, achieving lower endpoint error than MMD in 13 of 15 paired runs across library sizes. By avoiding pairwise kernel evaluation, it reduces discrepancy memory by 29.8% and trains at batch sizes where kernel MMD exceeds GPU memory. These results show that PCF provides accurate and efficient invertible transport, particularly in sample- and memory-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF)，一种无需密度估计的可逆传输框架，可将数据分布映射到仅有样本的先验分布。
AI.motivation: 许多有用的先验分布只能采样、无解析密度（经验样本、科学模拟器、黑箱生成模型），而基于似然的归一化流需要评估先验密度，因此这些 sample-only 先验无法直接使用。
AI.method: 利用投影经验特征函数对齐分布，无需密度估计、对抗训练或配对观测；针对传输映射的非唯一性，引入可选的传输正则项以选取位移更小的变换，同时保持端点对齐。
AI.result: 在受控传输、样本效率研究和高维对齐任务上评测：在受控基准与原始像素 MNIST–USPS 上达到与核 MMD 相当的精度，代价随批大小线性增长；15 组配对运行中有 13 组端点误差低于 MMD；避免成对核计算使差异度量内存降低 29.8%，并可在核 MMD 显存溢出的批大小下训练。
AI.conclusion: PCF 提供准确且高效的可逆传输，尤其在样本与内存受限场景下具有优势，可作为仅样本先验下归一化流的密度无关替代方案。

title: Sirius-Tiamat: How Small Can a One-Pass Decision Encoder Get Before Its Decisions Change?
summary: A one-pass decision encoder reads a text, a question and several named options, and returns a probability for each option in a single forward pass. We ask how far Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder of this kind, can be compressed before its decisions change. We count decisions that differ from Laya's own full-precision (fp32) answer, and track calibration (how well confidence matches accuracy, measured by expected calibration error, ECE), on 1,221 synthetic items with the training schemas, 273 with an unseen schema, and 800 out-of-family questions from ARC, MMLU and HellaSwag. Layer pruning of a related model family is known; we add flips, calibration, held-out data and retraining. bf16 changes 0.2% of in-family decisions but 2.2% out of family; 6-bit grouped rounding 1.3% and 5.9%; deleting 6 layers 0.9% and 9.1%, while ECE rises from 5.9% to 39.2%. One fitted temperature, needing no labels, restores it to 3.6%. One scale per tensor fails below six bits, and CPU dynamic int8 changes 30% of decisions, nearly all through one layer. Total variation tracks flips for rounding but not for deletion, and an early exit saves layers over a static cut only if its confidence gate is first recalibrated. Distilling a 16-layer student cuts its in-family flips from 44% to 9% (45% out of family). At equal stored size, rounding flips fewer decisions than deletion. Data are synthetic and LLM-labelled, for one architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了421M参数的单次前向决策编码器Laya在不同压缩手段下的决策翻转率与校准（ECE）变化，发现bf16、分组量化与层剪枝的翻转率在分布外显著放大，而温度缩放可无标签地恢复校准；同等存储体积下量化优于剪枝。
AI.motivation: 单次前向决策编码器（读入文本、问题与多个命名选项，一次前向输出各选项概率）在部署中需要压缩，但现有层剪枝研究多集中于相关模型族，且缺少对"决策是否改变"（而非仅精度）以及校准退化、分布外泛化、重训练的联合考察。
AI.method: 以Laya（421M）fp32答案为基准，统计决策翻转率与ECE。评测集：1,221条训练schema内合成样本、273条未见schema样本、800条ARC/MMLU/HellaSwag族外问题。压缩手段包括bf16、6-bit与5-bit分组舍入、删除6层、每张量单尺度量化、CPU dynamic int8、蒸馏16层学生模型、早退机制，并考察重训练与温度缩放。
AI.result: bf16翻转0.2%（族内）/2.2%（族外）；6-bit分组舍入1.3%/5.9%；5-bit更高；删6层0.9%/9.1%且ECE由5.9%升至39.2%，单一拟合温度（无需标签）恢复至3.6%。每张量单尺度在低于6-bit时失效；CPU dynamic int8翻转30%，几乎全由单层引起。TV距离对舍入能跟踪翻转，对删层不能。早退仅在置信门重新校准后才优于静态截断。蒸馏16层学生族内翻转由44%降至9%（族外45%）。等存储体积下舍入翻转少于删层。
AI.conclusion: 压缩对决策的影响在分布外被显著放大，校准退化可用单一温度无标签修复；同等存储预算下量化优于层剪枝，早退需先重校准门控。结论受限于合成、LLM标注数据与单一架构。

title: Learn, Freeze, and Transfer an Activation Function Across Architectures
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/AI4Bharat/LeFT-activation-transfer, Interactive figures: https://arunprakash-a.github.io/papers/learn-freeze-transfer/
summary: Transfer learning typically reuses knowledge acquired by a source network through its learned weights. We investigate whether a learned activation function can also be transferred and remain useful in networks trained from scratch. We study this complementary form of transfer through a learn-freeze-transfer protocol, in which the activation is optimized jointly with a source network in a single training run, and is then frozen and reused in target networks trained from scratch. A pointwise activation with globally shared parameters is independent of layer dimensions and can therefore be incorporated into networks of different architectures trained from scratch. We instantiate this protocol with FAct, a five-parameter activation represented by a two-harmonic truncated Fourier series, initialized from a Fourier approximation of GELU and learned in a Vision Transformer (ViT) on ImageNet-1K. When reused in a ViT of the same architecture trained from scratch on ImageNet-1K, the frozen activation (Frozen FAct) improves top-1 accuracy by 1.46 percentage points over GELU. Across four smaller target architectures (standard ViT, Swin Transformer, linear-attention ViT, and MLP-Mixer) and four image-classification datasets, it achieves the highest mean accuracy among eleven activation functions in 15 of 16 settings under a common training configuration, with improvements of up to 1.71 percentage points over the best conventional activation. When the learning rate and weight decay are tuned separately for each activation under the same search budget, Frozen FAct still ranks first in 11 of the 16 settings, second in four, and fourth in one. These results provide empirical evidence that a learned activation function can retain its usefulness when transferred across vision architectures, independently of the weights with which it was learned.

AI.tldr: 提出"学习—冻结—迁移"协议，将源网络中与权重联合学到的点式激活函数（FAct）冻结后应用于从头训练的视觉网络，验证激活函数本身可作为可迁移知识。
AI.motivation: 传统迁移学习只迁移权重；作者想探究"学到的激活函数"这一与权重正交的知识形式能否被单独迁移，并在从零训练的目标网络中保持有效。
AI.method: 采用 learn-freeze-transfer 协议：将全局共享参数的点式激活与源网络联合训练，随后冻结并接入从头训练的目标网络。具体实例为 FAct——由两项谐波截断傅里叶级数构成的5参数激活，以 GELU 的傅里叶近似初始化，在 ImageNet-1K 上的 ViT 中学习。目标侧覆盖4种较小架构（标准ViT、Swin、线性注意力ViT、MLP-Mixer）与4个图像分类数据集，与11种激活函数对比。
AI.result: 同架构ViT从头训练时，Frozen FAct 比 GELU 提升 top-1 准确率 1.46 个百分点；统一训练配置下，16个设置中有15个取得最高平均准确率，较最优常规激活最多提升1.71个百分点；在相同搜索预算下对各激活独立调学习率与权重衰减时，仍11次排名第一、4次第二、1次第四。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明学到的激活函数可脱离其学习时的权重，跨视觉架构迁移并保持增益，说明激活函数构成本身是一种可迁移、可复用的知识形式。

title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-training to Post-training
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on extended reasoning traces, yet the training signals used to shape this behavior remain coarse. Supervised fine-tuning on full trajectories forces the model to imitate an entire demonstration, overconstraining its output distribution, while trajectory-level reinforcement learning provides only weak credit assignment, rewarding or penalizing whole completions without identifying where they succeed or fail. We propose edit-based training, a general framework for learning from a model's own trajectories via localized textual corrections. Given a sampled completion, an editor identifies the first point of failure under a specified criterion and proposes a minimal replacement span. The model is then supervised only on these edited spans. By design, this concentrates supervision where the model's reasoning first breaks down and aims to preserve its existing reasoning patterns elsewhere. The method applies both offline and online, with the latter continually adapting supervision to the model's evolving failure modes. We instantiate this approach on reasoning instruction following with Qwen3-32B on the ReasonIF benchmark. Compared to full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning baselines, edit-based training substantially improves compliance with the reasoning instruction while largely preserving the model's skills on untargeted tasks. These results suggest that localized correction is an effective complement to these approaches for shaping how LLMs reason.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"编辑式训练"（edit-based training）通用框架：利用模型自身轨迹上的局部文本修正进行监督，只对编辑片段施加损失，从而把监督集中于推理首次失效处。
AI.motivation: 现有塑造长链推理行为的训练信号过于粗糙：全轨迹监督微调迫使模型模仿整段示范，过度约束输出分布；轨迹级强化学习信用分配弱，只对整体完成给奖励/惩罚，无法定位成败具体位置。
AI.method: 给定采样得到的完成，由编辑者在指定标准下定位首个失败点并提出最小替换片段；模型仅在这些编辑片段上被监督。方法可离线与在线使用，在线版本可随模型失败模式演化持续调整监督。在 Qwen3-32B 上针对 ReasonIF 基准的推理指令遵循任务实例化。
AI.result: 与全轨迹模仿和轨迹级强化学习基线相比，编辑式训练显著提升对推理指令的遵循度，同时基本保持模型在未针对性任务上的能力。
AI.conclusion: 局部修正可作为现有方法的有效补充，用于塑造大模型的推理方式：设计上聚焦推理首次崩溃之处，并尽量保留其他区域已有的推理模式。

title: World-delta: Continually Integrating Observations for Incremental 3D Scene Generation
summary: Existing 3D generation methods synthesize visually compelling scenes from fixed inputs, yet struggle to continually expand and revise a 3D world as new observations arrive. Iterative approaches often fuse real observations and generated content into a single representation, treating generated content as established structure rather than revisable predictions. Consequently, early generation errors can persist and accumulate despite new evidence. We propose World-delta, an incremental 3D scene generation framework combining uncertainty-aware persistent world modeling with delta-guided diffusion for continual scene expansion and correction. Our framework comprises three components: 1) Visual Evidence Encoding integrates geometric and semantic cues from incoming images into unified world tokens. 2) Observation-Calibrated World Modeling maintains a persistent latent world state that distinguishes observation-supported content from provisional completion hypotheses. New evidence drives selective world deltas to revise conflicting hypotheses while preserving well-supported content. 3) Incremental World Diffusion Generation uses delta-derived masks to restrict diffusion to regions requiring updates, freezing unchanged regions. Only affected 3D chunks are decoded and integrated into the existing scene. Together, these components enable continual world expansion and revision while reducing redundant generation and preserving scene consistency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of World-delta in incremental 3D scene generation, observation-driven correction, scene consistency, and update efficiency over successive scene updates.

AI.tldr: 提出 World-delta，一种增量式三维场景生成框架，将不确定性感知的持久世界建模与 delta 引导扩散相结合，实现持续的场景扩展与纠错。
AI.motivation: 现有三维生成方法只能从固定输入合成场景，难以随新观测持续扩展与修正；迭代式方法把生成内容与真实观测融合进单一表示，将生成内容视为既定结构而非可修正预测，导致早期生成误差在新证据下仍然残留并累积。
AI.method: 包含三个组件：(1) Visual Evidence Encoding，将输入图像的几何与语义线索编码为统一 world tokens；(2) Observation-Calibrated World Modeling，维护持久潜在世界状态，区分观测支撑内容与临时补全假设，新证据触发选择性 world delta 以修正冲突假设并保留可靠内容；(3) Incremental World Diffusion Generation，用 delta 导出的掩码将扩散限制在需更新区域，冻结未变区域，仅解码受影响的三维 chunk 并整合进现有场景。
AI.result: 实验表明 World-delta 在增量式三维场景生成、观测驱动修正、场景一致性以及多次更新下的更新效率方面均有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分观测证据与可修正假设并结合 delta 引导的局部扩散，可在减少冗余生成的同时实现持续扩展与纠错，并保持场景一致性。

title: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
summary: Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally, we relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization.

AI.tldr: 该文研究头部特化如何依赖训练数据量，发现BERT中句法关系特化头随数据规模增大而涌现；并在可解高维多注意力模型中证明头部特化是样本复杂度上的真实相变（测试误差等观测量非解析），且可表现为无信息区分或逐级恢复弱潜在特征的级联相变，最后将统计相变与在线学习中的阶段式涌现相联系。
AI.motivation: 以往对注意力头特化及训练中阶段性涌现的研究主要从训练时间角度考察，缺乏对"数据量"这一维度的理解，也不清楚头部特化是统计起源还是动力学起源。
AI.method: 1) 经验层面：在BERT上考察不同数据集规模下句法关系特化头的出现情况；2) 理论层面：构建可解的高维多注意力头模型，分析其样本复杂度行为，识别测试误差等观测量的非解析点；3) 讨论数据结构与正则化对特化路径的影响；4) 将统计相变与在线学习中的阶段式涌现进行对照分析。
AI.result: 经验上，句法关系特化头随数据规模增加而涌现；理论上，头部特化对应样本复杂度上的真实相变，表现为测试误差等观测量的非解析性。依数据结构与正则化不同，特化可先经历无信息（未特化）的头部差异化，或经由一系列相变级联、逐步恢复更弱的潜在特征，从而体现一种统计形式的简单性偏置（simplicity bias）。
AI.conclusion: 头部特化不仅是训练时间上的现象，也是数据量驱动的统计相变；将统计相变与动力学阶段式涌现区分开，有助于厘清头部特化的统计起源与动力学起源。

title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
summary: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge. We introduce DeepQuest, a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework for Alzheimer's disease research. DeepQuest transforms unresolved questions from domain reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses and prioritizes them through data feasibility screening and groupwise Elo ranking. It couples iterative experimentation with two-level auditing that separates experimental reliability from knowledge contribution relative to two frozen literature corpora. On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produces 42 feasible hypotheses and outperforms the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons across three language-model reviewers. The full framework achieves an audit-assessed scientific finding rate of 95.24%, outperforming both general-purpose executors and domain-specific research agents. This scientific finding rate remains stable across literature corpora and evaluator model families. Representative findings concern neuropsychiatric symptoms and dementia risk, longitudinal amyloid spatial stability, and neocortical tau-associated clinical impairment, with key associations supported in independent ADNI and AIBL cohorts. These results show how aligning knowledge gaps, data feasibility, and evidence auditing can turn automated research into traceable, evidence-supported scientific discovery. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeepQuest-3066/

AI.tldr: 提出知识缺口驱动的AI科学家框架DeepQuest，将综述中的未解问题转化为可追溯、可检验的假设，结合数据可行性筛选、分组Elo排序、迭代实验与两级审计，在OASIS-3上产出42条可行假设，科学发现率达95.24%，并在ADNI、AIBL独立队列中得到支持。
AI.motivation: 实验自动化并不等于科学理解的推进：研究型智能体需先识别有意义的知识缺口、判断现有数据能否解决、并评估发现是否推进既有知识。现有通用执行器与领域智能体缺乏这一闭环，因此需要一个以知识缺口为中心、可信可审计的AI科学家框架。
AI.method: DeepQuest将领域综述中未解决问题转化为可追溯、可检验的假设，经数据可行性筛选与分组Elo排序确定优先级；实验与审计迭代耦合，采用两级审计将实验可靠性与相对于两个冻结文献语料的知识贡献分离评估；在OASIS-3数据上开展实验，并以三个语言模型评审者在15个评估维度上比较，另在ADNI与AIBL独立队列中验证关键关联，同时检验跨语料与跨评审模型家族的稳健性。
AI.result: 在OASIS-3上生成42条可行假设，在三个语言模型评审者的15个评估维度比较中于14项优于最强基线；完整框架经审计的科学发现率为95.24%，优于通用执行器与领域专用智能体，且该比率在文献语料与评审模型家族变化下保持稳定。代表性发现涉及神经精神症状与痴呆风险、纵向淀粉样蛋白空间稳定性、新皮层tau相关临床损伤，关键关联在ADNI与AIBL独立队列中得到支持。
AI.conclusion: 将知识缺口、数据可行性与证据审计三者对齐，可使自动化研究转化为可追溯、有证据支撑的科学发现，为AI科学家在真实生物医学问题上的可信度评估提供了可复用的范式。

title: What Does Anti-Hallucination Training Buy? Saying Less, Cheap Pruning, and the Rest
summary: Preference training is the standard recipe for reducing object hallucination in vision-language models, and each new method reports a lower CHAIR score. We ask what that reduction consists of. Every trained system is compared with its base model's caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. On our own DPO checkpoints the accounting holds on Qwen2.5-VL but fails on InternVL2.5 on COCO (2 of 4 training designs). At matched recall, the base model plus the probe beats truncation for 8 of 9 LLaVA-1.5 systems on COCO and 9 of 9 on AMBER, on the two newer backbones, and when realized as actual sentence deletion. The same measure prices training signals: DPO on the model's own samples labelled by the probe or by an object-level CLIP score recovers 0.70 and 0.87 of the beyond-brevity gain of ground-truth-labelled DPO on Qwen2.5-VL (the probe 0.73 on InternVL2.5), both beat length-matched random labels, and CLIP labels buy more than probe labels on COCO. Human judgements show that the sentences the probe deletes are wrong more often than those truncation would delete; a human check of the CHAIR evaluator's precision falls below our pre-set bar, which we report as a limitation.

AI.tldr: 论文对"偏好训练降低物体幻觉"的增益做分解：去除"少说话"带来的部分后，剩余增益的绝大部分可由一个仅用11个特征、在500张标注图上拟合的冻结后处理探针复现，说明现有CHAIR分数下降主要反映可事后修正的表面偏差而非训练带来的新能力。
AI.motivation: 偏好训练被广泛视为降低视觉语言模型物体幻觉的标准方案，每种新方法都报告更低的CHAIR分数。但作者追问：这一下降到底由什么构成？现有评测把"说更少"与"真的更准确"混在一起，缺乏对训练增益来源的因果分解，也缺乏独立于被评测系统的基准。
