AI.method: 1）将每个训练系统的输出与"基座模型描述截断到相同物体召回率"对比，剥离"少说话"带来的收益；2）将剩余增益与一个刻意弱化的后处理探针对比——该探针冻结、仅11个特征、在500张标注图上拟合；3）所有判定标准在分析代码中预先指定，并在其所评判的输出产生之前冻结；4）评估8个公开方法（LLaVA-1.5-7B）、SENTINEL（LLaVA-1.5与Qwen2.5-VL），以及自建DPO检查点（Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL2.5，4种训练设计）；5）用同一度量对训练信号定价（真值标签DPO、探针标签、物体级CLIP标签、长度匹配随机标签）；6）人评探针删除句的错误率，并检验CHAIR评测器的精度。
AI.result: 在超越"少说话"的增益中，探针可复现至少三分之二：COCO上7/8方法、AMBER上8/8、Object HalBench上6/8，RLAIF-V为唯一一致的例外；SENTINEL在两个骨干上均达标。自建DPO在Qwen2.5-VL上成立，在InternVL2.5的COCO上失效（4种设计中2种）。匹配召回率下，基座+探针在9个LLaVA-1.5系统中COCO上胜出8个、AMBER上9/9，在两个较新骨干上同样成立，并在实现为真实句子删除时仍成立。训练信号定价：探针标签与物体级CLIP标签的DPO分别恢复真值标签DPO超越简洁性增益的0.70与0.87（InternVL2.5上探针为0.73），均优于长度匹配随机标签，CLIP标签在COCO上优于探针标签。人评显示探针删除的句子比截断删除的句子更常是错的；但CHAIR评测器精度的人评检查低于预设门槛，作者将其列为局限。
AI.conclusion: 偏好训练在CHAIR等指标上的物体幻觉下降，大部分（而非全部）可由一个极简、冻结、低数据量的后处理探针复现，而非来自训练赋予的新能力；该分解框架同时可用于给训练信号定价。RLAIF-V与InternVL2.5上的失效表明并非所有增益都可归因于此。作者透明披露CHAIR评测器精度未达预设门槛这一局限，提示结论的度量基础本身存在不确定性。

title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
summary: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity. ITPD takes a local-to-global learning approach that discovers the global graph by sequentially discovering the parent set for each variable. ITPD exploits temporal structural priors, graph partitioning, and the local Markov condition to swap higher-order conditional independence tests for lower-order alternatives. With an exact oracle, ITPD performed the least number of tests and used the smallest average conditioning set sizes relative to baselines. In benchmarking simulations, ITPD sat on the Pareto frontier with respect to F1 and wall-clock time and was faster than baselines on large graphs ($\geq$ 1000 nodes). For graphs with 2000 nodes, ITPD ran $2.3\times$, $9.1\times$, and $40.9\times$ faster than iterative IAMB, DF-PC, and PCMCI, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ITPD（迭代时间父节点发现），一种用于具有因果非平稳性的多变量时间序列因果结构学习的可靠且完备的约束型算法，通过局部到全局策略大幅降低条件独立性检验数量与条件集规模，在大规模图上显著提速。
AI.motivation: 时间序列上的学习与推断面临自相关观测、分布随时间漂移和维数灾难等统计挑战，使本就计算与样本复杂度高的因果发现算法难以实用。为缓解这些问题，需要一种能利用时间结构先验、降低高阶条件独立性检验负担的因果结构学习方法。
AI.method: ITPD采用局部到全局的学习策略：顺序地为每个变量发现其父节点集合，从而构造全局图。算法利用时间结构先验、图划分以及局部马尔可夫条件，将高阶条件独立性检验替换为低阶替代检验，在保证可靠性与完备性的前提下降低计算与样本需求。
AI.result: 在精确oracle下，ITPD相对基线执行的条件独立性检验次数最少，平均条件集规模也最小。基准仿真中，ITPD在F1与壁钟时间上处于Pareto前沿；在大图（≥1000节点）上快于基线。对2000节点的图，ITPD分别比迭代式IAMB、DF-PC和PCMCI快2.3倍、9.1倍和40.9倍。
AI.conclusion: ITPD是一种可靠且完备的、面向因果非平稳多变量时间序列的约束型因果结构学习算法，通过局部到全局与低阶条件独立性检验替代策略，在检验数量、条件集规模与运行时间上均优于现有基线，具备可扩展至千节点级大图的实用价值。

title: Context as a Resource
summary: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface. Yet when every context shares identical frozen backbone weights, funneling interleaved dialogues and external events into one linear session induces cross-topic constraint bleed and head-of-line stalling. Conversely, router-ticket hierarchies incur lossy prose handoffs, heavy routing overhead, and blind merges - collapsing true-conflict repository merges to a 33.3% three-run mean despite high isolated branch passes. Rather than scheduling anthropomorphic roles, we introduce ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a pluggable single-pass non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk. Across three programmatic multi-stream benchmarks and three model families, our portable trial merge gate lifts true-conflict merges to 63.3%, while ClonAct's routerless virtualization attains this ceiling with 45.9% fewer prompt tokens and prevents compact-model router collapse. Under continuous surge streams, ClonAct matches top completion (95.0%) with the lowest median wait and zero timed-out status checks.

AI.tldr: 提出无路由架构ClonAct，通过可插拔单遍非生成式Context MMU、原位Context Cell、带隔离试合并门控的Synaptic Bus与波冲刷Shared Trunk实现上下文虚拟化，在多流基准上以减少45.9%提示token达到63.3%真冲突合并率并保持低等待与零超时。
AI.motivation: 单一连续界面下的常驻个人代理需要并行管理多会话任务，但共享同一冻结骨干权重时，将交错对话与外部事件塞入单一线性会话会导致跨主题约束串扰与队头阻塞；而路由票据式层级（路由器-工单）存在有损文本交接、路由开销大与盲目合并问题，真冲突仓库合并仅达33.3%（三次运行均值），故需避免拟人化角色调度的新方案。
AI.method: ClonAct为无路由器架构，直接虚拟化上下文块：1）可插拔、单遍、非生成的Context MMU负责上下文块映射；2）原位Context Cells存放各上下文状态；3）Synaptic Bus具备足迹（footprint）感知与隔离的试合并门控；4）Shared Trunk采用波冲刷（wave-flushed）机制。核心创新在于将合并正确性作为可移植的试合并门控而非提示词级交接。
AI.result: 在三个程序化多流基准与三个模型族上：可移植试合并门控将真冲突合并提升至63.3%；ClonAct的无路由虚拟化以该上限达成，同时提示token减少45.9%，并防止小模型上的路由器崩溃。在持续突发流下，最高完成率为95.0%，中位等待最低，且超时状态检查为零。
AI.conclusion: 以上下文虚拟化替代路由器/角色调度，可在不牺牲合并质量的前提下显著降低token开销与延迟，并提升系统在持续高负载下的稳定性，为单界面常驻多会话代理提供可扩展的架构范式。

title: What Places an Action Boundary? Structure-Aware Attribution for Temporal Action Localization
summary: Temporal action localization (TAL) detectors must identify actions and estimate their temporal boundaries, but localization remains a major source of detection errors. While understanding what determines boundary placement requires faithful attribution of temporal evidence, existing attribution methods have not sufficiently addressed the temporal structure of TAL or the need to tailor attribution to boundary localization. We introduce a structure-aware attribution framework that averages contributions across random evidence-restoration orders following the Shapley-Shubik principle. We make it tractable by using the detector's receptive field to limit which time steps are ordered individually, and by approximating each order with a soft gradient path. For boundary predictions, we further introduce cell-structured restoration orders and boundary-anchored references that selectively remove adjacent evidence. We also adapt faithfulness evaluation to assess the joint effects of contiguous temporal evidence and the direction of boundary displacement. Experiments on THUMOS14 and EPIC-KITCHENS-100 with TriDet and ActionFormer demonstrate improved attribution faithfulness over existing methods. Attribution analysis and controlled interventions further reveal that class-score changes do not reliably track boundary displacement, providing input-level evidence that classification relies on content less informative about boundary placement. Code and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知的时序证据归因框架，用于解释TAL检测器的边界定位依据，并改进归因忠实度评估。
AI.motivation: TAL检测器需识别动作并估计时间边界，定位是主要错误来源；理解"什么决定边界位置"需要对时序证据做忠实归因，但现有归因方法未考虑TAL的时序结构，也未针对边界定位做定制化设计。
AI.method: 基于Shapley-Shubik原理，在随机证据恢复顺序上平均贡献；利用检测器感受野限制需单独排序的时间步以降低复杂度，并用软梯度路径近似每个顺序。针对边界预测引入单元结构恢复顺序与边界锚定参考（选择性移除相邻证据）。同时适配忠实度评估，衡量连续时序证据的联合效应与边界位移方向。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14与EPIC-KITCHENS-100上，结合TriDet与ActionFormer，归因忠实度优于现有方法；归因分析与受控干预表明，类别分数变化不能可靠反映边界位移，即分类所依赖的内容对边界定位信息较少。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知归因可有效解释TAL边界定位，揭示分类与定位证据的不一致性，为后续检测器设计提供输入层证据。

title: The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) aims to enable agents to adapt to changing tasks while preserving previously acquired capabilities. Evaluation often relies on final aggregate metrics that can hide temporary performance degradation during adaptation. This work introduces a simple CRL benchmark that varies observation representations while preserving environment dynamics and rewards, supporting proof-of-concept demonstrations, inexpensive experimentation, and easily reproducible sanity checks. Using this benchmark, we demonstrate the stability gap in CRL: a substantial drop in prior-task performance after the introduction of new tasks, followed by partial or complete recovery. This pattern occurs despite the agent having complete access to past tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一个仅改变观测表示、保持环境动力学与奖励不变的简易持续强化学习基准，用于低成本、可复现的验证，并据此揭示持续强化学习中的"稳定性差距"现象：新任务引入后旧任务性能显著下降，随后部分或完全恢复。
AI.motivation: 持续强化学习（CRL）的评估常依赖最终聚合指标，这类指标会掩盖适应过程中出现的临时性能退化，因而需要更细粒度的诊断工具与现象刻画。
AI.method: 构建一个简单的CRL基准：在保持环境动力学与奖励函数不变的前提下，仅改变观测表示，从而生成任务序列；该基准支持概念验证演示、廉价实验和易复现的健全性检查。作者在该基准上对智能体进行训练并追踪新任务引入前后各任务的性能轨迹。
AI.result: 实证显示存在稳定性差距：引入新任务后，先前任务性能出现大幅下降，随后部分或完全恢复；且该现象在智能体可完全访问历史任务的情况下依然出现。
AI.conclusion: 最终聚合指标不足以刻画CRL的适应过程；稳定性差距是CRL中一种普遍且值得关注的暂态退化现象，即使在无遗忘压力的设定下也会发生，因此需要过程性评估与相应方法设计。

title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个让LLM智能体从自身轨迹中学习经验的流水线：先从轨迹中挖掘简短"lessons"，再合并为带合并计数的"guidelines"，推理时注入全部或选定子集。核心发现是最佳记忆量取决于模型而非记忆本身：强模型随guidelines增加持续受益（DeepSeek-V3.2全量191条提升+9.5任务完成点），弱模型则在小规模精选子集上表现更优（gpt-oss-120b全量199条达51.2%，而约29条子集达55.4%）。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务中会以重复的程序性方式失败（如API分页错误、实体解析错误、未被提问却作答），因此需要一个能从智能体自身历史中自动提取可复用经验并注入推理过程的机制；同时作者希望报告在构建、测量与产品化该机制过程中得到的实践教训（包括失败案例与评估陷阱），为部署智能体记忆的团队提供建议。
AI.method: 构建altk-evolve开源库中的流水线：(1) 从智能体自身轨迹中挖掘每回合1-3条简短lessons；(2) 将lessons整合为更少的guidelines，并记录每条guideline合并了多少lesson；(3) 推理时向智能体提供全部guidelines或经过选择的子集。以AppWorld为评测基准，覆盖基线任务完成率40%–92%的多个模型；流水线已部署于IBM CUGA智能体与watsonx Orchestrate平台。
AI.result: 强模型随guidelines增加持续提升：DeepSeek-V3.2使用全部191条guidelines获得+9.5任务完成点与+16.1场景完成点。弱模型从全量集合获益少于从小规模精选子集获益：gpt-oss-120b基线任务完成率39.9%，全量199条guidelines下为51.2%，而精选约29条子集下为55.4%（两次运行均值）。此外报告了若干问题：一条高支持度guideline反而造成性能回退、整合过程中provenance被静默丢失、被吞掉的API错误导致所有任务失败却产出看似合理的日志、以及一处基线混淆险些造成与先前方法的有误导性比较。
AI.conclusion: "合适的记忆量"是模型属性而非记忆属性：强模型可承载并受益于大量guidelines，弱模型则需精选少量guidelines。基于上述经验（包括性能回退、provenance丢失、错误吞噬、基线混淆），论文提炼出面向部署智能体记忆的团队的可操作建议。

title: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
comment: to appear in Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027
summary: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCCV-6D，一种全稀疏多视图 RGB-D 6D 位姿估计器。它以毫米级重构三维空间，结合分级热力图背景剪枝、最高分辨率下的类别/平移偏移/旋转同步预测，以及基于规范坐标投票的对称感知闭式 Procrustes 求解，实现单阶段、免后处理的工业料箱抓取位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 工业料箱抓取场景存在杂乱堆叠、部分遮挡以及制造零件反光、弱纹理等挑战，要求位姿估计精度高。现有多阶段流水线精度高但内存与运行开销大，难以满足实际工业部署的算力与实时性约束；而单阶段整体式方法多依赖无差别降采样或降低分辨率来控制成本，牺牲精度。
AI.method: 1) 全稀疏多视图 RGB-D 框架，毫米级三维空间重建；2) 分级热力图机制完成背景剪枝，并在最高分辨率下同时预测类别、平移偏移与旋转，支持任意数量目标；3) 旋转表述为规范坐标投票——各点带置信度投票至物体规范坐标，配合对称感知加权 Procrustes 实现闭式位姿恢复；4) 由偏移投票诱导簇内点恢复，消除耗时后处理；5) 将热力图任务监督得到的注意力先验复用于注意力门控蒸馏目标，对师生特征对齐进行重加权。
AI.result: 在 IPD 测试集上取得 0.826 AP，单场景耗时 1.13 s，显著快于领先方法；在 MV-YCB 上达到 96.1 ADD-S；在 ROBI 密集堆放料箱场景中仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SCCV-6D 以单阶段稀疏范式在精度与效率间取得良好折中，兼顾高精度与低时延，适用于工业级料箱抓取部署；其贡献在于全稀疏多视图重建、投票式旋转估计与免后处理位姿恢复，以及注意力门控蒸馏的有效复用。

title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
summary: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill.png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill.png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill.png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill.png：将"技能"从离散文本改为可端到端梯度优化的图像像素，通过对冻结 VLM 视觉编码器反向传播获得图像技能，可跨任意 VLM 迁移并支持模型集成联合优化。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent 技能以自然语言文本注入上下文，具有离散性，无法进行连续优化（梯度下降）；而基于梯度的微调方法依赖具体模型结构，难以在不同 agent 间迁移技能。由于许多 agent 基于视觉语言模型（VLM），可以借助视觉通道同时获得"可梯度优化"与"可迁移"两种性质。
AI.method: 将技能表示为可学习的图像输入（skill-like image），其像素通过视觉编码器反向传播进行梯度下降优化，VLM 主体保持冻结；同一张图像可针对多个模型的集成联合优化；并进一步提出 hybrid skills，即文本技能与图像技能联合优化。推理时每项技能仅需 64–256 个图像 token。
AI.result: 在 4 个 VLM 与 4 个基准共 16 种设置中，Skill.png 在其中 9 种设置下显著优于由前沿 LLM 优化的 SOTA 文本技能，同时推理 token 消耗由约 900–2000 个文本 token 降至 64–256 个图像 token；hybrid 技能可进一步提升 agent 性能；用模型集成优化得到的图像技能可成功迁移到集成内的各个模型上。
AI.conclusion: Skill.png 是首个既能用梯度下降优化、又保留文本技能迁移优势的 agent 技能形式，在性能与推理效率上均具竞争力；代码已开源于 https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png。

title: World Models Favor Learned Priors over Visual Evidence
summary: World models are increasingly used to simulate physical interactions, but training a separate model for each environment limits scalability. Cross-environment prediction requires identifying the current physical rule, which appearance alone may not reveal. We therefore study visual calibration: using object motion and interactions in a short video as direct evidence to infer the current rule and predict motion under that rule from a different initial state. However, differences in data availability across physical conditions can yield a long-tailed training distribution, biasing models toward common rules even when evidence supports rare ones. To study this challenge, we introduce TailWorld, which evaluates the transfer of demonstrated rules across initial states while independently controlling training imbalance and calibration informativeness. The benchmark compares predictions with two reference futures from the same prediction initial state, one following the demonstrated rule and the other a common rule, to measure prediction bias toward common dynamics. We further propose Rule Inference for Transfer (RIFT), which learns how different rules affect object motion, infers the current rule from calibration interactions, and applies it to prediction from a new initial state. RIFT explicitly controls the influence of training frequency on rule inference, allowing sufficiently informative observational evidence to support rare rules. Experiments on TailWorld show that RIFT improves prediction accuracy and physical consistency across varying training imbalances and distribution shifts, with gains in predicting rare dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出视觉校准任务：从短时视频中的物体运动与交互作为证据推断当前物理规则，并在新初始状态下按该规则预测运动；针对物理条件数据不均衡导致的长尾分布偏置问题，构建TailWorld基准并提出RIFT方法，显著提升稀有规则下的预测准确性与物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在物理交互模拟中日益重要，但为每个环境单独训练模型难以扩展。跨环境预测的关键是识别当前物理规则，而外观信息往往无法揭示规则；同时不同物理条件的数据可得性差异会造成长尾训练分布，使模型偏向常见规则，即使证据支持稀有规则也难以纠正。
AI.method: 1）形式化"视觉校准"任务：利用短视频中物体运动与交互作为直接证据推断当前规则，并从不同初始状态进行预测。2）构建TailWorld基准，在独立控制训练不均衡程度与校准信息量的条件下评估已演示规则向新初始状态的迁移；用同一预测初始状态下的两个参考未来（分别遵循已演示规则与常见规则）对比预测，度量模型对常见动力学的偏置。3）提出Rule Inference for Transfer（RIFT）：学习不同规则对物体运动的影响方式，从校准交互中推断当前规则，再应用于新初始状态的预测，并显式控制训练频率对规则推断的影响，使信息充分的观测证据能够支持稀有规则。
AI.result: 在TailWorld上，RIFT在不同训练不均衡程度与分布偏移条件下均提升了预测准确性与物理一致性，尤其在稀有动力学预测上取得明显增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨环境世界模型的关键在于基于观测证据的规则推断而非外观匹配；显式解耦规则推断与训练频率偏置可有效缓解长尾分布带来的常见规则偏置，TailWorld为系统研究该问题提供了可控评测平台。

title: Limits of local curvature for constructing search subspaces in segmentation models
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Includes an appendix
summary: We examine how well subspaces constructed from local curvature represent the change in the gradient update field after a finite step in semantic segmentation models. The local response is the action of the curvature operator on the actual input displacement. In a study of 50 images and two models, we measure the ratio of the loss increase attained in a fixed subspace to that attained in the full space. This ratio decreases as the search radius increases. On ten images from the same sample, we compare the one-dimensional subspace spanned by the initial gradient with two rank-16 subspaces for both models. The two equal-rank subspaces are assessed at the same initial states, using the same actual steps and measured vectors. Adding generalised Gauss-Newton directions to the initial gradient reduces the mean relative error in representing the field change from 0.922 to 0.874 for the first model and from 0.819 to 0.763 for the second. At the same rank, including the response direction for the initial gradient nearly eliminates the error in representing the local response. The mean error in representing the field change does not decrease. A decomposition with fixed pixel weights shows that the finite-step remainder is comparable in norm to the field change and makes the largest diagonal contribution to the squared projection error of the field after the step. Evaluation of a search subspace should measure how accurately it represents the field change and the local response.

AI.tldr: 该文考察语义分割模型中由局部曲率构造的子空间对有限步梯度更新的表示能力，发现低秩子空间对场变化的表示精度随搜索半径下降，且包含响应方向虽能几乎消除局部响应误差却无助于降低场变化误差，固定像素权重分解显示有限步余项范数与场变化相当并主导投影误差。
AI.motivation: 实践中常以局部曲率构造的低秩子空间近似梯度更新场（用于优化或二阶方法），但缺乏对"子空间在有限步长下究竟多好地表示场变化"以及"局部响应"的定量评估，作者因此希望明确子空间评估应衡量的两个维度。
AI.method: 以局部响应即曲率算子作用于真实输入位移来刻画；在50张图像、两个模型上测量固定子空间损失增量与全空间损失增量之比随搜索半径的变化；在同一样本中的10张图像上，对两个模型比较初始梯度张成的一维子空间与两个秩16子空间（相同初始状态、相同实际步长与测量向量），其中向初始梯度加入广义Gauss-Newton方向；并做固定像素权重的分解以定位有限步余项的作用。
AI.result: 子空间/全空间损失增量比随搜索半径增大而下降；加入广义Gauss-Newton方向后，场变化表示的平均相对误差由0.922降至0.874（模型一）、由0.819降至0.763（模型二）；同秩下纳入初始梯度的响应方向几乎消除局部响应表示误差，但场变化的平均误差不下降；有限步余项范数与场变化相当，且对场在更新后平方投影误差贡献最大的对角项。
AI.conclusion: 局部曲率子空间在有限步长下只部分刻画梯度更新场；局部响应与场变化的可表示性是两个不同性质，纳响应方向只改善前者。评价搜索子空间应同时衡量其对场变化与局部响应的表示精度。

title: A Control-Theoretic Approximation to Predictive Coding Dynamics
summary: Backpropagation remains the dominant method for training deep neural networks, but its reliance on non-local computations has motivated the search for biologically plausible alternatives. Two prominent frameworks, predictive coding (PC) and deep feedback control (DFC), offer distinct approaches to local learning, yet their relationship remains unclear. Here, we show that DFC arises as a local approximation to predictive coding dynamics near fixed points, with exact equivalence in shallow linear networks and systematic deviations arising with depth, nonlinearity, and distance from equilibrium. We characterize how this approximation, which we call Approx PC, deviates from PC in its activity dynamics, and show that these deviations can be mitigated by relinearizing the feedback controller and approaching the output target through a sequence of intermediate nudges. In networks trained on MNIST and FashionMNIST, Approx PC reaches task performance comparable to PC trained with the same nudges, and weights learned with it transfer directly to PC inference. Our results unify energy-based and control-theoretic perspectives on learning and open the door to applying tools from control theory to the training of predictive coding networks.

AI.tldr: 本文证明深度反馈控制（DFC）可作为预测编码（PC）在不动点附近的局部近似（称为Approx PC），并刻画其偏差来源及缓解方法，从而统一了基于能量与控制论的学习视角。
AI.motivation: 反向传播依赖非局部计算，缺乏生物合理性，因此需要局部学习替代方案。PC与DFC是两种主流的局部学习框架，但二者关系尚不明确，作者希望厘清二者联系并搭建理论桥梁。
AI.method: 从理论上推导DFC作为PC动力学在不动点附近的局部近似：在浅层线性网络中二者精确等价；分析深度、非线性及偏离平衡程度所导致的系统性偏差；提出通过对反馈控制器重新线性化（relinearizing）并以一系列中间nudges逐步逼近输出目标来减小偏差；在MNIST与FashionMNIST上进行训练实验验证。
AI.result: Approx PC在MNIST和FashionMNIST上达到与使用相同nudges训练的PC相当的任务性能，且其学到的权重可直接迁移至PC推理阶段使用。
AI.conclusion: 研究统一了基于能量（PC）与控制论（DFC）两种学习视角，为将控制理论工具应用于预测编码网络训练打开了新途径。

title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
summary: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.

AI.tldr: ZeroVLN 是一种"慢-快"视觉语言导航框架，通过对 VLM 大脑零导航域 SFT、以语义工具调用接口连接动作专家，并用闭环强化学习联合优化慢/快策略，在 VLN-CE 上超越代表性 SFT 层次化方法且几乎不损失通用视觉能力。
AI.motivation: 代表性 VLN 方法将 VLM 大脑与可学习动作头耦合，并用导航域数据微调 VLM 以预测几何目标；这种适配会显著改变基础 VLM 权重、损害其通用视觉能力。作者希望在不做导航域 SFT 的前提下仍实现有效导航，从而保留大脑的通用能力。
AI.method: 提出 ZeroVLN 慢-快导航框架：(1) 不给大脑教授几何目标预测，而是为其配备语义工具调用接口，用自然语言把运动决策传达给动作专家；(2) 先适配动作专家执行这些运动请求；(3) 再通过闭环强化学习联合改进大脑的运动决策与动作专家的连续执行；VLM 大脑在导航域上零 SFT。
AI.result: 在相同导航回合数据训练下，ZeroVLN 在标准 VLN-CE 基准上显著优于代表性的基于 SFT 的层次化 VLN 方法；同时对大脑权重仅有微小改动，较大程度保留了其通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，ZeroVLN 是首个对 VLM 大脑零导航域 SFT 的慢-快 VLN 框架，也是首个在 VLN-CE 中通过闭环智能体强化学习联合优化慢、快策略的工作。

title: Fusing Multimodal CNN Features with Structurally-Masked Transformers for Hierarchical Sub-Pixel Tree Species Mapping
summary: Precise forest species mapping using spaceborne hyperspectral data is challenging due to high spectral similarity and the inherent sub-pixel heterogeneity of natural forest stands. While traditional deep learning models exploit spatial context through convolutional architectures, these approaches can introduce noise in fragmented or mixed-species forests. In this paper, we propose a hierarchy-aware, multimodal deep learning framework to resolve sub-pixel forest composition by integrating PRISMA (PRecursore IperSpettrale della Missione Applicativa) hyperspectral imagery, high-resolution panchromatic data, and digital elevation models. The architecture features a multi-branch encoder combining an EfficientNetV2-based one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) for spectral signatures and twin two-dimensional CNNs for spatial and topographic features, coupled with a novel structurally-masked Transformer. By using a binary transition tensor to condition the Transformer slot embeddings and constrain inference, the model enforces taxonomic consistency between broad forest categories and fine-grained species distributions. The framework is validated across three diverse Italian biogeographical regions (the Alps and the Central and Southern Apennines) using field-surveyed plots. The proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-label and ranking-based paradigms, particularly in identifying subordinate species and their relative dominance. The bidirectional learning mechanism allows sub-pixel compositional features to refine macroscopic forest type predictions, while the integration of topographic priors effectively resolves spectral ambiguities in complex terrains. This knowledge-driven method supports regional-scale biodiversity monitoring and forest characterization within the evaluated PRISMA scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该文提出层次感知的多模态深度学习框架，融合PRISMA高光谱、高分辨率全色与DEM数据，通过结构掩码Transformer约束森林大类与细粒度树种分布的分类一致性，用于亚像元森林组成反演。
AI.motivation: 星载高光谱森林树种精细制图面临两大难题：树种间光谱高度相似，天然林分存在固有的亚像元异质性；传统CNN依赖空间上下文，在破碎化或混交林中易引入噪声。
AI.method: 多分支编码器：EfficientNetV2驱动的1D-CNN提取光谱特征，双分支2D-CNN分别提取空间与地形特征；结合新型结构掩码Transformer，用二值转移张量对Transformer slot嵌入进行条件化并约束推理，从而在森林大类与细粒度树种间强制分类学一致性。
AI.result: 在意大利三个生物地理区（阿尔卑斯、亚平宁中部与南部）基于实测样地验证，方法稳定优于现有多标签与排序范式，尤其在从属树种识别及其相对优势度刻画上表现突出；双向学习机制使亚像元组成特征反哺宏观森林类型预测，地形先验有效缓解复杂地形下的光谱歧义。
AI.conclusion: 该知识驱动方法在已评估的PRISMA场景下可支撑区域尺度生物多样性监测与森林表征。

title: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
summary: Predicting part distortion before fabrication remains challenging in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), while thermomechanical simulation is computationally expensive for repeated design evaluations. This study presents a two-branch graph attention network (GAT) to predict three-dimensional surface displacement directly from STL-derived graphs. The first branch learns geometric relationships among connected vertices of a densified STL surface mesh, while the second incorporates 12 part-level descriptors of mass distribution, build-plate contact, overhang, size, and shape. Displacement labels from ANSYS Additive Print simulations are mapped onto STL vertices using Gaussian-kernel weighted averaging. Evaluated on 117 parts using five-fold cross-validation split by part, the model achieves an R^2 of 0.946 and a mean absolute error of 0.0178 mm for displacement magnitude. Relative to a node-wise multilayer perceptron, GAT improves R^2 from 0.913 to 0.946; for build-direction displacement, R^2 increases from 0.903 to 0.939. GAT also outperforms GraphSAGE (R^2 = 0.936) and a graph convolutional network (R^2 = 0.934) across all five folds. Ablation experiments show that removing mass-distribution descriptors reduces magnitude R^2 to 0.900, while removing build-plate contact and overhang descriptors reduces it to 0.920. These results demonstrate the value of combining local mesh connectivity with global geometric descriptors to predict LPBF distortion, enabling faster design iteration and earlier identification of distortion-prone geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出双分支图注意力网络（GAT），直接从STL图预测LPBF零件的三维表面位移，跨零件五折交叉验证R²=0.946、MAE=0.0178 mm。
AI.motivation: 激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中零件变形难以在制造前预测；热力耦合仿真计算代价高，难以支撑反复的设计评估，需要快速代理模型。
AI.method: 构建双分支GAT：分支一在加密STL网格的连接顶点间学习几何关系，分支二引入12个零件级描述符（质量分布、基板接触、悬垂、尺寸、形状）。以ANSYS Additive Print仿真位移为标签，经高斯核加权平均映射到STL顶点；117个零件按件划分五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 位移幅值R²=0.946、MAE=0.0178 mm；相较逐节点MLP，R²由0.913提升至0.946，沿构建方向位移R²由0.903提升至0.939；优于GraphSAGE（0.936）与GCN（0.934）且五折一致。消融显示去除质量分布描述符R²降至0.900，去除基板接触与悬垂描述符降至0.920。
AI.conclusion: 局部网格连接性与全局几何描述符相结合可有效预测LPBF变形，支持更快的设计迭代与早期识别易变形几何。

title: Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate Q-matrices for diagnostic classification models that approximate expert specifications, but evaluations have focused on the final matrices, leaving the basis of individual item-attribute assignments unexamined. This opacity limits the responsible use of AI in measurement. We propose Reasoning-Trace Analysis (RTA), a framework in which an LLM generates attribute-labeled reasoning steps through chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and these steps are analyzed to reconstruct, compare, and inspect each assignment. RTA is intended to supplement expert review and empirical validation. In a simulation study with perturbed fraction subtraction items, four LLMs recovered the required attributes and withheld attributes the items did not require. In an empirical study with 11 fraction subtraction items, responses from 536 examinees, four LLMs, up to three temperatures, and 100 replications per condition, CoT-derived Q-matrices overlapped substantially with the reference Q-matrix (mean overlap .809) but less than directly generated Q-matrices (.877), and they varied more across replications. Inspection of the traces linked disagreements to item-type coding, labeling rules, and how operations were expressed as steps. Q-matrices with similar overlap differed in fit to examinee responses. RTA provides inspectable evidence that matrix-level agreement and fit do not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理链分析（RTA）框架，通过CoT提示让LLM生成带属性标签的推理步骤，使Q矩阵的每个条目—属性指派可被重建、比较和审查，以弥补仅评估最终矩阵所造成的不透明性。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成近似专家设定的诊断分类模型Q矩阵，但既有评估只关注最终矩阵，未考察单个题目—属性指派的依据；这种不透明性限制了AI在测量学中的负责任使用。
AI.method: RTA：用链式思维（CoT）提示使LLM输出带属性标签的推理步骤，再对这些步骤进行分析，以重建、比较和检查每一项指派；定位为对专家评审与实证验证的补充。研究包括扰动分数减法题目的模拟研究和11道分数减法题、536名被试、4个LLM、至多3档温度、每条件100次重复的实证研究。
AI.result: 模拟研究中4个LLM均能识别出题目所需的属性并保留题目不需要的属性。实证研究中，CoT导出的Q矩阵与参照Q矩阵重叠度高（平均.809），但低于直接生成矩阵（.877），且跨重复波动更大；推理链检查将分歧归因于题型编码、标签规则及运算步骤表达方式；重叠度相近的Q矩阵在拟合被试反应上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: RTA提供了可审查的证据，而矩阵水平的吻合度与模型拟合无法提供这类证据；CoT生成的Q矩阵稳定性与准确性略逊于直接生成，但可解释性更强，适合作为专家判断的补充工具。

title: Rank2Replace: VLM-Ranked Slot Replacement for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
summary: Spurious correlations can give image predictors high in-distribution accuracy but poor generalization under distribution shift. We introduce $\textbf{Rank2Replace}$, which transfers knowledge of task-relevant evidence from pretrained vision--language models (VLMs) to small predictors through training-time augmentation for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. The VLM ranks object-centric slots by task relevance and guides rank-dependent replacement with same-rank slot embeddings from another image. This augmentation retains the original image's label, encouraging reliance on preserved task evidence as incidental cues change, and supports combination with existing OOD methods. Across four datasets and six splits under shared frozen slot embeddings, the default cross-entropy configuration reaches macro-averaged average-group and worst-group accuracies of $80.43\%$ and $65.28\%$ without environment labels or dataset-specific replacement tuning. Slot corruption improves both macro-averaged metrics for all fourteen OOD training methods. Combining it with slot ranking and IRM reaches $81.96\%$ and $72.68\%$. Controlled ablations support the ranking and replacement design, with gains across five ranking VLMs and six extractor--predictor combinations. Permutation-invariant predictors further improve both macro-averaged metrics over their unaugmented counterparts while using VLM guidance only during training for efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 Rank2Replace：用预训练视觉-语言模型对目标中心槽位按任务相关性排序，并以另一图像同秩槽位嵌入进行秩相关替换的数据增强，将任务相关证据知识迁移至小模型，提升OOD泛化。
AI.motivation: 图像预测器可能依赖虚假相关，在分布内精度高但分布偏移下泛化差；需要一种无需环境标签、无需数据集特定调参的、可即插即用的OOD增强手段。
AI.method: 基于共享冻结的槽位嵌入，VLM对物体中心槽位进行任务相关性排序，引导从另一图像中按相同秩替换槽位嵌入，同时保留原图标签，促使模型依赖被保留的任务证据；可与现有OOD方法及置换不变预测器结合，VLM仅在训练期使用。
AI.result: 四个数据集、六个划分：默认交叉熵配置取得宏平均平均组精度80.43%、最差组65.28%；槽位损坏对全部14种OOD训练方法均有提升；与槽位排序和IRM结合达81.96%与72.68%；消融验证排序与替换设计，增益覆盖5种排序VLM与6种提取器–预测器组合。
AI.conclusion: VLM引导的秩相关槽位替换是一种通用、轻量的训练期增强，能在无环境标签与无数据集特调条件下稳定提升OOD泛化，且推理高效。

title: OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
summary: Numerical simulation is important in ocean engineering, but model construction requires expert knowledge. Large language models support automated modelling, but code syntax and successful execution alone do not establish whether generated models and results meet engineering requirements. We present OceanCoder, a Qwen3-8B-based large language model for automated simulation modelling in ocean engineering. To address specialised programming requirements and scarce training data, we develop an extensible data construction pipeline producing 12,000 verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples across 12 engineering task categories. A three-layer verification framework checks model inputs against engineering parameters and task constraints, verifies completion of required simulation analyses, and assesses the engineering plausibility of computed outputs. Its outcomes provide graded rewards for group relative policy optimisation (GRPO), guiding the model towards engineering task completion. We also construct the first benchmark for automated modelling in ocean engineering, covering out-of-distribution tasks and real-world engineering cases. Experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the data pipeline, verification framework and reward design. OceanCoder outperforms both base models and the closed-source comparison, with Pass@1 increasing from 0% for the base model to 46.77% after SFT and 51.43% after GRPO. These results support engineering verification as a training signal for automated simulation modelling.

AI.tldr: 提出OceanCoder（基于Qwen3-8B），通过可扩展数据流水线、三层工程验证框架与分级奖励GRPO，实现海洋工程仿真建模自动化，Pass@1由基线0%提升至46.77%（SFT）与51.43%（GRPO）。
AI.motivation: 海洋工程数值仿真建模依赖专家知识；现有LLM自动建模只关注代码语法正确与可执行，无法保证生成模型与结果满足工程要求，且领域数据稀缺、缺乏评测基准。
AI.method: 构建可扩展数据构造流水线，覆盖12类工程任务、产出12,000条经校验的SFT样本；设计三层验证框架（输入工程参数与任务约束校验、必需仿真分析完成度核查、计算结果工程合理性评估），其输出构成GRPO的分级奖励；并构建首个海洋工程自动建模基准，含分布外任务与真实工程案例。
AI.result: 消融实验验证了数据流水线、验证框架与奖励设计的有效性；OceanCoder优于基座模型与闭源对比模型，Pass@1从基座模型0%提升至SFT后46.77%、GRPO后51.43%。
AI.conclusion: 工程验证可作为自动化仿真建模的有效训练信号，将优化目标从"代码可运行"推进到"工程任务完成"。

title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
summary: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training. Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. The simulator and estimator are trained offline and reused across agents without further training. Moreover, Seer executes only the selected action and adds only real tool responses to the committed history, avoiding tool calls on discarded candidates at additional inference cost. Across multiple deep-research benchmarks, Seer substantially improves agent performance for different language models. For instance, GAIA accuracy rises from 13.6% to 41.7% for Qwen3.5-4B and from 22.3% to 50.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Furthermore, our analyses suggest that broader candidate coverage can compensate for imperfect simulation, while prediction and scoring errors limit the benefits of wider imagined search. These findings highlight the potential of reusable models for prediction and evaluation to strengthen small research agents through extra local computation without the real execution of the discarded candidates.

AI.tldr: Seer：一种推理时框架，将智能体的动作提议与"后果预测+价值估计"解耦，用离线训练后可复用的模拟器与估计器为本地小模型提供引导，在不额外调用真实工具的前提下显著提升深度研究智能体性能（GAIA上Qwen3.5-4B从13.6%→41.7%，9B从22.3%→50.5%）。
AI.motivation: 隐私与本地控制需求推动在用户设备上运行深度研究智能体，但设备有限的内存与算力偏好小模型，并使端上训练困难。现有推理时引导存在三大障碍：(1) 通过真实执行探索候选动作会额外增加工具调用开销；(2) 提示式自评受限于智能体自身判断能力；(3) 模型相关的引导方法导致重复的适配成本。
AI.method: 从共享的真实研究轨迹语料中离线训练两个模型：基于观测到的调用—响应对训练的"工具响应模拟器"，以及基于以折扣终端正确性标注的历史训练的"价值估计器"。推理时，由智能体提议候选动作，模拟器预测其后果、估计器打分并选出最优动作；仅执行被选中的动作，并只将真实工具响应写入已提交历史，从而避免对弃用候选产生额外工具调用。两模型离线训练、跨智能体复用、无需再训练。
AI.result: 在多个深度研究基准上，Seer 对不同语言模型均带来大幅提升：GAIA 准确率 Qwen3.5-4B 由 13.6% 升至 41.7%，Qwen3.5-9B 由 22.3% 升至 50.5%。分析表明：更广的候选覆盖可补偿不完美的模拟；而预测与打分的误差会限制扩大"想象式搜索"带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的预测与评估模型能够通过额外的本地计算增强小型研究智能体，且无需真实执行被弃用的候选动作，为设备端深度研究智能体提供了低成本、可迁移的推理时引导方案。

title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
summary: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: https://rainzor.github.io/contextrenderer/

AI.tldr: ContextRenderer：面向交互式游戏世界模型的自回归视频扩散渲染框架，通过动态上下文学习、循环历史压缩与跨表征流对齐，实现动态条件跟随与跨代理/风格泛化，并构建 WorldPrism 数据集。
AI.motivation: 交互式游戏世界模型将可执行的世界演化与视觉生成解耦，由视频模型把引擎提供的场景表征渲染为精细观测。但在持续游玩过程中，现有生成式渲染器难以在条件不断变化时既跟随条件又保持视觉连续性，且难以泛化到多样代理表示与目标风格。
AI.method: 提出 ContextRenderer 自回归视频扩散框架：(1) Dynamic-Context Learning（DCL）实现 chunk 级交互监督；(2) Recurrent History Compression（RHC）在有界 token 预算内压缩历史，兼顾条件更新跟随与视觉连续性；(3) Cross-Representation Flow Alignment（CRFA）通过共享高保真重建，将代理重建与外观/交互变化对齐，实现跨表征泛化。同时构建 WorldPrism 数据集，来源包括智能体构建世界、AAA 游戏与开源视频，提供对应渲染结果与 chunk 级标注。
AI.result: 在 GWM-Bench 与 Solar-Bench 上取得更优的重建质量与视觉质量；定性结果显示在提示词与主体参考持续变化下可实现分钟级交互式渲染。
AI.conclusion: 以条件动态性与跨代理泛化为核心设计目标的生成式渲染器可支撑长时段交互式游戏渲染，配套数据集与评测基准为后续研究提供了可复用的实验基础。

title: TRCF: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting supports healthcare monitoring, environmental analysis, and activity recognition. Channel-independent (CI) approaches capture each variable's temporal patterns but do not explicitly use observations from other variables. Channel-dependent (CD) modeling exploits relationships among variables, yet asynchronous measurements make these relationships difficult to learn. Incorporating cross-variable information while preserving each variable's irregular history therefore remains a key challenge. We propose Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting (TRCF), a framework that augments a compact CI forecaster with a complementary CD branch. ANCHOR aggregates observed values and timestamps at shared temporal locations, retaining observation support to form compact CI features. BRIDGE constructs complementary features through history completion. It first estimates each variable's historical values from its own observations, then uses differences between other variables' observed and estimated values at nearby times to correct missing entries. The completed history preserves observed values and is encoded to supply context alongside the direct CI representation. Finally, the two representations are fused, combined with the query-time embedding, and passed to a shallow multilayer perceptron for forecasting. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that TRCF achieves the lowest mean squared error and mean absolute error in the main benchmark comparison, while reducing measured peak inference memory by 17.28% to 87.98% relative to APN.

AI.tldr: TRCF框架在紧凑的通道独立预测器上增加一个互补的通道依赖分支：ANCHOR在共享时间位置聚合观测值与时间戳形成CI特征，BRIDGE通过历史补全估计并校正缺失值生成CD特征，二者融合后经浅层MLP预测，在四个真实数据集上取得最低MSE/MAE，并将峰值推理内存相对APN降低17.28%–87.98%。
AI.motivation: 不规则多变量时间序列预测中，通道独立（CI）方法能刻画各变量自身的时间模式，但不显式利用其他变量的观测；通道依赖（CD）方法可挖掘变量间关系，但异步采样导致这些关系难以学习。如何在保留各变量不规则历史的同时引入跨变量信息，是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出TRCF（Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting）框架，由一个紧凑CI预测器与一个互补CD分支组成。ANCHOR模块在共享时间位置聚合观测值与时间戳，保留观测支撑信息以构建紧凑CI特征；BRIDGE模块通过历史补全构建互补特征——先由各变量自身观测估计其历史值，再利用邻近时刻其他变量观测值与估计值之差修正缺失项，补全后的历史保留原有观测值并被编码，与直接CI表示一同提供上下文；最后融合两种表示并结合查询时刻嵌入，输入浅层多层感知机完成预测。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集的主基准对比中，TRCF取得最低的均方根误差（MSE）与平均绝对误差（MAE）；相对APN，实测峰值推理内存降低17.28%至87.98%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在紧凑CI主干上引入基于历史补全的互补CD分支，TRCF在保留各变量不规则观测历史的同时有效利用跨变量信息，在精度与推理内存效率上均优于对比方法。

title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
summary: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential $(+254,-256)$ tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed $\{+,-,\times\}$ circuits in constant $\mathsf{TC}^0$ depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, $N=1{,}728$; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic ($N=1{,}200$, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, $\le 0.036\%$) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, $\le 0.057\%$) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered $>2$K-token Tango splits ($N=4{,}392$; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).

AI.tldr: 提出闭式、零梯度“电路嫁接”原语，将确定性多位算术计算直接编译进预训练语言模型权重中，无需训练样本与运行时钩子，在保持自然语言能力的同时实现高精度精确算术。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型在不进行梯度微调或调用外部工具解释器时，无法可靠完成精确多位算术，而微调（如LoRA）成本高、泛化差且无法支持行内续写。
AI.method: 三项解析机制：(1) 在无偏置SwiGLU/GeGLU层上做两层Mellin-GLU数值积分，把未知的逐token RMSNorm缩放转化为对数间隔门控网格上的平移（>250倍动态范围），并给出IEEE 754误差界；(2) 通过带符号Chebyshev不定RoPE自汇注意力与无记忆SiLU反对称GatedDeltaNet位移实现跨token尺度消去；(3) 轴对齐宽度扩展(d→d+K)配√(d/(d+K))范数补偿、Base-1000规范的BPE输出、差分(+254,−256)绑定解嵌矩阵。另配自动化5阶段编译器，在常数TC⁰深度内合成4–8位有符号{+,-,×}电路，并覆盖3文字布尔与5位Majority/Parity电路，辅以因子化块稀疏sidecar控制显存。
AI.result: 6位算术(N=1,200, BF16)上IBM Granite 4.2 3B与Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B分别达99.17%/100.00% ALU前缀准确率（FP32 sidecar下100%），句中续写达98%–100%，远超12.8K样本LoRA(42.2%/61.7%，行内续写0%)。布尔电路100%(N=1,728)与Majority/Parity 100%。A100显存7.89/10.65 GiB（INT8/INT4+FP32 sidecar下4.60/8.14 GiB），14/14预注册长文本Tango划分全部通过，0次OOD触发。
AI.conclusion: 纯解析式权重注入可作为梯度微调的替代范式，以极少活跃参数与可控显存开销在预训练LM中实现可验证、可组合、保持自然语言能力的精确算术与逻辑电路计算。

title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Qiming Huang, Hanze Dong, and Jipeng Zhang contributed equally
summary: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlighting a relevant region can expose diagnostic evidence the model previously missed, but the added visual cue can also induce incorrect associations. As a result, even a ground-truth mask can correct some answers while turning initially correct ones into incorrect ones. Together, these findings show that acquiring the right mask is not enough. An agent must also decide how to present the evidence and whether it should change the answer. We therefore introduce TUNE (Tool Use is Not Enough), an evidence-management harness that explicitly manages what evidence to acquire, how to present it, and whether to accept the resulting answer update. Across three public medical VQA benchmarks, evidence management improves the fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B backbone's mean accuracy by 4.0 percentage points. Full TUNE improves over direct tool use by 9.1 points on average across seven benchmarks and achieves competitive results against existing medical VLMs and agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Mask-Evidence MedVQA基准，揭示医学视觉语言智能体"直接使用分割工具"的两大缺陷（证据呈现方式敏感、掩码带来证据权衡），并提出证据管理框架TUNE，在七个基准上平均比直接工具使用高9.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把"获取正确掩码"当作工具使用的终点，但未评估智能体能否有效利用掩码所携带的证据；同时缺少能解耦证据使用与分割质量、跨多种医学图像类型、且允许同一掩码多种呈现形式的基准。
AI.method: 构建Mask-Evidence MedVQA：2.5K样本、覆盖四类医学图像，每题配一个与答案相关的人工真值掩码及多种渲染方式；据此开展直接工具使用研究，并设计TUNE（Tool Use is Not Enough）证据管理框架，显式管理"获取什么证据、如何呈现证据、是否接受答案更新"三个环节。
AI.result: 同一固定掩码的不同渲染会显著改变模型行为；真值掩码既能纠正错误答案，也会把原本正确的答案变错，体现证据权衡。证据管理使微调后的Qwen3.5-9B主干平均准确率提升4.0个百分点；完整TUNE在七个基准上平均比直接工具使用高9.1个百分点，并与现有医学VLM及智能体相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 获得正确掩码并不充分，智能体还需决策证据呈现方式与是否采纳答案更新；证据管理是提升医学多模态智能体工具使用效用的关键方向。

title: Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. XX pages, X figures. Code: https://github.com/Cosmonaught/Mambaflownp
summary: Interpolating a spatial field, such as daily maximum temperature, from sparse, irregularly located observations recurs across the environmental and health sciences. Standard Gaussian-process kriging refits hyperparameters and solves an $O(N^3)$ system for every new field. When many related fields are observed, such as daily maps from one sensor network, neural processes (NPs) instead learn the interpolation map from past fields and predict a new field in one forward pass. Joint-predictive variants, which sample whole fields rather than independent per-location values, typically use self-attention over context and query points, costing $O(K^2)$ in the combined point count $K$ and limiting practical use to a few thousand points. State-space models offer a linear-time alternative, but a direct state-space adaptation compresses the context into one hidden state before reading queries, reducing what the decoder sees. We propose MambaFlowNP, a linear-compute joint-predictive NP trained with conditional flow matching. A multi-directional Mamba-2 scan reads context and query tokens in one shared sequence, so each query's velocity is read from its own scan position rather than a compressed context summary, and because queries only read the scan state, predictions are consistent across query sets. MambaFlowNP is competitive with the strongest attention-based joint-predictive baselines on synthetic Matérn Gaussian-process benchmarks, and on regional to continental-scale NOAA temperature interpolation it attains the lowest RMSE and CRPS and near-nominal coverage on every tier, while running 114--784$\times$ faster than the strongest joint-predictive baseline. A single forward pass scales to $10^6$ points on one NVIDIA L40S GPU in under a second. This makes joint prediction feasible for continental-scale, irregularly sampled sensor networks; predictive quality is evaluated up to $K=5{,}580$.

AI.tldr: 提出 MambaFlowNP：一种基于条件流匹配训练、采用多方向 Mamba-2 扫描的线性复杂度联合预测神经过程，实现大陆尺度不规则传感器网络的空间场插值，速度快 114–784 倍且精度更优。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏、不规则位置观测插值空间场（如日最高气温）是环境与健康科学的常见任务。高斯过程克里金需为每个新场重新拟合超参数并求解 O(N^3) 线性系统；神经网络过程可一次前向完成插值，但联合预测变体依赖上下文与查询点间的自注意力，代价为 O(K^2)，仅适用于数千点；直接的状态空间改造则把上下文压缩为单一隐状态，削弱了解码器可见的信息。
AI.method: MambaFlowNP：以条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）训练联合预测神经过程；用多方向 Mamba-2 扫描将上下文与查询 token 置于同一共享序列中读取，每个查询的流速从自身扫描位置获得，而非来自压缩后的上下文摘要；由于查询仅读取扫描状态，预测在不同查询集合间保持一致；总体计算为线性复杂度。
AI.result: 在合成 Matérn 高斯过程基准上与最强的注意力型联合预测基线相当；在 NOAA 区域至大陆尺度温度插值上，各层级均取得最低 RMSE 与 CRPS 及接近名义的覆盖率，速度比最强基线快 114–784 倍；单次前向在单块 NVIDIA L40S 上不到一秒即可扩展到 10^6 点；预测质量评估至 K=5,580。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使联合预测在大陆尺度、不规则采样的传感器网络上可行：以线性计算量保留逐查询的完整上下文读取，兼顾精度、不确定度校准与可扩展性。

title: Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces
summary: Set pieces produce about a third of non-penalty expected goals (xG), yet they are usually evaluated by what happened next. We present Monte Carlo Pass Search (MCPS) for set pieces, which treats a corner or a lofted free kick as a distribution over plausible executions and plausible futures instead of a single realised event. From the pre-kick state, MCPS proposes counterfactual deliveries and counterfactual set-ups (where the attackers stand at the kick), plays each out many times in a world model (3D ball physics, a generative model of all 22 players, the keeper's come-or-stay decision and a Player-to-Touch model) and scores every future with a value model. On 249 deliveries from 30 Serie A 2025/26 matches, with every model applied only to matches it never saw, the best available delivery is worth 0.0085 xG more than the one kicked (+28 %), mainly because it reaches an attacker before the keeper. Searching where the attackers stand as well adds +0.0027 xG with the observed ball and +0.0033 on top of the best ball; designing their runs too adds +0.0007 more. We show how to keep such a search honest, and estimate how much more data each component needs before a club could rely on it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出蒙特卡洛传球搜索（MCPS）框架，将角球与高吊任意球视为"执行方案×未来演化"的分布而非单次已实现事件，通过世界模型多次模拟并结合价值模型评分，在249次意甲定位球上找到比实际主罚更优的传球，最优可达+0.0085 xG（+28%）。
AI.motivation: 定位球贡献了约三分之一的非点球xG，但现有评估方式仅看"实际发生了什么"，属于事后归因，无法回答"是否存在更好的选择"。作者希望建立一种反事实、前瞻性的评估范式，量化单次传球的可改进空间，并区分球路设计、站位设计与跑动设计各自的增益。
AI.method: MCPS以开球前状态为起点，采样反事实传球方案与反事实站位（进攻球员在开球瞬间的位置），对每个方案在世界模型中反复推演：包括3D球体物理、全部22名球员的生成式模型、门将出击/留守决策模型与球员触球（Player-to-Touch）模型；再用价值模型对每条推演出的未来打分。实验使用2025/26赛季30场意甲共249次传球，所有模型仅在未见过的比赛上评估，并给出保证搜索诚实性（避免乐观偏差）的方法及各部件的样本量需求估计。
AI.result: 最优可选传球比实际主罚多0.0085 xG（+28%），主要收益来自球能在门将之前找到进攻球员；在固定实际球路下优化站位额外增益+0.0027 xG，在实际球路之上叠加最优球路后站位优化再贡献+0.0033 xG；进一步设计跑动路线再加+0.0007 xG。
AI.conclusion: 定位球决策存在可观且可被系统识别的改进空间，且增益结构可分解为"球—站位—跑动"三个层级，其中球路选择贡献最大、站位次之、跑动设计最小但仍有正收益。作者强调反事实搜索需严格隔离训练/评估数据以保持评估诚实，并给出了各组件在俱乐部实际落地前所需的数据规模估计。

title: TrajCal: Trajectory-Calibrated Time Schedules for Few-Step Flow Sampling
summary: Flow matching enables high-quality image and video generation, but its iterative sampling process requires repeated evaluations of large neural networks. Existing few-step methods can distort the output and reduce its agreement with a many-step reference. We propose TrajCal, a training-free calibration framework for few-step sampling. Based on scatter search, a well-established metaheuristic for difficult optimization problems, TrajCal starts with diverse seed schedules, deforms and combines these candidates, and selects one fixed schedule by final output fidelity for reuse on new inputs. For both image and video generation, TrajCal achieves higher reference fidelity than all compared baselines at low evaluation budgets while maintaining competitive visual quality. The search is effective even with randomly generated seeds, while trajectory-based seeds further improve fidelity. For cross-style generalization, photography-calibrated schedules also improve fidelity on unseen image styles.

AI.tldr: TrajCal：基于散射搜索的无训练少步采样轨迹标定框架，通过搜索一组固定时间步调度，在低评估预算下提升图像/视频生成与多步参考的保真度。
AI.motivation: 流匹配（flow matching）虽能生成高质量图像与视频，但迭代采样需反复评估大型神经网络，计算开销大。现有少步采样方法会使输出发生畸变，并与多步参考结果的一致性下降。作者希望在不重新训练模型的前提下，改善少步采样的参考保真度。
AI.method: 提出 TrajCal，一种免训练（training-free）的少步采样标定框架。方法借鉴散射搜索（scatter search）这一求解困难优化问题的元启发式算法：从多样化的种子调度（seed schedules）出发，对候选调度进行变形（deform）与组合（combine），再依据最终输出保真度选出一个固定调度，并复用于新输入。种子可由随机生成，也可基于轨迹生成。
AI.result: 在图像与视频生成任务上，TrajCal 在低评估预算下相较于所有对比基线取得更高的参考保真度，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量；即使使用随机生成的种子，搜索仍然有效，而基于轨迹的种子可进一步提升保真度；在跨风格泛化方面，以摄影图像标定得到的调度也能提升未见图像风格上的保真度。
AI.conclusion: TrajCal 表明，将元启发式搜索用于固定采样调度的离线标定，是一种无需训练即可提升少步流匹配采样保真度的有效途径，且所得调度具备一定的跨输入与跨风格泛化能力。

title: Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
summary: Continuous diffusion models generate discrete data through stochastic dynamics in an embedding space. We consider jump diffusions that additionally reset coordinates to embeddings of categorical values. A coordinate's own corrupted state can make prediction easy, potentially reducing the pressure to learn dependencies between coordinates. We study leave-one-out (LOO) prediction, in which each coordinate is predicted from the corrupted states of the other coordinates. We show that, under stated assumptions, jump diffusions with complete coordinate resets and state-independent clocks preserve the prescribed marginals when reset destinations use exact LOO probabilities and the drift uses the full endpoint posterior. We further show that this drift can be constructed from LOO probabilities by analytic likelihood completion without additional network evaluations. We evaluate unrestricted, LOO, and completed predictions on Text8 and LM1B text generation and ZINC250k molecular graph generation. LOO-based variants improve key generation metrics over matched unrestricted controls on all three datasets. Controlled interventions assess reliance on local inputs and context, and we analyze the effect of analytic likelihood completion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带有坐标重置的跳跃扩散（jump diffusion）连续扩散模型，提出用留一法（LOO）预测来削弱坐标自身被污染状态带来的"捷径"，并从理论上证明在完全重置、状态无关时钟、重置目标使用精确LOO概率且漂移使用完整端点后验的条件下，规定边际分布得以保持；同时给出无需额外网络评估的解析似然补全方法，在Text8、LM1B与ZINC250k上验证LOO变体优于匹配的无限制基线。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散模型通过嵌入空间中的随机动力学生成离散数据，而额外将坐标重置为类别值嵌入的跳跃扩散存在一个隐患：某坐标自身的污染状态就足以让预测变得容易，从而降低模型学习坐标间依赖关系的压力，可能导致生成质量受限。作者希望显式消除这种"自我信息泄漏"，迫使模型依赖其他坐标的上下文。
AI.method: 提出LOO预测范式：每个坐标仅由其他坐标的污染状态来预测，而非包含自身状态。理论上刻画了保持规定边际的条件——完全坐标重置、状态无关时钟、重置目标采用精确LOO概率、漂移采用完整端点后验。进一步证明该漂移可由LOO概率经解析似然补全（analytic likelihood completion）构造，无需额外网络前向评估。实验上在Text8、LM1B文本生成与ZINC250k分子图生成上对比unrestricted、LOO与completed三种预测，并设计受控干预实验考察对局部输入与上下文的依赖。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，基于LOO的变体在关键生成指标上均优于匹配的无限制对照组。受控干预实验揭示了模型对局部输入与上下文的依赖程度，并量化分析了解析似然补全的效果。
AI.conclusion: 以LOO预测替代包含自身状态的预测，可在保持规定边际的理论保证下有效缓解跳跃扩散中的捷径学习问题，提升离散数据（文本与分子图）生成质量；解析似然补全提供了无需额外网络评估的实用实现路径。

title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
summary: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FLUID 框架，用证据依据、必要性与时机灵活性来建模、评估并实现多模态任务引导中的灵活交互，并构建实时引导智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有基准把合成对话当作"说什么、何时说"的固定目标，忽略了实时任务引导的本质灵活性：同一任务允许多种措辞与时机，有时最佳动作是保持沉默。
AI.method: 利用 WTaG 与 HoloAssist 中自然发生的人-人引导数据，将干预标注/表示为支撑证据、必要性与时机灵活性，并用该表示同时用于灵活引导的评估与实时引导智能体的构建。
AI.result: 所构建智能体在响应正确性、干预精确性、引导及时性与响应延迟的综合平衡上优于所评估系统，但在避免语音重叠（speech overlap）方面仍有改进空间。
AI.conclusion: FLUID 使情境化任务引导从僵化的参考匹配转向更自然、自适应的"人—AI"交互。

title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
comment: 43 pages, including supplementary material. Zhengru Fang and Zehao Liu contributed equally. Project page: https://egowitness.github.io/ ; Code: https://github.com/egowitness/EgoWitness
summary: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.

AI.tldr: 该文提出首个面向自我中心长视频的实例级空间记忆基准EgoWitness（8,453题、约324小时），揭示现有VLM在此任务上表现很差（开放权重模型最高46.97%），并据此设计空间记忆智能体EgoClue，通过五工具+两阶段训练将4B控制器准确率从23.64%提升至72.65%。
AI.motivation: 回答"某物体最后在哪里、何时被看到、被谁看到"需要在跨天、跨人的条件下识别同一实例。现有长视频基准主要考察事件、物体类别或相对位置，实例级空间记忆在多模态模型中基本未被检验，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 构建EgoWitness基准：8,453个人工核验问题，覆盖约324小时、跨周与短时程的自我中心录制，七大能力（从识别物体/房间到回忆目击者、推理房间访问）；包含100万+经审核掩码、34个注册地标与21类可移动物体标签，并通过房间时间线关联。方法上提出EgoClue空间记忆智能体：检索候选区间、验证实例身份、用五个工具计算时空关系；采用SFT+GRPO两阶段训练。
AI.result: 十二个直接VLM中，开放权重模型最高仅46.97%，在"谁最后看到该物体"上无一超过35%。EgoClue将4B控制器在1,320道留出题上的准确率由23.64%提升至72.65%；证据链综合方法在跨周问题上达74.85%，与最佳直接VLM持平，并在训练未覆盖环境中达到80.56%。
AI.conclusion: 实例级空间记忆是当前VLM的显著短板；将记忆问题分解为检索—身份验证—时空关系计算，并以工具增强的智能体方式求解，可大幅缩小差距，且具备跨环境泛化能力。

title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
summary: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.

AI.tldr: 提出Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA)，按照token位置设定的静态无参数规则，仅在隐（特征）维度上计算部分点积注意力，训练与推理更高效且性能不降反升。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力几乎都做在token维度，鲜有关注特征（隐）维度的稀疏性；同时质疑注意力是否必须完整计算query与key的全量点积才能有效。
AI.method: 保留query和key投影不变，依据token位置设定静态、无参数的规则，仅计算部分点积，使注意力在隐藏特征维度上稀疏；利用RoPE结构将key和query拆分为可省略的部分；从零训练LLM验证；并将HiSA扩展到FlashAttention-3 kernel以支持训练与推理。
AI.result: 仅计算约三分之一的query-key乘积时，性能相较完整点积不降反升；推理阶段提升解码速度、降低内存占用；稠密注意力会自发学习抑制HiSA所丢弃的注意力分数部分，为该设计提供佐证。
AI.conclusion: 注意力在特征维度上的部分点积足以甚至优于完整点积，HiSA提供了一种token稀疏之外的新稀疏范式，兼具效率与效果，并可高效实现于FlashAttention-3。

title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers
summary:
Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbf{GLiDE}, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters.
  Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens.
  Across five model sizes, GLiDE lies on the performance--parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face \DI{}, with each model outperforming evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. \dmtwo{} (27B) achieves a hidden-set score of 71.52, with an expected calibration error of 2.0\% and a median latency of 92.9\,ms on a single GPU. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE~27B, which reaches 73.37 with an expected calibration error of 2.1\%.

AI.tldr: GLiDE提出一类0.4B–27B的决策模型，通过去除全注意力层因果掩码实现双向交互，并用多教师软标签蒸馏+渐进式后训练把推理能力迁移到单次前向的决策打分中，从而在不生成文本/推理链的情况下获得推理带来的质量提升。
AI.motivation: 决策模型通过一次前向对候选答案打分即可实现快速、具备置信度感知的决策，无需生成文本或中间推理；但推理本身能显著提升决策质量。核心问题是：能否在不付出推理生成成本的前提下保留推理的收益。
AI.method: 基于Qwen混合语言模型构建GLiDE（0.4B–27B多种规模）：移除全注意力层的因果掩码，使上下文、问题与候选答案之间形成双向交互；采用多教师（含推理模型）软目标蒸馏结合多类决策任务上的渐进式后训练，将推理能力迁移至单遍推理；并探索无参数循环深度（parameter-free recurrent depth），在不生成token的前提下增加推理期计算量。
AI.result: 五种规模下GLiDE均处于Hugging Face某决策榜单的性能–参数Pareto前沿，每个模型优于同尺寸或更小的对比方案。27B模型在隐藏集上得分71.52，期望校准误差（ECE）2.0%，单GPU中位延迟92.9 ms；进一步结合checkpoint平均与无参数循环深度后，GLiDE 27B达到73.37，ECE 2.1%。
AI.conclusion: 推理能力可以被有效"内化"进单次前向的决策打分模型：通过双向注意力、多教师蒸馏与循环深度，GLiDE在保持低延迟和高校准性的同时获得接近推理增强的决策质量，验证了决策模型路线的可扩展性与效率优势。

title: Thinking in Streams: Proactive Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
summary: Recognizing when a requested spatial condition holds in streaming video can require maintaining and updating spatial knowledge across changing viewpoints. We study this capability through proactive spatial reasoning, where a model receives a query in advance and determines whether and when to respond as the stream unfolds. We introduce ProSpace-Bench, comprising nine tasks across object, camera, and scene reasoning, and ProSpace-Train for supervised training. To support spatial decisions, we propose ProSpace-VLM, which injects explicit geometric encodings estimated causally from incoming frames into intermediate VLM layers, using the existing KV cache as spatial memory and spatial token selection for efficient streaming. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between VLMs and humans, while ProSpace-VLM improves timely responses and correct abstention over fine-tuned baselines. Analyses examine how ProSpace-VLM represents previously observed spatial information across changing viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProSpace-Bench 基准（含物体、相机、场景三类共九项任务）与 ProSpace-Train 训练集，并给出 ProSpace-VLM：将因果估计的显式几何编码注入 VLM 中间层，复用 KV cache 作为空间记忆并做空间 token 选择以支持高效流式推理。
AI.motivation: 在流式视频中判断某个空间条件何时成立，需要在视角变化中持续维护与更新空间知识；而模型需在查询预先给出的前提下决定“是否响应、何时响应”，现有多模态模型缺乏此类主动时空推理能力。
AI.method: 形式化为主动空间推理任务：模型预先获得查询，随视频流推进判断响应时机并决定是否弃答。构建 ProSpace-Bench（九项任务，覆盖物体、相机、场景推理）与 ProSpace-Train 监督训练数据。方法 ProSpace-VLM 将基于输入帧因果估计的显式几何编码注入 VLM 中间层，以现有 KV cache 充当空间记忆，并通过空间 token 选择实现高效流式处理。
AI.result: 实验显示 VLM 与人类存在显著差距；相较微调基线，ProSpace-VLM 在及时响应与正确弃答（correct abstention）上均有提升，并进一步分析其在视角变化下对已观测空间信息的表征方式。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何编码注入结合 KV cache 空间记忆与 token 选择，是提升流式视频主动空间推理的有效途径；但模型与人类水平仍有明显差距，值得继续研究其空间表征机制。

title: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
summary: Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. Published inhibition measurements for 79 molecules and 65 kinases revealed that some systems enriched active candidates, yet their hit yields changed little when recommendations were matched to different drugs or targets, whereas other systems lost substantially more hits. Some of the former systems also rarely ranked both molecules and kinases correctly when two drugs favoured different kinases. We further retrained the same architecture on the same data, with the training objective fixed and random seeds varied. Despite similar test performance, mean pairwise Top-10 overlap on a separate screening catalogue was about two candidates. Our study moves DTI model evaluation beyond benchmark performance to assess whether model predictions can guide meaningful experimental decisions in drug discovery and target identification.

AI.tldr: 该文系统评估了13个已发布的药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）模型的推荐一致性、命中富集能力与可复现性，指出基准性能相似并不代表预测可用于实验决策。
AI.motivation: DTI模型可对海量药物-靶点对排序，但实验验证通量有限，只能测试极少数候选；仅凭基准指标无法判断模型推荐能否真正指导实验选择，因此需要超越基准性能的评估。
AI.method: 在711个FDA批准药物的分子结构与614个人类蛋白上，比较13个已发布系统的双向推荐；统计同一靶点/药物下模型间Top-10列表的重合与分歧；利用79个分子、65个激酶已发表的抑制实测数据评估命中富集及推荐错配时的命中损失；并对同一架构、同一数据、固定训练目标、改变随机种子进行重训练，考察可复现性。
AI.result: 同一靶点或药物下，模型两两之间Top-10分子/蛋白列表完全不相交的比例分别为77.8%和70.1%；重合部分多源于对相同候选的重复偏好。实测显示部分系统能富集活性候选，但将推荐匹配到不同药物或靶点时命中率变化不大，另一些系统则损失显著更多命中；部分前者系统在两种药物偏好不同激酶时难以同时正确排序分子与激酶。重训练后测试性能相近，但在独立筛选目录上的平均Top-10两两重合仅约2个候选。
AI.conclusion: DTI模型的评价应从基准性能转向考察其预测能否在药物发现与靶点鉴定中指导有意义的实验决策；模型间推荐高度分歧且重训练可复现性低，提示需建立面向决策的评估标准。

title: LLM GerryMandering: Separating Interactions from Additive Effects in LLM Audits
summary: Intersectional bias arises when a model treats people who hold several marginalised identities at once differently from what their separate identities would predict. Auditing such intersectional subgroups remains a challenge: their number grows quadratically, and there is no agreed baseline for what independent attributes would predict. Without such a baseline, many existing audits flag a subgroup when it exceeds each attribute alone, a condition that attributes acting independently already satisfy. We test this standard criterion on 150 synthetic datasets built with no interaction. With the shuffle null, it flags 66.1 false subgroups per dataset on average, and at least one in every dataset. When we plant interactions of known size into these datasets, a repaired null lets the criterion recover only 32% of them. We introduce ADDIS (Additive Intersectional Screen), which fits an additive model over all attributes, scores each subgroup by its Additive Residual Distance (ARD) from that model's prediction, and tests it against a Freedman-Lane null. On our synthetic benchmark, ADDIS flags 0.09 false subgroups per dataset and recovers 84% of the same planted interactions. We then build IndiPersona, 10,000 synthetic Indian personas with six identity attributes, and audit 13 open language models. The standard criterion flags 7.1% of the 738 tested subgroups on average; ADDIS flags 3.0%. Gender identity crossed with sexual orientation is the largest pairing in every model, and counterfactual personas confirm it and additionally reveal a caste x class interaction in all but one model that the observational test lacked the data to detect. Much of what audits report as intersectional bias can thus arise from independent single-attribute effects alone, yet a small core of interactions survives.

AI.tldr: 提出ADDIS方法以审计交叉性偏见，用加性模型残差距离配合Freedman-Lane零分布检验子群交互效应，显著降低误报并提高真实交互检出率。
AI.motivation: 现有交叉性偏见审计存在两大难题：交叉子群数量随属性组合呈二次增长，且缺乏"属性独立时应有的预测"这一基准。因此许多审计采用"超过任一单一属性即判定"的标准，但该条件在属性独立时本就能被满足，导致大量误报，无法区分真实交互效应与单属性效应的叠加。
AI.method: 1) 在150个无交互的合成数据集上检验标准判据与shuffle零分布的表现；2) 提出ADDIS：对所有属性拟合加性模型，以子群相对该模型预测的加性残差距离（ARD）作为评分，并用Freedman-Lane置换零分布进行显著性检验；3) 构建IndiPersona——10,000个具六种身份属性的合成印度人物，审计13个开源语言模型，并用反事实人物做交叉验证。
AI.result: shuffle零分布下标准判据平均每数据集误报66.1个子群，且每个数据集至少误报1个；植入已知交互后，修复后的零分布仅能回收32%。ADDIS在同一基准上每数据集误报0.09个，回收84%的植入交互。在IndiPersona上，738个测试子群中标准判据平均标记7.1%、ADDIS标记3.0%；各模型中性别认同×性取向均为最大配对，反事实人物进一步揭示出近乎所有模型都存在观测数据无法探测的种姓×阶层交互。
AI.conclusion: 审计所报告的交叉性偏见很大一部分可由独立的单属性效应解释，即存在系统性误报；但仍有小部分真实交互效应稳健存续。ADDIS提供了兼具低误报与高检出的审计基准，反事实方法可补充观测数据在稀有交叉子群上的数据不足。

title: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
summary: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WHU-Road3D——一个约100公里、涵盖15类路面要素的大规模多模态路面制图数据集（MLS点云+全景影像+轨迹+矢量化与逐点实例标注），并系统综述了现有数据集与方法。
AI.motivation: 高清地图、道路资产管理与智能交通系统需要精确提取与制图路面要素；但现有基准数据集在语义丰富度、数据模态多样性和场景复杂度三方面仍存在不足，缺少支持细粒度实例级路面要素制图的多模态数据资源。
AI.method: 首先从"俯视—透视""大范围—局部尺度""粗粒度—细粒度"三个维度综述路面要素提取与制图的基准数据集，并系统梳理相关提取方法；进而构建WHU-Road3D数据集，采集约100 km中国高速公路与城市道路，融合MLS激光点云、同步全景影像、车辆轨迹、详细矢量化标注与路面要素逐点实例标注，覆盖15类要素（道路边界、斑马线、车道分隔线、停止线等常见标线及10类方向符号），并提供基准方法代码。
AI.result: 据作者所知，WHU-Road3D是首个覆盖如此全面路面要素类别的多模态制图数据集，可支撑路面要素实例分割、全要素提取与制图等研究，同时为层次化道路拓扑推理、地图更新和街景生成提供数据基础；数据集与基准代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过构建大规模、多模态、细粒度标注的路面要素数据集，弥补了现有基准在语义、模态与场景复杂度上的差距，为路面要素提取制图及相关下游任务提供了统一评测平台。

title: Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Internal benchmark and controlled ablation study; not peer-reviewed
summary: We present an internal, pre-registered evaluation of the UCMT causal discovery algorithm family alongside established alternatives across heterogeneous benchmark regimes, complemented by a separately pre-registered, controlled study of UCMT v2 Global components. The contribution is both empirical and methodological: a family-stratified comparison of three actively developed algorithm configurations and targeted evidence about which internal stages affect their outcomes. In the main benchmark, UCMT v2 Global has higher directed F1 than NOTEARS and DAGMA in selected real, semi-synthetic and Gaussian-network comparisons at the paired-run level, while trailing leading permutation-search methods in other settings. The BOSS-based UCMT v4 produces a CSuite-specific directed-F1 improvement over BOSS (mean paired difference +0.279; pair-level Holm p < 0.001), but the dataset-level adjusted result is not significant (p = 0.188). In a separate fixed-skeleton ablation, UCMT v2 Global exceeds an adapted R^2-SortnRegress orientation baseline on standardized iSCM data (directed F1 0.537 vs 0.468, dataset-level Holm p = 0.031); absolute orientation accuracy is 0.563 and there is no established broad advantage over RESIT, ANM or DirectLiNGAM. Controlled ablations show that sparsity and BIC-based refinement materially affect some outcomes, whereas the examined arbitration and automatic regime-selection mechanisms do not yield confirmed general improvements. We report performance shortcomings, multiple-testing correction, runtime costs, evaluation limitations and reproducibility checks. The results support UCMT as an implemented and empirically investigated algorithm family, not a claim of overall superiority, independent validation or demonstrated commercial impact.

AI.tldr: 对UCMT因果发现算法族进行内部预注册评估：在配对层面部分设定优于NOTEARS/DAGMA，UCMT v4相对BOSS在CSuite上有定向F1提升但数据集级校正后不显著；消融显示稀疏性与BIC精炼有实质影响，仲裁与自动机制选择未获证实；结论定位为已实现并经实证考察的算法族，而非整体优越性主张。
AI.motivation: 对自研UCMT算法族进行客观、可复现的内部评估，厘清其相对既有方法（NOTEARS、DAGMA、置换搜索类、BOSS等）的真实表现边界，并识别内部哪些阶段真正影响结果，避免过度宣称优越性。
AI.method: 预注册的、按算法族分层的基准比较：三种在研配置（UCMT v2 Global、UCMT v4 等）对照NOTEARS、DAGMA、置换搜索方法与BOSS，覆盖真实、半合成与高斯网络数据；配对运行层面比较并做多重检验校正（Holm）。另设独立预注册的受控研究：固定骨架消融比较UCMT v2 Global与适配的R²-SortnRegress、RESIT、ANM、DirectLiNGAM；并做受控消融考察稀疏性、BIC精炼、仲裁与自动机制选择等组件的贡献。
AI.result: 主基准中UCMT v2 Global在部分真实、半合成与高斯网络比较的配对层面定向F1高于NOTEARS与DAGMA，但在其他设定下逊于领先的置换搜索方法。UCMT v4相对BOSS在CSuite上平均配对差+0.279（配对级Holm p<0.001），但数据集级校正后不显著（p=0.188）。固定骨架消融中UCMT v2 Global在标准化iSCM数据上定向F1为0.537，高于R²-SortnRegress的0.468（数据集级Holm p=0.031），绝对定向准确率0.563，相对RESIT、ANM、DirectLiNGAM无确立的广泛优势。消融表明稀疏性与BIC精炼对部分结果有实质影响，仲裁与自动机制选择未见确证性普遍改进。此外报告了性能短板、运行时成本、评估局限与可复现性检查。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将UCMT定位为一个已实现并经过实证考察的算法族，而非整体优越性、独立外部验证或商业影响已获证明的主张。

title: The Geometry of Lies: Knowledge and Persona Directions for Detecting Deception in Large Language Models
summary: Linear probes are the cheapest LLM lie detectors but often fail to transfer across kinds of lie. Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a published persona bank with roles that deny knowledge they have, plus honest counterparts. At each model's middle layer the resulting persona direction ranks lies across Liars' Bench better than single-dataset probes on three of its four models; it fails on Qwen, even when Qwen stays in role far more often. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct it beats directions from a random persona bank, but its gain over the published direction is within the range of random widenings. On lies about knowledge, persona directions mainly track a reply's wording: where lies and honest denials share their words, our three main contrasts stay inside the random-direction band on Llama and Qwen and reach only its edge on Gemma, though on Mistral one clears it. A knowledge direction contrasts questions the model can answer with ones nobody can, each followed by the same scripted denial. It separates lies from identical honest denials on two models and narrowly on a third, but not on the fourth; its other results partly depend on the benchmark's wording. On the Gender-Secret fine-tune it clears the band by a few hundredths on Llama and fails on Mistral.
