The sum of the two directions ranks lies better than a supervised probe at the same depth on all four models (on one, both near chance) but is level with the persona direction on Llama's average and behind that probe on held-out lies. More varied role-play questions do not help the persona direction on Liars' Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文考察 70B 规模下无标签"人格方向"（honest vs. deceptive role-play）作为谎言检测器的可迁移性：它在中层对四个模型中的三个优于单数据集探针，但在 Qwen 上失效；相较于随机扩增的人格库其增益仍在随机带内。针对"关于知识的谎言"，作者引入"知识方向"以区分谎言与措辞相同的诚实否认，在部分模型上有效；两方向相加在四个模型上均优于同深度监督探针，但不及更强探针。
AI.motivation: 线性探针是最便宜的 LLM 谎言检测器，但难以跨谎言类型迁移；已有的无标签角色扮演方向尚未在 70B 规模、以及"关于知识的谎言"（谎言与诚实否认可能字面完全相同）这一最困难场景下验证。作者希望检验这类无监督方向能否作为可迁移、低成本的替代方案。
AI.method: 扩展已发表的人格库，加入"否认自己掌握的知识"的角色及对应的诚实角色；在各模型中间层提取人格方向。构造"知识方向"，以"模型能回答的问题"与"无人能回答的问题"作对比，两者后接相同脚本化的否认语句，从而在字面受控条件下分离谎言与诚实否认。以带随机方向带（random-direction band）的对照方式，在 Liars' Bench、Gender-Secret 微调等设定下评估，并与随机人格库扩增、已发表方向、同深度监督探针比较；另检验更多样化的角色扮演问题是否有帮助。
AI.result: 人格方向在四个模型中的三个上跨 Liars' Bench 的谎言排序优于单数据集探针，但在 Qwen 上失败——即使 Qwen 保持角色的频率更高。在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上它优于随机人格库得到的方向，但相对已发表方向的增益落在随机扩增的波动范围内。在字面相同的谎言/诚实否认上，三个主要对比在 Llama 与 Qwen 上处于随机带内，Gemma 仅触及带边缘，仅 Mistral 有一个对比越出。知识方向在两个模型上分离成功、第三个勉强、第四个失败，其余结果部分依赖基准措辞。Gender-Secret 微调上，Llama 超出随机带几个百分点，Mistral 失败。两方向之和在四个模型上均优于同深度监督探针（其中一个两者都接近随机水平），但在 Llama 上仅与人格方向平均持平，在留出谎言上落后于该探针。更多样化的角色扮演问题未提升 Liars' Bench 表现。
AI.conclusion: 无标签人格方向在 70B 规模上具有一定跨谎言类型的迁移能力，但其相对简单基线的优势常常落在随机方向波动带内，说明证据偏弱；对"关于知识的谎言"这一字面不可分场景，单一措辞导向的方向难以奏效，需借助知识方向的互补信号。两方向相加是较稳健的无监督组合方案，但在留出谎言上仍不及监督探针。作者据此对该方法的实际效用持审慎态度。

title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
summary: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: EvoMem：一种由自演化检索技能引导的时间感知长视频记忆智能体，通过分层时间索引记忆与检索技能演化，显著提升长视频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强型LVLM的长视频检索仍依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏状态驱动的时间控制，常返回碎片化或冗余证据，难以维持连贯的证据链。
AI.method: 构建分层时间索引记忆，将不同类型证据对齐到统一视频时间线；检索时把已获证据的时间线索转化为显式信号约束后续记忆访问；引入检索技能提供过程级指导，动态调整检索内容、记忆操作与目标时间范围并决定停止时机；借鉴强化学习将技能演化建模为奖励引导的策略改进，候选技能作为外部策略补丁，依据验证集上答案正确性状态转移分配奖励，实现免参数更新的技能接受/拒绝。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上显著优于现有基线，平均准确率60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提升8.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 时间感知记忆与自演化检索技能的结合能有效解决长视频推理中的证据碎片化与过程性错误问题，验证了其在长视频推理任务上的有效性。

title: A Complete Geometric Message-Passing Architecture for Point Clouds
comment: 44 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Ancillary files: exact-arithmetic verifier, certificate and companion notebook for the Platonic color-atom computation
summary:
Three-dimensional point clouds are a fundamental data modality, and a large family of machine learning architectures has been developed to respect their natural symmetries to rigid motions and permutations. A principled way to compare these architectures, which vary widely in complexity and cost, is through their expressive power. That is, an architecture is complete if it can distinguish any two inputs not related by the symmetries it respects. Simple distance-based message-passing networks are known to be incomplete, and while there exist complete alternatives, they typically rely on computationally intensive mechanisms like high-order representations of the rotation group or higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman-type tests.
  In this work, we devise a novel, simple, equivariant message-passing architecture for point clouds, and prove that it is complete. We complement our theoretical result with experiments showing that our architecture separates challenging point clouds that distance-based message passing provably cannot distinguish. Our results suggest that high-order equivariant features may not be necessary to enhance the expressivity of point cloud architectures, and can help settle completeness for other equivariant architectures for which such results are currently unknown. We give initial evidence for this by proving completeness of a slightly modified version of SEGNN.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新颖、简单的点云等变消息传递架构，并从理论上证明其具有完备性，实验上可区分传统距离型消息传递无法区分的点云。
AI.motivation: 三维点云机器学习架构种类繁多、复杂度与计算代价差异巨大，需要以表达能力（完备性）为标准进行原则性比较。距离型消息传递网络已知不完备，而现有完备替代方案通常依赖计算昂贵的机制（如旋转群高阶表示或高阶Weisfeiler-Leman类检验），因此作者希望找到一种简单且完备的架构。
AI.method: 设计一种新的、简单的、对刚体运动与置换等变的点云消息传递架构，并证明其完备性（即可区分任何不被所尊重对称性关联的两个输入）。辅以实验验证，并对SEGNN做略微修改后证明其完备性作为初步证据。
AI.result: 理论证明该架构完备；实验表明该架构能区分距离型消息传递可证明无法区分的困难点云；并证明略微修改后的SEGNN亦具备完备性。
AI.conclusion: 高阶等变特征并非提升点云架构表达能力的必要条件；该工作可为其他等变架构的完备性证明提供思路。

title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
summary: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model--backbone pairs, decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs; six pairs also show lower option-order flip rates. They incur smaller accuracy losses under incorrect external judgments in all seven pairs and conflicting descriptions in six. In six pairs, they gain less accuracy from correct external judgments and show less favorable accuracy changes under consistent descriptions. Among pairs with unchanged semantic decisions, mean absolute changes in answer probabilities range from 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points, revealing input effects that accuracy alone misses.

AI.tldr: 提出 MM-SystemOneBias 基准，用六个配对干预在 9 个数据集 11 个任务场景的 5,323 个样本上评测 13 个模型，系统比较多模态决策模型与其骨干模型的决策稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将"决策接口偏差"与"多模态模型行为"分开考察，缺乏统一协议，无法在实践中把多模态决策模型与同源骨干模型进行可比对照。
AI.method: 构建统一评测协议，包含六类配对干预：选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息、评分量表；对 7 组"决策模型—骨干模型"匹配对进行对比，除准确率外还引入语义决策不变时的答案概率变化（平均绝对变化，以百分点计）作为细粒度指标。
AI.result: 决策模型在全部 7 对中于选项标签、无关信息、评分量表扰动下更稳定，6 对在选项顺序翻转率上更低；错误外部判断下 7 对准确率损失更小，冲突描述下 6 对损失更小；但 6 对从正确外部判断获益更少、一致描述下准确率提升更小；语义决策不变时答案概率平均绝对变化为 4.56–11.55 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型主要换取的是鲁棒性而非证据敏感性：它们对表面扰动和错误证据更稳健，但也更容易忽视有效信息，呈现稳定—敏感的权衡；仅看准确率会遗漏输入对内部判断的实质影响。

title: Does It Depend on the Split? Frozen Satellite Features vs. Fine-Tuned CNNs for Tree Species Mapping
summary: Self-supervised foundation models are often said to need fewer labels than supervised training. We test this on a forestry task: classifying 20 tree species classes in 0.2 m aerial images from the TreeSatAI dataset. We compare a frozen DINOv3 model pretrained on 493 million satellite images, with only a linear classifier trained on top, against an ImageNet ResNet-50 that is fine-tuned end to end. On the official split, fine-tuning wins clearly (macro F1 0.764 vs. 0.685). However, 28.8% of the official test patches overlap a training or validation patch, and copying the label of the nearest such patch is correct for 83.6% of them. We therefore build a spatial split that holds out whole 2 km squares with a 200 m buffer. On this split the comparison becomes inconclusive (0.648 vs. 0.640, paired 95% CI of the difference [-0.054, 0.016]), and the learning curves of the two models overlap at every label budget from 343 to 33,126 training patches. On the five rarest classes, the frozen model achieves a higher mean F1 (0.566 vs. 0.445), although the confidence interval for this difference includes zero ([-0.05, 0.23]). Diagnostics show that the frozen features mainly miss differences between closely related species, such as the two native oaks. Choosing the input size and layer on validation data (224 px, block 16) raises the frozen model to 0.662 on the spatial split. A comparison that looks decisive on the official split is thus inconclusive under geographically separated evaluation. We release the spatial split and our code.

AI.tldr: 在TreeSatAI 20类树种分类任务上，官方划分显示全监督微调（0.764）明显优于冻结DINOv3+线性探针（0.685），但官方测试集存在28.8%的空间重叠泄漏；改用2 km网格+200 m缓冲的空间划分后，二者差异不再显著（0.648 vs 0.640，CI含0），学习曲线在343–33,126样本预算内完全重叠。
AI.motivation: "自监督基础模型需要更少标签"这一常见论断缺乏在地理空间任务上的严格检验；遥感数据集常用的随机patch划分会导致训练/测试空间重叠，从而高估模型（尤其是微调模型）的泛化能力，使比较结论失真。作者希望验证：在消除空间泄漏后，冻结自监督特征与端到端监督微调的优劣是否仍成立。
AI.method: 任务为TreeSatAI 0.2 m航拍影像的20类树种分类。对比对象：(1) 在4.93亿张卫星影像上预训练的DINOv3，冻结骨干、仅训练线性分类头；(2) ImageNet预训练ResNet-50，端到端微调。评估协议：先复现官方划分；再构建空间划分，按完整2 km方格留出、并设200 m缓冲区。此外通过最近邻patch标签复制实验量化泄漏程度，在343至33,126个训练patch的多个标签预算下绘制学习曲线，并用验证集选择输入尺寸与特征层（最优为224 px、block 16）。
AI.result: 官方划分：微调ResNet-50 macro F1=0.764，冻结DINOv3=0.685，差距明显；但28.8%的官方测试patch与训练/验证patch重叠，其中83.6%可通过复制最近邻标签得到正确标签，说明泄漏显著。空间划分：0.648 vs 0.640，配对95% CI为[-0.054, 0.016]，差异不显著；各标签预算下两者学习曲线重叠。五个最稀有类别上冻结模型均值F1更高（0.566 vs 0.445），但CI [-0.05, 0.23]包含零。诊断显示冻结特征的短板主要在近缘树种（如两种本地栎属）的区分。经验证集调参（224 px、block 16）后，冻结模型在空间划分上提升至0.662。
AI.conclusion: 在存在空间泄漏的官方划分上看似决定性的结论，在地理分离评估下变为"不确定"；随机patch划分会系统性夸大监督微调的优势，遥感基础模型评测应采用带缓冲的空间分块划分。冻结自监督特征在低标签、稀有类别场景具备潜力，但对细粒度近缘类别仍需更强的特征适配。作者公开了空间划分方案与代码。

title: Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
summary: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN), improve language model outputs by generating multiple candidates per prompt and selecting among them using a reward model. Much of this cost is wasted: a fixed budget is applied to every prompt, although the computation required by prompts varies widely. Adaptive methods halt once sampled answers appear settled, but their thresholds are tuned heuristics with no statistical control over early-stopping errors. We instead seek an anytime-valid stopping rule that takes an error tolerance $α$ as input and halts only once an answer is certified to hold a majority ($θ_a > 1/2$) under the generator's distribution. We aggregate candidates by final answer with a reward-weighted self-consistency (RWSC) score and treat stopping as a sequential test over the resulting clusters. Applying Wald's sequential probability ratio test to these clusters yields SPRT-RWSC, which performs well empirically, but its guarantee fails because the leading answer shifts during sampling, and the run is continuously monitored. Our main contribution, e-RWSC, replaces Wald's test with a betting supermartingale (an e-process) for every answer the policy produces, bounding the probability of ever certifying a non-dominant answer by $α$, uniformly over time and across all answers. The RWSC scores drive the bets, so they affect only how quickly a dominant answer $a^\star$ is certified, not validity; certification takes $O(\log(1/α)/d_{\mathrm{KL}}(θ_{a^\star}\|1/2))$ samples. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm the predicted $1/d_{\mathrm{KL}}$ scaling of cost and show that accuracy improves over baselines at substantially lower token cost.

AI.tldr: 提出e-RWSC：用e-process（betting supermartingale）对每个答案做 anytime-valid 的序贯检验，在任意时间、所有答案上一致地控制错误认证概率不超过α，实现带统计保证的自适应推理时对齐早停，成本随1/d_KL缩放。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N等推理时对齐方法对每个提示分配固定预算，浪费大量计算；而现有自适应早停方法的阈值是启发式调参的，对早停错误缺乏统计控制。作者希望得到一个以容错α为输入、只有在某答案被证明在生成器分布下占多数（θ_a>1/2）时才停止的 anytime-valid 停止规则。
AI.method: 以最终答案聚合候选，构造reward-weighted self-consistency（RWSC）分数，将停止问题视为对答案簇的序贯检验。直接用Wald的SPRT得到SPRT-RWSC，但因领先答案在采样中漂移且过程被连续监控，其保证失效。主方法e-RWSC为策略产生的每个答案构造betting supermartingale（e-process），以RWSC分数驱动下注；RWSC只影响认证速度而非有效性。认证所需样本数为O(log(1/α)/d_KL(θ_a*‖1/2))。
AI.result: 在多个语言模型、数据集和奖励模型上的实验证实了预测的1/d_KL成本缩放规律；在显著更低的token成本下，准确率优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: e-RWSC给出了对早停错误具有严格 anytime-valid 统计控制的推理时对齐方法，把奖励加权的自一致性分数与e-process检验结合，实现了更快、更省且更准的自适应停止；其有效性不依赖于奖励分数质量，分数质量仅决定效率。

title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
summary: Graphic designs are ordered compositions of RGBA layers whose separation enables selection, movement, and reuse. Existing layered models represent each layer with a full-canvas or region-sized spatial latent grid, so representation size grows with the cumulative spatial extent of the layers. We present ProtoDiffusion, a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE, a multi-layer variational autoencoder that encodes a design into one shared spatial prototype and one candidate vector per layer. Each candidate conditions a shared decoder to reconstruct its corresponding RGBA layer. For $N$ layers, the representation contains $HW+N$ tokens before backbone-specific packing, compared with $NHW$ for full-grid-per-layer representations. ProtoDiffusion jointly denoises the prototype and a fixed set of candidate slots, conditioned on an image or text, with bounding boxes as optional layout guidance. The model leaves unneeded slots empty and determines the number of layers and, in absence of boxes, their layout, requiring neither as input. The same architecture supports both image-to-design and text-to-design. ProtoVAE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction from its compact shared latent representation, reaching 40.43 dB PSNR on layer crops. On the LayerD evaluation split, image-to-design achieves RGB L1 scores of 0.040 with bounding boxes and 0.057 without, with box-guided alpha soft IoU (0.850) comparable to the strongest fine-tuned baseline (0.871). On merged images, text-to-design reaches 66.41 FID versus 86.84 for FLUX.2 [klein], achieves a 0.860 text-accuracy score, and runs $19.1\times$ faster than the same-backbone generation-then-decomposition cascade.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProtoDiffusion：基于 ProtoVAE 的潜扩散框架，用“一个共享空间原型 + 每层一个候选向量”的紧凑表示替代逐层全网格潜变量，表示规模从 NHW 降至 HW+N，并统一支持图像到设计与文本到设计生成，可自动确定层数（及无边框时的布局）。
AI.motivation: 图形设计本质是 RGBA 图层的有序组合，但现有分层表示对每层使用全画布或区域大小的空间潜网格，表示规模随图层累计空间范围线性增长（N 层需 NHW），带来存储与计算开销；同时多数方法依赖给定的图层数或布局，且需为图像/文本条件分别设计架构。
AI.method: 构建 ProtoVAE：多层变分自编码器将设计编码为一个共享空间原型加每层一个候选向量，各候选条件化共享解码器重建对应 RGBA 层。在此基础上构建 ProtoDiffusion：联合去噪原型与固定数量的候选槽位，条件为图像或文本，边界框作为可选布局引导；模型可将不需要的槽位置空，从而自行推断图层数量并在无框时推断布局。同一架构同时支持 image-to-design 与 text-to-design。
AI.result: ProtoVAE 在层裁剪上达 40.43 dB PSNR，实现高保真重建。LayerD 评测集上，image-to-design 在有框/无框时 RGB L1 分别为 0.040 与 0.057，有框引导的 alpha soft IoU 为 0.850，接近最强微调基线 0.871。合并图像上 text-to-design 的 FID 为 66.41（FLUX.2 [klein] 为 86.84），文本准确率 0.860，且比同主干“先生成后分解”级联快 19.1 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享空间原型加层级候选向量的紧凑潜表示，可在显著压缩表示规模的同时保持高保真重建，并使单一扩散架构完成图像/文本到分层的生成、自动决定层数与布局，兼顾质量与效率。

title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
summary:
Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios.
  In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialMem 记忆框架，让 VLM 智能体积累工具使用经验，以两级记忆（任务记忆+场景记忆）编排视觉专家，并配合双态轨迹优化，在 MetricBench 等基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: VLM 在定量空间推理上能力有限，现有方法将每个功能需求绑定到单一预定义视觉专家，形成固定僵化的工具流水线；而处理多样空间场景与任务需要更丰富的流水线编排与专家选择多样性，这带来组合爆炸的执行空间，智能体难以对每种场景选出最优流水线与专家。
AI.method: 1) SpatialMem 两级记忆结构：任务记忆捕获工具编排（orchestration），场景记忆捕获工具选择（selection）；2) 双态轨迹优化（dual-state trajectory optimization）过程，保留成功的工具使用经验并精炼次优经验；3) 构建 MetricBench 基准，覆盖室内外场景与三类定量空间推理任务，弥补现有基准质量与场景/任务覆盖不足。
AI.result: 在 MetricBench、Q-Spatial、SpatialRGPT-Bench 上取得 SOTA；在 MetricBench 上比最优 VLM 基线高出 32%；相比无记忆智能体，记忆设计带来 9.1% 的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆驱动的方式替代硬编码工具流水线，可有效应对组合式编排空间，显著提升 VLM 智能体的定量空间推理能力，并配套提供覆盖面更广的评测基准。

title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
summary: Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. Here, a Composites World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer architecture is designed to meet these requirements. The proposed architecture combines a material encoder, a Spiking Neural Network memory block that tracks the long-term internal state of the material, and transformer blocks that learn the short-term applied strain state. The system is trained in three stages: material architecture encoding, base training on short time windows, and recursive fine-tuning with scheduled sampling to suppress cumulative error drift. The trained model is disassembled at inference and coupled to a non-linear FE solver, enabling structural scale simulation of composites containing embedded defects. Benchmarks against experimental results for IM7/8552 laminates under tension, compression and transverse shear, for pristine and wrinkled composites, show that the SNN memory block successfully tracks the material internal state and results in prediction errors between 0.4% and 4.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于多模态脉冲Transformer架构的"复合材料世界模型"（Composites World Model），作为材料尺度代理模型嵌入非线性有限元求解器，实现含缺陷复合材料结构的高效多尺度实时仿真。
AI.motivation: 纤维增强复合材料存在材料构架差异、制造方法与缺陷导致的局部性能变化，需要能在结构各处实时解析响应的材料尺度模型。并发多尺度方法虽具备此能力，但积分点与时间增量随时间步随结构尺寸线性增长，大结构计算成本过高。现有代理模型难以同时满足：表征任意含缺陷局部构架、跟踪未知步数下的不可逆材料状态、递归自驱动时保持稳定、并适配每个积分点的内存限制。
AI.method: 设计多模态脉冲Transformer架构的复合材料世界模型，包含三部分：材料编码器、用于跟踪材料长期内部状态的脉冲神经网络（SNN）记忆模块、学习短期施加应变状态的Transformer模块。训练分三阶段：材料构架编码、短时间窗基础训练、带调度采样的递归微调以抑制累积误差漂移。推理时将模型拆解并与非线性有限元求解器耦合。
AI.result: 针对IM7/8552层合板在拉伸、压缩、横向剪切载荷下（无缺陷与含褶皱缺陷）的基准测试表明，SNN记忆模块能有效跟踪材料内部状态，预测误差介于0.4%–4.8%，并与实验结果吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可在满足积分点内存约束的前提下表征任意局部构架与缺陷、稳定递归预测，实现含嵌入缺陷复合材料的结构尺度仿真，显著缓解并发多尺度方案的计算瓶颈。

title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态雅可比透镜 MC-Lens，将 VLM 中间状态映射到共享语义空间，用于检验全局工作空间理论（GWT）中的概念可及性、选择性访问与下游参与。
AI.motivation: VLM 融合视觉与文本信息，但其输出无法揭示内部概念表征；而 GWT 关于“信息被选择、整合于共享工作空间并为专门过程所用”的假设，缺乏在多模态人工系统中的实验检验手段。
AI.method: 构建 MC-Lens（多模态雅可比透镜）：分别对视觉编码器与语言解码器施加透镜，将中间状态映射到由解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，从而跨模态比较概念可及性；支持内部概念干预（反事实实验）。将“readout carrier”从单一名称 token 扩展为 token 集合，以更好捕捉与表达概念信息；并设计两项 J-space 指标追踪跨模态对齐与选择性访问的发展。
AI.result: (i) 多模态概念信息可在中间状态读出，并随任务需求被选择性访问；(ii) 反事实实验表明被访问的概念信息参与下游计算与推理；(iii) 两项 J-space 指标在受控训练中比隐状态余弦相似度更清晰地刻画跨模态概念对齐的发展，且可靠的选择性访问晚于概念可及性出现；(iv) 跨 VLM 家族与规模存在共享的概念可及性、查询依赖选择性与跨任务干预效应模式，尽管内部组织存在差异。
AI.conclusion: MC-Lens 为在多模态人工系统中研究 GWT 提供了实验基础，并可用于指导跨模态对齐的改进。

title: Why Flat Drafts Stay Flat: Region-Mean Latents Govern Texture in Flow-Based Image Generation
summary: Flat color-block drafts specify layout and regional color while leaving interior detail unspecified, yet pretrained flow-based generators can preserve their flat appearance even under photorealistic prompts. We trace this behavior to a cross-scale mechanism linking fine pixel variation to regional means in variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. Flattening photo regions systematically shifts their latent means, with offsets concentrated along a shared channel direction within each backbone. Controlled field exchanges in FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image establish the effect of this displacement on texture generation: adding the photo-derived regional mean field to a flat latent restores texture, whereas adding its complementary field alone largely preserves flatness. A second-order encoding expansion explains how encoder curvature can convert zero-mean perturbations into mean shifts. An analytically solvable conditional Gaussian flow shows how regional noise averaging enables near-unit endpoint sensitivity at high signal-to-noise ratios. This mechanism motivates training-free rendering through pixel dither before encoding, mean-field scaling, and early boundary holding. Paired low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with draft conditioning improves content recovery and produces photo-like regional means under the standard velocity objective. Explicit regional mean guidance remains effective after adaptation, continuously controlling texture and improving color fidelity. These findings connect encoding shifts to persistent generation behavior and support interventions evaluated for texture, spatial fidelity, and semantic recovery.

AI.tldr: 平涂色块草图在写实提示下仍保持平面外观，这一现象被归因于VAE潜空间中像素细节与区域均值之间的跨尺度机制：区域平坦化会沿共享通道方向系统性地平移潜变量均值，进而通过条件高斯流的高信噪比灵敏度被放大；据此提出免训练的抖动-均值场缩放-边界保持渲染流程，以及配对的LoRA+草图条件方案。
AI.motivation: 预训练流匹配/扩散生成器在给定平涂色块草图（仅含布局与区域颜色、内部细节缺失）时，即使配以写实提示词也倾向于保持平面外观。作者希望解释这一持续性行为的成因，并将其转化为可控的生成优势，而非当作需要回避的缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 在VAE潜空间分析跨尺度机制：区域平坦化导致潜变量均值发生系统性偏移，偏移集中于各骨干网络内的共享通道方向；2) 在FLUX.1-dev与Qwen-Image上做受控场交换（将照片导出的区域均值场加入平坦潜变量，或仅加入其补场）；3) 用二阶编码展开解释编码器曲率如何将零均值扰动转为均值偏移；4) 构造可解析求解的条件高斯流，说明区域噪声平均在高SNR下产生近单位的端点敏感度；5) 基于该机制设计免训练渲染（像素抖动→编码、均值场缩放、早期边界保持），并提出配对LoRA+草图条件，在标准velocity目标下训练。
AI.result: 场交换实验确立了均值位移对纹理生成的决定性作用：加入照片导出的区域均值场可恢复纹理，而仅加补场基本维持平坦。免训练渲染在纹理上有效；配对LoRA显著提升内容恢复，并在标准velocity目标下自发产生类照片的区域均值；显式的区域均值引导在适配后依然有效，可连续调控纹理并改善颜色保真度。干预效果从纹理、空间保真与语义恢复三个维度评估。
AI.conclusion: 编码层的均值位移是平涂草图持久外观的根源机制，并可解释为高SNR下由噪声平均放大的灵敏性。该机制既支撑免训练干预，也与LoRA适配相容，形成从编码偏移到生成行为的统一解释框架与可评估的控制手段。

title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
summary: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation. We propose Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer (EDA-L2D), a novel expert-aware L2D framework that explicitly models these temporal shifts by conditioning the deferral head on recent histories of expert outcomes via a sequence model. This history-aware approach enables adaptive deferral policies that anticipate reliability fluctuations and better allocate decisions between human and machine over time. We provide comprehensive experiments across three diverse tasks -- image classification, medical diagnosis, and hate speech detection -- including generalization analyses under realistic deferral conditions and irregular shifts in expert reliability. Our results show that EDA-L2D adapts more effectively than prior L2D methods to diverse temporal patterns of expert reliability, resulting in improved system performance and more effective deferral decisions. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiyaoMou/L2D-Expert-Drift.

AI.tldr: 提出 EDA-L2D 框架，用序列模型对专家近期表现历史建模，使 deferral head 感知专家可靠性随时间漂移，从而动态优化人机决策分配。
AI.motivation: 现有 learning-to-defer 工作大多假设专家可靠性固定，忽略疲劳、认知偏差等导致的人类表现随时间的显著系统性波动，而这类漂移在放射、航空、司法及众包标注等领域普遍存在。
AI.method: 构建 expert-aware L2D 框架：以专家近期结果历史为条件，通过序列模型对 deferral head 进行调制，显式建模专家可靠性的时间漂移，从而学习可预见可靠性波动并自适应地在人与机器之间分配决策。
AI.result: 在图像分类、医学诊断、仇恨言论检测三类任务上实验，含真实延迟条件下的泛化分析及专家可靠性不规则漂移情形；结果显示 EDA-L2D 较既有 L2D 方法更能适应多种专家可靠性时间模式，系统性能与延迟决策质量均更优。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模专家可靠性时间漂移可提升 L2D 的适应性与系统可靠性；历史感知的自适应延迟策略是处理动态人类表现波动的有效方向。

title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.

AI.tldr: PlayCraft 是一个自动化框架，用视觉智能体反复游玩游戏并基于其详细游玩经验修订游戏设计，以提升游戏的可掌握性（mastery）与参与度。
AI.motivation: 近期 AI 智能体已能生成可游玩的游戏，但这些游戏未必具有吸引力。掌握（mastery）是参与度的关键来源，而面向掌握进行设计需要大量人类游玩与调参，成本高昂。
AI.method: PlayCraft 在"游玩"与"制作"两阶段间交替。游玩阶段：玩家智能体观察游戏画面、使用控制、在多回合中追求游戏目标并保留记忆，每回合后汇报进度、结果、决策与反思。制作阶段：制作智能体利用这些报告修订游戏，估计玩家能力、预测不同熟练度水平下的表现，并与目标学习曲线比较，诊断游戏并通过为玩家提供有意义的改进机会（更好的决策与操作执行）来弥补差距。
AI.result: 在三种智能水平设置下用玩家智能体进行全新运行评估，以学习增益（learning gain）和学习斜率（learning slope）为指标。与初始游戏相比，PlayCraft 在大多数游戏中带来更大的学习增益与更陡的学习斜率；在每种智能水平设置下，其各指标的宏平均值均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以具备记忆与反思能力的视觉游玩智能体作为"代理玩家"来驱动游戏迭代修订，可自动实现面向掌握的学习曲线设计，优于人工初始设计及基线方法。

title: AGSR: Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution for Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP 2026). Recipient of the Best Paper Award
summary:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but Gaussian rasterization attenuates fine-scale scene structure through the projected covariance of each primitive. We show that contracting these projected covariances at inference time can mitigate the effective bandwidth limitation induced by finite Gaussian footprints, motivating a multi-aperture rendering framework for super-resolution.
  Based on this insight, we propose AGSR (Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution), a lightweight inference-time framework that progressively fuses multi-aperture renderings using uncertainty-guided feature aggregation and geometric conditioning from transmittance and depth cues. AGSR operates as a plug-in enhancement for pre-trained 3DGS models.
  Experiments on the Mip-NeRF 360 benchmark show that AGSR outperforms lightweight image-space super-resolution baselines, with gains increasing as the underlying Gaussian representation deteriorates. The results provide evidence that covariance contraction exposes bandwidth-sensitive structural cues attenuated by native Gaussian rasterization. AGSR achieves these improvements while maintaining real-time performance with up to 139k parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出 AGSR：一种推理时多孔径渲染框架，通过收缩投影协方差并做不确定性引导特征融合，实现 3DGS 的超分辨率增强。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 可实时新视角合成，但每个高斯基元投影协方差导致光栅化对细尺度结构产生衰减，形成有限高斯足迹带来的有效带宽限制。
AI.method: 观察到推理时收缩投影协方差可缓解该带宽限制，据此构建多孔径渲染框架：渐进式融合多次多孔径渲染结果，采用不确定性引导的特征聚合，并以透射率与深度线索作几何条件。AGSR 作为预训练 3DGS 模型的即插即用增强模块，仅约 139k 参数。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360 基准上优于轻量级图像空间超分基线，且底层高斯表示越退化增益越大；保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 协方差收缩能显露出被原生高斯光栅化衰减的带宽敏感结构线索，验证了多孔径超分思路的有效性。

title: Neural Conditional Gaussian Model: Efficient Data Assimilation with Sequential Uncertainty Quantification for Nonlinear Dynamics
summary: Data assimilation (DA) in partially observed nonlinear systems requires repeated estimation of both hidden states and their uncertainty. Conventional nonlinear filtering can be computationally expensive and often relies on an explicit dynamical model. In this paper, we develop the Neural Conditional Gaussian Model (Neural CGM), a data-driven dynamical model that maps unobserved physical states into a learned latent space, where the dynamics of the latent states follow a conditional Gaussian structure. This structure allows closed-form DA updates in the latent space, while nonlinear encoder-decoder mappings retain the flexibility needed to represent complex dynamics in physical space. A key feature of Neural CGM is its treatment of uncertainty in DA. The latent posterior mean and covariance are mapped to the physical variables through a Gaussian decoder that combines local moment propagation with learned nonlinear corrections. The resulting physical-space posterior statistics depend on the sequentially updated latent distribution rather than on a separate post-processing estimate. The same statistics enter a Gaussian negative log-likelihood during training, so both the posterior mean and uncertainty affect the learned model. Because Neural CGM learns the dynamical model itself, it can also be used for state forecasting and simulation without explicit knowledge of the governing equations. Numerical experiments on benchmark nonlinear dynamical systems show accurate state estimation and forecasting while substantially reducing online assimilation cost relative to conventional nonlinear DA methods. Neural CGM is therefore suited to repeated state estimation, uncertainty quantification, and prediction from partial observations.

AI.tldr: 提出Neural CGM：将物理状态映射到隐空间并令隐动力学服从条件高斯结构，从而实现隐空间闭式数据同化更新，并借高斯解码器将后验均值与协方差传播到物理空间。
AI.motivation: 部分观测的非线性系统数据同化需反复估计隐状态及其不确定性。传统非线性滤波计算代价高，且通常依赖显式动力学模型；而纯数据驱动方法在不确定性刻画与同化更新的一致性上存在不足。
AI.method: 构建数据驱动的神经条件高斯模型（Neural CGM）：用非线性编码器把未观测物理状态映射到隐空间，隐状态动力学采用条件高斯结构以支持闭式同化更新；解码器为高斯解码器，结合局部矩传播与学习到的非线性修正，把隐后验均值/协方差映射为物理空间后验统计量，并以高斯负对数似然作为训练目标，使均值与不确定性共同参与训练。
AI.result: 在基准非线性动力系统上的数值实验表明：状态估计与预测精度良好，且在线同化开销相较传统非线性数据同化方法显著降低；模型无需显式控制方程即可用于状态预测与仿真。
AI.conclusion: Neural CGM通过隐空间条件高斯结构实现高效、一致的闭式同化与不确定性量化，适用于基于部分观测的重复状态估计、不确定性量化与预测，并具备替代显式动力学模型的潜力。

title: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
summary: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes, where a generated face is pasted back into a real frame. Recent generators synthesize the entire face and leave no traces of blending. On a benchmark of 19 datasets released from 2019 to 2026, the best prior facial deepfake detector reaches a mean AUROC of 96.2% on ten blending datasets, but none exceeds 78.1% on five datasets of entire face synthesis (EFS). AI-generated content (AIGC) detectors do not close this gap. We propose TwinD, a detector trained on FaceForensics++ fakes and two kinds of twins: fakes made from a real frame. A reconstruction twin is a real frame reconstructed by an autoencoder, with the real pixels put back in a random region. It targets the neural traces of a decoder. A blob twin blends an altered copy of a real frame with the frame itself, targeting blending artifacts. It needs no generator and no face-shaped mask. Together, these twins provide two complementary forensic cues that generalize to unseen manipulations. TwinDreaches a mean AUROC of 96.3%, 8.9 points above the prior state-of-the-art, with 98.1% on the blending datasets and 95.6% on the EFS datasets. Trained on twins alone, without a deepfake dataset, single models still reach 94.3% on average over three seeds. For reproducibility, the code, trained model, and training data are at: https://github.com/yermandy/TwinD

AI.tldr: 提出TwinD检测器，利用"重建孪生"和"斑块孪生"两类合成孪生样本提供互补取证线索，解决了整脸合成（EFS）伪造检测泛化差的问题，在19个数据集上平均AUROC达96.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有面部深度伪造检测器多在"混合式伪造"（生成人脸回贴至真实帧）上训练，而新一代生成器直接合成整张人脸、不留混合痕迹，导致检测器在EFS数据集上失效（最优基线仅78.1%），且通用AIGC检测器也无法弥补该差距。核心动机是寻找不依赖特定生成器、可泛化到未见操纵方式的取证线索。
AI.method: 在FaceForensics++伪造样本基础上构造两类"孪生"伪造：(1) 重建孪生——用自编码器重建真实帧，再将真实像素随机回填到某一区域，旨在暴露解码器的神经轨迹特征；(2) 斑块孪生——将真实帧的改动副本与原帧混合，针对混合伪影，无需生成器也无需人脸形状掩码。二者结合提供两组互补取证线索并联合训练检测器。
AI.result: 在2019—2026年19个数据集基准上，TwinD平均AUROC达96.3%，较此前最优方法提升8.9个百分点；混合类数据集98.1%，EFS数据集95.6%（基线均未超过78.1%）。仅用孪生数据、不接触深度伪造数据集训练时，三个随机种子下单模型平均仍达94.3%。
AI.conclusion: 无需依赖真实生成器或人脸掩码的合成孪生策略可有效捕获解码器痕迹与混合伪影，显著提升对整脸合成伪造的跨数据集泛化能力；方法对训练数据依赖低，且代码、模型与数据均已开源以支持复现。

title: A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes
summary: We present a new adaptive stepsize rule that biases gradient descent toward flatter minima in both theory and practice, and establish the first uniform-in-time guarantees for both sharpness and loss reduction for a broad class of locally quadratic objectives. Our critically damped Polyak (CDP) stepsizes multiply the classical Polyak rule by $4$ and a mild damping factor. The factor $4$ is critical in that it produces equioscillations around the manifold of minimizers $\mathcal{M}$ to leading order. Damping provably drives convergence to $\mathcal{M}$. CDP thus operates at the edge of stability by adapting its stepsizes to local curvature. Once the loss is small, its projected iterates follow gradient descent on $\log{λ_1(\nabla^2 \mathcal{L})}$ along $\mathcal{M}$ to leading order, paralleling the flatness bias of normalized gradient descent (Arora et al., 2022). Unlike normalized gradient descent, CDP step lengths shrink with the distance to $\mathcal{M}$, enabling convergence to an interpolating solution that locally minimizes sharpness at finite learning rate. We establish our theory for a broad class of non-negative losses with locally quadratic Morse-Bott structure near $\mathcal{M}$, capturing regular interpolation regimes in smooth overparameterized neural networks. Empirically, CDP stepsizes produce a flattening effect similar to that of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM, Foret et al., 2021), reducing sharpness even in settings beyond our theory, including nonlinear teacher-student networks and fine-tuning of pre-trained LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"临界阻尼Polyak (CDP)"步长规则（将经典Polyak步长乘以4与一个温和阻尼因子），在理论与实践中使梯度下降偏向更平坦的极小值，并首次给出局部二次目标下锐度与损失下降的一致时间（uniform-in-time）保证。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降的解具有隐式平坦性偏好，但缺乏对步长规则如何系统性地诱导这种偏好、并在有限学习率下收敛到插值解且局部最小化锐度的理论刻画；同时希望在理论上解释并复现SAM类方法的平坦化效果。
AI.method: 将经典Polyak步长乘以4倍并引入温和阻尼因子得到CDP步长；借助目标在极小值流形M附近的局部二次Morse-Bott结构，用等振幅振荡（equioscillation）与投影迭代分析锐度与损失动力学，并与归一化梯度下降（NGD）的log λ1梯度流作对比。
AI.result: 因子4在主导阶上产生围绕极小值流形M的等振幅振荡（处于稳定性边缘），阻尼可证明地驱动收敛到M；损失变小时，投影迭代在主导阶上等价于沿M对log λ1(∇²L)做梯度下降，具有与NGD类似的平坦性偏置；但CDP步长随到M的距离缩小，故能在有限学习率下收敛到局部锐度最小的插值解。理论覆盖非负损失且局部为二次Morse-Bott结构的一类目标（含光滑过参数化网络的正则插值区）。实验中，CDP在非线性teacher-student网络和预训练LLM微调等超出理论范围的设置下也降低了锐度，效果类似SAM。
AI.conclusion: CDP步长通过自适应局部曲率在稳定性边缘运行，统一解释了平坦性偏置与有限学习率下的插值收敛，是一种无需额外梯度计算即可获得SAM式平坦化效果的简单步长规则。

title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
summary: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将机器人世界模型中的"动力学预测"与"视觉渲染"解耦，以3D点动力学作为二者的中间代理，从而显著降低物体运动误差。
AI.motivation: 现有视频式机器人世界模型虽能紧密跟随给定动作，但被操作物体常出现坍塌或与动作不一致的移动。作者将其归因于条件信号（动作或机器人渲染）只指定机器人"去哪里"，而不指定"场景如何响应"，迫使单一视频模型在渲染外观的同时隐式推断交互动力学。
AI.method: 将首帧提升为3D点，用学习到的点动力学模型模拟这些点对机器人运动的响应，再把模拟后的点渲染回像素对齐的视频，供任意视频模型读取；从而把动力学预测与视觉渲染分离，并以3D点动力学作为二者之间的代理表示。在DROID数据集上以两种不同架构的视频渲染器进行受控实验。
AI.result: 两种渲染器下物体运动误差分别降低8.6%和6.2%，且图像质量不下降；在真实双臂机器人上降低8.1%。此外，视频表现与仿真一致：动力学越准确，物体运动越准确；编辑点云可引导视频生成。
AI.conclusion: 以3D点动力学为中间代理的解耦式条件化可产生更忠实的机器人世界模型，表明动力学建模的进展可转化为更可靠的视频世界模型。

title: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurReps and WiML workshops at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Continual reinforcement learning requires agents to adapt when the task changes while reusing what they know about the environment. Successor features separate dynamics from task-specific reward, but their effectiveness depends on the choice of base features. Taking the identification of entorhinal grid cells with eigenvectors of the successor representation as a design principle, we build this basis from eigenvectors of the transition matrix of a fixed reference policy. With such a basis, the successor features at a state-action pair are a linear combination of the base features at that same pair, which is not true in general, and the coefficients are known in closed form: each successor feature is its base feature multiplied by $θ_i = 1/(1-γλ_i)$, where $λ_i$ is its eigenvalue. The long-term return is thus predicted from the same features as the immediate reward, no successor-feature network or replay buffer is needed, and adapting to a new task reduces to a linear regression on the reward. The agent acts greedily on the action values of the reference policy, which is one step of policy improvement over it and suffices to reach a single goal. In a two-goal gridworld, with the uniform random walk as reference policy, whose eigenvectors are the low-frequency Laplacian eigenvectors, agents built this way maintain near-maximal return across every change of goal, whereas SimpleSF and DQN lose most of their return at each change.

AI.tldr: 基于参考策略转移矩阵特征向量构造基特征，使后继特征成为该基的闭式线性组合（系数θ_i=1/(1-γλ_i)），无需后继特征网络或回放缓冲，新任务仅需对奖励做线性回归；在双目标网格世界中跨目标切换保持近最优回报。
AI.motivation: 持续强化学习要求智能体在任务变化时自适应并复用已有环境知识。后继特征（SF）可将动力学与任务相关奖励解耦，但其效果高度依赖基特征的选择；受内嗅皮层网格细胞与后继表征特征向量相对应的观点启发，需要一个有理论依据的基特征构造原则。
AI.method: 以固定参考策略的转移矩阵的特征向量构建基特征。由此，状态-动作对上的后继特征等于同一对上基特征的线性组合，且系数有闭式解：每个后继特征等于其基特征乘以θ_i=1/(1-γλ_i)，λ_i为对应特征值。长期回报与即时奖励由同一组特征预测；无需SF网络与回放缓冲；任务自适应化为对奖励的线性回归；行为上对参考策略的动作值贪心，即对其做一步策略改进。实验采用均匀随机游走为参考策略（其特征向量为低频拉普拉斯特征向量），在双目标网格世界中与SimpleSF和DQN对比。
AI.result: 在双目标网格世界中，每次目标切换时该方法构建的智能体维持接近最大回报；而SimpleSF与DQN在每次目标变化时损失大部分回报。
AI.conclusion: 将网格细胞识别为后继表征特征向量的原则作为设计依据，可得到一个闭式、轻量且高效的后继特征基，使持续学习中的任务适应退化为简单线性回归，并显著优于基线方法的跨任务回报保持能力。

title: MorphTwin: Enriching Deformable Material Responses from Videos for Morphable and Interactive Physical Twins
summary: Reconstructing interactive physical twins from video requires accurately capturing how objects deform while maintaining efficient simulation. We observe that reproducing motion in a video does not guarantee correct responses to new forces when the physical representation restricts how an object can deform. In spring-based twins, coupling between volume and shape responses creates such a limitation. We present MorphTwin, which enriches local deformation modes to capture and independently control these responses while retaining standard spring forces and explicit simulation. To support interpretable material editing and transfer, we use offline calibration to map shared relative response changes to stiffness updates on each reconstructed graph. Under identical inverse settings on synthetic scenes, MorphTwin reduces the mean absolute error of Poisson's ratio by 75.8% and the mean relative error of Young's modulus by 22.1% compared to PhysTwin. We introduce an egocentric stereo and RGB-D benchmark covering interactions with objects of varying stiffness. Real-world experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and up to 14.4% lower future tracking error than PhysTwin at interactive speeds.

AI.tldr: MorphTwin：从视频重建可交互物理孪生体，通过丰富局部变形模式解耦体积与形状响应，提升材料参数反演精度与交互仿真速度。
AI.motivation: 从视频重建交互式物理孪生体需兼顾形变捕捉精度与仿真效率。作者观察到：即便能复现视频中的运动，若物理表示限制了物体的可变形方式，则对新施加力的响应仍会出错；弹簧型孪生体中体积响应与形状响应的耦合正是这一限制的根源。
AI.method: 提出 MorphTwin：在保留标准弹簧力与显式仿真的前提下，引入（enrich）局部变形模式以捕捉并可独立控制体积与形状响应；并采用离线标定，将共享的相对响应变化映射为各重建图上的刚度更新，从而支持可解释的材料编辑与迁移；同时构建以自我中心立体与RGB-D 的交互基准数据集。
AI.result: 在合成场景相同逆问题设置下，Poisson 比的平均绝对误差降低 75.8%，Young 模量的平均相对误差降低 22.1%（相比 PhysTwin）；真实实验中重建精度提升，未来跟踪误差最多降低 14.4%，并保持交互级速度。
AI.conclusion: 解耦体积与形状响应的局部变形模式可显著改善弹簧型物理孪生体的材料参数辨识与泛化响应能力，配合离线标定实现可解释编辑；并给出涵盖不同刚度物体的自我中心立体/RGB-D 基准，验证了方法的有效性与实时性。

title: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
summary: Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens' information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. MahaSBERT-based fusion also increases precision from 0.781 to 0.808 while matching BM25 recall at 0.946. These results support the complementary use of lexical and semantic signals in this collection, while showing that improvements over a strong lexical baseline are modest and metric-dependent. The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.

AI.tldr: 本文构建面向马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划与公共服务的英-马拉地双语检索系统，采用BM25与句向量相似度的等权分数融合混合检索，在人工标注双语查询上评估BM25、稠密检索与混合检索（IndicSBERT、MahaSBERT），结果显示混合检索相较BM25仅有轻微提升（MRR 0.864→0.879），稠密检索明显较差。
AI.motivation: 检索政府计划需将公民的信息需求与正式的行政描述匹配，且常跨语言、跨术语；单语、单信号检索难以覆盖马拉地语用户与专业行政用语之间的语义鸿沟，因此需要评估词汇与语义信号在双语公共服务检索中的互补性。
AI.method: 构建英-马拉地对齐的计划描述索引；检索端以BM25词法检索与句嵌入相似度（IndicSBERT、MahaSBERT）按等权分数融合构成混合检索；支持多语言、马拉地语聚焦与翻译中介三种语义配置；在人工策划的双语查询上对BM25、纯稠密与混合检索做对比评估，指标为MRR、准确率与召回率。
AI.result: BM25为强基线，MRR=0.864；混合检索MRR提升至0.872（IndicSBERT）与0.879（MahaSBERT）；纯稠密系统仅0.663与0.655；基于MahaSBERT的融合将精确率从0.781提升至0.808，同时召回率与BM25持平为0.946。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在该语料上词法与语义信号具有互补性，但相对强词法基线的提升幅度有限且依赖具体指标；研究提供了面向应用的双语公共服务信息获取中混合检索的分析视角。

title: Sample-efficient end-to-end Optical Music Recognition through Active Learning
summary: End-to-end approaches to Optical Music Recognition (OMR) have recently shown promising results, but their performance often degrades on unseen data. A common solution is to pretrain and fine-tune models with annotated samples from the target domain, improving adaptation to new distributions. However, this process typically requires extensive manual annotation to yield competitive models, making it costly and time-consuming. In this work, we explore Active Learning to reduce this burden by selecting informative samples for labeling in low-resource scenarios, where the amount of manual annotation that can be performed is limited. We evaluate both uncertainty- and diversity-based sampling strategies on staff-level and full-page corpora. Results show that confidence-based sampling performs comparably to oracle selection (based on true error), and that each scenario benefits from a tailored strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在低资源场景下用主动学习减少光学乐谱识别（OMR）端到端模型的标注负担，并在谱表级与整页语料上比较基于不确定性与基于多样性的采样策略。
AI.motivation: 端到端OMR在未见数据上性能下降，通常需借助目标域标注样本进行预训练与微调以改善域适应，但大量人工标注成本高、耗时长，需在可标注量有限的条件下降低标注开销。
AI.method: 引入主动学习进行样本选择：构建低资源标注设定，对比基于不确定性（置信度）与基于多样性的采样策略，并在谱表级（staff-level）与整页（full-page）两类语料上分别评估。
AI.result: 基于置信度的采样效果与基于真实误差的oracle选择相当；谱表级与整页两种场景各自受益于针对性的采样策略。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习可有效缓解OMR域适应中的标注瓶颈，且采样策略需依场景定制，不存在单一通用最优策略。

title: The Window Lever: Longer Observation Windows Outweigh the Observed Effects of Data, Capacity, and Architecture in Customer Behavior Forecasting
summary: In our experiments on long-horizon customer-behavior forecasting, a longer observation window outweighed the observed effects of more data, more capacity and newer architectures. The window is the weeks of history a model sees before the week it forecasts from. Going from an 8- to a 16-week window adds a raw +0.070 to 0.107 log-space $R^2$ in every family at 1M. Matched test cohorts, which score the same customer-weeks at every window, show this raw comparison understates the gain in every family they cover. The direction holds on five public datasets, four spanning over a year (ridge and our transformer on all five). On our internal data, longer windows admit up to 10% more and colder training customers, which matching does not fix. Our design does not separate window length from calendar coverage, because every test anchor (the week a forecast is made from) falls in one eight-week band. On training-period anchors, the weekly ridge probe's gain persists outside the holiday season, keeping about 72% of it. We therefore report a robust positive association with longer windows and do not identify the magnitude of a calendar-independent history effect. Of four internally registered predictions, the only fully blind one failed. An activity-mixture model predicted +0.014 from 24 to 32 weeks; the weekly-aggregate probe returned -0.0004. For the sequence families, the other three levers are about an order of magnitude smaller, bounded and unresolved. Their observed effects are at most 0.006 between the nominal 1M and 10M tiers and 0.0052 among five sequence families at 16 weeks with clocks as built, both single-seed on the full test split, and 0.006 for capacity on three-seed means. These are observed intervals, not equivalence bounds. Our claim is the order-of-magnitude contrast between the window and those bounds. A team building on this class of data should start by lengthening the window.

AI.tldr: 在长时程客户行为预测中，观测窗口长度（8→16周）带来的增益（对数空间R² +0.070~0.107）远超增加数据量、模型容量或采用更新架构的效应（后者约小一个数量级，≤0.006）。
AI.motivation: 实践中团队常优先投入更多数据、更大模型和新架构，但作者在长时程客户行为预测中发现，模型可见的历史窗口长度可能是被忽视的主导因素，因此系统比较窗口长度与其他三类杠杆的相对重要性。
AI.method: 在1M规模下将观测窗口从8周延长至16周，按家族比较原始R²增益；采用匹配测试队列（同一批客户-周在各窗口下打分）校正构成偏差；在五个公开数据集（其中四个跨度超过一年，ridge与自研transformer）上验证方向一致性；用训练期锚点和每周ridge探针检验非节假日期间增益的持续性；并检验四项内部预注册预测（其中唯一完全盲测的一项失败）。
AI.result: 1M规模下，8→16周窗口在每个家族均带来原始+0.070~0.107的对数空间R²；匹配队列显示原始比较低估了增益。方向在五个公开数据集上成立。内部数据中更长窗口纳入最多10%更多且更冷门（更不活跃）的训练客户，匹配无法消除该效应。窗口长度与日历覆盖在设计上不可分离（所有测试锚点落在同一八周区间）；训练期锚点上ridge探针增益在非节假日仍保留约72%。序列家族中其他三杠杆效应至多0.006（1M与10M档）、0.0052（五个序列家族，16周）、0.006（容量，三种子均值）。预注册的活跃度混合模型预测24→32周增益+0.014，而每周聚合探针实测为-0.0004。
AI.conclusion: 结论是稳健的正相关：更长观测窗口的效应比其他杠杆大一个数量级，但作者未识别出独立于日历的历史效应量级，所报告区间为观测区间而非等价界。建议在此类数据上建模的团队优先延长观测窗口。

title: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
summary: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. (i) A multi-view inpainting transformer jointly edits a set of training views with full cross-view self-attention, so that cross-view correspondence is learned rather than imposed. (ii) A geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet conditions the diffusion editor on the garment image together with depth and surface normals rendered from the current 3DGS state, supplying explicit structure where visual evidence is weakest. (iii) A pose-adaptive persona-aware attention replaces the fixed blending weight between current-view and reference-view features with weights derived from camera-pose proximity. On the 3D-VTONBench benchmark, GS-VTON-MVT improves FID, KID, LPIPS-based cross-view consistency, and user preference over general-purpose 3D editors and prior 3D try-on methods.

AI.tldr: 提出GS-VTON-MVT三阶段框架，将隐式多视图编辑与显式3D几何推理结合，实现一致的三维高斯泼溅虚拟试穿。
AI.motivation: 现有3D虚拟试穿流程对训练视图基本独立编辑，再用人工设计的启发式规则（手工选参考视图、固定注意力融合权重）进行融合，导致跨视图不一致被固化进3D表示，在新视角出现纹理漂移、印花模糊和几何不合理。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(i) 多视图inpainting Transformer通过全跨视图自注意力联合编辑整组训练视图，使跨视图对应关系被学习而非强加；(ii) 几何引导的多模态ControlNet以服装图像加当前3DGS渲染的深度与表面法线作为条件，在视觉证据最弱处提供显式结构；(iii) 姿态自适应的人物感知注意力，用基于相机位姿邻近度导出的权重取代当前视图与参考视图特征间的固定融合权重。
AI.result: 在3D-VTONBench基准上，相较通用3D编辑器与既有3D试穿方法，在FID、KID、基于LPIPS的跨视图一致性及用户偏好上均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 以学习式跨视图对应、显式几何条件与位姿驱动注意力替代手工启发式，可有效缓解3DGS试穿的跨视图不一致问题。

title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
summary: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OracleImitator：在训练阶段利用标签与未观测特征值构造一个闭式"误差影响排序"教师（oracle），再通过软目标模仿将该排序蒸馏为可在部署阶段执行的特征获取策略，从而把AFA从"优化自设效用目标"转为"模仿显式教师"。
AI.motivation: 获取实例的每个特征往往代价高昂（金钱、时延、隐私）。主动特征获取（AFA）通过按实例、在预算约束下学习"获取哪些特征"的策略来缓解该问题。但现有AFA方法训练策略时优化的是自构造的效用目标，缺少显式教师信号，导致目标设计与可学习性难以分离评估。
AI.method: 训练时标签与未观测特征值均可得，二者共同闭式确定一个教师：以"对下游预测器误差的影响"为准则对所有候选特征（组合）排序的oracle。OracleImitator以软目标模仿（soft-target imitation）方式将该排序蒸馏为仅依赖部署可见信息的获取策略。
AI.result: 在多模态医学诊断任务与AFABench基准上，OracleImitator在整个预算区间内与现有AFA方法持平或更优；在不足四分之一获取成本下恢复约90%的可达精度增益。
AI.conclusion: 由于教师是显式算法对象而非隐式优化目标，可直接度量：在部署可见信息约束下，策略能恢复教师排序的多少比例。该框架将AFA的目标构造与策略学习解耦，提供了可解释的性能上界与差距分析工具。

title: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted to the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup (UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge); first place, LUMPI track. Code: https://github.com/dipper13579/urbantwin-sim2real-lidar
summary: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.

AI.tldr: 提出面向路边LiDAR仿真的Sim2Real检测流程：以合成数据训练CenterPoint，通过对齐坐标/点密度/框约定、生成缺失行人与骑行者、重建真实尺寸与点密度对象、非学习式点密度重采样及无标签后处理，在UrbanTwin Sim2Real挑战赛LUMPI赛道获第一（0.5541）、V2X-Real赛道第五（0.8102）。
AI.motivation: 真实标签训练路边LiDAR检测器代价高，数字孪生可替代标签，但孪生与真实站点在传感器、目标类别和标注约定上存在系统性差异，导致直接迁移效果差；作者希望明确哪些修正能真正迁移到测试集。
AI.method: 全部检测器均为仅在合成数据上训练的CenterPoint，单张8GB笔记本GPU完成；主要手段为：对齐孪生坐标、点密度与框标注约定；生成孪生缺失的行人与骑行者，并加入街道杂物作为无标注负样本；按真实尺寸与真实点密度重建孪生目标；采用非学习的逐格点密度重采样（对齐真实无标签帧统计）；再用无标签后处理利用固定路边传感器的先验（静态结构逐帧重复、真实目标点统计特征）。
AI.result: 逐格点密度重采样将LUMPI真实度从0.589提升至0.947（真实帧之间为0.949）；LUMPI赛道第一（0.5541），V2X-Real赛道第五（0.8102）；分组件在验证集与测试集上并排报告，系统性Sim2Real修正通常保留验证增益的1/4至3/4，而针对验证集少量目标拟合的选择无法迁移。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升主要来自弥合孪生与真实站点的系统性差异而非检测器本身；只有纠正系统性Sim2Real差异的修正能迁移到测试集，应避免对验证集小样本过拟合，这为低成本合成数据训练路边LiDAR检测提供了可复用的工程准则。

title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
summary: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. We explore whether synthetic IMU data generated in the representation space of a pretrained biosignal encoder, Bio-PM \cite{b1}, can serve as a practical augmentation source. Rather than synthesizing raw signals, we leverage Bio-PM's frozen encoder to convert 10-second IMU windows into token embedding sequences and train class-conditional decoders in this space: (1) an autoregressive transformer decoder that predicts tokens sequentially, and (2) a diffusion decoder that learns the token distribution through a denoising objective. We analyze generation realism through distributional metrics and embedding-space visualizations, evaluate downstream utility through leave-one-subject-out HAR classification, and present a PatchDecoder for approximate raw waveform reconstruction. Our diffusion decoder achieves a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) macro-F1 of 0.68, demonstrating that generated tokens are realistic enough to train a classifier that transfers to real data. Combining synthetic-token augmentation with a 320-dimensional gravity-aware feature representation raises LOSO macro-F1 from 0.729 to 0.809 over a real-only baseline across 51 subjects on the WISDM benchmark, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the most challenging activity classes. These results demonstrate that high-fidelity generation in a pretrained encoder's representation space is achievable and practically useful for cross-subject HAR augmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索在预训练生物信号编码器Bio-PM的表示空间中生成合成IMU数据，作为跨被试人体活动识别(HAR)的增广来源。
AI.motivation: IMU数据采集与标注成本高，跨被试泛化困难，且动态相似的活动类别难以区分，亟需有针对性的数据增广手段。
AI.method: 利用Bio-PM冻结编码器将10秒IMU窗口转换为token嵌入序列，在该空间训练两类类条件解码器：(1)自回归Transformer解码器逐token预测；(2)基于去噪目标的扩散解码器；并提出PatchDecoder用于近似原始波形重建，结合分布度量与嵌入可视化评估真实性。
AI.result: 扩散解码器取得TSTR宏F1为0.68；在WISDM基准51名被试上，合成token增广结合320维重力感知特征，将LOSO宏F1从0.729提升至0.809，增益集中于最具挑战性的活动类别且统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 在预训练编码器表示空间中进行高保真生成是可行且实用的，可有效支持跨被试HAR数据增广。

title: Streaming-AAA: Streaming AAA Game Video Generation at High Resolution, High Frame Rate, and Low Latency
summary: Controllable streaming video generation offers a promising route toward interactive game simulation, yet existing methods remain far from practical gameplay. They often fail to jointly achieve high visual fidelity, high frame rates, and low interaction latency, resulting in poor responsiveness and degraded user experience. We present Streaming-AAA, a new paradigm for controllable infinite generation of AAA-quality game videos. Our system generates 1080p gameplay videos at 43 FPS with 198 ms end-to-end latency interaction on merely NVIDIA A800 GPUs, while supporting long-horizon play without severe temporal degradation or collapse. Streaming-AAA is built upon three key designs. First, we redesign the VAE architecture for efficient high-resolution decoding, enabling real-time synthesis at 1080p. Second, we pretrain the diffusion model using diffusion forcing and significantly extend the temporal training horizon, allowing the model to capture long-term dependencies and maintain persistent memory. Third, we perform post-training distillation and memory compression to improve inference efficiency while retaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Experiments show that Streaming-AAA substantially improves visual fidelity, frame rate, latency, and long-term stability over prior controllable video generation approaches, enabling a significantly more playable experience for interactive AAA game video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Streaming-AAA：一种可控无限生成 AAA 级游戏视频的新范式，在 A800 GPU 上实现 1080p、43 FPS、端到端交互延迟 198 ms 的实时可玩体验，并支持长时间稳定生成而不出现明显退化或崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有可控流式视频生成方法难以同时兼顾高视觉保真度、高帧率与低交互延迟，导致响应性差、用户体验不佳，距离实际可玩游戏模拟仍有较大差距。
AI.method: 三项关键设计：（1）重新设计 VAE 架构以实现高效高分辨率解码，支持 1080p 实时合成；（2）采用 diffusion forcing 预训练扩散模型，并显著延长时间训练跨度，以捕获长期依赖并维持持久记忆；（3）进行后训练蒸馏与记忆压缩，在保持视觉质量与时间一致性的同时提升推理效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较先前可控视频生成方法，Streaming-AAA 在视觉保真度、帧率、延迟与长期稳定性上均有实质性提升，显著增强了交互式 AAA 游戏视频生成的可玩性。
AI.conclusion: Streaming-AAA 通过 VAE 重构、长时序 diffusion forcing 预训练与蒸馏/记忆压缩的组合设计，实现了高质量、低延迟、长时稳定的可控流式 AAA 游戏视频生成，为交互式游戏模拟提供了可行路径。

title: PaveSplat: Resolution-Robust Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting with Residually Corrected Surface-Aligned Covariances
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://janghunn.github.io/pavesplat/ ; code: https://github.com/janghunn/pavesplat
summary: We present PaveSplat, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting method that adds a learned residual to the analytic surface-aligned covariance, keeping surfels paving the visible surface across rendering resolutions. Pixel-aligned feed-forward Gaussian splatting predicts one primitive per pixel from a few images in a single pass, and its rendering quality depends on how well these primitives cover the surface. Recent surfel-based methods compute the surface-aligned covariance analytically from predicted depth. However, this covariance has no way to correct the surfel orientation where the depth-derived frame is ill-posed. The surfels then cover the surface loosely; at the training resolution each surfel's one-pixel minimum footprint covers the gaps, but they show up as holes when the same prediction is re-rendered at a higher resolution. To address this, we keep the analytic covariance as an initialization, with its axes aligned to the surface tangents, and add an identity-initialized unit-quaternion residual that reorients a surfel only where this improves rendering, turning surfels that the analytic frame mis-aims back onto the surface. On RealEstate10K, PaveSplat achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among single-Gaussian-per-pixel methods at every scale (1x-8x). The native-resolution gain is small; the benefit appears when the same prediction is rendered at higher display resolutions without re-running the network. On zero-shot DL3DV, it leads PSNR within this group at every scale and ranks first or second on SSIM/LPIPS. A coverage-hole analysis shows fewer uncovered pixels than both baselines under high-resolution re-rendering.

AI.tldr: PaveSplat 在基于解析式表面对齐协方差的前馈高斯泼溅方法上，引入恒等初始化的单位四元数残差来修正深度导出坐标系病态处的 surfel 朝向，使同一预测在高分辨率重渲染时仍能铺满可见表面，减少孔洞。
AI.motivation: 像素对齐的前馈高斯泼溅从少量图像单次预测每像素一个图元，渲染质量依赖这些图元对表面的覆盖程度。近期基于 surfel 的方法由预测深度解析计算表面对齐协方差，但该协方差无法在深度导出坐标系病态（ill-posed）处纠正 surfel 的朝向，导致 surfel 松散覆盖表面：在训练分辨率下靠单像素最小足迹掩盖间隙，一旦以更高分辨率重渲染同一预测就出现孔洞。
AI.method: 将解析协方差（轴与表面切向对齐）作为初始化，在其上叠加一个恒等初始化的单位四元数残差，仅当重定向能改善渲染时才重新调整 surfel 朝向，把被解析坐标系瞄偏的 surfel 拉回表面；方法保持前馈、单次前向、每像素一个高斯。
AI.result: RealEstate10K 上，在 1x–8x 各尺度下 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均为单高斯每像素方法中最优；原生分辨率增益较小，收益主要体现在不重跑网络而直接高分辨率重渲染的情形。零样本 DL3DV 上该组内各尺度 PSNR 领先，SSIM/LPIPS 排名第一或第二。覆盖孔洞分析显示高分辨率重渲染下未覆盖像素数少于两个基线。
AI.conclusion: 解析表面对齐协方差仅宜作初始化，学习式的少量朝向残差即可显著提升跨分辨率重渲染的表面覆盖一致性与质量。

title: Less Than Meets the Eye: Action-Set Identifiability and Principled Abstention for 3D Physical Geometry
summary: A corridor, its mirror reflection, and its image on a display can look identical, yet their physical surfaces lie at different depths. We test whether bounded camera motions distinguish these explanations. Intervene3D takes an image and an initial geometry estimate, predicts the view under each hypothesis and candidate motion, and selects a motion by maximin separability. It reports the mechanism and first physical surface only if the available motions separate the hypotheses still in contention. Otherwise it abstains. An adequacy test also rejects observations that no hypothesis explains. On a matched synthetic benchmark with exact landmarks, disabling abstention gives confident answers on 76.4% of unresolvable scenes. With abstention, none receives a confident answer under exact or noisy landmarks. At 100% accuracy on answered scenes, maximin selection answers 61.0% of scenes and summed selection 43.1%. The adequacy test lowers wrong answers on strongly curved mirror scenes from 56.8% to 12.4%. Real display experiments compare two hypotheses using one frozen depth-network estimate. The second image supplies photometric evidence and is never passed through the depth network. One executed motion reduces the pooled median surface error of twelve networks by 31.5%. These networks have larger error inside the annotated panel than outside on 33.4% of illusion-benchmark images. They place the first physical surface behind the glass on 36.9% of Mirror3D frames.

AI.tldr: 提出Intervene3D：给定图像与初始几何估计，对"走廊本体/镜面反射/屏幕显示"三种假设在各候选相机运动下预测视图，以最大化最坏情况可分性（maximin）选择动作；仅当动作能分离剩余竞争假设时才报告机制与首个物理表面，否则弃权；并设充分性检验拒斥无假设可解释的观测。
AI.motivation: 走廊、其镜面反射与其在显示器上的图像可视觉上完全一致，但物理表面深度不同，单帧图像存在根本性的解释歧义。作者希望检验有界相机运动能否区分这些竞争解释，并避免在不可分辨情形下给出高置信错误答案。
AI.method: 1) 输入图像与初始几何估计，对每个假设×候选运动预测视图；2) 用maximin可分性准则选取动作（对照summed选择）；3) 主动弃权机制：若可用运动无法分离仍在竞争的假设则不回答；4) 充分性检验剔除任何假设都无法解释的观测；5) 合成匹配基准含精确地标，另做真实显示实验：两个假设共享一个冻结深度网络估计，第二张图仅提供光度证据、不经过深度网络；并在十二个网络上评估表面误差与错觉基准。
AI.result: 关闭弃权时，76.4%的不可分辨场景仍给出高置信答案；开启弃权后，在精确与含噪地标下均无场景被高置信回答。在已答场景100%准确的前提下，maximin选择覆盖61.0%场景，summed选择覆盖43.1%。充分性检验将强曲率镜面场景的错误答案从56.8%降至12.4%。真实显示实验中，一次执行动作使十二个网络的合并中位表面误差降低31.5%。这些网络在33.4%的错觉基准图像上标注面板内部误差大于外部，并在36.9%的Mirror3D帧中将首个物理表面置于玻璃之后。
AI.conclusion: 有界相机运动结合主动弃权与充分性检验可显著缓解单目深度/几何中的机制与表面归属歧义；maximin动作选择在同等精度下覆盖更多可解场景，且能有效抑制不可分辨情形下的过度自信，并揭示现有深度网络在镜面/显示错觉上的系统性失败。

title: One-to-Many: Diverse and Bidirectional Image-to-Image Translation via Rectified Flow
comment: 12 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Many paired image-to-image translation tasks admit multiple valid target appearances, while training provides only one target per source. We propose One-to-Many Flow (O2MFlow), a latent-conditioned Rectified Flow (RF) model for one-to-many generation and backward translation (target$\rightarrow$source) within a single transport framework. Conditioning the RF dynamics on an appearance latent turns transport into a family of latent-indexed bijections: a fixed latent gives a mapping that is inverted by time-reversed integration, and sampled latents produce diverse outputs for the same input. We formalize reusable appearance variations as Shared Latent Transport and show that Kullback--Leibler (KL) regularization directly controls the source--latent distribution gap between training and generation. Across three benchmarks, O2MFlow offers dataset-dependent forward diversity--fidelity trade-offs and the lowest backward LPIPS-Dist among evaluated methods, with the lowest backward FID on two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: O2MFlow：以隐变量为条件的整流流模型，在单一传输框架内同时实现一对多生成与反向翻译。
AI.motivation: 配对图像翻译中，同一源图像往往存在多种合理的目标外观，但训练数据只提供一个目标。现有方法难以在保持可逆性的同时建模这种一对多映射。
AI.method: 提出隐变量条件的Rectified Flow（RF），以外观隐变量调制RF动力学，使传输变为一族以隐变量索引的双射：固定隐变量时可由时间反转积分求逆，采样隐变量则产生多样输出。将可复用的外观变化形式化为Shared Latent Transport，并用KL正则控制训练与生成之间的源—隐变量分布差距。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，O2MFlow呈现依赖数据集的正向多样性—保真度权衡；反向LPIPS-Dist在所评估方法中最低，其中两个基准上反向FID最低。
AI.conclusion: 隐变量条件RF可在统一框架内兼顾一对多正向生成与高质量反向翻译，KL正则是控制分布差距的关键。

title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
summary: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.

AI.tldr: 针对合成图像标定的保形位姿估计在真实图像上失效且存在"静默失败"的问题，提出用图像翻译后的合成图像进行标定，无需真实标注数据即可恢复覆盖率并大幅降低静默失败率。
AI.motivation: 自主交会与近距操作需要可靠的位姿不确定性指示，保形预测（conformal prediction）可给出带形式化保证的位姿不确定集。但其覆盖率保证依赖标定与测试数据同分布，而轨道感知中标注数据仅来自合成渲染、运行图像为真实图像，导致域偏移下保证失效。
AI.method: 在SPEED+数据集上验证合成标定的保形位姿估计在真实图像上的覆盖率崩塌与静默失败现象；随后采用两种图像翻译模型将合成图像转换到真实图像外观（几何不变、仅改变外观），使合成位姿标签依然有效，从而在翻译后的合成图像上完成标定，全程不需要真实标注图像。
AI.result: 在miscoverage水平0.1及以上时，翻译后标定可将覆盖率恢复到指定水平以上；静默失败比例从最高43.5%降至不超过3.3%的测试图像。
AI.conclusion: 利用保持几何的图像翻译实现跨域标定，是一种无需真实标注即可修复保形预测覆盖率保证的实用方案，推动保形位姿估计在空间任务中的可信部署。

title: DfD-GS: Defocus Image Prior for Metric-Scale Single-View Depth Estimation and View Synthesis
summary: Recovering metric-scale geometry from observations at a single viewpoint remains fundamentally ill-posed, limiting the reliability of novel view synthesis. Recent methods rely on learned monocular depth priors, which provide strong structural estimates but can suffer from scale ambiguity and dataset-dependent biases. We propose DfD-GS, a feed-forward framework that predicts a metric-scale 3D Gaussian scene representation from a single-view all-in-focus--defocused image pair. The key idea is to exploit defocus blur as a physical metric depth cue. DfD-GS first estimates a defocus-based metric disparity map from the all-in-focus--defocused image pair and the corresponding defocus strength. This estimate is used to align and refine a monocular depth prior to metric scale. Visible and hidden 3D Gaussians are then predicted for occlusion-aware novel view synthesis. Experiments on synthetic-defocus datasets constructed from Booster and Middlebury show that DfD-GS outperforms single-image baselines in metric depth estimation and novel view synthesis. On WildRGB-D, DfD-GS achieves lower AbsRel and LPIPS but higher depth RMSE than the single-image baselines. Additional analyses show that DfD-GS maintains a more stable metric scale under field-of-view changes. Qualitative results on a real dataset show recovery of the main scene structure under optical defocus.

AI.tldr: DfD-GS 提出一种前馈框架，仅用单视角的"全聚焦—离焦"图像对，借助离焦模糊作为物理度量深度线索，预测度量尺度的3D高斯场景表示，实现遮挡感知的新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 单视角恢复度量尺度几何本质上是病态问题，限制新视角合成的可靠性。现有方法依赖学习到的单目深度先验，虽有较强结构估计但存在尺度模糊与数据集相关偏差。
AI.method: 以全聚焦—离焦图像对及对应离焦强度估计基于离焦的度量视差图；用该估计将单目深度先验对齐并精化到度量尺度；再预测可见与隐藏3D高斯，用于遮挡感知的新视角合成。
AI.result: 在由 Booster 与 Middlebury 构建的合成离焦数据集上，DfD-GS 在度量深度估计和新视角合成上优于单图基线；在 WildRGB-D 上 AbsRel 与 LPIPS 更低，但深度 RMSE 更高。额外分析表明其在视场变化下度量尺度更稳定；真实数据集上的定性结果显示在光学离焦条件下能恢复主要场景结构。
AI.conclusion: 利用离焦模糊作为物理度量线索，可有效消除单目先验的尺度模糊，获得稳定的度量尺度3D高斯表示；但深度绝对误差在某些真实数据上仍有提升空间。

title: Frequency-Synchronized Boundary Coupling for Training-Free Multi-Prompt Long Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video generation has made remarkable progress with diffusion models and transformer-based video architectures, yet generating coherent long videos from evolving textual descriptions remains challenging. Training long-video models from scratch requires substantial computation and large-scale multi-event data, while training-free multi-prompt generation must activate new prompt semantics without breaking temporal continuity. We identify a frequency-agnostic boundary coupling problem in existing transition strategies: weak coupling causes abrupt changes, flicker, and background jumps, whereas overly strong or coarse coupling may over-preserve source semantics and produce ghosting or duplicated subjects around prompt boundaries. To address this problem, we propose FreqSync, a training-free framework that formulates prompt transitions as frequency-selective boundary coupling. FreqSync combines Frequency-Synchronized Source-Conditioned Attention (FS-SCA) with Residual-Clipped Spectral Stitching (RCSS), enabling adjacent segments to share stable low- and mid-frequency structure and motion cues while keeping high-frequency prompt-specific details target-dominant under explicit residual constraints. Extensive experiments show that FreqSync achieves state-of-the-art transition smoothness and prompt alignment while maintaining strong perceptual video quality, demonstrating its effectiveness for coherent multi-prompt long video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 FreqSync，将多提示词长视频生成的提示切换建模为频率选择性边界耦合，通过 FS-SCA 与 RCSS 在共享低频结构/运动的同时保持高频细节以新提示为主导，实现平滑转场与提示对齐的 SOTA 表现。
AI.motivation: 从零训练长视频模型需大量算力与大规模多事件数据；免训练多提示词生成需在激活新提示语义的同时保持时间连续性。现有转场策略存在"频率无关的边界耦合"问题：耦合过弱导致突变、闪烁与背景跳变，耦合过强或过粗则过度保留源语义，在提示边界处产生重影或主体重复。
AI.method: 免训练框架 FreqSync：1) Frequency-Synchronized Source-Conditioned Attention（FS-SCA，频率同步的源条件注意力）；2) Residual-Clipped Spectral Stitching（RCSS，残差裁剪的频谱拼接）。二者使相邻片段共享稳定的低、中频结构与运动线索，并在显式残差约束下让高频提示特定细节由目标片段主导。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FreqSync 在转场平滑度与提示对齐上达到 SOTA，同时保持较强的感知视频质量。
AI.conclusion: 频率选择性的边界耦合是解决多提示词长视频转场矛盾的有效途径，FreqSync 免训练即可实现连贯的多提示词长视频生成。

title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
summary: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing. Specifically, HiUni reuses the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both capabilities, while confining task-specific computation to the output side. Yet such a design introduces two key challenges. Generation in pixel space is difficult to optimize, and semantic abstraction in pretrained ViT discards fine spatial details required for synthesis. To address these challenges, HiUni introduces a \emph{Pixel Diffusion Head} tailored to direct pixel-space optimization and a lightweight \emph{HiGate} pathway that provides fine-grained spatial details near the output stage. Extensive experiments show that HiUni achieves a similar average understanding score to the pretrained VLM while attaining competitive performance on image generation and editing. Controlled comparisons and analyses further demonstrate that a single dense backbone can effectively support both capabilities without task-specific backbone computation, highlighting a simpler path toward unified multimodal modeling.

AI.tldr: HiUni 提出一种高参数共享的统一多模态方案：复用同一个语言对齐 ViT 与稠密 Transformer 主干同时承担视觉理解与生成，仅在输出端保留任务特定计算，并通过 Pixel Diffusion Head 与轻量 HiGate 分别解决像素空间优化困难与 ViT 细粒度空间信息丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型通常为满足理解与生成两类任务的不同需求，而在视觉表征或主干计算上做分离设计（如独立编码器、独立骨干），限制了统一程度。作者希望验证：预训练 VLM 能否直接扩展为高参数共享的统一模型。
AI.method: HiUni 将任务特定计算限制在输出侧，理解与生成共享同一语言对齐 ViT 和稠密 Transformer 骨干。针对两大挑战提出两项设计：(1) Pixel Diffusion Head，面向直接像素空间优化，缓解像素空间生成难以优化的问题；(2) 轻量 HiGate 通路，在输出阶段附近注入细粒度空间细节，弥补预训练 ViT 语义抽象导致的空间信息损失。
AI.result: 实验显示 HiUni 的平均理解得分与预训练 VLM 相近，同时在图像生成与编辑任务上取得有竞争力的性能；受控对比与分析进一步表明，单一稠密骨干无需任务特定主干计算即可有效支撑两类能力。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态建模不必依赖分离的骨干计算，高参数共享的单一稠密骨干即可同时支持理解与生成，为更简洁的统一多模态路径提供了实证支持。

title: Learning Reconstruction Errors as Spatiotemporal Evidence for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: The proliferation of AI-generated videos has raised growing concerns about misinformation, fraud, and potential societal risks, creating an urgent need for detection. Reconstruction-error-based methods have shown strong empirical performance for AI-generated image detection by exploiting discrepancies between an input and its reconstructed version. Their extension to video detection, however, faces two challenges: (i) a fixed reconstructor is not optimized for the detection objective and may yield weak discriminative signals; and (ii) an additional raw-video feature stream is often introduced to model temporal dependencies, increasing architectural overhead. To address these challenges, we develop a detector that learns and exploits reconstruction errors as a unified source of spatiotemporal evidence. First, we jointly optimize a reconstructor and the downstream classifier to produce reconstruction errors that are more informative for detecting AI-generated videos. Second, we show that consecutive reconstruction errors alone carry temporal evidence, and thus a 3D convolution over them captures spatiotemporal evidence without a raw-video stream. Extensive experiments on over 30 existing AI-video generators demonstrate competitive performance against baselines.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于重建误差的AI生成视频检测器：通过联合优化重建器与分类器获得更具判别性的重建误差，并仅对连续重建误差施加3D卷积以捕获时空证据，无需额外的原始视频特征流。
